en.title: THE TWELVE APOSTLES CHURCH IN AFRICA
en.message:
Beloved in the Lord,

The time has come again for us to work together to praise the Lord with one voice, because of His blessings in the past year. I thank you all, my brethren, for abiding by God's messages and acting according to His word.

Remember that God always holds us and our children. Is that not something to be thankful for? It is. Giving thanks and praising God is not just about attending service and breaking bread out of habit, but it is connected with a continuous inner remembrance.

BREAK BREAD EVEN WHEN YOU ARE ALONE WHERE YOU ARE. ESPECIALLY WHEN YOU HAVE NOTHING TO DO AT THAT TIME, SO THAT THE EVIL ONE DOES NOT FIND YOU IDLE AND GIVE YOU HIS WORK.

He will keep us always so that many may be saved through us. May God's will increase in the coming year.

I am,
Yours in the Lord,
J. S. Ndlovu.
Apostle.

st.title: KEREKE EA BAAPOSTOLA BA LESHOMA LE METSO E 'MELI AFRIKA
st.message:
Baratuoa Moreneng,

Nako e fihlile hape ea hore re sebetse 'moho ho rorisa Morena ka lentsoe le le leng, ka lebaka la litlhohonolofatso tsa hae selemong se fetileng. Kea le leboha bohle, bana beso, ka ho lula melaetseng ea Molimo le ho etsa ho ea kamoo lentsoe la hae le le laelang kateng.

Hopolang hore Molimo o lula a re tšoere hammoho le bana ba rona. Na eo hase ntho e lokelang ho lebohuoa? Ke eona. Ho leboha le ho rorisa Molimo hase feela ho ea tšebeletsong le ho arolelana bohobe ka tloaelo, empa ho amana le khopolo e tsoelang pele e ka hare ho motho.

AROLELANANG BOHOBE LEHA LE LE BANG MOO LE LENG TENG. HAHOLO-HOLO HA LE SE NA SEO LE SE ETSANG KA NAKO EO, E LE HORE E MOBE A SE KE A LE FUMANA LE SA ETSE LETHO A LE FA MOSEBETSI OA HAE.

O tla re boloka kamehla hore ba bangata ba pholosoe ka rona. Thato ea Molimo e ke e ate selemong se tlang.

Ke 'na,
Ea lona Moreneng,
J. S. Ndlovu.
Moapostola.

ts.title: KEREKE YA VAPOSTOLA VA KHUME-MBIRHI E-AFRIKA
ts.message:
Varhandziwa eka Hosi,

Nkarhi wu fike nakambe leswaku hi tirhisana ku dzunisa Hosi hi rito rin'we, hikwalaho ka mikateko ya yona eka lembe leri nga hundza. Ndza mi nkhensa hinkwenu vamakwerhu hi ku tshama eka marungula ya Xikwembu, na ku endla hi ndlela leyi rito ra xona ri mi lerisaka ha yona.

Tsundzukani leswaku Xikwembu xi tshama xi hi khomile swin'we na vana va hina. Xana sweswo a hi swa ku nkhensiwa? I swona. Ku nkhensa na ku dzunisa Xikwembu a hi ku ya ekerekeni ntsena na ku avelana vuswa hi ntolovelo, kambe swi fambisana na ku tsundzuka ka le ndzeni nkarhi hinkwawo.

AVELANANI VUSWA HAMBILOKO MI RI NOXE LAHA MI NGA KONA. NGOPFU-NGOPFU LOKO MI NGA RIKI NA XA KU XI ENDLA HI NKARHI WOLOWO, LESWAKU LOWO BIHA A NGA MI KUMI MI NGA ENDLI NCHUMU A MI NYIKA NTIRHO WA YENA.

Xi ta hi hlayisa nkarhi hinkwawo leswaku vo tala va ponisiwa ha hina. Ku rhandza ka Xikwembu a ku andze eka lembe leri taka.

Hi mina,
Wa n'wina eka Hosi,
J. S. Ndlovu.
Mupostola.

xh.title: ICAWE YABAPOSTILE ABALISHUMI ELINESIBINI E-AFRIKA
xh.message:
Bathandekayo eNkosini,

Kuphinde kwafika ixesha lokuba sibambisane ukudumisa iNkosi ngazwi linye, ngenxa yeentsikelelo zayo kunyaka ophelileyo. Ndiyanibulela nonke bazalwana bam ngokuhlala kwimilayezo kaThixo, nangokwenza ngendlela ilizwi lakhe elinilayela ngayo.

Khumbulani ukuba uThixo usoloko esibambile kunye nabantwana bethu. Asiyonto yokubulelwa na leyo? Yiyo. Ukubulela nokudumisa uThixo asikokuya enkonzweni nje kuphela nokuqhekeza isonka ngokwesiqhelo, kodwa kuxhumene nenkumbulo eqhubekayo ngaphakathi emntwini.

QHEKEZA ISONKA NOBA UWEDWA APHO UKHO KHO. INGKAKUMBI XA KUNGEKHO NTO UYENZAYO NGALOO XESHA, UKUZE OMBI ANGAFUMANI UNGENANTO UYENZAYO AZE AKUNike UMSEBENZI WAKHE.

Uya kusigcina njalo ukuze kusindiswe abaninzi ngathi. Mayande intando kaThixo kunyaka ozayo.

Ndim,
Owakho eNkosini,
J. S. Ndlovu.
UMpostile.

zu.title: THE TWELVE APOSTLES CHURCH IN AFRICA
zu.message:
Bathandwa eNkosini,

Bekuphinde kwafika isikhathi futhi lapha sifanele sibambisane ukudumisa iNkosi ngazwi linye, ngenxa. yezibusiso zayo kunyaka ophelayo. Ngiyanibonga nonke futhi bakwethu ngokuhlala kwenu emilayezweni ka Thixo, nangokwenza nge ndlela ilizwi lakhe elinilayeza ngakhona.

Khumbulani uNkulunkulu uloku esisingethe njalo kanye nabantwa. bethu. Akuyiko yini okokubongwa loko na? Yiko. Ukubonga nokudumisa uNkulunkulu ke akuyiko ukuya enkonzweni nje kuphela nokuhlephula isinkwa ngokwesighelo, kodwa.. kuhlangene ne nrumbulo njalo njalo ngaphakathi komuntu.

HLEPHULA ISINKNA NOMA UWEDWA LAPHO UKHONΝΑ. IKAKHULU UMA KUNGEKHO LUTHO OLWENZAYO NGALESO SIKHATI, UKUZE OMUBI ANGAKUFUMANI UDINGA. AZE AKWABELE OWAKHE UNSEBENZI.

Uyosigcina njalo kuze kusinde nabaningi ngerxa yethu. Mayande oka Thixo intande kunyaka ongenayo.

Yinina,
Owenu eNkosini,
J. S. Ndlovu.
U Mpostoli.

nso.title: KEREKE YA BAAPOSTOLA BA LESOMEPEDI MO AFRIKA
nso.message:
Barategi go Morena,

Nako e fihlile gape ya gore re šome mmogo go tumiša Morena ka lentšu le tee, ka baka la ditšhegofatšo tša gagwe ngwageng o fetilego. Ke a le leboga ka moka, bana bešo, ka go dula melaetšeng ya Modimo le go dira go ya ka moo lentšu la gagwe le le laelago ka gona.

Gopolang gore Modimo o dula a re swere mmogo le bana ba rena. Na yeo ga se taba ya go lebogwa? Ke yona. Go leboga le go tumiša Modimo ga se fela go ya kerekeng le go arolelana senkgwa ka tlwaelo, eupša go tswalana le kgopolo ya ka gare ka mehla.

AROLELANA SENKGWA LE GE O LE NNOŠI MO O LEGO GONA. GUDU GE O SE NA SEO O SE DIRAGO KA NAKO YEO, GORE YO MOBE A SE KE A GO HWETŠA O SA DIRE SELO A GO NEE MOŠOMO WA GAGWE.

O tla re boloka ka mehla gore ba bantši ba phološwe ka rena. Thato ya Modimo a e ate ngwageng o tlang.

Ke nna,
Wa lena go Morena,
J. S. Ndlovu.
Moapostola.

en.title: TO ALL CONGREGATIONS IN AFRICA (11 DEC 1977)
en.message:
Beloved in Christ,

I wish to thank you again along with all the congregations, standing with you as in the past year. We moved forward all together, united, with no one acting on their own and disobeying.

You are witnesses yourselves that the one who acts on their own is harmed by what they do to themselves, but the one who does as instructed is well up to this day.

Our church is now at a very high standard because of the good works among you. It is my wish that you grow with the church with no one doing things differently from others, because by doing so you will be destroying.

The grace of the Father be with you always.

I am,
Yours in the Lord,
J. S. Ndlovu.
Apostle.

st.title: HO DIPHUTHEHO TSOHLE AFRIKA (11 TSIT 1977)
st.message:
Baratuoa ho Kreste,

Ke lakatsa ho le leboha hape hammoho le liphutheho tsohle, ke eme le lona joalo ka selemong se fetileng. Re tsoetse pele kaofela re kopane, ho se na ea iketsetsang kapa ea sa mameleng.

Le lipaki lona ka bolona hore ea iketsetsang o utloisoa bohloko ke seo a iketsetsang sona, empa ea etsang kamoo a laetsoeng a ntse a phela hantle ho fihlela kajeno.

Kereke ea rona joale e boemong bo phahameng haholo ka lebaka la mesebetsi e metle har'a lona. Ke takatso ea ka hore le hole le kereke ho se na ea etsang lintho ka tsela e fapaneng le ba bang, hobane ka ho etsa joalo o tla be a senya.

Mohau oa Ntate o be le lona kamehla.

Ke 'na,
Ea lona Moreneng,
J. S. Ndlovu.
Moapostola.

ts.title: EKA MAVANDLHA HINKWAWO E-AFRIKA (11 DEC 1977)
ts.message:
Varhandziwa eka Kreste,

Ndzi navela ku mi nkhensa nakambe swin'we na mavandlha hinkwawo, ndzi yima na n'wina tanihi lembe leri hundzeke. Hi ye emahlweni hinkwerhu swin'we, hi ri un'we, ku nga ri na loyi a tiendlelaka na loyi a nga yingisiki.

Mi timbhoni n'wina hi n'wexe leswaku loyi a tiendlelaka u vavisiwa hi leswi a tiendlelaka swona, kambe loyi a endlaka hilaha a lerisiweke hakona u hanyile ku fika namuntlha.

Kereke ya hina sweswi yi le ka xiyimo xa le henhla swinene hikwalaho ka mintirho leyinene exikarhi ka n'wina. I ku navela ka mina leswaku mi kula na kereke ku nga ri na loyi a endlaka swilo ku hambana na van'wana, hikuva hi ku endla tano u ta va u onha.

Tintswalo ta Tatana a ti ve na n'wina nkarhi hinkwawo.

Hi mina,
Wa n'wina eka Hosi,
J. S. Ndlovu.
Mupostola.

xh.title: KUWO ONKE AMABANDLA E-AFRIKA (11 DEC 1977)
xh.message:
Bathandekayo kuKristu,

Ndinqwenela ukuphinda ndinibulele kunye namabandla onke, ndimi nani njengakunyaka ophelileyo. Besiqhubela phambili sonke kunye, simanyene, kungekho ozenzelayo nongathobeliyo.

Ningamangqina nina ngokwenu ukuba lowo uzenzelayo wenzakaliswa koko azenzela kona, kodwa owenza ngendlela alalelwa ngayo uphilile ukuza kuthi ga namhlanje.

Icawe yethu ngoku ikwinqanaba eliphezulu kakhulu ngenxa yemisebenzi emihle phakathi kwenu. Kungumnqweno wam ukuba nikhule necawe kungekho owenza ngokwahlukileyo kwabanye, kuba ngokwenza njalo uya kuba uyachitha.

Ubabalo loBawo malube nani njalo.

Ndim,
Owakho eNkosini,
J. S. Ndlovu.
UMpostile.

zu.title: KUWO WONKE AMABANDLA E AFRICA (11 DEC 1977)
zu.message:
Bathandwa ku Kristu,

Ngifisa ukuphinda futhi nginibonge kanye namabandla onke, njokuma kanye nani eninyakeni eyedlule. Besitotoba sonke kanye kanye sibambene kungekho ozenzelayo nongalaleli.

Ningofakazi nina ngokwenu ngokuthi ozenzelayo ulinyazwa yiko loko azenzela kona yena ngokwakhe kodwa owenza ngendlela alayelwa ngayo uphilile kufinyelela kuleli langa.

Inkonzo yethu se isezingeni eliphakene Kakhulu nanje ngenxa yemisebenzi emihle phakathi kwenu. Kuyisifiso sami ukuba nikhule nayo inkonzo kungabikho owenza okwehlukene nabanye, ngoba ngokwenzenjalo uyobe uyadiliza.

U musa ka Baba ube nani njalo njalo.

Yimina,
Owenu o Nkosini,
J. S. Ndlovu.
U Mpostoli.

nso.title: GO DIPHUTHEGO KA MOKA MO AFRIKA (11 DES 1977)
nso.message:
Barategi go Kriste,

Ke duma go le leboga gape mmogo le diphuthego ka moka, ke eme le lena bjalo ka ngwageng o fetilego. Re tšwetše pele mmogo, re le tee, go se na yo a itirelago le yo a sa kwego.

Le dihlatse lena ka bolena gore yo a itirelago o gobatšwa ke se a itirelago sona, eupša yo a dirago ka moo a laetšwego o phetše gabotse go fihla lehono.

Kereke ya rena ga bjale e maemong a godimo kudu ka baka la mediro e mebotse gare ga lena. Ke kganyogo ya ka gore le gole le kereke go se na yo a dirago dilo ka go fapana le ba bangwe, gobane ka go dira bjalo o tla be o senya.

Mogau wa Tate o be le lena ka mehla.

Ke nna,
Wa lena go Morena,
J. S. Ndlovu.
Moapostola.

en.title: TO ALL CONGREGATIONS OF THE APOSTOLIC CHURCH
en.message:
Beloved in Christ,

You will remember that last year I wrote to you because of the critical situation due to the turmoil that had attacked God's nation. My writing to you was because I wish you good health and blessings. Therefore, it was necessary for me to protect you from those who were confusing your minds.

Beloved, as I have said above, let me say thank you to all of you who accepted me as your servant and worker in Christ Jesus. It is my prayer that I work with you in a commendable way for all of you and for God the creator. But all that can happen because we are united with you as you have already shown your integrity. Beloved, as the past year ended, it brought us pain and many challenges, but nevertheless we held on to the creator. We must never forget the teachings we were given by father Apostle. Furthermore, beloved, I ask you all to be with our father wherever he is with your hearts and prayers.

Beloved, I could not truly forgive myself if I did not thank you for the great work you have done to protect and stand with your servants. I pray to God our creator to make me be among you for the work I have been sent to do for you very soon. God the father will reveal to us what this year holds for us. May He bless you all.

I am your servant,
In the House of Christ,
D. PAKATHI: Apostle

st.title: HO DIPHUTHEHO TSOHLE TSA KEREKE EA BAAPOSTOLA
st.message:
Baratuoa ho Kreste,

Le tla hopola hore selemong se fetileng ke ile ka le ngolla ka lebaka la boemo bo thata ba moferefere o neng o hlasetse sechaba sa Molimo. Ho le ngolla ha ka e ne e le hobane ke le lakaletsa bophelo bo botle le litlhohonolofatso. Ka hona, ho ne ho hlokahala hore ke le sireletse ho bao ba neng ba ferekanya menahano ea lona.

Baratuoa, joalokaha ke boletse ka holimo, e re ke re kea leboha ho lona bohle ba nkamohetseng joaloka mohlanka le mosebeletsi oa lona ho Kreste Jesu. Ke thapelo ea ka hore ke sebetse le lona ka tsela e babatsehang ho lona bohle le ho Molimo 'mopi. Empa tseo tsohle li ka etsahala hobane re kopane le lona joalokaha le se le bontšitse bots'epehi ba lona. Baratuoa, selemo se fetileng ha se fela se ile sa re tlisetsa bohloko le liqholotso tse ngata empa leha ho le joalo re ile ra tšoarella ho 'mopi. Ha rea lokela le ka mohla ho lebala lithuto tseo re li filoeng ke ntate Moapostola. Hape baratuoa, ke kopa lona bohle hore re be le ntate oa rona moo a leng teng ka lipelo le ka lithapelo tsa rona.

Baratuoa, nka be ke sa intšoarele e le kannete haeba ke ne nka se le lebohe ka mosebetsi o moholo oo le o entseng oa ho sireletsa le ho ema le bahlanka ba lona. Ke rapela Molimo 'mopi oa rona hore a nketseng hore ke be har'a lona bakeng sa mosebetsi oo ke o rometsoeng ho lona haufinyane. Molimo ntate o tla re tšenolela hore na selemo sena se re tšoaretse eng. A le hlohonolofatse kaofela.

Ke 'na mohlanka oa lona,
Ntlong ea Kreste,
D. PAKATHI: Moapostola

ts.title: EKA MAVANDLHA HINKWAWO YA KEREKE YA VAPOSTOLA
ts.message:
Varhandziwa eka Kreste,

Mi ta tsundzuka leswaku eka lembe leri hundzeke ndzi mi tsalele hikwalaho ka xiyimo xo tika xa hasahasa leyi a yi hlasele tiko ra Xikwembu. Ku mi tsalela ka mina a ku ri hikwalaho ka leswi ndzi mi navelelaka rihanyo lerinene na mikateko. Hikokwalaho a swi fanerile leswaku ndzi mi sirhelela eka lava a va pfilunganya mianakanyo ya n'wina.

Varhandziwa hilaha ndzi vuleke hakona laha henhla, a ndzi vule ndzi nkhensa eka n'wina hinkwenu lava mi ndzi amukeleke tanihi nandza na mutirhi wa n'wina eka Kreste Yesu. I xikhongelo xa mina leswaku ndzi tirhisana na n'wina hi ndlela yo rhandzeka eka n'wina hinkwenu na le ka Xikwembu muvumbi. Kambe sweswo hinkwaswo swi nga endleka hikuva hi hlangene na n'wina hilaha mi kombiseke vutshembeki bya n'wina hakona. Varhandziwa, lembe leri hundzeke loko ri hela ri hi tisele ku vava na mintlhontlho yo tala kambe nambitanu hi khomelele eka muvumbi. A hi fanelanga hi rivala tidyondzo leti hi ti nyikiweke hi tatana Mupostola. Nakambe varhandziwa, ndza mi kombela hinkwenu leswaku hi va na tatana wa hina laha a nga kona hi timbilu na swikhongelo swa hina.

Varhandziwa a ndzi nge tirivaleli hakunene loko ndzi nga mi nkhensanga hi ntirho wa n'wina lowukulu lowu mi wu endleke wo sirhelela na ku yima na malandza ya n'wina. Ndzi khongela eka Xikwembu muvumbi wa hina leswaku xi ndzi endla ndzi va exikarhi ka n'wina hi ntirho lowu ndzi rhumiweke wona eka n'wina ku nga ri khale. Xikwembu tatana xi ta hi paluxela leswaku lembe leri ri hi khomele yini. A xi mi katekise hinkwenu.

Hi mina nandza wa n'wina,
Endlwini ya Kreste,
D. PAKATHI: Mupostola

xh.title: KUWO ONKE AMABANDLA ECAWE YABAPOSTILE
xh.message:
Bathandekayo kuKristu,

Niza kukhumbula ukuba kunyaka ophelileyo ndanibhalela ngenxa yemeko emaxongo ngenxa yesiphithiphithi esasihlasele isizwe sikaThixo. Ukunibhalela kwam kwakungenxa yokuba ndininqwenelela impilo entle neentsikelelo. Ngoko ke kwakuyimfuneko ukuba ndinikhusele kwabo babebhida iingqondo zenu.

Bathandekayo njengoko senditshilo ngasentla, mandithi ndiyabulela kuni nonke enandamkelayo njengesicaka nomsebenzi wenu kuKristu Yesu. Kungumthandazo wam ukuba ndisebenzisane nani ngendlela encomekayo kuni nonke nakuThixo umdali. Kodwa konke oko kungenzeka kuba simanyene nani njengoko senibubonisile ubuqotho benu. Bathandekayo, unyaka ophelileyo uthe xa uphela wasizisela iintlungu nemingeni emininzi kodwa nangona kunjalo sabambelela kumdali. Asifanele konke konke ukulibala iimfundiso esazinikwa ngutata uMpostile. Kananjalo bathandekayo ndiyanicela nonke ukuba sibe kunye notata wethu apho akhona ngeentliziyo nemithandazo yethu.

Bathandekayo andinokuxola ngokwenene ukuba andinibulelanga ngomsebenzi wenu omkhulu eniwenzileyo wokukhusela nokuma nezicaka zenu. Ndithandaza kuThixo umdali wethu ukuba andenze ndibe phakathi kwenu ngomsebenzi endiwuthunyiweyo kuni kungekudala. UThixo utata uya kusityhilela ukuba lo nyaka usiphathele ntoni na. Manisikelele nonke.

Ndim isicaka senu,
ENdlwini kaKristu,
D. PAKATHI: uMpostile

zu.title: KUWO WONKE AMABANDLA ENKONZO YABAPOSTOLI
zu.message:
Bathandwa kukrestu,

Nizokhumbula ukuthi ngonyaka odlule nginibhalele ngenxa yesima esasibucayi ngenxa yenxushunxushu eyayihlasele isizwe sikaTixo. Ukunilobela kwami kwakungenxa yokuba nginifisela impilo enhle nezibusiso. Ngakhoke kwakudingekile ukuba nginivikele kulabo ababenidida izingqonda zenu.

Bathandwa njengoba sengishilo ngasenhla mangisho ukuthi ngiyabonga nonke nina enangemukelayo njengenceku nesisebenzi senu kukrestu Jesu. Kungumthandazo wami ukuba ngisebenzisane nani ngendlela etusekayo kini nonke nakuTixo umdali. Kodwa konke lokho kungenzeka ngoba sibambene nani njengoba senibutshengisile ubuqotho benu. Bathandwa, unyaka odlule uthe uma usuphela wasizela nobuhlungu nezingqinamba eziningi noba kunjalo sabambelela kumdali. Asifanele neze ukuba sikhohlwe izimfundo esabe sinikwe ubaba uMpostoli. Futhike bathandwa ngiyanicela nonke ukuba sibe naye ubaba wethu lapho ekhona ngezinhliziyo nangemithandazo yetnu.

Bathandwa ngingeze ngaxola ngempela uma nginganibonganga ngomsebenzi wenu omkhulu eniwenzile wokuvikela nokuma nezinceku zenu. Ngikhuleka kuTixo umdali wethu ukuba angenze ngibe phakathi kwenu ngamsebenzi engithunywe ngawo kini maduze nje. UTixo ubaba uyasambulela yena ukuba lonyaka usiphatheleni utixo. Anibusise nonke.

Yimi isisebenzi senu,
eNdlini ka Krestu,
D. PAKATHI: uMpostoli

nso.title: GO DIPHUTHEGO KA MOKA TŠA KEREKE YA BAAPOSTOLA
nso.message:
Barategi go Kriste,

Le tla gopola gore ngwageng o fetilego ke le ngwaletše ka baka la boemo bjo thata ka baka la khuduego yeo e bego e hlasetše setšhaba sa Modimo. Go le ngwalela ga ka e be e le ka gobane ke le lakaletša maphelo a mabotse le ditšhegofatšo. Ka gona, go be go le bohlokwa gore ke le šireletše go bao ba bego ba ferekanya menagano ya lena.

Barategi, bjalo ka ge ke boletše ka godimo, e re ke re ke a leboga go lena ka moka bao le nkamogetšego bjalo ka mohlanka le mošomi wa lena go Kriste Jesu. Ke thapelo ya ka gore ke šome le lena ka tsela ye e rategago go lena ka moka le go Modimo mmopi. Eupša tšeo ka moka di ka direga gobane re kopane le lena bjalo ka ge le šetše le bontšhitše potego ya lena. Barategi, ngwaga o fetilego o rile ge o fela wa re tlišetša bohloko le ditlhohlo tše dintši eupša le ge go le bjalo re kgomaretše mmopi. Ga re a swanela le gatee go lebala dithuto tšeo re di filwego ke tate Moapostola. Gape barategi, ke kgopela lena ka moka gore re be le tate wa rena mo a lego gona ka dipelo le ka dithapelo tša rena.

Barategi, nka se ikgabarele e le ruri ge nka se le leboge ka mošomo o mogolo wo le o dirilego wa go šireletša le go ema le bahlanka ba lena. Ke rapela Modimo mmopi wa rena gore a ntire gore ke be gare ga lena ka mošomo wo ke romilwego wona go lena mo e sego kgale. Modimo tate o tla re utollela gore ngwaga wo o re swaretše eng. A le šegofatše ka moka.

Ke nna mohlanka wa lena,
Ntlong ya Kriste,
D. PAKATHI: Moapostola

en.title: TO ALL CONGREGATIONS OF THE APOSTOLIC CHURCH
en.message:
Beloved in Christ,

As you all know that God gave us two lions in this church that we love, where father Apostle Ndlovu is the head. And as you also know that father Apostle Ndlovu went on his work called by God to Maputo. And as you know that when father Apostle Ndlovu ordained me Apostle Pakathi, he made it clear that there is no boundary dividing me and him. He stated that we all work together with him equally.

I ask that we all remember that, the Apostle said we should stay where we are led, and walk in order without colliding. Therefore, if we love our Apostle, I do not see anyone who can remove another where they are led. Let us also remember that the Apostle united us and built us into one body, and joints in the body of Christ. Whoever is truly a joint of this body of Christ should feel pain when a joint is separated from another by spirits.

I repeat that if we love Apostle Ndlovu who is the father of us all, let us not accept decisions that divide us. So that there may be peace and tranquility which I was called for, let me take this opportunity to inform you that all overseers operate as the Apostle left them, stay with them. I thank you for accepting me as your servant in Christ. May God keep you and bless you all.

I am yours in the Lord,
S.D. PAKATHI
(Apostle)

st.title: HO DIPHUTHEHO TSOHLE TSA KEREKE EA BAAPOSTOLA
st.message:
Baratuoa ho Kreste,

Joalokaha le tseba kaofela hore Molimo o re file litau tse peli kerekeng ena ea rona eo re e ratang, moo ntate Moapostola Ndlovu e leng hlooho. Mme joalokaha le tseba hape hore ntate Moapostola Ndlovu o ile a tsamaea ka mosebetsi oa hae oo a bitselitsoeng oona ke Molimo a ea Maputo. Le joalokaha le tseba hore ntate Moapostola Ndlovu mohla a mpeang 'na Moapostola Pakathi, o ile a hlakisa hore ha ho na moeli o arolang 'na le eena. O hlalositse hore bohle re sebetsa le eena ka ho tšoana.

Ke kopa re hopole bohle hore, Moapostola o itse re lule moo re tataisoang, 'me re tsamaee ka tatellano re sa thulane. Ka hona, haeba re rata Moapostola oa rona ha ke bone hore ho na le ea ka tlosang e mong moo a tataisoang teng. A re hopoleng hape hore Moapostola o re kopantse a re haha ho ba 'mele o le mong, le manonyello' meleng oa Kreste. Mang kapa mang eo e leng lenonyello e le kannete la 'mele ona oa Kreste o lokela ho utloa bohloko ha lenonyello le arohanngoa le le leng ke meea.

Kea pheta ke re haeba re rata Moapostola Ndlovu e leng ntate oa rona bohle a re se keng ra amohela liqeto tse re arolang. E le hore ho ka ba le khotso le thutso eo ke biletsitsoeng eona ke nke monyetla ona ho le tsebisa hore balebeli bohle ba sebetsa joalokaha Moapostola a ba siile, lulang ho bona. Kea le leboha ka ho nkamohela ha lona joaloka mohlanka oa lona ho Kreste. Molimo a le boloke a le hlohonolofatse kaofela.

Ke 'na oa lona Moreneng
S.D. PAKATHI
(Moapostola)

ts.title: EKA MAVANDLHA HINKWAWO YA KEREKE YA VAPOSTOLA
ts.message:
Varhandziwa eka Kreste,

Hilaha mi tivaka hakona hinkwenu leswaku Xikwembu xi hi nyikile tinghala timbirhi ekerekeni leyi ya hina leyi hi yi rhandzaka, laha tatana Mupostola Ndlovu a nga nhloko. Na hilaha mi tivaka hakona nakambe leswaku tatana Mupostola Ndlovu u fambile hi ntirho wa yena lowu a vitaniweke wona hi Xikwembu a ya eMaputo. Na hilaha mi tivaka hakona leswaku tatana Mupostola Ndlovu siku a ndzi vekaka mina Mupostola Pakathi, u swi veke erivaleni leswaku a ku na ndzilakana lowu hambanisaka mina na yena. U vule leswaku hi tirha hinkwerhu na yena hi ku ringana.

Ndzi kombela hi tsundzuka hinkwerhu leswaku, Mupostola u te a hi tshame laha hi rhangelaka kona, hi famba hi ku landzelelana hi nga thulani. Hikokwalaho loko hi rhandza Mupostola wa hina a ndzi voni leswaku ku na loyi a nga susaka un'wana laha a rhangelaka kona. A hi tsundzukeni nakambe leswaku Mupostola u hi hlanganisile a hi aka ku va miri wun'we, ni malungu emirimbeni ya Kreste. Loyi a nga rirho hakunene ra miri lowu wa Kreste u fanela ku twa ku vava loko xirho xi hambanisiwa na xin'wana hi mimoya.

Ndzi tlhela ndzi vula leswaku loko hi rhandza Mupostola Ndlovu loyi a nga tatana wa hina hinkwerhu a hi nga amukeli swiboho leswi hi hambanisaka. Leswaku ku va na ku rhula ni ku rula leswi ndzi vitaniweke swona ndzi teka nkarhi lowu ku mi tivisa leswaku valanguteri hinkwavo va tirha hilaha Mupostola a va siyeke hakona, tshamani na vona. Ndza mi nkhensa hi ku ndzi amukela ka n'wina tanihi nandza wa n'wina eka Kreste. Xikwembu xi mi hlayisa xi mi katekisa hinkwenu.

Hi mina wa n'wina eka Hosi
S.D. PAKATHI
(Mupostola)

xh.title: KUWO ONKE AMABANDLA ECAWE YABAPOSTILE
xh.message:
Bathandekayo kuKristu,

Njengoko nisazi nonke ukuba uThixo usinike iingonyama ezimbini kule cawe yethu siyithandayo, apho utata uMpostile Ndlovu eyintloko. Kanjalo njengoko nisazi kwakhona ukuba utata uMpostile Ndlovu wahamba ngomsebenzi wakhe awubizelwa nguThixo waya eMaputo. Kwaye njengoko nisazi ukuba utata uMpostile Ndlovu mhla endibeka mna Mpostile Pakathi, wakubeka ngokuphandle ukuba awukho umda owahlulayo phakathi kwam naye. Wathi sisebenza sonke naye ngokufanayo.

Ndicela sikhumbule sonke ukuba, uMpostile wathi masihlale apho sikhokelwa khona, sihambe ngokulandelelana singangqubani. Ngoko ke ukuba siyamthanda uMpostile wethu andiboni ukuba kukho ongasusa omunye apho akhokelwa khona. Masiqaphele kwakhona ukuba uMpostile usidibanisile wasakha saba mzimba mnye, namalungu emzimbeni kaKristu. Lowo ulilungu ngokwenene lalo mzimba kaKristu ufanele eve iintlungu xa ilungu lahlulwa kwelinye yimimoya.

Ndiyaphinda ndithi ukuba siyamthanda uMpostile Ndlovu ongutata wethu sonke mashingamkeli izigqibo ezisahlulayo. Ukuze kubekho uxolo noxolo endibizelwa lona ndithatha eli thuba ukunazisa ukuba bonke abaveleli basebenza njengoko uMpostile wabashiyayo, hlalani kubo. Ndiyanibulela ngokundamkela kwenu njengesicaka senu kuKristu. UThixo anigcine anisikelele nonke.

Ndim owakho eNkosini
S.D. PAKATHI
(UMpostile)

zu.title: KUMABANDLA ONKE ENKONZO YABA POSTOLI
zu.message:
Bathandwa kukrestu,

Njengoba nazi nonke ukuthi uTixo usinike izingonyamá ezimbili kule nkonzo yethu esiyithandayo, lapha ubaba umPostoli Ndlovu eyinhloko khona. Nanjengoba nazi futhi ukuthi ubaba umPostoli Ndlovu wahamba ngomsebenzi wakhe awubizelwa uTixo waya eMaputo. Nanjengoba nazi ukuthi ubaba umPostoli Ndlovu mhla ebeka mina mPostoli Pakathi, wakubeka ngokusobala ukuthi awukho umngcele ongumehlukaniso kimi naye. Wakubeka ukuthi sisebenza sonke naye ngokufana.

Ngicela sikhumbule sonke ukuthi, umPostoli wathi asihlale lapho sikhokhelwa khona, sihambe ngokulandelana singashayisani. Ngakhoke uma simthanda umPostoli wethu angiboni ukuthi kukhona ongasusa omunye lapho ekhokhelwa khona. Asiphinde sikhumbule ukuthi umPostoli usihlanganisile wasakha sabamzimba munye, namalunga emzimbeni kakrestu. Lowoke oyilunga ngempela lalomzimba kakrestu ufanele ezwe ubuhlungu uma ilunga lahlukaniswa nelinye ngemimoya.

Ngiyaphinda ngithi uma simthanda umPostoli Ndlovu ongubaba wethu sonke asingamukeli izinqumo ezisahlukanisayo. Ukuze kubekhona uxolo nokuthula engabizelwa khona ngithathe lelithuba lokunazisa ukuthi bonke abaveleli basebenza njengoba umPostoli wabashiya nihlale kubo. Ngiyanibonga ngokungamukela kwenu njengesisebenzi senu.kukrestu. uTixo anigcine anibusise nonke.

Yimi owenu eNkosini
S.D. PAKATHI
(UmPostoli)

nso.title: GO DIPHUTHEGO KA MOKA TŠA KEREKE YA BAAPOSTOLA
nso.message:
Barategi go Kriste,

Bjalo ka ge le tseba ka moka gore Modimo o re file ditau tše pedi ka kerekeng ye ya rena ye re e ratago, mo tate Moapostola Ndlovu e lego hlogo. Le bjalo ka ge le tseba gape gore tate Moapostola Ndlovu o ile a tloga ka mošomo wa gagwe wo a o bileditšwego ke Modimo a ya Maputo. Le bjalo ka ge le tseba gore tate Moapostola Ndlovu mohla a mpea nna Moapostola Pakathi, o beile gabotse gore ga go na mollwane wo o re aroganyago nna le yena. O beile gore re šoma ka moka le yena ka go swana.

Ke kgopela gore re gopoleng ka moka gore, Moapostola o itše a re duleng mo re etelelwago pele, re sepele ka tatelano re se thulane. Ka gona ge re rata Moapostola wa rena ga ke bone gore go na le yo a ka tlošago yo mongwe mo a etelelwago pele. A re gopoleng gape gore Moapostola o re kopantše a re aga go ba mmele o tee, le malokollo mmeleng wa Kriste. Yola e lego lelokollo ruri la mmele wo wa Kriste o swanetše go kwa bohloko ge lelokollo le aroganywa le le lengwe ka meoya.

Ke a boeletša ke re ge re rata Moapostola Ndlovu yo e lego tate wa rena ka moka a re se amogeleng diphetho tše di re aroganyago. Gore go be le khutšo le thekgo ye ke e bileditšwego, ke tšea sebaka se go le tsebiša gore balebeledi ka moka ba šoma bjalo ka ge Moapostola a ba tlogetše, dulang go bona. Ke a le leboga ka go nkamogela ga lena bjalo ka mohlanka wa lena go Kriste. Modimo a le boloke a le šegofatše ka moka.

Ke nna wa lena go Morena
S.D. PAKATHI
(Moapostola)

en.title: THE TWELVE APOSTLES' CHURCH IN CHRIST
en.message:
BELOVED IN CHRIST:

I greet you in the name of our Lord Jesus Christ. By the grace and love of God our Creator, we are gathering up the year 1995 very soon. However, we understand that our Lord Jesus suffered and was killed because of us. But He conquered death because of perseverance and trusting in God His father until we too received forgiveness for our sins. After forgiving us, Christ made us joints of His body and we had the right to be called children of God. As joints of the body, it means our head is Christ who rose from the dead, and we too have risen from the dead and become life that should also give life to others.

I thank you very much for your perseverance and cooperation with us in this very delicate work of carrying forward the gospel of peace. There are many things you have encountered in this past year, some painful, some funny. If it were in the world, we would be suffering from HIGH BLOOD PRESSURE and SUGAR DIABETES, but the things of God are amazing. But we learn that we must thank the Lord our creator for everything that happens to us.

MAY GOD BLESS YOU ALL IN THE COMING YEAR 1996.

Yours in Christ,
NV MLANGENI (APOSTLE)

st.title: KEREKE EA BAAPOSTOLA BA LESHOMA LE METSO E 'MELI HO KRESTE
st.message:
BARATUOA HO KRESTE:

Kea le lumelisa ka lebitso la Morena oa rona Jesu Kreste. Ka mohau le lerato la Molimo 'Mopi oa rona, re tl'o phutha selemo sa 1995 haufinyane. Empa rona re utloisisa hore Morena oa rona Jesu o ile a utloa bohloko a ba a bolaoa ka lebaka la rona. Empa o ile a hlola lefu ka lebaka la tiisetso le ho tšepa Molimo ntate oa hae ho fihlela le rona re fumana tšoarelo bakeng sa libe tsa rona. Ka mor'a ho re tšoarela Kreste o ile a re etsa manonyello a 'mele oa hae ra ba le tokelo ea ho bitsoa bana ba Molimo. Joaloka manonyello a 'mele ho bolela hore hlooho ea rona ke Kreste ea tsohileng bafung, 'me le rona re tsohile bafung ra ba bophelo bo lokelang ho phelisa le ba bang.

Ke le leboha haholo ka tiisetso ea lona le tšebelisano 'moho le rona mosebetsing ona o thata oa ho ntšetsa pele evangeli ea khotso. Ho na le lintho tse ngata tseo le kopaneng le tsona selemong sena se fetileng, tse ling li bohloko, tse ling lia tšehetsa. Hoja e ne e le lefatšeng re ka be re tšoeroe ke HIGH BLOOD PRESSURE hammoho le SUGAR DIABETES, empa tsa Molimo lia makatsa. Empa re ithuta hore re tlameha ho leboha Morena 'mopi oa rona ka lintho tsohle tse re etsahallang.

MOLIMO A LE HLOHONOLOFATSE BOHLE SELEMONG SE TLANG SA 1996.

Ea lona ho Kreste,
NV MLANGENI (MOAPOSTOLA)

ts.title: KEREKE YA VAPOSTOLA VA KHUME-MBIRHI EKA KRESTE
ts.message:
VARHANDZIWA EKA KRESTE:

Ndzi mi losa hi vito ra Hosi ya hina Yesu Kreste. Hi tintswalo ni rirhandzu ra Xikwembu Muvumbi wa hina, hi ta pfalela lembe ra 1995 ku nga ri khale. Kambe hina ha twisisa leswaku Hosi ya hina Yesu u xanisekile a tlhela a dlayiwa hikwalaho ka hina. Kambe u hlurile rifu hikwalaho ka ku tiyisela ni ku tshemba Xikwembu tata wa yena ku fikela loko na hina hi kuma ku rivaleriwa eka swidyoho swa hina. Endzhaku ko hi rivalela Kreste u hi endle swirho swa miri wa yena hi va ni mfanelo yo vitaniwa vana va Xikwembu. Tanihi swirho swa miri swi vula leswaku nhloko ya hina i Kreste loyi a pfukeke exikarhi ka lava feke, na hina hi pfukile exikarhi ka lava feke hi va vutomi lebyi faneleke ku hanyisa na van'wana.

Ndza mi nkhensa swinene hi ku tiyisela ka n'wina na ku tirhisana na hina eka ntirho lowu wo rharhangana wo yisa evhangeli ya ku rhula emahlweni. Ku ni swilo swo tala leswi mi hlanganyeteke na swona eka lembe leri hundzeke, swin'wana swi vava, swin'wana swa hlekisa. Loko a swi ri emisaveni a hi fanele hi khomiwa hi HIGH BLOOD PRESSURE swin'we na SUGAR DIABETES, kambe swa Xikwembu swa hlamarisa. Kambe hi dyondza leswaku hi fanele ku nkhensa Hosi muvumbi wa hina hi swilo hinkwaswo leswi hi humelelaka.

XIKWEMBU XI MI KATEKISA HINKWENU EKA LEMBE LERI TAKA RA 1996.

Wa n'wina eka Kreste,
NV MLANGENI (MUPOSTOLA)

xh.title: ICAWE YABAPOSTILE ABALISHUMI ELINESIBINI KUKRISTU
xh.message:
BATHANDEKAYO KUKRISTU:

Ndiyanibulisa egameni leNkosi yethu uYesu Kristu. Ngobabalo nangothando lukaThixo uMdali wethu, siza kugoqa unyaka ka-1995 kungekudala. Kodwa ke thina siyaqonda ukuba inkosi yethu uYesu yeva ubunzima yaze yabulawa ngenxa yethu. Kodwa yaloyisa ukufa ngenxa yokunyamezela nokuthembela kuThixo uyise de nathi safumana uxolelo kwizono zethu. Emva kokusixolela, uKristu wasenza amalungu omzimba wakhe saba nelungelo lokubizwa ngokuba singabantwana bakaThixo. Njengamalungu omzimba, oko kuthetha ukuba intloko yethu nguKristu owavuka kwabafileyo, nathi ke sivukile kwabafileyo saba bubomi obufanele buphilise nabanye.

Ndiyanibulela kakhulu ngokunyamezela kwenu nokusebenzisana nathi kulo msebenzi unovakalelo wokuhambisa ivangeli yoxolo. Zininzi izinto enihlangabezane nazo kulo nyaka uphelileyo, ezinye zibuhlungu, ezinye ziyahlekisa. Ukuba bekusehlabathini, ngebekufanele siphathwe yi-HIGH BLOOD PRESSURE kwakunye ne-SUGAR DIABETES, kodwa izinto zikaThixo ziyamangalisa. Kodwa sifunda ukuba kufuneka siyibulele iNkosi umdali wethu ngazo zonke izinto ezisehlelayo.

UTHIXO ANISIKELELE NONKE KUNYAKA KA-1996 OZAYO.

Owakho kuKristu,
NV MLANGENI (UMPOSTILE)

zu.title: THE TWELVE APOSTLE'S CHURCH IN CHRIST
zu.message:
BA THANDEKAYO KUKRESTU:

Ngiyanibulisa egameni lenkosi yethu uJesu Krestu. Ngomusa Nothando luka Thixo uMdali wethu, sesiyawuqoqa unyaka ka1995 maduzane nje. Kepha ke thina siyaqonda ukuthi inkosi yethu yethu uJesu wahlushwa waza wabulawa ngenxa yethu. Kodwa ke wakunqoba ukufa ngenxa yokubekezela nokwethemba kuThixo uyise saze sathola ukuthethelelwa nathi ezonweni zethu. Sesithethelwa uKrestu wasenza saba amalunga omzimba wakhe saba nelungelo lokubizwa ngokuthi singabantwana baka Thixo. Njengamalunga ke omzimba kisho ukuthi intloko yethu uKrestu owavuka ekufeni, nathi ke sesivukile ekufeni saba yimpilo ekufanele ukuthi nathi nathi siyophilisa abanye phela.

Ngiyanibonga kakhulu ngokubekezela kwenu nasekubambisaneni nathi kulo msebenzi obucayi kangaka wukuqhuba ivangeli lokuthula noxolo ziningi ke izinto enihlangabebezene nazo kulo nyaka odlulile, ezinye zibuhlungu, ezinye zihlekisa, ukuba kwakusezweni kwakufanele ukuthi siphathwe ngo HIGH BLOOD PRESSURE kunye noSUGAR DIABETICS, kodwa okuka Thixo kuyamangalisa. Kodwa ke sifunda ukuthi kufanele siyibonge iNkosi umdali wethu ngazo zonke izinto ezisehlelayo.

UTHIXO ANIBUSISE NONKE KULONYAKA KA-1996 OZAYO.

Owenu kuKrestu
NV MLANGENI (UMPOSTOLI)

nso.title: KEREKE YA BAAPOSTOLA BA LESOMEPEDI GO KRISTE
nso.message:
BARATEGI GO KRISTE:

Ke le dumediša ka leina la Morena wa rena Jesu Kriste. Ka mogau le lerato la Modimo Mmopi wa rena, re tlo phutha ngwaga wa 1995 mo e sego kgale. Eupša rena re a kwešiša gore Morena wa rena Jesu o tlaišegile a ba a bolawa ka baka la rena. Eupša o fentše lehu ka baka la kgotlelelo le go tshepa Modimo tatagwe go fihla le rena re hwetša tshwarelo dibeng tša rena. E rile ge a re swaretše Kriste a re dira malokollo a mmele wa gagwe ra ba le tokelo ya go bitšwa bana ba Modimo. Bjalo ka malokollo a mmele go ra gore hlogo ya rena ke Kriste yo a tsogilego bahung, le rena re tsogile bahung ra ba bophelo bjo bo swanetšego go phediša ba bangwe gape.

Ke le leboga kudu ka kgotlelelo ya lena le go šomišana le rena mo mošomong wo o hlokago tlhokomelo wa go tšwetša pele ebangedi ya khutšo. Go na le dilo tše dintši tšeo le kopanego le tšona ngwageng wo o fetilego, tše dingwe tše bohloko, tše dingwe tše di segišago. Ge nkabe e le lefaseng re be re tla be re swerwe ke HIGH BLOOD PRESSURE le SUGAR DIABETES, eupša tša Modimo di a makatša. Eupša re ithuta gore re swanetše go leboga Morena mmopi wa rena ka dilo ka moka tše di re diragalelago.

MODIMO A LE ŠEGOFATŠE KA MOKA NGWAGENG WA 1996 WO O TLANG.

Wa lena go Kriste,
NV MLANGENI (MOAPOSTOLA)

en.title: APOSTLE's GREETING TO ALL CONGREGATIONS
en.message:
BELOVED IN CHRIST,
I WRITE THIS GREETING WITH GREAT JOY AND AMAZING LOVE FOR YOU ALL, CHILDREN OF GOD WHO WERE LOVED BY OUR LORD JESUS CHRIST, WHO DIED FOR US ON THE CROSS SO THAT WE MAY BE FORGIVEN OUR SINS. AND I WRITE THIS GREETING BEING HAPPY FOR THE GOOD WORK AND DEEDS YOU HAVE DONE THIS YEAR. LET US ALSO PRAISE THE CREATOR AND OUR LORD JESUS CHRIST FOR ALL HE HAS DONE FOR US IN THE YEAR 1996.

I AM CERTAIN THAT IF WE WEIGH THE GOOD AND BAD THINGS THAT HAVE HAPPENED TO US IN THIS CHURCH, WE CAN FIND THAT THERE IS MUCH MORE THAT IS GOOD AND PLEASING RATHER THAN BAD, AND GOD HAS DONE WHAT IS PLEASING TO US. TRULY GOD WAS WITH US THIS YEAR AS HIS CHILDREN, YES SOME LOST FAMILIES AND RELATIVES, ALL THAT WAS A LESSON TO US THAT WHEN A BAD WIND BLOWS IT TAKES PEOPLE AWAY BECAUSE PEOPLE ARE CHASED BY THE DUST OF THE SPIRIT AND THEN THEY TAKE A PATH THEY WERE NOT CALLED TO WALK TO COME TO GOD, AND THEN THEY GET LOST, AND FIND THEMSELVES IN ANOTHER PLACE GOD DID NOT CALL THEM TO.

AS FOR ME, AS AN APOSTLE, I WISH TO THANK ALL THE OFFICERS AND BROTHERS AND SISTERS VERY MUCH FOR COOPERATING WITH ME IN THE WORK OF BUILDING THE HOUSE OF GOD. YOUR COOPERATION AND DEDICATION HAS BEEN VERY GREAT. MAY GOD STRENGTHEN YOU IN THIS COMMENDABLE DEED. AND THOSE WHO WAITED FOR REASONS TO CRITICIZE AND DESTROY, YOU DID NOT ALLOW THEM. THAT IS WHY THE AIMS AND DESIRES OF THE DESTROYERS DID NOT SUCCEED.

BELOVED, I WISH YOU THAT THE YEAR 1997 BE A SUCCESS FOR YOU AND YOUR CHILDREN, MAY IT GUIDE YOU WELL PERHAPS IN THE LIGHT SO WE WORK FOR THE CREATOR, LET US NOT FORGET OUR PARENTS. MAY GOD GIVE YOU THE STRENGTH TO CARRY YOUR CROSS EVEN UNTIL THE VICTORY THROUGH OUR LORD JESUS CHRIST. AMEN.

YOURS IN THE LORD
N.V. MLANGENI (APOSTLE)

st.title: TUMELISO EA MOAPOSTOLA HO DIPHUTHEHO TSOHLE
st.message:
BARATUOA HO KRESTE,
KE LE NGOLLA TUMELISO ENA KE E-NA LE THABO E KHOLO LE LERATO LE MAKATSAHANG HO LONA BOHLE BANA BA MOLIMO BA RATILOENG KE MORENA OA RONA JESU KRESTE, EA RE SHOELETSENG SEFAPANONG HORE RE TSOARELOE LIBE TSA RONA. MME KE NGOLA TUMELISO ENA KE THABILE KA MOSEBETSI LE LIKETSO TSE NTLE TSEO LE LI ENTSENG SELEMONG SENA. A RE RORISENG HAPE MMOPI, LE MORENA OA RONA JESU KRESTE BAKENG SA TSOHLE TSEO A RE ENTSALETSENG TSONA SELEMONG SA 1996.

KE TŠEPILE HORE HAEBA RE KA LEKANYA LINTHO LE LIKETSO TSE NTLE LE TSE MPE TSE RE ETSAHALETSENG RONA KEREKENG ENA, RE KA FUMANA HORE HO NA LE TSE NGATA HAHOLO TSE NTLE LE TSE THABISANG HO FETA TSE MPE: MME MOLIMO O RE ENTSALETSE TSE THABISANG. KA NNETE MOLIMO O NE A E-NA LE RONA SELEMONG SENA JOALOKA BANA BA HAE, EE BA BANG BA LAHLEHETSWE KE MALAPA LE METSOALLE EA BONA, TSOHLE TSEO E NE E LE THUTO HO RONA HORE HA MOYA O MOBE O FOKA O TLOSA BATHO HOBANE BATHO BA LELEKOA KE LEROLE LA MOYA 'ME BA NKA TSELA EO BA SA BITSOHOANG HO TSAMAEA KA EONA HO TLA HO MOLIMO MME BA LAHLEHA, BA ITFUMANA BA LE SEBAKENG SE SENG SEO MOLIMO A SA BA BITSETSANG HO SONA.

MME HA E LE NNA JOALOKA MOAPOSTOLA KE LAKATSA HO LEBOHA HAHOLO HO BAHLANKA BOHLE LE BANA BESO BA BANNA LE BA BASALI KA HO SEBELISANA LE NNA MOSEBETSING ONA OA HO HAHA NTLO EA MOLIMO. TŠEBIISANO 'MOHO LE BOINEHELO BA LONA E BILE E KHOLO HAHOLO. MOLIMO A LE MATLAFATSE KETSOHONG ENA E BABATSEHANG. LE BAO BA NENG BA EMETSE MABAKA LE HO TŠOAEA LIPHOSO LE HO SENYA, HA LAA BA LUMELLA. KE KA HONA MAIKEMISETSO LE LITAKATSO TSA BASENYI LI SA KANG TSA ATLEHA.

BARATUOA KE LE LAKALETSA. SELEMO SA 1997 E BE SA KATLEHO HO LONA LE BANA BA LONA, SE LE TATAISO HANTLE MOHLOMONG LESELING RE SEBELETSE MMOPI, RE SE KE RA LEBALA BATSOALI BA RONA. MOLIMO A LE FENG MATLA A HO JARA SEFAPANO SA LONA LE KAJENO HO FIHLELA HLOLONG KA MORENA OA RONA JESU KRESTE. AMEN.

EA LONA MORENENG
N.V. MLANGENI (MOAPOSTOLA)

ts.title: XILUMISO XA MUPOSTOLA EKA MAVANDLHA HINKWAWO
ts.message:
VARHANDZIWA EKA KRESTE,
NDZI MI TSALELA XILUMISO LEXI NDZI RI NA NTSAKO LOWUKULU NA RIRHANDZU RO HLAMARISA EKA N'WINA HINKWENU VANA VA XIKWEMBU LAVA RHANDZIWEKE HI HOSI YA HINA YESU KRESTE, LOYI A HI FELEKE EXIHAMBANWENI LESWAKU HI RIVALERIWA SWIDYOHO SWA HINA. NASWONA NDZI TSALA XILUMISO LEXI NDZI TSAKILE HI NTIRHO NA SWIENDLO SWASWINENE LESWI MI SWI ENDLEKE EKA LEMBE LERI. A HI DZUNISENI NAKAMBE MUVUMBI, NA HOSI YA HINA YESU KRESTE EKA HINKWASWO LESWI A HI ENDLELEKE SWONA EKA LEMBE RA 1996.

NDZI TIYISILE LESWAKU LOKO HI KALA SWILO NA SWIENDLO SWASWINENE NA SWO BIHA LESWI HI HUMELELEKE EKEREKENI LEYI, HI NGA KUMA LESWAKU KU NA SWO TALA SWASWINENE NA SWO TSAKISA KU TLULA SWO BIHA: NASWONA XIKWEMBU XI HI ENDLELE SWO TSAKISA. HAKUNENE XIKWEMBU A XI RI NA HINA EKA LEMBE LERI TANIHI VANA VA XONA, INA VAN'WANA VA LAHKERIWUWE HI MINDYANGU NA MAXAKA YA VONA, HINKWASWO SWESWO A KU RI NDYONDZO EKA HINA LESWAKU LOKO MOYA WO BIHA WU HUNGUTELA WU SUSA VANHU HIKUVA VANHU VA HLOTIWA HI RITSHURI RA MOYA KUTANI VA TEKA NDLELA LEYI A VA NGA VITANIWANGA KU FAMBA HA YONA KU TA EKA XIKWEMBU KUTANI VA LAHLEKA, VA TIKUMA VA RI ENDHAWENI YIN'WANA LEYI XIKWEMBU XI NGA VA VITANANGIKI EKA YONA.

KASI MINA TANIHI MUPOSTOLA NDZI NAVELA KU NKHENSA SWINENE EKA MALANDZA HINKWAWO NA VAMAKWERHU VA VAVANUNA NA VAVASATI HI KU TIRHISANA NA MINA EKA NTIRHO LOWU WO AKA YINDLU YA XIKWEMBU. KU TIRHISANA NA KU TINYIKETELA KA N'WINA KU VE KUKULU SWINENE. XIKWEMBU XI MI TIYISA EKA XIENDLO LEXI XO DZUNISEKA. NA LAVA A VA RINDZELE MAVAKALA NA KU TSOLAVISISA NA KU ONHA, A MI VA PFUMELELANGA. HI YONA MHAKA MAKUNGU NA KUNAVELA KA VAONHI SWI NGA HUMELELANGIKI.

VARHANDZIWA NDZA MI NAVELELA. LEMBE RA 1997 A RI VE RA MPHUMELELO EKA N'WINA NA VANA VA N'WINA, RI MI KONGOMISA KAHLE KUMBE EKU VONAKALENI HI TIRHELA MUVUMBI, HI NGA RIVALI VATSWARI VA HINA. XIKWEMBU XI MI NYIKA MATIMBA YO RHWALA XIHAMBANO XA N'WINA HAMBI NAMUNTLHA KU FIKA EKU HLULENI HI HOSI YA HINA YESU KRESTE. AMEN.

WA N'WINA EKA HOSI
N.V. MLANGENI (MUPOSTOLA)

xh.title: UMBULISO WOMPOSTILE KUWO ONKE AMABANDLA
xh.message:
BATHANDEKAYO KUKRISTU,
NDINIBHALELA LO MBULISO NDINOVUYO OLUKHULU NOTHANDO OLUMANGALISAYO NGANI NONKE BANTWANA BAKA THIXO ENATHANDWA YINKOSI YETHU UYESU KRISTU, OWASIFELAYO EMNQAMLEZWENI UKUZE SIXOLELWE IZONO ZETHU. KWAYE NDIBHALA LO MBULISO NDIVUYA NGOMSEBENZI NEZENZO EZINTLE ENIZENZILEYO KULO NYAKA. MASIPHINDE SIBONGE UMDALI, NENKOSI YETHU UYESU KRISTU KUKO KONKE ASENZELEYO KUNYAKA KA-1996.

NDIQINISEKILE UKUBA XA SINGAKHA SITHATHE IZIPHUMO ZEENTON EZINTLE NEZIMBI EZIYE ZASEHLELA THINA KULE CAWE, SINGAFUMANA UKUBA KUNINZI NGAKUMBI OKUHLE NOKUVUYISAYO KUNOKUBI, KWAYE UTHIXO USENZELE OKUVUYISAYO. INENENE UTHIXO UBE NATHI KULO NYAKA NJENGABANTWANA BAKHE, EWE ABANYE BAPHITSHANELWE YIMINDENI KUNYE NEZIZALWANE ZABO, KONKE OKO KUBELISIFUNDO KUTHI UKUBA XA UMOYA OMBI UVUTHUZA UMKISA ABANTU KUBA ABANTU BAQhutywa LUTHULI LOMOYA BAZE BATHATHE INDLELA ABANGABIZELWANGA KUKUHAMBA NGAYO UKUZA KUTHIXO BAZE BALAHLEKE, BAZIFUMANE BESE NDaweni ENYE UTHIXO ANGABABIZELANGA KUYO.

KANTI KE MNA NJENGOMPOSTILE NDINQWENELA UKUBULELA KAKHULU KWIZICAKA ZONKE KUNYE NAKUBAZALWANA NOODADE NGOKUBAMBISANA NAM KULO MSEBENZI WOKWAKHA INDLU KATHIXO. KUBE KUKHULU KAKHULU UKUBAMBISANA NOKUZINIKELA KWENU. UTHIXO MAKANIQINISE KULE SENZO SINCOMEKAYO. KWAYE ABO BABELINDE IZIBAKALA NOKUGXEKA NOKUCHITHA, ANIBANIKANGA THUBA. KUNGOKO IINJONGO NEEMFIHLO ZABACHITHI ZINGAPHUMELELANGA.

BATHANDEKAYO NDININQWENELELA. UNYAKA KA-1997 UBE YIMPUMELELO KUNI NABANTWANA BENU, UNIKHOKHELE KAKUHLE MHLawumbi EKUKHANYENI SISEBENZELE UMDALI, SINGALIBALI NGABAZALI BETHU. UTHIXO ANINike AMANDLA OKUTHWALA UMNQAMLEZO WENU NAMhlanje KUDE KUBE SEKUYISENI NGENKOSI YETHU UYESU KRISTU. AMEN.

OWAKHO ENKOSINI
N.V. MLANGENI (UMPOSTILE)

zu.title: UMBULISO WOMPOSTOLI KUMABANDLA ONKE
zu.message:
BATHANDWA KU KRESTU,
NGINILCUELA LOMBULISO NGINOKUJABULA OKUKHULU NOTHANDO OLUMANGALISAYO NGANI NONKE ZANTWANA ΠΑΚΑ ΤΙΧΟ ENATHANDWA INKOSI YETHU UJESO KRESTE, OWASIFELA ESIPHAMDANWENI UKUZE SITHETHELELI EZONWENI ZETHU, FUTHI NGILOEA LOMBULISO NGINOKUJASULA NGOMSEBENZI NEZENZO EZINHLE ENIZENZILE KULONYAKA. SIPHINDE FUTHI SIMDUMISE UMDALI, NE NKOSI YETHU UJESO KRESTU KUKO KONKE ASENZELELE KONA KULONYAKA ΚΑ 1996.

NGIQINISILE UKUTHI UMA SINGADALA IZINTO NEZENZO EZINHLE NEZIMBI EZISIVELELE THINA KULENKON 20, SINGATHOLA UKUTHI KUNINGI NAGAPHEZULU OKUHLE NCKUTHOKOZISAYA KUNALOKHO: OKUPI NOKUJABISAYO UTHIXO ASENZELA KONA. NGEMPELA UTHIXO UΓΕΝΑΤΗΙ KULONYAKANENGADANTWANA SAKHE, YEBO ADANYE BALAHLEKELWA IMINDENI NEZIHLODO ZADO, KONKE LOKHO KWALA ISIFUNDO NAKUTHINA UKU UMA UMOYA OMULI UVUNGUZA WEMUKA NABANTU NGOBA ADANTU AFANYE DASUKE EXHOSWE IZINTULI ZOMOYA BESE BETHATHA INDLELA ADANGADIZELWANGA UKUTHI BAHAMDE NGAYO UKUZA KU THIXO BESEDAYALAHLEKA, DAZITHOLE SEDE KWENYE INDAWO UTRIXO ANGALAI IZELANGA KUYONA.

ΚΑΝΤΙ ΚΕ MINA NJE NGOMPOSTOLI NGIFISA UKUDONGA KAKHULU EZINCEKWINI ZONKE NAKUBAZALWANE NODADE NGOKUBAMBISANA NAMI KUWO UMSELENZI WOKWAKHA INDLU KA THIXO. KUBE KUKHULU KAKHULU UKUDAMBISANA NOKUZINIKELAKWENU. UNKULUNKULU MAKANIQINISE KULESISENZO ESINCOMEKAYO. NALALO ANAHLALELE IZIZATHU NOKUGXEKA NOKUDILIZA, ANIBAVUMELANGA. YINGAKHO IZINJONGO NEZIFISO ZABARIDLIZI ZINGAPHUMELANGA..

BATHANDWA NGINIFISELA. UNYAKA KA 1997 UDE YIMPUMELELO KINI NADANTWANA BENU, UNIMQODE CMUDI MHLAMDE EKUKHANYENI SISEBENZELE UMDALI, SINGAKHOHLWA NGADAZALI DETHU. UTHIXO ANIPHE AMANDLA OKUSITHWALA ISIPHAMDANO SENU M, ANJE KUZE KUDE SEKUNQOLENI NGENKOSI YETHU UJESC KRESTU. AMEN.

OWENU ENKOSINI
N.V. MLANGENI (UMPOSTOLI)

nso.title: TUMEDIŠO YA MOAPOSTOLA GO DIPHUTHEGO KA MOKA
nso.message:
BARATEGI GO KRISTE,
KE LE NGWALELA TUMEDIŠO YE KE NA LE LETHABO LE LEGOLO LE LERATO LE LE MAKATŠAGO GO LENA KA MOKA BANA BA MODIMO BA BA RATILWEGO KE MORENA WA RENA JESU KRISTE, YO A RE HWETŠEGO SEFAMPANONG GORE RE SWARELWE DIBE TŠA RENA, GAPE KE NGWALA TUMEDIŠO YE KE THABILE KA MOŠOMO LE MEDIRO E MEBOTSE YE LE E DIRILEGO NGWAGENG WO. A RE TUMIŠENG GAPE MMOPI, LE MORENA WA RENA JESU KRISTE GO TŠOHLE TŠEO A RE DIRETŠEGO NGWAGENG WA 1996.

KE THEKGile GORE GE RE KA ELA DILO LE MEDIRO E MEBOTSE LE E MEBE YEO E RE DIRAGALETŠEGO RENA KEREKENG YE, RE KA HWETŠA GORE GO NA LE TŠE DINTŠI GAPE TŠE DIBOTSE LE TŠE DI THABIŠAGO GO FETA TŠEO: TŠE MPE GOMME MODIMO O RE DIRETŠE TŠE DI THABIŠAGO. RURI MODIMO O BE A NA LE RENA NGWAGENG WO BJALO KA BANA BA GAGWE, EE BA BANGWE BA LOBILE MALAPA LE METSWALELA YA BONA, SE KA MOKA E BE E LE THUTO GO RENA GORE GE MOYA O MOBE O TŠUTLA O TLOŠA BATHO GOBANE BATHO BA RAKWA KE LEROLE LA MOYA GOMME BA TŠEA TSELA YEO BA SA BILETŠWAGO GORE BA SEPELE KA YONA GO TLA GO MODIMO GOMME BA LALAHLEGA, BA IKHUETŠA BA LE LEFELONG LE LENGWE LEO MODIMO A SA BA BILETŠAGO GO LONA.

GOMME GE E LE NNA BJALO KA MOAPOSTOLA KE DUMA GO LEBOGA KUDU GO BAHLANKA KA MOKA LE GO BANA BABO RENA LE DIKGAETŠEDI KA GO ŠOMIŠANA LE NNA MOŠOMONG WA GO AGA NTLO YA MODIMO. GO ŠOMIŠANA LE BOIKGAFO BJA LENA E BE E LE BJO BOGOLO KUDU. MODIMO A LE TIIPŠENG KA MEDIRO YE E TUMEGAGO. LE BAO BA LETETŠEGO MABAKA LE GO TSHWAYA DIPHOSO LE GO SENYA, GA LA BA DUMELELA. KE KA BAKA LEO MAIKEMIŠETŠO LE DIKGANYOGO TŠA BASENYI DI SA KAGO TŠA ATLEGA.

BARATEGI KE LE LAKALETŠA GORE NGWAGA WA 1997 E BE WA KATLEGO GO LENA LE BANA BA LENA, A O LE HLAHLE GABOTSE GOMME SEDING RE ŠOMELE MMOPI, RE SE KE RA LEBALA BATSWADI BA RENA. MODIMO A LE NEE MAATLA A GO RWALA SEFAMPANO SA LENA LE GARENG GA DITLAIŠEGO GO FIHLA PHENYONG KA MORENA WA RENA JESU KRISTE. AMEN.

WA LENA GO MORENA
N.V. MLANGENI (MOAPOSTOLA)

en.title: Greetings to all congregations
en.message:
Beloved in the Lord,

I greet you all in the name of our Lord Jesus Christ, for our saviour once said to his followers, I call you beloved, because you are being loved by God, who created heaven and earth through love and created birds and animals through love, and lastly he created man in his own image, also through love where then at the end, when God finished creating, he sent his begotten son Jesus Christ who was born alone to come to earth and die for only those who believed that he came from heaven and sent by his father, for the world did not believe in him and they called him by names instead. But those who accepted hira as Lord and Saviour and carried their crosses and followed him were called Christians for they followed Christ on his golden foot steps.

Beloved in the Lord we all know how our Lord Jesus Christ suffered on earth until the day of his crucifixior through us, but he conquered the death througu perseverance and also by being honest to God his father. Our sins were then forgiven. After the forgiveness of our sins the Lord Jesus Christ made us to be the joints of his body and we had all the right to be called the children of God.

Beloved Jesus Christ once said to his disciples, "My father is the gardener and I am the vine, you are the branches on this vine which is me, every branch that bears no fruit will be removed and thrown outside the vineyard and it will become dry, and it will be picked up by those who are in need of firewood and they will make fire thereof."

My beloved brothers and sisters, officers and sisters, as we now all understand that we are the joints on this body of Christ, let us bring this to our attention that Christ is the head who had risen from the dead. Likewise we have also risen from the dead. We have become life so that we can now go forth and save others.

I want to thank every one of you for having enough patience and to be so supportive to us in the difficult and heavy task to preach evangelism of love and peace. We have encountered many things on the way of this outgoing year. Some were painful and some were like jokes, but God is great, we are taught always that we must thank our Lord always for things that we encounter. We all know that even a person who does not believe in God, when he is in trouble, will always say "Oh, my God". That shows us that misery can bring you nearer to God, and likewise pleasure can also make us forget about our enemies.

Let us also be careful about things that we utter, because our mouths can cause disaster between God and ourselves. We are facing difficult times, beloved, where the devil is also clothed in white like the children of God so that he cannot be noticed easily, but the spirit of God will always reveal itself to you, only if you keep his four commandments, namely:-

1. Keep time of all your services.
2. Offer your tithes (materially).
3. Offer your tithes (spiritually), and
4. Love thy neighbour, inside the church and outside the church.

We are looking forward to entering the year 2000, which I say is going to be a year of blessings. Let us not forget to respect our officers, for they are our fountains that are opened by us. Let us not dirty them for tomorrow you will become thirsty and think of the water you once drank, and once you think of the dirty things you did to the fountain, you will feel bilious and you will die of thirst. Remember my beloved, respect is your key to open, and love is your weapon to conquer in the new year 2000.

GOD BLESS YOU ALL.

Yours in Christ
N.V. MLANGENI
CHIEF APOSTLE/PRESIDENT.

st.title: Litumeliso ho liphutheho tsohle
st.message:
Baratuoa Moreneng,

Kea le lumelisa bohle ka lebitso la Morena oa rona Jesu Kreste, hobane 'mopholosi oa rona o kile a re ho balateli ba hae, ke le bitsa baratuoa, hobane le ratoa ke Molimo, ea bopileng leholimo le lefatše ka lerato 'me a bopa linonyana le liphoofolo ka lerato, mme qetellong a bopa motho ka setšoantšo sa hae, hape ka lerato moo qetellong, ha Molimo a qeta ho bopa, a rometseng mora oa hae ea tsoetsoeng a le mong Jesu Kreste ho tla lefatšeng ho shoela feela ba lumelang hore o tsoa leholimong a rometsoe ke ntate oa hae, hobane lefatše ha lea ka la mo lumela empa la mo bitsa ka mabitso. Empa ba mo amohetseng joaloka Morena le 'Mopholosi ba nkile lifapano tsa bona' me ba mo latela ba ne ba bitsoa Bakreste hobane ba latetse Kreste mehatong ea hae ea khauta.

Baratuoa ho Morena bohle rea tseba hore Morena oa rona Jesu Kreste o ile a utloa bohloko hakaakang lefatšeng ho fihlela letsatsi la ho thakhisoa ha hae ka lebaka la rona, empa o ile a hlola lefu ka mamello 'me hape ka ho tšepahala ho Molimo ntate oa hae. Joale libe tsa rona li ile tsa tšoareloa. Ka mor'a tšoarelo ea libe tsa rona Morena Jesu Kreste o re entse hore re be manonyeletso a 'mele oa hae mme re bile le tokelo eohle ea ho bitsoa bana ba Molimo.

Baratuoa Jesu Kreste o kile a re ho barutuoa ba hae, "Ntate ke molemi 'me nna ke sefate sa morara, lona le makala sefateng sena sa morara seo e leng nna, lekala le leng le le leng le sa beheng tholoana le tla tlosoa 'me le lahleloe ka ntle ho serapa sa morara mme le tla omella, 'me le tla nkuoa ke ba hlokang patsi' me ba tla e besa mollo."

Bana beso ba ratehang le likhaitseli, basebeletsi le likhaitseli, kaha joale bohle re utloisisa hore re manonyeletso 'meleng ona oa Kreste, a re hopoleng sena hore Kreste ke hlooho ea tsohileng bafung. Ka mokhoa o tšoanang le rona re tsohile bafung. Re fetohile bophelo hore joale re ka ea pele ra pholosa ba bang.

Ke batla ho leboha e mong le e mong oa lona ka ho ba le mamello e lekaneng le ho re ts'ehetsa mosebetsing o thata le o boima oa ho bolela evangeli ea lerato le khotso. Re kopane le lintho tse ngata tseleng ea selemo sena se fetang. Tse ling li ne li utloisa bohloko 'me tse ling li ne li tšoana le metlae, empa Molimo o moholo, re rutoa kamehla hore re lokela ho leboha Morena oa rona kamehla ka lintho tseo re kopanang le tsona. Kaofela rea tseba hore esita le motho ea sa lumeleng ho Molimo, ha a le mathateng, o tla lula a re "Oh, Molimo oa ka". Seo se re bontša hore mahlomola a ka u atametsa haufi le Molimo, 'me ka mokhoa o tšoanang monyaka le oona o ka etsa hore re lebale ka lira tsa rona.

A re hlompheng hape lintho tseo re li buang, hobane melomo ea rona e ka baka tlokotsi lipakeng tsa Molimo le rona. Re tobane le linako tse thata, baratuoa, moo diabolose a apereng tse tšoeu joaloka bana ba Molimo hore a se ke a bonoa habonolo, empa moea oa Molimo o tla lula o iponahatsa ho uena, feela haeba u boloka litaelo tsa hae tse 'ne, e leng:-

1. Boloka nako ea litšebeletso tsa hau tsohle.
2. Fana ka karolo ea leshome ea hau (ka nama).
3. Fana ka karolo ea leshome ea hau (ka moea), mme
4. Rata moahelani oa hau, ka hare ho kereke le ka ntle ho kereke.

Re lebeletse ho kena selemong sa 2000, seo ke reng se tl'o ba selemo sa litlhohonolofatso. A re se keng ra lebala ho hlompha liofisiri tsa rona, hobane ke liliba tsa rona tse butsoeng ke rona. A re se keng ra ba silafatsa hobane hosasane le tla nyoroa 'me le hopole metsi ao le kileng la a noa, mme hang ha le nahana ka lintho tse litšila tseo le li entseng selibeng, le tla ikutloa le nyekeloa' me le tla bolaoa ke lenyora. Hopolang baratuoa ba ka, tlhompho ke senotlolo sa lona sa ho bula, 'me lerato ke sebetsa sa lona sa ho hlola selemong se secha sa 2000.

MOLIMO A LE HLOHONOLOFATSE BOHLE.

Ea lona ho Kreste
N.V. MLANGENI
MOAPOSTOLA E MOHOLO/MOPRESIDENTE.

ts.title: Xilumiso eka mavandlha hinkwawo
ts.message:
Varhandziwa eka Hosi,

Ndzi mi losa hinkwenu hi vito ra Hosi ya hina Yesu Kreste, hikuva muponisi wa hina u tshame a byela valandzeri va yena a ku, ndzi mi vitana varhandziwa, hikuva mi rhandziwa hi Xikwembu, lexi tumbuluxeke tilo ni misava hi rirhandzu xi tlhela xi tumbuluxa tinyanyana ni swiharhi hi rirhandzu, naswona eku heteleleni xi tumbuluxile munhu hi xifaniso xa xona, na swona hi rirhandzu laha kutani eku heteleleni, loko Xikwembu xi hetile ku tumbuluxa, xi rhumile n'wana wa xona la tswariweke a ri yexe Yesu Kreste ku ta emisaveni a ta fela ntsena lava kholweke leswaku u huma etilweni a rhumiwa hi tata wa yena, hikuva misava a yi n'wi kholwanga naswona va n'wi vitanile hi mavito. Kambe lava n'wi amukeleke tanihi Hosi ni Muponisi va rhwala swihambano swa vona va n'wi landzela va vitaniwile Vakreste hikuva va landzele Kreste eka mikondzo ya yena ya nsuku.

Varhandziwa eka Hosi hinkwerhu ha swi tiva leswaku Hosi ya hina Yesu Kreste u xanisekile njhani emisaveni ku fikela siku ra ku vambiwa ka yena hikwalaho ka hina, kambe u hlurile rifu hikwalaho ka ku tiyisela naswona hi ku tshembeka eka Xikwembu tata wa yena. Swidyoho swa hina swi tlhele swi rivaleriwa. Endzhaku ka ku rivaleriwa swidyoho swa hina Hosi Yesu Kreste u hi endlile swirho swa miri wa yena naswona hi ve ni mfanelo hinkwayo ya ku vitaniwa vana va Xikwembu.

Varhandziwa Yesu Kreste u tshame a byela vadyondzisiwa va yena a ku, "Tatana i murimi wa nsimu naswona mina ndzi nsinya wa vhinya, n'wina mi marhavi eka nsinya lowu wa vhinya ku nga mina, rhavi rin'wana ni rin'wana leri nga tswaliki mihandzu ri ta susiwa ri hoxiwa ehandle ka nsimu ya vhinya kutani ri ta oma, naswona ri ta rholeriwa hi lava lavaka tihunyi kutani va ta endla ndzilo hi rona."

Vamakwerhu va vavanuna ni va vavasati lava rhandzekaka, malandza ni vamakwerhu va vavasati, tanihi leswi hinkwerhu sweswi hi twisisaka leswaku hi swirho eka miri lowu wa Kreste, a hi tiviseni leswaku Kreste i nhloko loyi a pfukeke exikarhi ka lava feke. Hi ku fanana na hina hi pfukile exikarhi ka lava feke. Hi ve vutomi leswaku sweswi hi nga ya emahlweni hi ponisa van'wana.

Ndzi lava ku nkhensa un'wana ni un'wana wa n'wina hi ku va ni mbilu yo leha leyi ringaneke naswona hi ku hi seketela eka ntirho wo tika ni wo bindza wo chumayela evhangeli ya rirhandzu ni ku rhula. Hi hlanganyetile swilo swo tala endleleni ya lembe leri hundzaka. Swin'wana a swi vava naswona swin'wana a swi fana ni mafenya, kambe Xikwembu i xikulu, hi dyondzisiwa nkarhi hinkwawo leswaku hi fanele ku nkhensa Hosi ya hina nkarhi hinkwawo hi swilo leswi hi hlanganyetaka na swona. Hinkwerhu ha swi tiva leswaku hambi ku ri munhu loyi a nga kholwiki eka Xikwembu, loko a ri emaxangwini, u ta nkarhi hinkwawo a ku "Oho, Xikwembu xanga". Sweswo swi hi komba leswaku nhlomulo wu nga ku tshineta kusuhi ni Xikwembu, naswona hi ku fanana ntsako wu nga hi endla leswaku hi rivala hi valala va hina.

A hi tlheleni hi tivonela eka swilo leswi hi swi vulavulaka, hikuva milomo ya hina yi nga vanga khombo exikarhi ka Xikwembu na hina. Hi langutane ni minkarhi yo tika, varhandziwa, laha diyavulosi a ambaleke swo basa tanihi vana va Xikwembu leswaku a nga voniwi hi ku olova, kambe moya wa Xikwembu wu ta tipaluxa nkarhi hinkwawo eka wena, ntsena loko u hlayisa milawu ya xona ya mune, ku nga:-

1. Hlayisa nkarhi wa mintirho ya wena hinkwayo.
2. Nyikela vukhume bya wena (hi tlhelo ra nyama).
3. Nyikela vukhume bya wena (hi tlhelo ra moya), naswona
4. Rhandza warikwenu, endzeni ka kereke ni le handle ka kereke.

Hi languterile ku nghena eka lembe ra 2000, leri ndzi nge ri ta va lembe ra mikateko. A hi nga rivali ku hlonipha malandza ya hina, hikuva i swihlovo swa hina leswi pfuriweke hi hina. A hi nga va thyakisi hikuva mundzuku u ta twa torha kutani u tsundzuka mati lawa u tshameke u ma nwa, naswona loko u ehleketa hi swilo swo thyaka leswi u swi endleke exihlobyeni, u ta titwa u vava kutani u ta fa hi torha. Tsundzukani varhandziwa va mina, xichavo i xilotlelo xa n'wina xo pfula, naswona rirhandzu i tlhari ra n'wina ro hlula eka lembe lerintshwa ra 2000.

XIKWEMBU XI MI KATEKISA HINKWENU.

Wa n'wina eka Kreste
N.V. MLANGENI
MUPOSTOLA WA NKULU/PURESIDENTE.

xh.title: Imibuliso kuwo onke amabandla
xh.message:
Bathandekayo eNkosini,

Ndiyanibulisa nonke egameni leNkosi yethu uYesu Kristu, kuba umsindisi wethu wakha wathi kubalandeli bakhe, ndinibiza ngokuba nibathandwa, kuba nithandwa nguThixo, owadala izulu nomhlaba ngothando kwaye wadala iintaka nezilwanyana ngothando, kwaye ekugqibeleni wadala umntu ngomfanekiso wakhe, nakwakhona ngothando apho ke ekugqibeleni, xa uThixo wagqiba ukudala, wathumela unyana wakhe okuphela kwamzeleyo uYesu Kristu owazalwa yedwa ukuba eze emhlabeni ukuze afele kuphela abo bakholelwayo ukuba uvela ezulwini wathunywa nguyise, kuba ihlabathi alizange limkholelwe baza bambiza ngamagama endaweni yoko. Kodwa abo bamamkelayo njengeNkosi noMsindisi bathwala iminqamlezo yabo bamlandela babizwa ngokuba ngamaKristu kuba balandela uKristu kumanyathelo akhe egolide.

Bathandekayo eNkosini sonke siyazi ukuba iNkosi yethu uYesu Kristu yeva ubunzima emhlabeni kude kube lusuku lokubethelelwa kwakhe emnqamlezweni ngenxa yethu, kodwa woyisa ukufa ngokunyamezela kwaye ngokunyaniseka kuThixo uyise. Izono zethu zaxolelwa ke. Emva kokuxolelwa kwezono zethu iNkosi uYesu Kristu yasenza saba ngamalungu omzimba wayo kwaye saba nalo lonke ilungelo lokubizwa ngokuba singabantwana bakaThixo.

Bathandekayo uYesu Kristu wakha wathi kubafundi bakhe, "Utata ngumlimi wam kwaye mna ndingumdiliya, nina ningamasebe kulo mdiliya ondim, lonke isebe elingathwali siqhamo liya kususwa liphoswe ngaphandle kwesidiliya lize lome, kwaye liya kucholwa ngabo bafuna iinkuni babaze umlilo ngalo."

Bazalwana nodade abathandekayo, magosa noodade, njengoko sonke ngoku siqonda ukuba singamalungu kulo mzimba kaKristu, masiqwalasele oku ukuba uKristu uyintloko ovukileyo kwabafileyo. Ngokukwanjalo nathi sivukile kwabafileyo. Sibe bubomi ukuze ngoku siphume siye kusindisa abanye.

Ndifuna ukunibulela nonke ngokuba nomonde owaneleyo kwaye nokusixhasa kulo msebenzi unzima nonzima wokushumayela ivangeli yothando noxolo. Sihlangabezane nezinto ezininzi kwindlela yalo nyaka uphumayo. Ezinye zazibuhlungu kwaye ezinye zazinjengeziqhulo, kodwa uThixo mkhulu, sifundiswa rhoqo ukuba simele sibulele iNkosi yethu rhoqo ngezinto esihlangabezana nazo. Sonke siyazi ukuba nomntu ongakholelwayo kuThixo, xa esengxakini, uya kusoloko esithi "Owu, Thixo wam". Oku kusibonisa ukuba usizi lungakusondeza kuThixo, kwaye ngokukwanjalo ubumnandi bunokusenza silibale ngotshaba lwethu.

Masikwalumkele izinto esizithethayo, kuba imilomo yethu inokubangela intlekele phakathi koThixo nathi. Sijamelene namaxesha anzima, bathandekayo, apho uMtyholi enxibe okumhlophe njengabantwana bakaThixo ukuze angaqatshelwa ngokulula, kodwa umoya kaThixo uya kuhlala uzityhila kuwe, kuphela ukuba ugcina imiyalelo yakhe emine, engale:-

1. Gcina ixesha lazo zonke iinkonzo zakho.
2. Nikela isishumi sakho (ngokwezinto eziphathekayo).
3. Nikela isishumi sakho (ngokomoya), kwaye
4. Thanda ummelwane wakho, ngaphakathi ecaweni nangaphandle kwecawe.

Sikhangele phambili ekungeneni kunyaka wama-2000, endithi uza kuba ngunyaka weentsikelelo. Masingalibali ukuhlonipha amagosa ethu, kuba ayimithombo yethu evulwe sithi. Masingawangcolisi kuba ngomso uya kunxanwa kwaye ukhumbule amanzi owawakha wawasela, kwaye nje ukuba ucinge ngezinto ezimdaka ozenzileyo emthonjeni, uya kuziva ukruqukile kwaye uya kufa lunxano. Khumbulani bathandekayo bam, intlonipho sisitshixo senu sokuvula, kwaye uthando sisixhobo senu sokoyisa kunyaka omtsha wama-2000.

UTHIXO ANISIKELELE NONKE.

Owakho kuKristu
N.V. MLANGENI
UMPOSTILE OYINTLOKO/UMONGAMELI.

zu.title: Imibuliso kuwo wonke amabandla
zu.message:
Bathandwa eNkosini,

Ngiyanibingelela nonke egameni leNkosi yethu uJesu Kristu, ngoba umsindisi wethu wake wathi kubalandeli bakhe, nginibiza ngokuthi bathandwa, ngoba nithandwa uNkulunkulu, owadala izulu nomhlaba ngothando, wadala izinyoni nezilwane ngothando, futhi ekugcineni wadala umuntu ngomfanekiso wakhe, nakho futhi ngothando, lapho wathi ekugcineni, uNkulunkulu eqeda ukudala, wathumela indodana yakhe ezelwe yodwa uJesu Kristu ukuba ize emhlabeni izofela kuphela labo abakholwayo ukuthi uvela ezulwini wathunywa nguyise, ngoba umhlaba awuzange umkholwe kodwa wambiza ngamagama. Kodwa labo abamamukela njengeNkosi nomsindisi bathwala iziphambano zabo bamlandela babizwa ngokuthi ngamaKrestu ngoba balandela uKrestu ezinyathelweni zakhe zegolide.

Bathandwa eNkosini sonke siyazi ukuthi iNkosi yethu uJesu Kristu yahlupheka kanjani emhlabeni kwaze kwaba lusuku lokubethelwa kwayo ngenxa yethu, kodwa yakunqoba ukufa ngokubekezela nangokwethembeka kuNkulunkulu uyise. Izono zethu zabe sezithethelelwa. Emva kokuthethelelwa kwezono zethu iNkosi uJesu Kristu yasenza saba amalungu omzimba wayo saba nelungelo lokubizwa ngokuthi singabantwana bakaNkulunkulu.

Bathandwa uJesu Kristu wake wathi kubafundi bakhe, "Ubaba ungumlimi wensimu kanti mina ngingumvini, nina ningamagatsha kulo mvini oyingimi, wonke amagatsha angatheli zithelo ayosuswa alahlwe ngaphandle kwesivini abese eyoma, azothathwa yilabo abadinga izinkuni babaze umlilo ngawo."

Bafowethu nodadewethu abathandekayo, zinceku nodadewethu, njengoba sonke sesiqonda manje ukuthi singamalungu omzimba kaKrestu, asikuqaphele lokhu ukuthi uKrestu uyinhloko evukile kwabafileyo. Ngokunjalo nathi sivukile kwabafileyo. Sesiyimpilo ukuze manje siphume siyosindisa abanye.

Ngifuna ukunibonga nonke ngokuba nesineke esanele nangokusisekela kulo msebenzi onzima nosindayo wokushumayela ivangeli lothando noxolo. Sihlangabezane nezinto eziningi endleleni yalo nyaka ophelayo. Ezinye zazibuhlungu futhi ezinye zazinjengamahlaya, kodwa uNkulunkulu mkhulu, sifundiswa njalo ukuthi kufanele sibonge iNkosi yethu njalo ngezinto esihlangabezana nazo. Sonke siyazi ukuthi ngisho nomuntu ongakholelwa kuNkulunkulu, uma esenkingeni, uhlale ethi "Awu, Nkulunkulu wami". Lokho kusikhombisa ukuthi usizi lungakusondeza kuNkulunkulu, futhi nenjabulo ingasenza sikhohlwe ngezitha zethu.

Masiphinde siqaphele ngezinto esizishoyo, ngoba imilomo yethu ingadala inhlekelele phakathi kukaNkulunkulu nathi. Sibhekene nezikhathi ezinzima, bathandwa, lapho usathane egqoke ezimhlophe njengabantwana bakaNkulunkulu ukuze angabonakali kalula, kodwa umoya kaNkulunkulu uyohlale uzibonakalisa kuwe, kuphela uma ugcina imiyalo yakhe emine, okungukuthi:-

1. Gcina isikhathi sako konke ukukhonza kwakho.
2. Nikela okweshumi kwakho (ngokwenyama).
3. Nikela okweshumi kwakho (ngokomoya), futhi
4. Thanda umakhelwane wakho, ngaphakathi esontweni nangaphandle kwesonto.

Sibheke ngabomvu ukungena onyakeni wezi-2000, engithi uzoba unyaka wezibusiso. Singakhohlwa ukuhlonipha izinceku zethu, ngoba ziyimithombo yethu evulwe yithi. Masingazingcolisi ngoba kusasa uyokoma ukhumbule amanzi owawaphuze, futhi uma ucabanga izinto ezingcolile ozenze emthonjeni, uzizwe ucika ufe ukoma. Khumbulani bathandwa bami, inhlonipho iwukhiye wenu wokuvula, nothando luyisikhali senu sokunqoba onyakeni omusha wezi-2000.

UNKULUNKULU ANIBUSISE NONKE.

Owenu kuKrestu
N.V. MLANGENI
UMPOSTOLI OMKHULU/UMONGAMELI.

nso.title: Ditumedišo go diphuthego ka moka
nso.message:
Barategi go Morena,

Ke le dumediša ka moka ka leina la Morena wa rena Jesu Kriste, gobane mophološi wa rena o kile a re go balatedi ba gagwe, ke le bitša barategi, gobane le a ratwa ke Modimo, yo a hlotšego legodimo le lefase ka lerato a ba a hlola dinonyana le diphoofolo ka lerato, mme mafelelong a hlola motho ka seswantšho sa gagwe, le gona ka lerato moo e rego mafelelong, ge Modimo a feditše go hlola, a romela morwa wa gagwe wa tswalwa a nnoši Jesu Kriste gore a tle mo lefaseng a hwele fela bao ba dumelago gore o tšwa legodimong a romilwe ke tatagwe, gobane lefase ga se la mo dumela mme ba mmitša ka maina a mangwe. Eupša bao ba mo amogetšego bjalo ka Morena le Mophološi ba ba ba rwala difampano tša bona ba mo latela ba be ba bitšwa Bakriste gobane ba latelela Kriste mehlaleng ya gagwe ya gauta.

Barategi go Morena ka moka ga rena re a tseba gore Morena wa rena Jesu Kriste o tlaišegile bjang mo lefaseng go fihlela letšatši la go bapolwa ga gagwe ka baka la rena, eupša o fentše lehu ka baka la kgotlelelo le gona ka go botegela Modimo tatagwe. Dibe tša rena di ile tša swarelwa. Ka morago ga tshwarelo ya dibe tša rena Morena Jesu Kriste o re dirile gore re be malokollo a mmele wa gagwe gomme ra ba le tokelo ka moka ya go bitšwa bana ba Modimo.

Barategi Jesu Kriste o kile a re go barutiwa ba gagwe, "Tate ke molemi gomme nna ke morara, lena le makala a morara wo e lego nna, lekala le lengwe le le lengwe le le sa enyego dienywa le tla tlošwa la lahlwa ka ntle ga serapa sa morara gomme le tla oma, le tla topša ke bao ba hlokago dikgong gomme ba tla di gotša mollo."

Bana bešo le dikgaetšedi tše rategago, bahlanka le dikgaetšedi, bjalo ka ge ga bjale re kwešiša ka moka gore re malokollo mmeleng wo wa Kriste, a re lemogeng se gore Kriste ke hlogo yeo e tsogilego bahung. Ka mo go swanago le rena re tsogile bahung. Re bile bophelo gore ga bjale re ka tšwela pele ra phološa ba bangwe.

Ke nyaka go leboga yo mongwe le yo mongwe wa lena ka go ba le kgotlelelo e lekanego le go re thekga mošomong o thata le o boima wa go rera ebangedi ya lerato le khutšo. Re gahlane le dilo tše dintši tseleng ya ngwaga wo o felago. Tše dingwe di be di le bohloko tše dingwe di be di swana le metlae, eupša Modimo ke o mogolo, re rutwa ka mehla gore re swanetše go leboga Morena wa rena ka mehla ka dilo tšeo re gahlanago le tšona. Ka moka ga rena re a tseba gore le motho yo a sa dumelego go Modimo, ge a le mathateng, o tla dula a re "Aowaa, Modimo wa ka". Seo se re bontšha gore tlalelo e ka go batametša kgauswi le Modimo, mme ka mo go swanago lethabo le lona le ka re lebatša ka manaba a rena.

A re hlokomeleng gape ka dilo tšeo re di bolelago, gobane melomo ya rena e ka baka masetlapelo magareng ga Modimo le rena. Re lebane le dinako tše thata, barategi, moo diabolo a apara tše tšhweu bjalo ka bana ba Modimo gore a se ke a lemogwa gabonolo, eupša moya wa Modimo o tla dula o ikutolla go wena, fela ge o boloka ditaelo tša gagwe tše nne, e lego:-

1. Boloka nako ya ditirelo tša gago ka moka.
2. Neela karolo ya gago ya lesome (ka dilo tša nama).
3. Neela karolo ya gago ya lesome (semoyeng), le
4. Rata moagišani wa gago, ka gare ga kereke le ka ntle ga kereke.

Re lebeletše pele go tsena ngwageng wa 2000, wo ke rego e tlo ba ngwaga wa ditšhegofatšo. A re se ke ra lebala go hlompha bahlanka ba rena, gobane ke methopo ya rena yeo e butšwego ke rena. A re se ke ra ba tšhilafatša gobane gosasa o tla nyorwa mme o gopole meetse ao o kilego wa a nwa, mme ge o gopola dilo tše ditšhila tšeo o di dirilego go mothopo, o tla ikwa o feroga dibete gomme o tla hwa ka lenyora. Gopolang barategi ba ka, tlhompho ke senotlelo sa lena sa go bula, gomme lerato ke sebetša sa lena sa go fenya ngwageng o moswa wa 2000.

MODIMO A LE ŠEGOFATŠE KA MOKA.

Wa lena go Kriste
N.V. MLANGENI
MOAPOSTOLA YO MOGOLO/MOPRESIDENTE.

en.title: TO ALL CONGREGATIONS OF THE TWELVE APOSTLES CHURCH IN CHRIST
en.message:
Beloved in Christ, I greet you.

As you all know that God has given us lions, and also gave us four offices, and healers, and nurses, and Priests as well as evangelists: God united us and bound us with His love and made us a golden chain that should be a ring so that all His children may stay inside it and be protected from the dangerous and evil things of the world.

It is sad to hear that there are still some of our brothers and sisters who say we worship, we praise our Lord and Saviour, yet they are still instigating strikes in our church which is so beautiful and which we love so much. They put wrong, evil spirits into some joints in this body of Christ, so that there may be no peace in the church, which is what the Lord wants. They create rebellion in the church, respect ends, whereas it is good to submit to one another.

Beloved I have said many times among you, wisdom comes to an end, but foolishness does not. The moment a person sees themselves as wiser than others, that is where their foolishness begins.

Beloved I thank you for your steadfastness that you have shown in this dying year. There have been good and bad things too; that we encountered on this journey, but we conquered the bad and kept the good alive.

I ask that you do not kill each other beloved, by leading each other into temptation, how? By having a sister or brother come to you and show you the badness of another brother or sister, or of the officer before you, or say to you "let us rebel against this officer". Know very well that you are rebelling against God Himself by doing so. If there is a matter between the two of you, sit down and fix it. That problem cannot fail to end because you both have the spirit of God and you submit to each other.

Enter then children of the Father with great blessing in the new year of 2001. Break bread at all times even if you are alone break it for yourself, so that the danger of darkness cannot enter among you and confuse you.

May God help us build this one body of Christ, so that we may be joints in it that work together in harmony. Likewise one heart that will be able to pump blood that will reach all joints so that all may live, and we thank the Lord in love as one.

May the Lord bless you all and your families.

I am Yours
NV Mlangeni
Apostle

st.title: HO DIPHUTHEHO TSOHLE TSA KEREKE EA BAAPOSTOLA BA LESHOMA LE METSO E 'MELI HO KRESTE
st.message:
Baratuoa ho Kreste, kea le lumelisa.

Joalokaha bohle le tseba hore Molimo o re file litau, mme a re fa le maemo a mane, le lingaka, le baoki, le Baprista hammoho le baevangeli: Molimo o re kopantse a re tlama ka lerato la Hae 'me a re etsa ketane ea khauta e lokelang ho ba reng hore bana ba Hae bohle ba lule kahare ho eona' me ba sireletsoe linthong tse kotsi le tse mpe tsa lefatše.

Ho utloisa bohloko ho utloa hore ho sa ntse ho e-na le ba bang ba bana babo rona le likhaitseli ba reng rea rapela, re rorisa Morena le 'Mopholosi oa rona, empa ba sa ntsane ba hlohlelletsa literaeke kerekeng ea rona e ntle haholo' me re e rata haholo. Ba beha meea e fosahetseng, e mpe manonyeletsong a mang 'meleng ona oa Kreste, hore ho se be le khotso kerekeng, eo Morena a e batlang. Ba theha borabele kerekeng, tlhompho ea fela, empa ho le molemo ho ikokobeletsana.

Baratuoa ke boletse hangata har'a lona, bohlale boa fela, empa bothoto ha bo fele. Motsotso oo motho a iponang a le bohlale ho feta ba bang, ke moo bothoto ba hae bo qalang teng.

Baratuoa kea le leboha ka botsitso ba lona boo le bo bontšitseng selemong sena se shoang. Ho bile le lintho tse ntle le tse mpe hape; tseo re kopaneng le tsona leetong lena, empa re hlōtse tse mpe ra boloka tse ntle li phela.

Ke kopa hore le se ke la bolaoana baratuoa, ka ho isana molekong, joang? Ka hore khaitseli kapa ngoan'eno a tle ho uena a u bontše bobe ba ngoan'eno e mong kapa khaitseli e 'ngoe, kapa ba mohlanka ea ka pel'a hao, kapa a re ho uena 'a re tsoheleng mohlanka enoa matla'. Tseba hantle hore u tsohela Molimo ka boeena matla ka ho etsa joalo. Haeba ho e-na le taba lipakeng tsa lona le le babeli, lulang fatše le e lokise. Bothata boo bo ke ke ba hloleha ho fela hobane bobeli ba lona le na le moea oa Molimo 'me lea ikokobeletsana.

Kenang he bana ba Ntate ka tlhohonolofatso e kholo selemong se secha sa 2001. Arolelanang bohobe ka linako tsohle esita le haeba le le bang le iarolele bona, e le hore kotsi ea lefifi e ke ke ea kena har'a lona ea le ferekanya.

Molimo a re thuse ho haha 'mele ona o le mong oa Kreste, hore re be manonyeletso ho oona a sebetsang' moho ka kutloano. Ka mokhoa o tšoanang pelo e le 'ngoe e tla khona ho pompa mali a tla fihla manonyeletsong 'ohle e le hore bohle ba phele,' me re leboha Morena leratong re le bang.

Morena a le hlohonolofatse bohle le malapa a lona.

Ke 'na Oa Lona
NV Mlangeni
Moapostola

ts.title: EKA MAVANDLHA HINKWAWO YA KEREKE YA VAPOSTOLA VA KHUME-MBIRHI EKA KRESTE
ts.message:
Varhandziwa eka Kreste, ndza mi losa.

Hilaha mi tivaka hakona hinkwenu leswaku Xikwembu xi hi nyikile tinghala, naswona xi hi nyikile na swikhundla swa mune, na tin'anga, na manesi, na Vaprista swin'we na vavangeli: Xikwembu xi hi hlanganisile xi hi boha hi rirhandzu ra Xona xi hi endla ncoti wa nsuku lowu faneleke ku va xingwavila leswaku vana va Xona hinkwavo va tshama endzeni ka xona va sirheleriwa eka swilo swo biha na swa khombo swa misava.

Swa twisa ku vava ku twa leswaku ka ha ri na vamakwerhu van'wana va vavanuna na vavasati lava nge ha gandzela, ha dzunisa Hosi na Muponisi wa hina, kambe vona va ha hlohletela switeleka ekerekeni ya hina leyi nga yo saseka swinene leyi hi yi rhandzaka ngopfu. Va hoxa mimoya yo biha, leyi hoxeke eka manon'wini man'wana eka miri lowu wa Kreste, leswaku ku nga vi na ku rhula ekerekeni, loku Hosi yi ku lavaka. Va endla vupfukeri ekerekeni, xichavo xa hela, kasi i swinene ku titsongahatelana.

Varhandziwa ndzi vurile kanyingi exikarhi ka n'wina, vutlhari bya hela, kambe vuphukuphuku a byi heli. Nkarhi lowu munhu a tivonaka a tlharihile ku tlula van'wana, hi laha vuphukuphuku bya yena byi sungulaka kona.

Varhandziwa ndza mi nkhensa hi ku tiya ka n'wina loku mi ku kombiseke eka lembe leri felaka. Ku vile na swilo swaswinene na swo biha nakambe; leswi hi hlanganyeteke na swona eka riendzo leri, kambe hi hlurile swo biha hi hlayisa swaswinene swi hanya.

Ndzi kombela leswaku mi nga dlayani varhandziwa, hi ku yisana endringweni, njhani? Hi ku va ku fika sesi kumbe makwenu eka wena a ku komba vubihi bya makwenu un'wana kumbe sesi, kumbe bya nandza loyi a nga emahlweni ka wena, kumbe a ku eka wena "a hi pfukeleni nandza loyi". Tiva kahle leswaku u pfukela Xikwembu hi xoxe hi ku endla tano. Loko ku ri na mhaka exikarhi ka n'wina vambirhi, tshamani ehansi mi yi lulamisa. Xiphiqo xexo xi nge tsandzeki ku hela hikuva mi na moya wa Xikwembu havambirhi naswona ma titsongahatelana.

Nghenani ke vana va Tatana hi mikateko leyikulu eka lembe lerintshwa ra 2001. Avelanani vuswa nkarhi hinkwawo hambiloko u ri wexe tiavele, leswaku khombo ra munyama ri nga koti ku nghena exikarhi ka n'wina ri mi pfilunganya.

Xikwembu a xi hi pfune ku aka miri lowu wun'we wa Kreste, leswaku hi ta va manon'wini eka wona lawa ya tirhisanaka hi ku twanana. Hilaha ku fanaka mbilu yin'we leyi nga ta kota ku pompa ngati leyi nga ta fika eka manon'wini hinkwawo leswaku hinkwavo va hanya, naswona hi nkhensa Hosi erirhandzwini hi ri un'we.

Hosi a yi mi katekise hinkwenu na mindyangu ya n'wina.

Hi mina Wa N'wina
NV Mlangeni
Mupostola

xh.title: KUWO ONKE AMABANDLA ECAWE YABAPOSTILE ABALISHUMI ELINESIBINI KUKRISTU
xh.message:
Bathandekayo kuKristu, ndiyanibulisa.

Njengoko nisazi nonke ukuba uThixo usinike iingonyama, wasinika nezikhundla ezine, namaxhwele, nabongikazi, nabaPristi kwanabavangeli: UThixo wasidibanisa wasibopha ngothando lwakhe wasenza ikhonkco legolide elifanele ukuba yiringi ukuze bonke abantwana bakhe bahlale ngaphakathi kwayo bakhuseleke kwizinto eziyingozi nezimbi zehlabathi.

Kuyadanisa ukuva ukuba basekho abanye babazalwana noodade bethu abathi sikhonza, sidumisa iNkosi noMsindisi wethu, kanti basaxhokonxa uqwayito (strikes) ecaweni yethu entle kangaka nesiyithanda kangaka. Bafaka imimoya engalunganga, emibi kwamanye amalungu kulo mzimba kaKristu, ukuba kungabikho xolo ecaweni, olufunwa yiNkosi. Badala imvukelo ecaweni, intlonipho iphele, kanti kuhle ukuthobelana.

Bathandekayo nditshilo kaninzi phakathi kwenu ndathi, ubulumko buyaphela, kodwa ubuyatha abupheli. Umntu ngelixa ezibona elumkile kunabanye, kulapho ke buqala khona ubuyatha bakhe.

Bathandekayo ndiyanibulela ngokuzinza kwenu enikubonisileyo kulo nyaka ufayo. Kubekho izinto ezintle nezimbi kwakhona; esihlangabezane nazo kolu hambo, kodwa sizoyisile ezimbi sagcina ezintle ziphila.

Ndicela ukuba ningabulalani bathandekayo, ngokukhokelana esilingweni, njani? Ngokuba kufike udade okanye umzalwana kuwe akubonise ububi bomnye umzalwana okanye udade, okanye besicaka esiphambi kwakho, okanye athi kuwe "masivukele esi sicaka". Yazi kakuhle ukuba uvukela uThixo ngokwakhe ngokwenza njalo. Ukuba kukho umcimbi phakathi kwenu nobabini, hlalani phantsi niwulungise. Loo ngxaki inakho ukungapheli kuba ninomoya kaThixo nobabini kwaye niyathobelana.

Ngenani ke bantwana boBawo ngentsikelelo enkulu kunyaka omtsha ka-2001. Qhekezani isonka ngawo onke amaxesha nokuba uwedwa ziqhekezele, ukuze ingozi yobumnyama ingakwazi ukungena phakathi kwenu inibhidanise.

UThixo masincede sakhe lo mzimba mnye kaKristu, ukuze sibe ngamalungu kuwo asebenzisana ngemvisiswano. Ngokukwanjalo nentliziyo enye eya kukwazi ukuphompa igazi eliya kufikelela kuwo onke amalungu ukuze onke aphile, kwaye siyibulela iNkosi eluthandweni simunye.

INkosi inisikelele nonke neentsapho zenu.

Ndim Owenu
NV Mlangeni
UMpostile

zu.title: KUMABANDLA WONKE ENKONZO YABA - POSTOLI ABALISHUMI NAMBILI KU-KRISTU
zu.message:
Bathandwa ku-Kristu, ngiyanibingelela.
