Njengoba nazi nonke ukuthi u Thixo, usinike, izingonyama, wasinika futhi neziqu ezine, nezinyanga, namanesi, naba Pristi kanjalo nabashumayeli: Wasihlanganisa u Thixo wasibopha ngothando Iwakhe wasenza saba yiketango (chain) legolide ekufanele ukuthi libe yindingilizi (ring) ukuze bonke abantwana bakhe bahlale phakathi kwayo bavikeleke ezintweni ezinobungozi, nezimbi zelizwe.

Kuyadabukisa ukuzwa ukuthi kusekhona abanye abafowethu nodadewethu esithi sikhonza, sidumisa inkosi yethu nomsindisi, bona babe besagqugquzela iziteleka (strikes) enkonzweni yethu enhle kangaka, nesiyithanda kangaka. Bafake imimoya engalunganga, emibi kwamanye amalunga Kulomzimba ka-kristu, ukuthi kungabikhona ukuthula enkonzweni, okufunwa yinkosi. Badale ukuvukelana enkonzweni, ukuhloniphana kuphele, kanti kuhle ukuthobelana.

Bathandwa ngasho kaningi phakathi kwenu ngathi, ukuhlakanipha kuyaphela, kepha ubilima abupheli. Umuntu ngalesikhathi ezibona ukuthi yena uhlakaniphile kunabanye, yilapho-ke bunqala khona ubu-phukuphuku bakhe.

Bathandwa ngiyanibonga ngobunqutho benu enibutshengisile kulonyaka ofayo. Kubekhona izinto ezinhle nezimbi futhi; esihlangabezane nazo kulendiela, kodwa sizehlulike ezimbi saziphilisa ezinhle.

Ngicela ukuthi nigabulalani bathandwa, ngokufakana ekulingweni, kanjani na? Ngokuthi kufike omunye undadewenu noma umfowenu kuwe akutshengise ububi bomuye umfowenu noma udadewenu, noma benceku emphambi kwakho, moma athi kuwe "asiyivukele lenceku". Yazi kahle kamhlophe ukuthi usuvukela u Thixo uqobo-Iwakhe ngokwenzenjalo. Uma kukhona indaba phakathi kwenu nobabili, hlalani phansi niyilungise. Angeke inga pheli leyonkinga ngoba ninomya ka Thixo nobabili niyathobelana.

Ngenani-ke batwnana baka-Baba ngokubusiseka okukhulu onyakeni omusha ka 2001. Nihlephule isinkwa ngaso sonke isikhathi ngisho noma uwendwa uzihlephulele, ukuze ingozi yobumnyama ingakwazi ukungena phakathi kwenu inidunge.

Unkulunkulu asisize siwakhe lomzimba owodwa ka-kristu, ukuze thina sibe ngamalunga kuwona asebenzisana ngkuzwana. Kanjalo nenhliziyo eyodwa ezokwazi, uku-pompa igazi eliyofinyelela kuwo wonke amalunga ukuze wonke aphile, siyibonge inkosi eluthando simunye.

Inkosi inibusise nonke kanye nemindeni yenu.

Yimi Owenu
NV Mlangeni
U Mpostoli

nso.title: GO DIPHUTHEGO KA MOKA TŠA KEREKE YA BAAPOSTOLA BA LESOMEPEDI GO KRISTE
nso.message:
Barategi go Kriste, ke a le dumediša.

Bjalo ka ge le tseba ka moka gore Modimo o re file ditau, a ba a re fa maemo a mane, le dingaka, le baoki, le Baprista go akaretša le baebangedi: Modimo o re kopantše a re tlema ka lerato la Gagwe a re dira ketane ya gauta yeo e swanetšego go ba palamonwana gore bana ba Gagwe ka moka ba dule ka gare ga yona mme ba šireletšwe dilong tše kotsi le tše mpe tša lefase.

Go a nyamiša go kwa gore go sa na le ba bangwe ba bana babo rena le dikgaetšedi bao ba rego re a rapela, re tumiša Morena le Mophološi wa rena, eupša ba sa hlohletša diteraeke kerekeng ya rena yeo e lego e botse yeo re e ratago gakaaka. Ba tsenya meoya e fošagetšego, e mpe go malokollo a mangwe mmeleng wo wa Kriste, gore go se ke gwa ba le khutšo kerekeng, yeo Morena a e nyakago. Ba baka borabele kerekeng, tlhompho e a fela, mola go le botse go ikokobeletšana.

Barategi ke boletše gantši gare ga lena, bohlale bo a fela, eupša bošilo ga bo fele. Motsotso wo motho a iponago a le bohlale go phala ba bangwe, ke moo bošilo bja gagwe bo thomago gona.

Barategi ke le leboga ka go tia ga lena mo le go bontšhitšego ngwageng wo o felago. Go bile le dilo tše dibotse le tše mpe gape; tšeo re kopanego le tšona leetong le, eupša re fentše tše mpe ra phediša tše dibotse.

Ke kgopela gore le se ke la bolayana barategi, ka go išana molekong, bjang? Ka gore kgaetšedi goba ngwaneno a tle go wena a go bontšhe bobe bja ngwaneno goba kgaetšedi ye nngwe, goba bja mohlanka yo a lego pele ga gago, goba a re go wena "a re tsogeleng mohlanka yo madira". Tseba gabotse gore o tsogela Modimo ka noši madira ka go dira bjalo. Ge go na le taba magareng ga lena le le babedi, dulang fase le e lokiše. Bothata bjoo bo ka se palelwe ke go fela gobane bobedi bja lena le na le moya wa Modimo gomme le a ikokobeletšana.

Tsenang gona bana ba Tate ka tšhegofatšo e kgolo ngwageng o moswa wa 2001. Arolelanang senkgwa ka dinako tšohle le ge o le noši arolelana, gore kotsi ya leswiswi e se ke ya tsena gare ga lena ya le ferekanya.

Modimo a re thuše go aga mmele wo o tee wa Kriste, gore re be malokollo go wona a šomisanago ka kwano. Ka mo go swanago pelo e tee yeo e tlogo kgona go pompa madi ao a tlago fihla malokollong ka moka gore ka moka a phele, gomme re leboge Morena leratong re le batee.

Morena a le šegofatše ka moka le malapa a lena.

Ke nna wa Lena
NV Mlangeni
Moapostola

en.title: 2001 - 2002 FESTIVE GREETINGS
en.message:
Beloved in the Lord,

I greet you all in the name of our Lord Jesus Christ. I want to thank you all for your perseverance in the out going year, I know some of you went through many unpleasant situations, but, through perseverance you were able to overcome all that, through our Lord Jesus Christ and our officers whom we are blessed with by our living apostle. Let us praise the Lord again in the new coming year of 2002, beloved, we have seen the good fruits of the teachings of childhood. We learn about the disciples of Jesus Christ who at one time approached the Lord and asked him a question and said, "Lord : who is the greatest in the kingdom of heaven?"

We learn that Jesus called a little child unto him and set him in the midst of them, and said, verily I say unto you, except ye be converted, and become as little children, ye shall not enter into the kingdom of heaven. Whosoever therefore shall humble himself as this little child, the same is greatest in the Kingdom of heaven. My beloved, I call unto you all let us not dispise the word that comes from above, because if we dispise and criticize the officers given to us by the living apostles we shall be decreasing our blessings. Blessed are those who humble themselves as little children for they will be uplifted on their last days.

My dear brother and sisters, let us learn to forgive those who trespass against us so that we can also be forgiven our trespasses one day by the Lord.

I want to wish you all well in the new year, may God Almighty through his son Jesus Christ and living apostles pour his blessings and better life to all of you and your families.

Your humble servant
N.V. MLANGENI
Chief Apostle / President

st.title: LITUMELISO TSA MATSATSI A PHOMOLO TSA 2001 - 2002
st.message:
Baratuoa Moreneng,

Kea le lumelisa bohle ka lebitso la Morena oa rona Jesu Kreste. Ke batla ho le leboha bohle ka mamello ea lona selemong se fetang, kea tseba hore ba bang ba lona ba fetile maemong a mangata a sa thabiseng, empa, ka mamello le khonne ho hlola tsena tsohle, ka Morena oa rona Jesu Kreste le basebeletsi ba rona bao re hlohonolofalitsweng ka bona ke moapostola oa rona ea phelang. A re roriseng Morena hape selemong se secha se tlang sa 2002, baratuoa, re bone litholoana tse ntle tsa lithuto tsa bongoaneng. Re ithuta ka barutuoa ba Jesu Kreste ba kileng ba ea ho Morena mme ba mo botsa potso ba re, "Morena : e moholo 'musong oa leholimo ke ofe?"

Re ithuta hore Jesu o ile a bitsa ngoana e monyenyane 'me a mo beha har'a bona, mme a re, kannete ke re ho lona, haese ha le ka sokoloha, mme la ba joaloka bana ba banyenyane, le ke ke la kena 'musong oa leholimo. Kahoo mang kapa mang ea ikokobetsang joaloka ngoana enoa e monyenyane, ke eena e moholo 'Musong oa leholimo. Baratuoa ba ka, ke ipiletsa ho lona bohle hore re se ke ra nyelisa lentsoe le tsoang holimo, hobane haeba re nyelisa 'me re tšoaea liphoso liofisiri tseo re li filoeng ke baapostola ba phelang re tla be re fokotsa litlhohonolofatso tsa rona. Ho hlohonolofalitsoe ba ikokobetsang joaloka bana ba banyenyane hobane ba tla phahamisoa matsatsing a bona a ho qetela.

Bana beso ba ratehang le likhaitseli, a re ithuteng ho tšoarela ba re siteloang e le hore le rona re ka tšoareloa litšito tsa rona ka tsatsi le leng ke Morena.

Ke le lakaletsa tse ntle selemong se secha, eka Molimo ea Matla 'Ohle ka mora oa hae Jesu Kreste le baapostola ba phelang a ka tšollela litlhohonolofatso tsa hae le bophelo bo betere ho lona bohle le malapeng a lona.

Mohlanka oa lona ea ikokobelitseng
N.V. MLANGENI
Moapostola e Moholo / Mopresidente

ts.title: SWILUMISO SWA TIHOLIDE SWA 2001 - 2002
ts.message:
Varhandziwa eka Hosi,

Ndzi mi losa hinkwenu hi vito ra Hosi ya hina Yesu Kreste. Ndzi lava ku mi nkhensa hinkwenu hi ku tiyisela ka n'wina eka lembe leri hundzaka, ndza swi tiva leswaku van'wana va n'wina mi hundzile eka swiyimo swo tala swo ka swi nga tsakisi, kambe, hi ku tiyisela mi kotile ku hlula sweswo hinkwaswo, hi Hosi ya hina Yesu Kreste na malandza ya hina lawa hi katekisiweke ha wona hi mupostola wa hina la hanyaka. A hi dzuniseni Hosi nakambe eka lembe lerintshwa leri taka ra 2002, varhandziwa, hi vonile mihandzu leyinene ya tidyondzo ta vuhlangi. Hi dyondza hi vadyondzisiwa va Yesu Kreste lava hi nkarhi wun'wana va yeke eka Hosi va yi vutisa xivutiso va ku, "Hosi : i mani lonkulu emfunghweni wa tilo?"

Hi dyondza leswaku Yesu u vitanile n'wana lontsongo a n'wi veka exikarhi ka vona, kutani a ku, ndzi tiyisile ndzi ri eka n'wina, loko mi nga hundzuki, mi va tanihi vana lavatsongo, a mi nga ngheni emfunghweni wa tilo. Hikokwalaho loyi a titsongahataka tanihi n'wana loyi lontsongo, hi yena lonkulu eMfunghweni wa tilo. Varhandziwa va mina, ndza mi kombela hinkwenu leswaku hi nga rhandziwi rito leri humaka ehenhla, hikuva loko hi tsan'wa ni ku sola malandza lawa hi nyikiweke wona hi vapostola lava hanyaka hi ta va hi hunguta mikateko ya hina. Va katekile lava titsongahataka tanihi vana lavatsongo hikuva va ta tlakusiwa emasikwini ya vona yo hetelela.

Vamakwerhu va vavanuna ni va vavasati lava rhandzekaka, a hi dyondzeni ku rivalela lava hi dyohelaka leswaku na hina hi ta rivaleriwa swidyoho swa hina siku rin'wana hi Hosi.

Ndzi mi navelela leswinene eka lembe lerintshwa, Xikwembu xa Matimba Hinkwawo hi ku tirhisa n'wana wa xona Yesu Kreste na vapostola lava hanyaka a xi chululele mikateko ya xona ni vutomi byo antswa eka n'wina hinkwenu ni le mindyangwini ya n'wina.

Nandza wa n'wina la titsongahataka
N.V. MLANGENI
Mupostola wa Nkulu / Puresidente

xh.title: IMIBULISO YEHOLIDE YANGO-2001 - 2002
xh.message:
Bathandekayo eNkosini,

Ndiyanibulisa nonke egameni leNkosi yethu uYesu Kristu. Ndifuna ukunibulela nonke ngokunyamezela kwenu kunyaka ophelayo, ndiyazi ukuba abanye benu badlule kwiimeko ezininzi ezingathandekiyo, kodwa, ngokunyamezela nikwazile ukoyisa konke oko, ngeNkosi yethu uYesu Kristu namagosa ethu esisikelelwe ngawo ngumpostile wethu ophilayo. Masidamise iNkosi kwakhona kunyaka omtsha ozayo wama-2002, bathandekayo, sizibonile iziqhamo ezilungileyo zeemfundiso zobuntwana. Sifunda ngabafundi bakaYesu Kristu abakha baya eNkosini bayibuza umbuzo bathi, "Nkosi : ngubani oyena mkhulu ebukumkanini bamazulu?"

Sifunda ukuba uYesu wabiza umntwana omncinci wambeka phakathi kwabo, wathi, inene ndithi kuni, ngaphandle kokuba niguquke, nibe njengabantwana abancinci, aniyi kungena ebukumkanini bamazulu. Ngoko ke osukuba eziyisa njengalo mntwana mncinci, lowo ngoyena mkhulu ebukumkanini bamazulu. Bathandekayo bam, ndiyanibongoza nonke ukuba singalidelili ilizwi elivela phezulu, kuba ukuba sidelela kwaye sigxeka amagosa esinikwe wona ngabapostile abaphilayo siya kuba siphungula iintsikelelo zethu. Basikelelwe abo bazithobayo njengabantwana abancinci kuba baya kuphakanyiswa ngeentsuku zabo zokugqibela.

Bazalwana namadade abathandekayo, masifunde ukuxolela abo basonayo ukuze nathi sixolelwe iziphoso zethu ngenye imini yiNkosi.

Ndininqwenelela okuhle kunyaka omtsha, wanga uThixo uSomandla ngonyana wakhe uYesu Kristu nabapostile abaphilayo angathululela iintsikelelo zakhe kunye nobomi obungcono kuni nonke nakwiintsapho zenu.

Isicaka senu esithobekileyo
N.V. MLANGENI
UMpostile oyiNtloko / UMongameli

zu.title: IMIBULISO YAMAHOLIDI YA-2001 - 2002
zu.message:
Bathandwa eNkosini,

Ngiyanibingelela nonke egameni leNkosi yethu uJesu Krestu. Ngifuna ukunibonga nonke ngokubekezela kwenu onyakeni ophelayo, ngiyazi ukuthi abanye benu badlule ezimweni eziningi ezingezinhle, kodwa, ngokubekezela nikwazile ukunqoba konke lokho, ngoJesu Krestu iNkosi yethu nezinceku zethu esibusiswe ngazo ngumpostoli wethu ophilayo. Masidumise iNkosi futhi onyakeni omusha ozayo wezi-2002, bathandwa, sizibonile izithelo ezinhle zezimfundiso zobuntwana. Sifunda ngabafundi bakaJesu Krestu ngesinye isikhathi abaya eNkosini bayibuza umbuzo bathi, "Nkosi : ngubani omkhulu embusweni wezulu?"

Sifunda ukuthi uJesu wabiza umntwana omncane wambeka phakathi kwabo, wathi, ngiqinisile ngithi kini, ngaphandle kokuba niphenduke, nibe njengabantwana abancane, aniyikungena embusweni wezulu. Ngalokho-ke ozithobayo njengalo mntwana omncane, uyena omkhulu embusweni wezulu. Bathandwa bami, ngiyaninxusa nonke ukuba singalideleli izwi elivela phezulu, ngoba uma sidelela futhi sigxeka izinceku esizinikwe ngabapostoli abaphilayo siyobe sinciphisa izibusiso zethu. Babusisiwe abazithobayo njengabantwana abancane ngoba bayophakanyiswa ngezinsuku zabo zokugcina.

Bafowethu nodadewethu abathandekayo, masifunde ukuthethelela abasonayo ukuze nathi sithethelelwe iziphambeko zethu ngelinye ilanga yiNkosi.

Nginifisela okuhle kodwa onyakeni omusha, uNkulunkulu uMninimandla onke ngendodana yakhe uJesu Krestu nabapostoli abaphilayo anithululele izibusiso zakhe nempilo engcono kinina nonke nasemindenini yenu.

Inceku yenu ethobekile
N.V. MLANGENI
UMpostoli Omkhulu / UMongameli

nso.title: DITUMEDIŠO TŠA MATŠATŠI A MAKHUTŠO A 2001 - 2002
nso.message:
Barategi go Morena,

Ke le dumediša ka moka ka leina la Morena wa rena Jesu Kriste. Ke nyaka go le leboga ka moka ka kgotlelelo ya lena ngwageng wo o felago, ke a tseba gore ba bangwe ba lena ba fetile maemong a mantši a sa thabišego, eupša, ka kgotlelelo le kgonne go fenya tšeo ka moka, ka Morena wa rena Jesu Kriste le bahlanka ba rena bao re šegofaditšwego ka bona ke moapostola wa rena yo a phelago. A re tumišeng Morena gape ngwageng o moswa o tlang wa 2002, barategi, re bone dienywa tše dibotse tša dithuto tša bjana. Re ithuta ka barutiwa ba Jesu Kriste bao ka nako ye nngwe ba ilego go Morena mme ba mmotšiša potšišo ba re, "Morena : yo mogolo mmušong wa legodimo ke mang?"

Re ithuta gore Jesu o ile a bitša ngwana o monyenyane a mmea gare ga bona, gomme a re, ruri ke a le botša, ntle le ge le ka sokologa, la ba bjalo ka bana ba banyenyane, le ka se tsene mmušong wa legodimo. Ka gona mang le mang yo a ikokobetšago bjalo ka ngwana yo monyenyane, ke yena e lego yo mogolo mmušong wa legodimo. Barategi ba ka, ke a le ipiletša gore re se ke ra nyatša lentšu leo le tšwago godimo, gobane ge re nyatša le go swaya diphošo bahlanka bao re ba filwego ke baapostola ba ba phelago re tla be re fokotša ditšhegofatšo tša rena. Go šegofaditšwe bao ba ikokobetšago bjalo ka bana ba banyenyane gobane ba tla phagamišwa matšatšing a bona a mafelelo.

Bana bešo le dikgaetšedi tše rategago, a re ithuteng go lebalela bao ba re foseditšego gore le rena re lebalelwe diphošo tša rena ka letšatši le lengwe ke Morena.

Ke lakaletša gore le be gabotse ngwageng o moswa, eka Modimo Ramatlaohle ka morwa wa gagwe Jesu Kriste le baapostola ba ba phelago a ka tšhollela ditšhegofatšo tša gagwe le bophelo bjo bokaone go lena ka moka le malapeng a lena.

Mohlanka wa lena yo a ikokobeditšego
N.V. MLANGENI
Moapostola yo Mogolo / Mopresidente

en.title: Apostle's Greeting to All Congregations
en.message:
Beloved in Christ,

I write this greeting with great joy, and amazing love for you all, children of God who were loved by our Lord Jesus Christ, who died for us on the cross so that we may be forgiven our sins. And I write this greeting happy about the good works and deeds you have done this year. I cannot count the bad works, where the evil one was also trying to put a baboon's foot into the good works of God.

I don't believe that there is even one person who is still confused today in our church, because I told you, the evil one does not like a good thing. He finds the people of the Lord united, praising, together, being one thing, he comes and tries to separate them, he puts a spirit of misunderstanding even among the officers so they fight, and there is no harmony.

Let me ask you children of God; Do you enjoy seeing male or female officers fighting because of you or for your sake? Let me come to you as male and female officers; would it please you if there was no peace in your homes, children fighting and bringing out bad weapons against each other? Have we forgotten that we were bought at a very high price? There is no one with money like that which bought us. Do you know that money that bought us? It is indeed the blood of the Lord Jesus Christ which was shed on the cross, the day he died for our sins. We were bought with that blood. Think about how painful it was for that man.

We should not be like people who don't think, and who don't care about their lives, even though we were suffered for so much. Such love with which we were loved, until we were called beloved because we are loved by the Lord. Beloved there is no one who can say they do not know what they were called for in this church except to work for the salvation of their soul and those of their family who have passed on from the world.

You find a person doing things contrary to righteousness, forgetting to pray for themselves. There is nothing difficult or heavy in this church of God as long as we are like teachable children, who keep his laws. Let us be the ground that receives water coming from the Throne, through these three rivers. What is the Throne? It is indeed the Apostle himself, where there is everything that gives life. What are these three rivers? The first is the shepherd the Overseer, the second is the evangelist, the third is the Prophet.

Listen beloved: The evangelist fetches them from the world with love and peace and brings them to heaven, then they are shepherded with love and truth by the Shepherd, then they are warned by the prophet. They know the place they are in how safe it is, and what God expects his people to do. And the danger that is present and coming they are made aware by the Prophet. If it is a good thing the anointed or the shepherd opens it, but if it is a bad thing the shepherd is given power to close it so it doesn't happen.

Beloved in the Lord, you can see for yourself how much God loves us. That is why he says: any congregation that does not have the spirit of prophecy is dead together with its works.

Beloved, I wish you blessings and good health in the new year and all your families. Shine children of light. Let us fold up the old year of 2002 and its events, forgive each other for all we have wronged each other, and enter all of us new into 2003, having thrown away all old rags. Let us burn all calendars, and old books, let us respect each other, love each other, be patient with each other, and stop looking down on each other.

Down with cases! Down with gossip! Up with works! May God bless you.

I am yours in Christ
NV MLANGENI
CHIEF/PRESIDENT

st.title: Tumeliso Ea Moapostola Ho Diphutheho Tsohle
st.message:
Baratuoa ho Kreste

Ke le ngolla tumeliso ena ke e-na le thabo e kholo, le lerato le makatsang ho lona bohle bana ba Molimo ba ratiloeng ke morena oa rona Jesu Kreste, ea re shoeletseng sefapanong hore re tšoareloe libe tsa rona. Hape ke ngola tumeliso ena ke thabile ka mesebetsi le liketso tse ntle tseo le li entseng selemong sena. Nka se bale mesebetsi e mpe, moo ea khopo le eena a neng a leka ho kenya leoto la tšoene mesebetsing ea Molimo e metle hakaalo.

Ha ke lumele hore ho na le ea mong ea ntseng a ferekane kajeno kerekeng ena ea rona, hobane 'na ke le boleletse, ea khopo ha a rate ntho e ntle. O fumana batho ba morena ba kopane ba rorisa, ba le 'moho, e le ntho e le' ngoe, a tle a leke ho ba arola, a kenye le moea oa ho se utloane le ho basebeletsi hore ba loane, ho se be le kutloano.

A ke botse bana ba Molimo; Na lea thabela ho bona basebeletsi ba banna kapa ba basali ba loana ka lebaka la lona? E re ke tle ho lona joaloka basebeletsi ba banna le ba basali; na ho ka le thabisa haeba ho ne ho se na khotso malapeng a lona, bana ba loana ba ntsetsana libetsa tse mpe? Na re lebetse hore re rekiloe ka theko e phahameng haholo? Ha ho na le ea mong ea nang le chelete e joalo ka e re rekileng. Na chelete eo e re rekileng lea e tseba? Ehlile ke mali a morena Jesu Kreste a ileng a tšolloa sefapanong, tsatsing leo a shoelang libe tsa rona. Re rekiloe ka mali ao. Nahana le uena hore ho ne ho le bohloko hakaakang ho monna eo.

Ha rea lokela ho tšoana le batho ba sa nahaneng, ba sa tsotelleng maphelo a bona, leha re hlokofalitsoe hakaalo. Lerato le lekaakang leo re ratiloeng ka lona, ho fihlela re bitsoa baratuoa hobane re ratoa ke morena. Baratuoa ha ho na ea ka reng ha a tsebe hore o biletselitsoe eng kerekeng ena ntle le ho tl'o sebeletsa poloko ea moea oa hae le ba lelapa la hae ba seng ba fetile lefatšeng.

O fumana motho a etsa lintho tse fapaneng le ho loka, a lebetse ho ithapella. Ha ho letho le thata kapa le boima kerekeng ena ea Molimo ha feela re tšoana le bana ba rutohang, ba bolokang melao ea hae. A re beng mobu o amohelang metsi a tsoang Teroneng, ka linoka tsena tse tharo. Terone ke eng? Ehlile ke Moapostola ka boeena, moo ho nang le tsohle tse phelisang. Linoka tsena tse tharo tsona ke eng? E ea pele ke molisa Molebeli, ea bobeli ke moevangeli, ea boraro ke Moprofeta.

Mamelang baratuoa: Moevangeli o ba lata lefatšeng ka lerato le khotso a ba tlise leholimong, ebe ba lisoa ka lerato le 'nete ke Molisa, ebe ba lemosoa ke moprofeta. Ba tseba sebaka seo ba leng ho sona hore se bolokehile hakaakang, le hore Molimo o lebeletse eng hore batho ba hae ba se etse. Le kotsi e leng teng le e tlang ba tsebisoe ke Moprofeta. Haeba e le ntho e ntle motlotsuoa kapa molisa o ea e bula, empa haeba e le ntho e mpe molisa o filoe matla a ho e koala hore e se ke ea etsahala.

Baratuoa Moreneng, le ka iponela ka bolona hore Molimo o re rata hakaakang. Ke kahoo a reng: phutheho efe kapa efe e se nang moea oa boprofeta e shoele hammoho le mesebetsi ea eona.

Baratuoa, ke le lakaletsa litlhohonolofatso le bophelo bo botle selemong se secha le malapa a lona 'ohle. Khanyang bana ba leseli. A re phutheng selemo sa khale sa 2002 le liketsahalo tsa sona, re tšoarelane ho tsohle tseo re foseditsaneng ho tsona, re kene bohle re le bacha ho 2003, re lahlile makatana 'ohle a khale. A re cheseng lik'halendara tsohle, le libuka tsa khale re hlomphane, re ratane, re be le mamello, re tlohele ho nyelisana.

Fatše ka linyeoe! Fatše ka leshano! Holimo ka mesebetsi! Molimo a le hlohonolofatse.

Ke 'na oa lona ho Kreste
NV MLANGENI
MOAPOSTOLA E MOHOLO/MOPRESIDENTE

ts.title: Xilumiso Xa Mupostola Eka Mavandlha Hinkwawo
ts.message:
Varhandziwa eka Kreste

Ndzi mi tsalela xilumiso lexi ndzi ri na ntsako lowukulu, na rirhandzu ro hlamarisa eka n'wina hinkwenu vana va Xikwembu lava rhandziweke hi Hosi ya hina Yesu Kreste, loyi a hi feleke exihambanweni leswaku hi rivaleriwa swidyoho swa hina. Naswona ndzi tsala xilumiso lexi ndzi tsakile hi mintirho na swiendlo swaswinene leswi mi swi endleke eka lembe leri. A ndzi nge hlayi mintirho yo biha, laha lowo biha na yena a a ri karhi a ringeta ku hoxa nenge wa mfenhe eka mintirho ya Xikwembu yo saseka swonghasi.

A ndzi kholwi leswaku ku na hambi a ri un'we loyi a ha pfilunganyekeke namuntlha ekerekeni leyi ya hina, hikuva mina ndzi mi byelile, lowo biha a nga rhandzi nchumu wunene. U kuma vanhu va Hosi va ri un'we va dzunisa, va hlangene, va ri nchumu wun'we, a ta a ringeta ku va hambanisa, a hoxa na moya wa ku nga twanani na le ka malandza va lwa, ku nga vi na ku twanana.

A ndzi vutisi vana va Xikwembu; Xana ma swi tsakela ku vona malandza ya vavanuna kumbe ya vavasati va lwa hikwalaho ka wena kumbe ka n'wina? Ndzi tlhela ndzi ta eka n'wina tanihi malandza ya vavanuna na ya vavasati; xana swi nga mi tsakisa loko ku nga ri na ku rhula emindyangwini ya n'wina, vana va lwa va humeselana matlhari yo biha? Xana ha rivala leswaku hina hi xaviwe hi ntsengo wa le henhla swinene? A ku na ni un'we loyi a nga na mali yo fana na yoleyo leyi nga hi xava. Xana mali yoleyo leyi nga hi xava ma yi tiva? Phela i ngati ya Hosi Yesu Kreste leyi halatiweke exihambanweni, siku a fela swidyoho swa hina. Hi xaviwe hi ngati yoleyo. Ehleketa na wena leswaku a swi vava ku fikela kwihi eka wanuna yoloye.

A hi fanelanga ku fana na vanhu lava nga ehleketiki, lava nga khathaleliki vutomi bya vona, hambileswi hi xanisekeke swonghasi. Rirhandzu lerikulu leri hi rhandziweke ha rona, ku fikela laha hi vitaniweke varhandziwa hikuva hi rhandziwa hi Hosi. Varhandziwa a ku na ni un'we loyi a nga vulaka leswaku a nga tivi leswaku u vitaneriwe yini ekerekeni leyi handle ko ta tirhela ku ponisiwa ka moya wa yena na va ndyangu wa yena lava hundzeke emisaveni.

U kuma munhu a endla swilo leswi hambaneke na vululami, a rivala ku tikhongelela. A ku na nchumu wo tika kumbe wo bindza ekerekeni leyi ya Xikwembu ntsena loko hi fana na vana lava dyondzisekaka, lava hlayisaka milawu ya xona. A hi veni misava leyi amukelaka mati lama humaka eXiluvelweni, hi milambu leyi yinharhu. Xiluvelo i yini? Phela i Mupostola yoloye hi xiviri xa yena, laha ku nga na hinkwaswo leswi hanyisaka. Milambu leyi yinharhu yona i yini? Wo sungula i murisi Mulanguteri, wa vumbirhi i muvangeli, wa vunharhu i Muprofeta.

Yingisani varhandziwa: Muvangeli u va teka emisaveni hi rirhandzu na ku rhula a va tisa etilweni, kutani va risiwa hi rirhandzu na ntiyiso hi Murisi, kutani va tsundzuxiwa hi muprofeta. Va tiva ndhawu leyi va nga eka yona leswaku yi hlayisekile ku fikela kwihi, naswona i yini leswi Xikwembu xi swi languteleke eka vanhu va xona leswaku va swi endla. Na khombo leri nga kona na leri taka va tivisiwa rona hi Muprofeta. Loko ku ri nchumu wunene mutotiwa kumbe murisi wa swi pfula, kambe loko ku ri nchumu wo biha murisi u nyikiwile matimba yo swi pfala leswaku swi nga endleki.

Varhandziwa eka Hosi, mi nga tivonela hi n'wexe leswaku Xikwembu xi hi rhandza ku fikela kwihi. Hi yona mhaka xi nge: vandlha rin'wana na rin'wana leri nga riki na moya wa vuprofeta ri file swin'we na mintirho ya rona.

Varhandziwa, ndzi mi navelela mikateko na rihanyo lerinene eka lembe lerintshwa na mindyangu ya n'wina hinkwayo. Voningani vana va ku vonakala. A hi pfaleni lembe ra khale ra 2002 na swiendlakalo swa rona, hi rivalelana eka hinkwaswo leswi hi dyoheleraneke eka swona, hi nghena hinkwerhu hi ri lavantshwa eka 2003, hi cukumetile madzanganya hinkwawo ya khale. A hi hiseni tikhalendara hinkwato, na tibuku ta khale hi hloniphana, hi rhandzana, hi lehiselana mbilu, hi tshika ku langutelana ehansi.

Ehansi hi milandzu! Ehansi hi mavarivari! Ehenhla hi mintirho! Xikwembu xi mi katekisa.

Hi mina wa n'wina eka Kreste
NV MLANGENI
MUPOSTOLA WA NKULU/PURESIDENTE

xh.title: Umbuliso WoMpostile Kuwo Onke Amabandla
xh.message:
Bathandekayo kuKristu

Ndinibhalela lo mbuliso ndinovuyo olukhulu, nothando olumangalisayo ngani nonke bantwana bakaThixo enathandwa yinkosi yethu uYesu Kristu, owasifela emnqamlezweni ukuze sixolelwe ezonweni zethu. Kwaye ndibhala lo mbuliso ndivuya ngemisebenzi nezenzo ezintle enizenzileyo kulo nyaka. Andinakuyibala imisebenzi emibi, apho ongendawo wayezama ukufaka unyawo lwemfene kwimisebenzi kaThixo entle kangaka.

Andikholelwa ukuba kukho nokuba mnye osabhidekayo namhlanje kule cawe yethu, kuba mna ndathi kuni, ongendawo akayithandi into entle. Ufumana abantu benkosi bemanyene bedumisa, behlangene, beyinto enye, afike azame ukubahlukanisa, afake nomoya wokungavisisani nakumagosa axabane, kungabikho mvisiswano.

Makhe ndinibuze bantwana bakaThixo; Niyakuvuyela na ukubona amagosa angamadoda okanye amabhinqa exabana ngenxa yakho okanye yenu? Ndiphinde ndize kuni njengamagosa angamadoda namabhinqa; kungakuvuyisa na ukuba kungekho xolo emizini yenu, abantwana bexabana bekhuphelana izixhobo ezimbi? Ngaba siyalibala na ukuba thina sathengwa ngexabiso eliphezulu kakhulu? Akukho namnye onemali engangaleyo eyathenga thina. Ingaba yona loo mali eyathenga thina niyayazi? Kaloku ligazi lenkosi uYesu Kristu elaphalala emnqamlezweni, mhla wayefela izono zethu. Sathengwa ngaloo gazi ke. Cinga ke nawe ukuba kwakubuhlungu kangakanani kuloo ndoda.

Akufuneki ke sifane nabantu abangacingiyo, nabangakhathaleliyo iimpilo zabo, nangona sevayo ubunzima obungaka. Uthando olungaka esathandwa ngalo, sade sabizwa ngokuba sibathandwa kuba sithandwe yinkosi. Bathandekayo akukho namnye onokuthi akazi ukuba wabizelwa ntoni kule cawe ngaphandle kokuzosebenzela usindiso lomphefumlo wakhe nabakubo asele bedlule ehlabathini.

Ufumana umntu esenza izinto eziphambene nobulungisa, elibele ukuzithandazela. Akukho nto inzima nesindayo kule cawe kaThixo ukuba nje sinjengabantwana abafundisekayo, nabagcina imithetho yakhe. Masibe ngumhlaba owamkela amanzi aphuma eTroneni, ngale milambo mithathu. Yintoni iTrone? Kaloku nguMpostile lowo ngokwakhe, apho kukho konke okuphilisayo. Le milambo mithathu yona yintoni? Owokuqala ngumalusi uMveleli, owesibini ngumvangeli, owesithathu nguMprofeti.

Phulaphulani ke bathandekayo: Umvangeli uyabalanda ehlabathini ngothando nangoxolo abazise ezulwini, baze baluswe ngothando nangenyaniso nguMalusi, baze balunyukiswe ngumprofeti. Bayayazi indawo abakuyo ukuba ikhuselekile kangakanani, nokuba yintoni uThixo ayilindeleyo ebantwini bakhe ukuba bayenze. Nengozi ekhoyo nezayo bayaziswa nguMprofeti. Ukuba yinto entle umthanjiswa okanye umalusi uyayivula, kodwa ukuba yinto embi umalusi uphiwe amandla okuyivala ukuze ingenzeki.

Bathandekayo eNkosini, ungabona ke ngokwakho ukuba uThixo usithanda kangakanani. Kungoko esithi: elo nalo bandla elingenamoya wesiprofeto lifile kunye nemisebenzi yalo.

Bathandekayo, ndininqwenelela iintsikelelo nempilo entle kunyaka omtsha neentsapho zenu zonke. Khanyani bantwana bokukhanya. Masiwugoqe unyaka omdala ka-2002 neziganeko zawo, sixolelane kuko konke esiphosisene ngako, singene sonke simatsha ku-2003, sesilahle onke amadlavu amadala. Masitshise zonke iikhalenda, neencwadi ezindala sihloniphane, sithandane, sinyamezelane, siyeke nokujongelana phantsi.

Phantsi ngamatyala! Phantsi ngentlebendwane! Phezulu ngemisebenzi! UThixo anisikelele.

Ndim owakho kuKristu
NV MLANGENI
UMPOSTILE OYINTLOKO/UMONGAMELI

zu.title: Umbuliso WoMpostoli Kumabandla Wonke
zu.message:
Bathandwa ku kristu

Nginilobela lombuliso nginokujabula okukhulu, nothando olumangalisyo ngani nonke bantwana baka-Thixo enathandwa yinkosi yethu u Jesu Kristu, owasifela esiphambanweni ukuze sithethelelwe ezonweni zethu. Futhi ngiloba lombuliso nginokujabula ngemisebenzi nezenzo ezinhle enizenzile kulongyaka. Ngingebale imisebenzi emibi, lapho omubi naye ekade ezama ukufaka unyawo Iwemfene emisebenzinini ka Nkulunkulu emihle kangaka.

Angikholwa ukuthi ukhona noyedwa osadideka namhlanje kulenkonzo yakithi, ngoba mina ngathi kini, omubi akayithandi into enhle. Ufica abantu benkosi bemunye bedumisa, behlangene, beyinto eyodwa, afike azame ukubehlukanisa, afake nomoya wokungezwani nasezincekwini zixabane, kungabi nokuzwana.

Ake-ngibuze bantwana baka Thixo; Niyakujabulela yini ukubona izinceku noma izincekukazi zixabana ngenxa yakho noma yenu? Ngibuye ngize kini njengezinceku nezincekukazi; kunganijabulisa yini uma kungekho ukuthula emizini yenu, izingane zixabana zikhiphelana izikhali ezimbi? Ngabe siyakhohlwa yini ukuthi thina sathengwa ngenani eliphezulu kakhulu? Akekho namunye onemali engangaleyo eyathenga thina. Ingabe yona-ke leyo-mali eyathenga thina niyayazi? Angani phela yileligazi lenkosi u-Jesu Kristu elachitheka esiphambanweni, mhla yayifela izono zethu. Sathengwa ngalelogazi-ke. Cabangake nawe ukuthi kwakubuhlungu kangakanani kuleyondoda.

Akufuneki-ke sifane nabantu abangacabangi, nabangakhathaleli izimpilo zabo, yize sahlushekelwa kangaka. Uthando olungaka esathandwa ngalo, saze sabizwa ngabathandwa ngoba sithandwe yinkosi. Bathandwa akekho noyedwa ongathi akazi ukuthi wabizelwani kulenkonzo ngaphandle kokuzosebenzela usindiso lomphefumulo wakhe nabakubo asebadlula ezweni.

Uthole umuntu enza izinto eziphambene nokulunga, akhohiwe ukuzithandazela. Akukho lutho olulukhuni nolusindayo kulenkozo ka-Nkulunkulu uma-nje sinjengabantwana abafundisekayo, nabagcina imithetho yakhe. Sibe umhlaba owamukela amanzi aqhamuka e Tronini (Throne), ngalemifula emithathu. Yini I-Troni (Throne)? Engani phela ngu Mpostoli loyo uqobo Iwakhe, lapho kukhona konke okuphilisayo. Lemifula emithathu-ke yona yini na? Owokuqala ngumelusi uMveleli, owesibili ngumvangeli, owesithathu ngu Mprofethi.

Lalelake mthandwa: Umvangeli uyabalanda ehlabathini ngothando nangoxolo abalethe ezulwini, bese beluswa ngothando nangeqiniso nguMelusi, bese bexwayiswa ngu mprofethi. Bayazi inaawo abakuyona ukuthi iphephe kangakanani, nokuthi yini u-Nkulunkulu ayilindele ebantwini bakhe ukuthi bayenze. Nengozi ekhona nezayo bayaziswe ngu Mprofethi. Uma kuyinto enhle umgcotshwa noma umelusi ayivulele, kodwa uma kuyinto embi umelusi uphiwe amandla okuyivala ukuthi ingenzeki.

Bathandekayo enkosini, ungabona-ke ngokungokwakho ukuthi uNkulunkulu usithandla kangakanani. Kungakho ethi: yilelo nalelo bandla elingenawo umoya wesi-profetho lifile kanye nemisebenzi yalo.

Bathandwa, nginifisela izibusiso nokuphila okuhle kulonyaka omusha nemindeni yonke yenu. Khanyani bantwana bokukhanya. Masiwugoge unyaka omdala ka-2002 nezigameko zawo, sixolelane kukho-konke esiphosiselene ngakho, singene sonke sibasha ku 2003, sesilahle wonke ama-vukuvuku amadala. Sishise wonke ama almanaka (Calenders), nezincwadi ezindala sihloniphane, sithandane, sibekezelelane, siyeke nokubukelana phansi.

Phansi ngamacala! Phansi ngezindaba! Phenzulu ngemisebenzi! U-Nkulunkulu anibusise.

Yimi owenu ku-Krestu
NV MLANGENI
CHIEF/PRESIDENT

nso.title: Tumedišo ya Moapostola go Diphuthego ka Moka
nso.message:
Barategi go Kriste,

Ke le ngwalela tumedišo ye ke na le lethabo le legolo, le lerato le le makatšago go lena ka moka bana ba Modimo ba ba ratilwego ke Morena wa rena Jesu Kriste, yo a re hwetšego sefampanong gore re swarelwe dibe tša rena. Gape ke ngwala tumedišo ye ke thabile ka mešomo le mediro e mebotse ye le e dirilego ngwageng wo. Nka se bale mešomo e mebe, mo yo mobe le yena a bego a leka go tsenya leoto la tšhwene mešomong e mebotse gakaaka ya Modimo.

Ga ke dumele gore go na le le o tee yo a sa ferekanyegago lehono kerekeng ye ya rena, gobane nna ke le boditše, yo mobe ga a rate selo se sebotse. O hwetša batho ba Morena ba le tee ba tumiša, ba kopane, e le selo se setee, a tle a leke go ba aroganya, a tsenye le moya wa go se kwane le go bahlanka gore ba lwe, go se be le kwano.

A ke botšiše bana ba Modimo; Na le a thaba go bona bahlanka ba banna goba ba basadi ba lwa ka baka la gago goba ka baka la lena? E re ke tle go lena bjalo ka bahlanka ba banna le ba basadi; na go ka le thabiša ge go be go se na khutšo magaeng a lena, bana ba lwa ba ntšhetšana dibetša tše mpe? Na re lebetše gore re rekilwe ka theko e kgolo kudu? Ga go na le o tee yo a nago le tšhelete ye e swanago le yeo e re rekilego. Na tšhelete yeo e re rekilego le a e tseba? Ke ruri madi a Morena Jesu Kriste ao a tšholletšwego sefampanong, letšatši leo a hwetšego dibe tša rena. Re rekilwe ka madi ao. Nagana fela gore go be go le bohloko gakaakang go monna yoo.

Ga re a swanela go swana le batho ba ba sa naganego, ba ba sa kgathalelego maphelo a bona, le ge re tlaišegilwe gakaaka. Lerato le legolo leo re ratilwego ka lona, go fihla re bitšwa barategi gobane re ratwa ke Morena. Barategi ga go na yo a ka rego ga a tsebe gore o bileditšwe eng kerekeng ye ntle le go šomela phološo ya moya wa gagwe le ba lapa la gagwe bao ba fetilego lefaseng.

O hwetša motho a dira dilo tše di fapanego le go loka, a lebetše go ithapelela. Ga go na selo se se thata goba se se boima kerekeng ye ya Modimo ge fela re swana le bana ba ba rutegego, ba ba bolokago melao ya gagwe. A re beng mabu ao a amogelago meetse a tšwago Teroneng, ka dinoka tše tše tharo. Terone ke eng? Ke ruri Moapostola ka noši, mo go nago le tšohle tše di phedišago. Dinoka tše tše tharo tšona ke eng? Ya mathomo ke modiši e lego Molebeledi, ya bobedi ke moebangedi, ya boraro ke Moporofeta.

Theeletšang barategi: Moebangedi o ba tšea lefaseng ka lerato le khutšo a ba tliše legodimong, gomme ba dišwa ka lerato le therešo ke Modiši, gomme ba lemošwa ke moporofeta. Ba tseba lefelo leo ba lego go lona gore le boltegile gakaakang, le gore Modimo o letetše eng gore batho ba gagwe ba se dire. Le kotsi ye e lego gona le ye e tlang ba a lemošwa ke Moporofeta. Ge e le selo se sebotse motlotšwa goba modiši o a se bula, eupša ge e le selo se sebe modiši o filwe maatla a go se tswalela gore se se direge.

Barategi go Morena, le ka iponela ka bolena gore Modimo o re rata gakaakang. Ke ka baka leo a rego: phuthego efe goba efe ye e se nago moya wa boporofeta e hwile mmogo le mešomo ya yona.

Barategi, ke le lakaletša ditšhegofatšo le maphelo a mabotse ngwageng o moswa le malapa a lena ka moka. Phadimang bana ba seetša. A re phutheng ngwaga wa kgale wa 2002 le ditiragalo tša wona, re lebalelane go tšohle tše re fošeditšanego go tšona, re tsene ka moka re le ba baswa go 2003, re lahlile marantha ka moka a kgale. A re fišeng dialamanaka ka moka, le dipuku tša kgale re hlomphane, re ratane, re kgotlelelane, re tlogele go nyatšana.

Fase ka ditsheko! Fase ka ditshebo! Godimo ka mešomo! Modimo a le šegofatše.

Ke nna wa lena go Kriste
NV MLANGENI
MOAPOSTOLA YO MOGOLO/MOPRESIDENTE

en.title: GREETING FOR 2004-2005
en.message:
Beloved in Christ,

I greet you in the name of our Lord and Saviour. I write this greeting to you full of great love for you, children of the father.

I want to say that I am very happy with how you are preaching the gospel of peace, love, and truth in the world so that the nation of God our creator may be saved. Yes, the nation will be converted if we walk in truth and honesty. Let us not tell people good things so they get attracted, but when they arrive where we called them, they find that none of that is there, and they become disappointed and shocked.

If that is the case, it will be no different from people who go into the world and find people full of mud on their feet, troubled, not knowing how to get this heavy mud off their feet (carnal things). Brothers and sisters preach the gospel to them and these people convert and come to church. When they arrive here in church, they find a surprise, people here in church have mud caked on their feet, there is no difference. Then they say it is just the same, and then it is fulfilled that: If it is like this in the green tree, what will it be like in the dry.

I urge you, brothers and sisters, let there be a difference between those in the Apostolic church and those in the world. Let it be seen that we were bought at a very high price - the blood of the lamb Jesus Christ, who died for us on the cross, we were forgiven our sins, by the breaking of his flesh we were saved, by the shedding of his blood, we had understanding and knowledge through the water (teaching) that came from his side when they pierced him with a spear.

Let us stop making each other cry, let there be some who worship joyfully in church, let there be some who worship with tears. Some are made to worship painfully by their brothers in church, some are badly troubled in their homes because of their brothers and sisters, and fathers as officers. I want to inform you officers that an officer found involved in incidents like these, will run to the benches. It is like taking congregations from each other when we are officers of one Apostle. That is not a good spirit.

Let us work, let each one build a good work for themselves. Do not be jealous of the works of others or the yards of other people's homes, because they are clean and beautiful, you too make yours beautiful and dress your wife so she is beautiful and your husband so he is beautiful.

Then the jealousy of other people will end. We will see the importance of these three rivers. It will be the first river which is the Evangelist, the second be the good Shepherd, and the third which is the Prophet. There is no one who does not have a role they must play, the time for gossip will not be there. Let us not forget to humble ourselves to be children, to respect each other if we want to go to heaven on the last day.

We wish you a blessed coming year of 2005 and good health.

I am yours in Christ,
N.V.Mlangeni
Chief/President

st.title: TUMELISO EA 2004-2005
st.message:
Baratuoa ho Kreste,

Kea le lumelisa ka lebitso la morena oa rona le mopholosi. Ke le ngolla tumeliso ena ke tletse lerato le leholo ho lona bana ba ntate.

Ke rata ho re ke thabile haholo ka tsela eo le bolelang evangeli ea khotso, lerato le 'nete lefatšeng hore sechaba sa Molimo 'mopi oa rona bohle se pholosoe. Ee sechaba se tla sokoloha haeba re tsamaea ka 'nete, le ka bots'epehi. A re se keng ra bolella batho lintho tse ntle e le hore ba hoheloe, empa ha ba fihla moo re ba bitselitseng teng, ba fumana hore ha ho na le e 'ngoe ea tsona,' me ba nyahama le ho tšoha.

Haeba ho le joalo ho ke ke ha fapana le batho ba eang lefatšeng ba fumana batho ba tletse seretse maotong a bona ba khathatsehile, ba sa tsebe hore ba ka etsa joang hore seretse sena se boima maotong a bona se tsoe (lintho tsa nama). Bana beso le likhaitseli ba ba bolella evangeli mme batho bana ba sokoloha 'me ba tla kerekeng. Ha ba fihla mona kerekeng, ba fumana mohlolo, batho ba mona kerekeng seretse se omme maotong a bona, ha ho phapang. Ebe ba re ho tšoana feela, mme ho phethahala hore: Haeba ho le joalo sefateng se setala, ho tla ba joang ho se omeletseng.

Kea le kōpa bana beso le likhaitseli tsa ka, a ho be le phapang lipakeng tsa ba kerekeng ea Baapostola le ba lefatšeng. A ho bonahale hore re rekiloe ka theko e phahameng haholo - mali a konyana Jesu Kreste, ea re shoetseng sefapanong, ra tšoareloa libe tsa rona, ka ho ngatsojoa ha nama ea hae ra pholosoa, ka ho tšolloa ha mali a hae, ra ba le kutloisiso le tsebo ka metsi (thuto), a tsoileng lehlakoreng la hae ha ba mo hlaba ka lerumo.

A re tloheleng ho llisana, a ho be le ba bang ba rapelang ka thabo kerekeng, ho be le ba bang ba rapelang ka meokho. Ba bang ba hlokofatsoa ke bana babo bona kerekeng, ba bang ba hlorisoa haholo malapeng a bona ka lebaka la bana babo bona le likhaitseli tsa bona, le bo-ntate e le liofisiri. Ke rata ho tsebisa lona liofisiri hore ofisiri e tla fumanoa e kentse letsoho liketsahalong tse kang tsena, e tla mathela libencheng. Ho tšoana le ho nkelana liphutheho athe re liofisiri tsa Moapostola a le mong. Moea oo hase o motle.

A re sebetseng, e mong le e mong a ikaha mosebetsi o motle. Le se ke la honohela mesebetsi ea ba bang kapa mabala a malapa a ba bang, hobane a hloekile a le matle, le uena iketsetse hore ho be hotle 'me u khabise mosali oa hau hore a be motle le monna oa hau a be motle.

Ebe mōna oa batho ba bang o tla fela. Re tla bona bohlokoa ba linoka tsena tse tharo. E tla ba noka ea pele e leng Moevangeli, ea bobeli e be Molisa ea molemo, le ea boraro e leng Moprofeta. Ha ho ea se nang karolo eo a tlamehang ho e bapala, nako ea leshano e ke ke ea e-ba teng. A re se keng ra lebala ho ikokobetsa re be bana, re hlomphane haeba re batla ho ea leholimong ka letsatsi la ho qetela.

Re le lakaletsa selemo se tlang se hlohonolofalitsoeng sa 2005 le bophelo bo botle.

Ke 'na oa lona ho Kreste,
N.V.Mlangeni
Moapostola e Moholo/Mopresidente

ts.title: XILUMISO XA 2004-2005
ts.message:
Varhandziwa eka Kreste,

Ndzi mi losa hi vito ra Hosi ya hina na Muponisi. Ndzi mi tsalela xilumiso lexi ndzi tele hi rirhandzu lerikulu eka n'wina vana va tatana.

Ndzi rhandza ku vula leswaku ndzi tsakile swinene hi ndlela leyi mi chumayelaka evhangeli ya ku rhula, rirhandzu, na ntiyiso emisaveni leswaku tiko ra Xikwembu muvumbi wa hina hinkwerhu ri ponisiwa. Ina tiko ri ta hundzuka loko hina hi famba hi ntiyiso, na hi vutshembeki. A hi nga byeli vanhu swaswinene va kokiwa rinoko, kambe loko va fika laha hi va vitaneleke kona, va kuma leswaku a ku na hambi xin'we xa swona, va khomiwa hi gome na ku hlamala.

Loko swi ri tano swi ta fana na vanhu lava yaka emisaveni va kuma vanhu va tele hi ndzhope emilengeni va pfilunganyekile, va nga tivi leswaku va nga endla njhani leswaku ndzhope lowu bindzaka emilengeni ya vona wu suka (swilo swa nyama). Va fika vamakwerhu va vavanuna na vavasati va va chumayela evhangeli va hundzuka vanhu lava va ta ekerekeni. Loko va fika laha ekerekeni, va kuma xihlamariso, vanhu laha ekerekeni ndzhope wu namarhele emilengeni ya vona, a ku na ku hambana. Kutani va ku swa fana ntsena, kutani ku hetiseka leswaku: Loko swi ri tano eka murhi lowu tsakamaka, swi ta va njhani eka lowu omeke.

Ndzi mi khongela vamakwerhu va vavanuna na vavasati, a ku ve na ku hambana eka lava nga ekerekeni ya Vapostola na lava nga emisaveni. A swi tikombe leswaku hina hi xaviwe hi ntsengo wa le henhla swinene - ngati ya xinyimpfana Yesu Kreste, loyi a hi feleke exihambanweni, hi rivaleriwa swidyoho swa hina, hi ku phemeleliwa ka nyama ya yena hi ponisiwile, hi ku halatiwa ka ngati ya yena, hi ve na ku twisisa na ku tiva hi mati (dyondzo), lawa ya humeke etlhelo ra yena loko va n'wi tlhava hi tlhari.

A hi tshikeni ku ririsana, a ku ve na van'wana lava gandzelaka hi ntsako ekerekeni, ku va na van'wana lava gandzelaka hi mihloti. Van'wana va xanisiwa byo biha hi vamakwavo ekerekeni, van'wana va hluphiwa ngopfu emindyangwini ya vona hikwalaho ka vamakwavo va vavanuna na vavasati, na vatatana tanihi malandza. Ndzi rhandza ku tivisa n'wina malandza leswaku nandza loyi a nga ta kumiwa a khumbheka eka swiendlakalo swo fana na leswi, u ta tsutsumela eka mabenchi. Swi fana na ku tekelana mavandlha kasi hi malandza ya Mupostola un'we. A hi moya wunene wolowo.

A hi tirheni, un'wana na un'wana a tiakela ntirho wunene. Mi nga naveli mintirho ya van'wana kumbe swirhapa swa miti ya van'wana, hikuva yi basile yi sasekile, na wena tiendlele yi saseka kutani u sasekisa nsati wa wena a saseka na nuna wa wena a saseka.

Kutani vukwele bya vanhu van'wana byi ta hela. Hi ta vona nkoka wa milambu leyi yinharhu. Ku ta va mulambu wo sungula ku nga Muvangeli, wa vumbirhi ku nga Murisi lonene, na wa vunharhu ku nga Muprofeta. A ku na loyi a nga riki na xiphemu lexi a faneleke ku xi tlanga, nkarhi wa mavarivari a wu nge vi kona. A hi nga rivali ku titsongahata hi va vana, hi hloniphana loko hi lava ku ya etilweni hi siku ro hetelela.

Hi mi navelela lembe leri taka ra mikateko ra 2005 na rihanyo lerinene.

Hi mina wa n'wina eka Kreste,
N.V.Mlangeni
Mupostola wa Nkulu/Puresidente

xh.title: UMBULISO KA-2004-2005
xh.message:
Bathandekayo kuKristu,

Ndiyanibulisa egameni leNkosi yethu noMsindisi. Ndinobhalela lo mbuliso ndizele luthando olukhulu ngani bantwana baka bawo.

Ndinqwenela ukutsho ukuba ndivuya kakhulu ngokushumayela kwenu ivangeli yoxolo, yothando, neyenyaniso ehlabathini ukuze kusindiswe isizwe sikaThixo uMdali wethu sonke. Ewe isizwe siya kuguquka ukuba thina sihamba ngenyaniso, nangentembeko. Masingaxeleli abantu okuhle ukuze batsaleleke, kodwa xa befika apho sibabizele khona, bafumanise ukuba akukho nanye yaloo nto, baze badane kwaye bothuke.

Ukuba kunjalo kuya kuba kufana nqwa nabantu abaya ehlabathini bafumane abantu bezele ludaka ezinyaweni zabo bexakekile, bengazi ukuba bangenza njani ukuze olu daka lubasindayo ezinyaweni zabo lusuke (izinto zenyama). Bafike abazalwana noodade babashumayeze ivangeli baguquke aba bantu beze ecaweni. Xa befika apha ecaweni, bafumane ummangaliso, abantu apha ecaweni udaka seluqinile ezinyaweni zabo, akukho mahluko. Baze bathi kuyafana nje, ize kuzaliseke ukuba: Ukuba kunje emthini oluhlaza, kuya kuba njani kowomileyo.

Ndiyanibongoza bazalwana bam noodade wethu, makhe kubekho umahluko kwabasecaweni yabaPostile nakwabasehlabathini. Makubonakale ukuba thina sathengwa ngexabiso elikhulu kakhulu - igazi lemvana uYesu Kristu, owasifela emnqamlezweni, saxolelwa izono zethu, ngokuqhekezwa kwenyama yakhe sasindiswa, ngokuphalazwa kwegazi lakhe, saba nokuqonda nokwazi ngamanzi (imfundiso), aphuma ecaleni lakhe ukumgwaza kwabo ngomkhonto.

Makhe siyeke ukulilisana, makubekho abanye abakhonza ngovuyo ecaweni, kubekho abanye abakhonza ngeenyembezi. Abanye bakhonziswa kabuhlungu ngabazalwana babo ecaweni, abanye bahlaselwa kabi emizini yabo ngenxa yabazalwana babo noodade wabo, nooyise njengamagosa. Ndinqwenela ukunazisa magosa ukuba igosa eliya kufunyanwa libandakanyeka kwiziganeko ezifana nezi, liya kuya ezibhentshini libaleka. Kufana nokuthathelana amabandla kwaye singamagosa oMpostile omnye. Umoya ongemhle lowo.

Masisebenze, omnye nomnye makazakhele umsebenzi omhle. Musani ukuba nomona ngemisebenzi yabanye okanye iiyadi zemizi yabanye, kuba zicocekile zintle, nawe zenzele kube kuhle kwakho uze uhombise umkakho abe mhle nomyeni wakho abe mhle.

Luya kuphela ke umona ngabanye abantu. Siya kubona ukubaluleka kwale milambo mithathu. Iya kuba ngumlambo wokuqala onguMvangeli, owesibini ube nguMalusi olungileyo, nowesithathu onguMprofeti. Akukho namnye ongenayo indima amele ayidlale, ixesha leentlebendwane aliyi kubakho ke. Masingalibali ukuzithoba sibe ngabantwana, sihloniphane ukuba sifuna ukuya ezulwini ngomhla wokugqibela.

Sininqwenelela unyaka onesikelelo ozayo ka-2005 nempilo entle.

Ndim owakho kuKristu,
N.V.Mlangeni
UMpostile oyiNtloko/UMongameli

zu.title: UMBULISO KA 2004-2005
zu.message:
Bathandekayo ku-Krestu,

Ngiyanibingelela egameni lenkosi yethu nomsindisi. Nginilobela lombuliso ngigcwele uthando olukhulu ngani bantwana baka baba.

Ngithanda ukusho ukuthi ngijabule kakhulu gokushaya kwenu ivangeli loxolo, nothando, neqiniso ezweni ukuze sisinde isizwe sika Nkulunkulu umdali wethu sonke. Yebo soguquka isizwe uma thina sihamba ngeqiniso, nangokwethembeka. Singatsheli abantu okuhle bathatheke, kodwa uma befika lapho esibabizela khona, bafice ukuthi akukho nokukodwa kwalokho, bafikelwe ukudumala nokushaqeka.

Uma kunjalo kuyobe asehlukile kubantu abaya ezweni bafice abantu begcwele udaka ezinyaweni bexakekile, bengazi ukuthi bangenza kanjani ukuthi loludaka olubasindayo ezinyaweni zabo lusuke (izinto zenyama). Bafike abazalwane nodade babashasyele ivangeli baguquke lababantu beze enkonzweni. Uma befika lapha enkonzweni, bathole isimanga, abantu lapha enkonzweni udaka seluze lwakhabathisa ezinyaweni zabo, akukho mehluko. Bese bethi kuyefana-nje, bese kugcwaliseka ukuthi: Uma kunje kwezimanzi, kuyobanjani kwezomileyo.

Ngiyaninxusa bafowethu nodadewethu, ake kubekhona umehluko kwabasenkonzweni yaba Postoli nabasezweni. Sibonakale ukuthi thina sathengwa ngenani elikhulu kakhulu - igazi lemvana u Jesu Krestu, owasifela esiphambanweni, saxolelwa ezonweni zethu, ngokuhlephuka kwenyama yakhe sasindiswa, ngokuchitheka kwegazi lakhe, saba nokuqonda nokwazi ngamanzi (imfundo), aphuma ohlangothini Iwakhe uma bemhlaba ngomkhonto.

Akesiyeke ukukhalisana, kubekhona abanye abakhonza kamnandi enkonzweni, kubekhona abanye abakhonza ngezinyembezi. Abanye bakhonziswa abafowabo kabuhlungu enkonzweni, abanye bahlasliseke kabi emizini yabo ngenxa yabafowabo nodadewabo, noyise njengezinceku. Ngithanda ukunazisa zinceku ukuthi inceku eyotholakala ithinteka kuzigameko ezifana nalezi, iyoya emabhentshini igijima. Kufana nokuthathelana amabandla siyizinceku zomPostoli oyedwa. Umoya ongemuhle loyo.

Asisebenze, omunye nomunye akazakhele umsebenzi umuhle. Musani ukuhawukela imisebenzi yabaye noma amagceke emizi yabanye, ngoba ehlanzekile emahle, nawe zenzele kube kuhle kwakho nomkakho umhlobise abemuhle nomyeni wakho abe muhle.

Kuzophela-ke ukuhawukela okwabanye abantu. Siyokubona ukubaluleka kwalemifula emithathu. Siyoba yiwo umfula wokuqala ukunguMvangeli, owesibili kube nguMelusi olungileyo, nowesithathu okungu Mprofethi. Akekho-ke ongenayo indima okufanele ayisebenze, isikhathi sezindaba ngeke sibekhona-ke. Singakhohlwa ukuzehlisa sibe ngabantwana, sihloniphane uma sifuna ukuya ezulwini ngelanga lokugcina.

Sinifisela unyaka onesibusiso ozayo ka-2005 nempilo enhle.

Yimi owenu ku-Krestu,
N.V.Mlangeni
Chief/President

nso.title: TUMEDIŠO YA 2004-2005
nso.message:
Barategi go Kriste,

Ke le dumediša ka leina la Morena wa rena le Mophološi. Ke le ngwalela tumedišo ye ke tletše ka lerato le legolo go lena bana ba tate.

Ke rata go bolela gore ke thabile kudu ka tsela ye le rerago ebangedi ya khutšo, le lerato, le therešo lefaseng gore setšhaba sa Modimo mmopi wa rena se phološwe. Ee, setšhaba se tla sokologa ge rena re sepela ka therešo, le ka potego. A re se ke ra botša batho tše dibotse gore ba gogelwe, eupša ge ba fihla mo re ba bileditšego gona, ba hwetša go se na le e tee ya tšona, gomme ba nyame ba tšhoge.

Ge go le bjalo go ka se fapane le batho bao ba yago lefaseng ba hwetša batho ba tletše seretse dinaong tša bona ba tshwenyegile, ba sa tsebe gore ba ka dira bjang gore seretse se se boima dinaong tša bona se tloge (dilo tša nama). Bana babo rena le dikgaetšedi ba ba rerele ebangedi mme batho ba ba sokologe ba tle kerekeng. Ge ba fihla mo kerekeng, ba hwetša mohlolo, batho ba mo kerekeng seretse se kgomaretše dinaong tša bona, ga go na phapano. Gomme ba re go fo swana, gomme gwa phethagala gore: Ge go le bjalo sehlahleng se se tala, go tla ba bjang go se se omilego.

Ke le kgothatša bana bešo le dikgaetšedi tša ka, a go be le phapano gare ga ba kereke ya Baapostola le ba lefaseng. A go bonagale gore re rekilwe ka theko e kgolo kudu - madi a kwanyana Jesu Kriste, yo a re hwetšego sefampanong, ra swarelwa dibe tša rena, ka go ngwathaganywa ga nama ya gagwe ra phološwa, ka go tšhollwa ga madi a gagwe, ra ba le kwešišo le tsebo ka meetse (thuto), ao a tšwilego lehlakoreng la gagwe ge ba mo hlaba ka lerumo.

A re tlogeleng go llišana, a go be le ba bangwe bao ba rapelago ka lethabo kerekeng, go be le ba bangwe bao ba rapelago ka meokgo. Ba bangwe ba rapetšwa bohloko ke bana babo bona kerekeng, ba bangwe ba tshwenywa kudu magaeng a bona ka baka la bana babo bona le dikgaetšedi tša bona, le botatago bona bjalo ka bahlanka. Ke rata go le tsebiša bahlanka gore mohlanka yo a tla hwetšwago a akaretšwa ditiragalong tša go swana le tše, o tla kitimela dipankeng. Go swana le go amogana diphuthego mola re le bahlanka ba Moapostola o tee. Moya wo ga se o mobotse.

A re šomeng, yo mongwe le yo mongwe a ikagele mošomo o mobotse. Le se ke la duma mešomo ya ba bangwe goba malapa a ba bangwe, gobane a hlwekile e bile a le mabotse, le wena itirele bjo bobotse gomme o aphiše mosadi wa gago gore a be mobotse le monna wa gago a be mobotse.

Gomme go duma ga batho ba bangwe go tla fela. Re tla bona bohlokwa bja dinoka tše tše tharo. E tla ba noka ya mathomo e lego Moebangedi, ya bobedi e be Modiši yo mobotse, mme ya boraro e lego Moporofeta. Ga go na yo a se nago karolo ye a swanetšego go e kgatha, nako ya ditshebo e ka se be gona. A re se ke ra lebala go ikokobetša ra ba bana, ra hlomphana ge re nyaka go ya legodimong ka letšatši la mafelelo.

Re le lakaletša ngwaga wo o tlang o šegofaditšwego wa 2005 le maphelo a mabotse.

Ke nna wa lena go Kriste,
N.V.Mlangeni
Moapostola yo Mogolo/Mopresidente

en.title: APOSTLE'S GREETING TO ALL OFFICERS AND ALL CONGREGATIONS
en.message:
Beloved in Christ

I greet you all in the good name of our Lord and saviour Jesus Christ. Let me say that we should thank with one voice, the great love with which the Lord loved us, sought us and found us, came to us, and stayed with us. It is not us who sought Him, He is the one who sought us because He wants to show His love to us so that we may learn what love is, love each other, stop fighting because the Lord does not want people who fight. Fighting does not come from God but comes from the lusts of the flesh.

Let everyone love the officer placed before them because that is the fountain of salvation, opened for your sake. If you fight with your officer you are no different from a person who jumps and hits a wall with their head, and then fools themselves saying "I have taught him a lesson", but when they look at where they hit with their head, they find a blood spot, and fool themselves saying this blood came from the wall, yet it came from them.

We are advised beloved to humble ourselves to be like children, whoever wants to be great must first humble themselves to be small so they can be raised.

I told you another year, even if a person does not believe, seeing themselves living for themselves as they are, forgetting that the life they live comes from God, He is the one who holds our life. Let that person stub their toe and feel pain, you will hear them say "Oh my God I am hurt". Which means pain makes a person remember that they did not create themselves, they were created by God, and then they draw closer to God.

I would then say it is necessary that if you are a thinking person my brother and my sister you should pinch yourself and feel whether you are still living for your Lord or not, because you will keep saying they are alive yet they died long ago in divinity, it is just an empty shell, or you are twitching to death. Let us live for the Lord in truth, let us be seen to be the messengers of good news by preaching the gospel of peace and love. Let me thank the evangelists for your success in going to Cape Town to praise the Lord, and you also felt how alive you are, even today it is still the talk of the town. You made history evangelists, satan tucked his tail between his legs. May God be with you and your families, may you all be protected in the days of Christmas.

I wish you a beautiful, blessed new year in 2006.

Yours in the Lord
N.V.MLANGENI
President

st.title: TUMELISO EA MOAPOSTOLA HO BAHLANKA BOHLE LE DIPHUTHEHO TSOHLE
st.message:
Baratuoa ho Kreste

Kea le lumelisa bohle ka lebitso le letle la Morena oa rona le moshuelli oa rona Jesu Kreste. A ke re a re lebokeng ka lentsoe le le leng, lerato le leholo leo Morena a re ratileng ka lona, a re batla a re fumana, a tla ho rona, a lula le rona. Hase rona ba mo batlileng, ke eena ea re batlileng hobane o batla ho bontša lerato la Hae ho rona e le hore re ithute hore lerato ke ntho e joang, re ratane, re tlohele ho loana hobane Morena ha a batle batho ba loanang. Ho loana ha ho tsoe ho Molimo empa ho tsoa litakatsong tsa nama.

E mong le e mong a rate mohlanka ea behiloeng ka pele ho eena hobane ke oona mohloli oa poloko oo, o butsoeng ka lebaka la hau. Haeba u loana le mohlanka oa hau ha u fapane le motho ea tlolang a otla lebota ka hlooho ea hae, ebe o ithetsa a re "ke mo rutile thuto", empa ha a sheba moo a otlileng teng ka hlooho ea hae, a fumana hore ho na le letheba la mali, a ithetse a re mali ana a tsoa leboteng, empa a tsoa ho eena.

Rea eletsana baratuoa hore re ikokobetse re tšoane le bana, ea batlang ho ba e moholo a qale a ikokobetse a be monyenyane hore a hōlisoe.

Ke le boleletse selemong se seng, motho leha a sa lumele, a ipona a iphelela feela kamoo a leng kateng, a lebala hore bophelo boo a bo phelang bo tsoa ho Molimo, ke eena ea tšoereng bophelo ba rona. A ke ho hlokoe motho eo a utloe bohloko monoaneng oa leoto la hae, u tla mo utloa a re "ao Molimo oa ka ke ntse ke utloa bohloko". Ho bolelang hore athe bohloko bo etsa hore motho a hopole hore ha a itlhola, o bopiloe ke Molimo, ebe o atamela ho Molimo.

Ke ne nka re ho hlokahala hore haeba u motho ea nahanang ngoan'eso le uena khaitseli ea ka u be u ee u tsamaee u itšoare u ikutloe hore na ebe u sa ntsane u phelela Morena oa hau kapa che, hobane u tla 'ne u re ba ea phela empa khale ba shoele bomolimong, e se e le lekhapetla feela, kapa u thothomela lefung. A re pheleleng Morena ka 'nete, re bonahale re le batho ba tlisang litaba tse molemo ka ho bolela evangeli ea khotso le lerato. E re ke lebohe baevangeli ka katleho ea lona ea ho ea Kapa ho ea rorisa Morena, le lona hape le ikutloile hore na le phela hakae, le kajeno e sa ntse e le taba. Le ngotse nalane baevangeli, satane o kentse mohatla oa hae lipakeng tsa maoto a hae. Molimo a be le lona le malapa a lona, le sireletsoe bohle matsatsing a keresemese.

Ke le lakaletsa selemo se secha se setle, se nang le litlhohonolofatso ho 2006.

Ea lona Moreneng
N.V.MLANGENI
Mopresidente

ts.title: XILUMISO XA MUPOSTOLA EKA MALANDZA HINKWAWO NA MAVANDLHA HINKWAWO
ts.message:
Varhandziwa eka Kreste

Ndzi mi losa hinkwenu hi vito lerinene ra Hosi ya hina na mufeli wa hina Yesu Kreste. A ndzi vule leswaku a hi nkhenseni hi rito rin'we, rirhandzu lerikulu leri Hosi yi hi rhandzeke ha rona, yi hi lavile yi hi kuma, yi ta eka hina, yi tshama na hina. A hi hina lava hi yi laveke, hi yona leyi nga hi lava hikuva yi lava ku komba rirhandzu ra yona eka hina leswaku hi ta dyondza leswaku rirhandzu i nchumu wa njhani, hi rhandzana, hi tshika ku lwa hikuva Hosi a yi lavi vanhu lava lwaka. Ku lwa a ku humi eka Xikwembu kambe ku huma eka ku navela ka nyama.

Un'wana na un'wana a a rhandze nandza loyi a vekiweke emahlweni ka yena hikuva i xihlovo xa ku ponisiwa xexo, lexi pfuriweke hikwalaho ka wena. Loko u lwa na nandza wa wena a wu hambananga na munhu loyi a tlulaka a ba khumbi hi nhloko ya yena, kutani a tixisa a ku "ndzi n'wi tshinyile", kambe loko a languta laha a beke kona hi nhloko ya yena, a kuma leswaku ku na xivati xa ngati, a tixisa a ku ngati leyi yi huma ekhumbini, kasi yi huma eka yena.

Ha tsundzuxana varhandziwa leswaku hi titsongahata hi va tanihi vana, loyi a lavaka ku va lonkulu a a sungule a titsongahata a va lontsongo leswaku a ta kurisiwa.

Ndzi mi byerile lembe rin'wana, munhu hambiloko a nga kholwi, a tivona a tihanyela ntsena hilaha a nga hakona, a rivala leswaku vutomi byebyo lebyi a byi hanyaka byi huma eka Xikwembu, hi xona lexi khomeke vutomi bya hina. A ku humelele munhu yoloye a twa ku vava exikunwaneni xa yena, u ta n'wi twa a ku "mawe Xikwembu xanga ndzi vavisekile". Leswi swi vulaka leswaku kasi ku vava ku endla munhu leswaku a tsundzuka leswaku a nga tiendlanga, u tumbuluxiwile hi Xikwembu, kutani a tshinela kusuhi na Xikwembu.

Kutani a ndzi ta vula leswaku swa fanela leswaku loko u ri munhu wo ehleketa makwerhu wa xinuna na wena makwerhu wa xisati u fanele u famba u famba u tiphincha u titwa leswaku xana u ha hanyela Hosi ya wena kumbe e-e, hikuva u ta tshamela ku vula u ku va hanya kasi khale va file eku vuxikwembu, i xikhumba ntsena, kumbe u le ku rhurhumeleni ka rifu. A hi hanyeleni Hosi hi ntiyiso, hi voniwa hi ri hina vafambisi va mahungu lamanene hi ku chumayela evhangeli ya ku rhula na rirhandzu. A ndzi nkhense vavangeli hi ku humelela ka n'wina ku ya eKapa ku ya dzunisa Hosi, na n'wina nakambe mi titwile leswaku mi hanya ku fikela kwihi, hambi namuntlha ya ha ri mhaka emhakeni. Mi endle matimu vavangeli, sathana u nghenisile ncila wa yena exikarhi ka milenge ya yena. Xikwembu a xi ve na n'wina na mindyangu ya n'wina, mi sirheleleka hinkwenu emasikwini ya khisimusi.

Ndzi mi navelela lembe lerintshwa lerinene, ra mikateko eka 2006.

Wa n'wina eka Hosi
N.V.MLANGENI
Puresidente

xh.title: UMBULISO WOMPOSTILE KUZINCEKU ZONKE NAMABANDLA ONKE
xh.message:
Bathandekayo kuKristu

Ndiyanibulisa nonke egameni elihle leNkosi yethu nomfeli wethu uYesu Kristu. Mandithi masibonge ngazwi linye, uthando olungaka iNkosi eyasithanda ngalo, yasifuna yasifumana, yeza kuthi, yahlala nathi. Asithi esayifunayo, yiyo eyasifunayo kuba ifuna ukubonisa uthando Lwayo kuthi ukuze sifunde ukuba uthando luyinto enjani, sithandane, siyeke ukulwa kuba iNkosi ayibafuni abantu abaxabanayo. Ukuxabana akuveli kuThixo kodwa kuvela kwiinkanuko zenyama.

Omnye nomnye makayithande isicaka esibekwe phambi kwakhe kuba ngowona mthombo wosindiso lowo, owavulwa ngenxa yakho. Ukuba uxabana nesicaka sakho awahlukanga emntwini oTsibayo abethe udonga ngentloko yakhe, aze azikhohlise athi "ndimfundisile", kodwa xa ejonga apho abethe khona ngentloko yakhe, afumane ukuba kukho ibala legazi, azikhohlise athi eli gazi liphuma edongeni, kanti liphuma kuye.

Siyalulekwa bathandekayo ukuba sizithobe sibe njengabantwana, ofuna ukuba mkhulu makaqale azithobe abe mncinci ukuze akhuliswe.

Ndathi kuni ngomnye unyaka, umntu nokuba akakholwa, ezibona eziphilela nje ngokwakhe, alibale ukuba loo mpilo ayiphilayo ivela kuThixo, nguye ophethe ubomi bethu. Makhe akhutshwe loo mntu eve intlungu ezinzwaneni zakhe, uya kumva esithi "Owu Thixo wam ndenzakele". Oku kuthetha ukuba kanti intlungu iyamenza umntu ukuba akhumbule ukuba akazidalanga, wadalwa nguThixo, aze asondele kuThixo.

Ngoko ke ndingathi kufuneka ukuba ungumntu ocingayo mzalwana wam nawe dade wethu uhambe uhambe uzikrobise uzive ukuba usayiphilela na iNkosi yakho okanye hayi, kuba uya kuhlala uthi baphilile kanti kade bafe kubuThixo, kuligobolondo nje, okanye uyangcangcazela ukufa. Masiyiphilele iNkosi ngenyaniso, sibonakale siyibo abahambisi beendaba ezilungileyo ngokushumayela ivangeli yoxolo nothando. Mandibabonge abavangeli ngempumelelo yenu yokuya eKapa ukuya kudumisa iNkosi, nani kanjalo naziva ukuba niphila kangakanani, kwananamhlanje kuseyindaba endabeni. Nenze imbali bavangeli, uSathana wafaka umsila wakhe phakathi kwemilenze yakhe. UThixo abe nani neentsapho zenu, nikhuseleke nonke kwiintsuku zekrisimesi.

Ndininqwenelela unyaka omtsha omhle, onesikelelo ngo-2006.

Owakho eNkosini
N.V.MLANGENI
UMongameli

zu.title: UMBULISO WOMPOSTOLI KUZINCEKU ZONKE NAMABANDLA ONKE
zu.message:
Bathandwa ku-Kristu

Ngiyanibingelela nonke egameni elihle lenkosi yethu nomfeli wethu uJesu Kristu. Mangisho ukuthi akesibonge ngazwi linye, uthando olungaka inkosi eyasithanda ngalo, yasifuna yasithola, yeza kithi, yahlala nathi. Akuthina esayifuna, iyona eyafuna thina ngoba ifuna ukutshengisa uthando Iwayo kithi ukuze sifunde ukuthi uthando luyinto enjani, sithandane, siyeke ukulwa ngoba inkosi ayibafuni abantu abaxabanayo. Ukuxabanana akuqhamuki ku-Thixo kepha kuqhamuka ezinkanukweni zenyama.

Omunye nomunye akayithande inceku ebekwe phambi kwakhe ngoba yiwona umthombo wosindiso lowo, owavulwa ngenxa yakho. Uma uxabana nenceku yakho awehlukile kumuntu ogxuma ashaye ubonda ngekhanda lakhe, abesezikhohlisa athi "ngimlayile", kodwa uma ebheka lapho eshaye khona ngekhanda lakhe, afice ukuthi kunebala legazi, azikhohlise athi leligazi liphume obondeni, kanti liphume kuyena.

Siyalwa bathandwa ukuthi sizithobe sibe njengabantwana, ofuna ukubamkhulu akaqale azithobe abemncane ukuze akhuliswe.

Ngathi kini ngomunye unyaka, umuntu noma engakholwa, ezibona eziphilela yena nje ngesingaye, akhohlwe ukuthi leyo mpilo ayiphilayo iveľa ku Nkulunkulu, uyena ophethe ukuphila kwethu. Ake akhutshwe loyo muntu ezwe ubuhlungu onyaweni lwakhe, uyomuzwa ethi "awu Thixo wami ngaze ngalimala". Okusho ukuthi kanti ubuhlungu buyamenza umuntu ukuthi akhumbule ukuthi akazidalanga, wadalwa ngu Thixo, abesesondela ku Thixo.

Ngabe sengithi kufanele ukuthi uma ungumuntu ocabangayo mfowethu nawe dadewethu ubohamba uhambe ubusuzincinza uzizwe ukuthi ingbe usayiphilela yini inkosi yakho noma cha, ngoba uyobulokhu uthi ayaphila kanti kudala wafa ebuthixweni, sekuyigobongo nje, noma usudikizelela ekufeni. Asiyiphilele inkosi ngokweqiniso, sibonakale siyibo abahambisi bezindaba ezilungileyo ngokushaya ivangeli loxolo nothando. Angibonge bavangeli ngokuphumelela kwenu ukuya eKapa ukuyodumisa inkosi, nani futhi nazizwa ukuthi niphila kangakanani, ngisho nanamhlanje kuseyindaba endabeni. Nawuqopha umlando bavangeli, usathane washutheka umsidlana wakhe phakathi kwemilenze yakhe. uThixo abe nani nemindeni yenu, nikhuseleke nonke ezinsukwini zika-khisimusi.

Nginifisela unyaka omusha omuhle, onezibusiso ku 2006.

Owenu eNkosini
N.V.MLÄNGENI
Umongameli

nso.title: TUMEDIŠO YA MOAPOSTOLA GO BAHLANKA KA MOKA LE DIPHUTHEGO KA MOKA
nso.message:
Barategi go Kriste

Ke le dumediša ka moka ka leina le lebotse la Morena wa rena le Mohwedi wa rena Jesu Kriste. E re ke re a re lebogeng ka lentšu le tee, lerato le legolo leo Morena a re ratilego ka lona, a re nyaka a re hwetša, a tla go rena, a dula le rena. Ga se rena re mo nyakilego, ke yena a re nyakilego gobane o nyaka go bontšha lerato la Gagwe go rena gore re ithute gore lerato ke selo sa mohuta mang, re ratane, re tlogele go lwa gobane Morena ga a nyake batho ba ba lwang. Go lwa ga go tšwe go Modimo eupša go tšwa dikganyogong tša nama.

Yo mongwe le yo mongwe a rate mohlanka yo a beilwego pele ga gagwe gobane ke wona mothopo wa phološo woo, wo o butšwego ka baka la gago. Ge o lwa le mohlanka wa gago ga o fapane le motho yo a tlolago a itia lebota ka hlogo ya gagwe, a be a ikhora a re "ke mo rutile thuto", eupša ge a lebelela mo a itilego gona ka hlogo ya gagwe, a hwetša go na le lerope la madi, a ikhora a re madi a tšwa leboteng, mola a tšwa go yena.

Re a eletsana barategi gore re ikokobetše re be bjalo ka bana, yo a nyakago go ba yo mogolo a thome a ikokobetše a be yo monyenyane gore a godišwe.

Ke le boditše ngwaga o mongwe, motho le ge a sa dumele, a ipona a iphelela fela bjalo ka ge a le, a lebala gore bophelo bjoo a bo phelago bo tšwa go Modimo, ke yena a swerego bophelo bja rena. E re motho yoo a kgotšwe a kwe bohloko monwaneng wa leoto la gagwe, o tla mo kwa a re "Joo Modimo wa ka nka se gobatšwa". Seo se ra gore bohloko bo dira gore motho a gopole gore ga se a itlhola, o hlotšwe ke Modimo, a be a batamela go Modimo.

Nka re go a hlokagala gore ge o le motho wa go nagana ngwanešo le wena kgaetšedi ya ka o be o eya o eya o itšhware o ikwe gore na e be o sa phelela Morena wa gago goba aowa, gobane o tla dula o re ba a phela mola kgale ba hwile go bomodimo, e fo ba lekgapetla fela, goba o a hwa. A re pheleleng Morena ka therešo, re bonagale re le batliši ba ditaba tše dibotse ka go rera ebangedi ya khutšo le lerato. Ke leboga baebangedi ka katlego ya lena ya go ya Kapa go tumiša Morena, le lena la ikwa gore le phela gakaakang, le lehono e sa le taba. Le ngwadile histori baebangedi, sathane o tsentše moselana wa gagwe magareng ga maoto a gagwe. Modimo a be le lena le malapa a lena, le šireletšwe ka moka matšatšing a khirisemose.

Ke le lakaletša ngwaga o moswa o mobotse, wo o šegofaditšwego wa 2006.

Wa lena go Morena
N.V.MLANGENI
Mopresidente

en.title: Apostle's Greeting for the year 2007/2008
en.message:
Beloved in the Lord.

I greet you all.

Let me remind you that God created the heavens and the earth, and the sea. After doing that he separated the water from the earth as they were together. He said let the water gather to one side. Truly it happened, and God Himself said that is the sea.

Then God, who is the Word, said let there be vegetation on the earth so that the earth may be beautiful. Truly trees, grass, and flowers grew, and it was beautiful. Then God Himself said it would be good if there were animals walking on the earth and flying in the sky, and they came to be. It pleased God to see wild animals going into their dens, and birds flying to the trees, going into their nests when the sun sets.

He found Himself having no place, or nowhere to lay His head. Then God said, "I too will build myself a place where I will stay." He gathered the dust of the earth and made the body of a man with it and said, "This is my temple," and He sanctified it.

It becomes a painful thing when a person turns God's temple into a hotel, and starts renting it out. All kinds of people enter a hotel. Witches, believers, criminals, and murderers enter a hotel. It is that person's money talking. That is why the Apostle puts a mark on the foreheads of his children. After finishing that, he now comes back and gives everyone a sword in their hand to strike down all those who do not have the mark on their foreheads.

Who are those who do not have a mark on their foreheads?
Hatred, boasting, looking down on others, criticizing, disrespecting one another, and so on. If you have a jealous eye, it is better to close it so that you can strike down these things yourself, because God does not want them in His heaven.

May God bless you all.

Yours in Christ,
N.V.Mlangeni.
PRESIDENT.

st.title: Tumeliso ea Moapostola ea selemo sa 2007/2008
st.message:
Baratuoa Moreneng.

Kea le lumelisa bohle.

E re ke le hopotse hore Molimo o bopile maholimo le lefatše, le leoatle. Ka mor'a ho etsa seo o ile a arola metsi le lefatše kaha li ne li kopane. A re metsi a khutlele ka thoko e 'ngoe. Ruri ho ile ha etsahala, eena Molimo a re leo ke leoatle.

Joale Molimo, e leng Lentsoe, a re a ho be le tse melang lefatšeng hore lefatše le be letle. Ruri ha mela lifate, joang, le lipalesa, ha e-ba botle. Joale eena Molimo a re ho ka ba hotle ha ho ka ba le liphoofolo tse tsamaeang lefatšeng le tse fofang sepakapakeng tsa e-ba teng. Ho ile ha thabisa Molimo ho bona liphoofolo tsa naha li kena mekoting ea tsona, le linonyana li fofela lifateng, li kena lihlaha tsa tsona ha letsatsi le likela.

O ile a iphumana a se na sebaka, kapa moo a ka beang hlooho ea hae. Joale Molimo a re "le 'na ke tla ikahhela sebaka seo ke tla lula ho sona." A bokella lerole la lefatše a etsa ka lona 'mele oa motho a re "ena ke tempele ea ka", a e halaletsa.

Ho ba ntho e bohloko ha motho a fetola tempele ea Molimo hotele, a qala ho e hirisa. Hoteleng ho kena mefuta eohle ea batho. Baloi, balumeli, litsotsi, le babolai ba kena hoteleng. Ho bua chelete ea motho eo. Ke kahoo Moapostola a beang letšoao liphatleng tsa bana ba hae. Ha a qetile ho etsa seo, oa khutla joale a fa e mong le e mong sabole letsohong la hae hore a reme bohle ba se nang letšoao liphatleng tsa bona.

Ke bo-mang ba se nang letšoao liphatleng tsa bona?
Hloeo, ho ikhohomosa, ho nyelisa ba bang, ho tšoaea liphoso, ho se hlomphane, le tse ling. Haeba u na le leihlo la mona, ho molemo u le koale hore u khone ho irema lintho tsena, hobane Molimo ha a li batle leholimong la hae.

Molimo a le hlohonolofatse bohle.

Ea lona ho Kreste,
N.V.Mlangeni.
MOPRESIDENTE.

ts.title: Xilumiso xa Mupostola xa lembe ra 2007/2008
ts.message:
Varhandziwa eka Hosi.

Ndzi mi losa hinkwenu.

A ndzi mi tsundzuxeni leswaku Xikwembu xi tumbuluxile tilo na misava, na lwandle. Endzhaku ko endla sweswo xi hambanisile mati na misava tanihi leswi a swi hlangene. Xi te mati a ya tlhelela etlhelo. Hakunene swi endlekile, xona Xikwembu xi ku hi lona lwandle ke lolo.

Xi ku "Xikwembu i Rito" a ku ve na leswi milaka emisaveni leswaku misava yi saseka. Hakunene ku milile mirhi, byanyi, na swiluva, swa saseka. Xi ku xona Xikwembu swi nga va swinene loko ku nga va na swiharhi leswi fambaka emisaveni na leswi hahaka empfhukeni swi va kona. Swa xi tsakisile Xikwembu sweswo ku vona swiharhi swi nghena emakheleni ya swona, na tinyanyana ti hahela emirhini, ti nghena eswisakeni swa tona loko dyambu ri pela.

Xi tikumile xona xi nga ri na ndhawu, kumbe laha xi nga pfulamisaka nhloko ya xona. Xi ku Xikwembu "na mina ndzi ta tiakela ndhawu laha ndzi nga ta tshama kona." Xi hlengeletile ritshuri ra misava xi endla hi rona miri wa munhu xi ku "leyi i tempeli ya mina", xi yi hlawulekisa.

Swi va nchumu wo vava loko munhu a hundzula tempeli ya Xikwembu yi va hotela, a sungula ku yi hirisa. E-hotela ku nghena tinxaka hinkwato ta vanhu. Valoyi, vapfumeri, swigevenga, na vadlayi va nghena ehotela. Ku vulavula mali ya munhu yoloye. Hi yona mhaka Mupostola a vekaka mfungho emimombyeni ya vana va yena. Loko a hetile ku endla sweswo, wa vuya ke sweswi a nyika un'wana na un'wana banga evokweni ra yena leswaku a tsema hinkwavo lava nga riki na mfungho emimombyeni ya vona.

I vamani lava nga riki na mfungho emimombyeni ya vona ke?
Rivengo, ku tikukumuxa, ku langutela van'wana ehansi, ku tsolavisisa, ku nga hloniphani, na swin'wana. Loko u ri na tihlo ra mona, swi antswa u ri pfala leswaku u ta kota ku titsema swilo leswi, hikuva Xikwembu a xi swi lavi etilweni ra xona.

Xikwembu a xi mi katekise hinkwenu.

Wa n'wina eka Kreste,
N.V.Mlangeni.
PURESIDENTE.

xh.title: Umbuliso woMpostile wonyaka ka-2007/2008
xh.message:
Bathandekayo eNkosini.

Ndiyanibulisa nonke.

Ndithi mandinikhumbuze ukuba uThixo wadala izulu nomhlaba, nolwandle. Esekuyenzile oko waze wahlula amanzi nomhlaba njengoko kwakuhlangene. Wathi amanzi makabuyele kwelinye icala. Ngenene kwenzeka, yena uThixo waze wathi lulwandle ke olo.

Waze wathi ke "uThixo uliLizwi" makubekho okumilayo emhlabeni ukuze umhlaba ube mhle. Ngenene kwamila imithi, ingca, neentyatyambo, kwaba kuhle. Waze wathi yena uThixo kungakuhle ukuba kungabakho izilwanyana ezihamba emhlabeni neziza kubhabha esibhakabhakeni zaba kho. Kwamvuyisa uThixo oko ukubona iinyamakazi zitshona emingxunyeni yazo, neentaka zibhabhela emithini, zingena kwiindlwane zazo xa ilanga litshona.

Wazifumana yena engenandawo, okanye apho anokubeka khona intloko yakhe. Waze wathi uThixo "nam ndizakuzakhela indawo apho ndizakuhlala khona." Waze waqokelela uthuli lomhlaba wenza ngalo umzimba womntu wathi "leyi yitempile yam", wayingcwalisa.

Kuba yinto ebuhlungu xa umntu esephendula itempile kaThixo ihotele, eseyiqeshisa. E-hotele kungena zonke iintlobo zabantu. Amagqwirha, amakholwa, izigebenga, nababulali bayangena ehotele. Kuthetha imali yaloo mntu. Kungoko ke uMpostile ebeka uphawu emabunzini abantwana bakhe. Esegqibile ukuyenza oko, uyabuya ke ngoku unika omnye nomnye ikrele esandleni sakhe ukuba agawule bonke abangenalo uphawu emabunzini abo.

Ngabaphi abangenaphawu emabunzini abo na?
Inzondo, ukuzigabisa, ukujongela abanye phantsi, ukugxeka, ukungahloniphani, nokunye. Ukuba uneliso lokunqwenela, kungcono uluvale ukuze ukwazi ukuzigawula ezi zinto, kuba uThixo akazifuni ezulwini lakhe.

UThixo anisikelele nonke.

Owakho kuKristu,
N.V.Mlangeni.
UMONGAMELI.

zu.title: Umbuliso woMpostoli wonyaka-ka-2007/2008
zu.message:
Bathandekayo eNkosini.

Ngiyanibingelela nonke.

Ngithi akenginkhumbuze ukuthi uNkulunkulu wadala izulu nomhlaba, nolwandle. Eşekwenzile lokho wabe esehlukanisa amanzi nomhlaba njengalokhu kwakuhlangene. Wathi amanzi awabuyele nganxaye. Ngempela kwenzeka, yena uNkulunkulu wayesethi wulwlandle ke lolo.

Wayesethi-ke u"Nkulunkulu ulizwi" makubekhona okumilayo emhlabeni ukuze umhlaba ube muhle. Ngempela kwamila izihlahla, utshani, nezimbali, kwabakuhle. Wayesethi yena uNkulunkuklu kungakuhle uma kungabakhona izilwane ezihamba emhlabeni nezizondiza emkhathini zaba khona. Kwamjabulisa uNkulunkulu lokho ukubona izinyamazane zishona emigedeni yazo, nezinyoni zindizela ezihlahleni, zingena ezidlekekni zazo uma ilanga lishona.

Wazithola yena engenandawo, noma lapho engaqamelisa khona ikhanda lakhe. Wayesethi uNkulunkulu "nami ngizozakhela indawo lapho ngizohlala khona." Wayesebutha uthuli lomhlaba wenza ngalo umzimba womuntu wathi "leli yithempeli lami", walingcwelisa.

Kuba yinto ebuhlungu uma umuntu esephendula ithempeli likaNkulunkulu i-hotela, eseqashisa. E-hotela kungena zonke izinhlobo zabantu. Abathakathi, amakholwa, izigebengu, nababulali bayangena ehotela. Kukhuluma imali yalowo muntu. Kungakho-ke uMpostoli ebeka uphawu emabunzini abantwana bakhe. Eseqedile ukukwenaza lokho, uyabuya-ke manje unika omuye nomunye inkemba esandleni sakhe ukuba agence bonke abangenalo uphawu emabunzini abo.

Yibaphi abangenaphawu emabunzini abo na?
Inzondo, ukuzigabisa, ukubukela abanye phansi, ukugxeka, ukungahloniphani, nokunye. Uma uneso lokuhawukela, kungcono ulivale ukuze ukwazi ukuzigenca lezizinto, ngoba uNkulunkulu akazifuni ezulwini lakhe.

UNkulunkulu anibusise nonke.

Owenu ku-Kristu,
N.V.Mlangeni.
UMONGAMELI.

nso.title: Tumedišo ya Moapostola ya ngwaga wa 2007/2008
nso.message:
Barategi go Morena.

Ke le dumediša ka moka.

E re ke le gopotše gore Modimo o hlotše magodimo le lefase, le lewatle. Ka morago ga go dira bjalo o ile a aroganya meetse le lefase ka ge a be a kopane. A re meetse a a boele ka thoko e tee. Ruri gwa direga, yena Modimo a re yeo ke lewatle.

Ke moka Modimo, e lego Lentšu, a re a go be le tše di melago lefaseng gore lefase le be lebotse. Ruri gwa mela dihlare, bjang, le matšoba, gwa ba botse.
