Ke moka yena Modimo a re go ka ba botse ge go ka ba le diphoofolo tše di sepelago lefaseng le tše di fofago sebakeng tša ba gona. Gwa thabiša Modimo seo go bona diphoofolo tša naga di tsena meleteng ya tšona, le dinonyana di fofela dihlareng, di tsena dihlageng tša tšona ge letšatši le sobela.

O ikhweditše yena a se na lefelo, goba mo a ka samelago hlogo ya gagwe gona. Ke moka Modimo a re "le nna ke tlo ikagela lefelo leo ke tlogo dula go lona." A kgoboketša lerole la lefase a dira ka lona mmele wa motho a re "ye ke tempele ya ka", a e kgethwaša.

Go ba selo se bohloko ge motho a fetoša tempele ya Modimo hotele, a thoma go e hiriša. Hoteleng go tsena mehuta ka moka ya batho. Baloi, badumedi, disenyi, le babolai ba a tsena hoteleng. Go bolela tšhelete ya motho yoo. Ke ka baka leo Moapostola a beago leswao diphatleng tša bana ba gagwe. Ge a feditše go dira seo, o a boa bjale a fa yo mongwe le yo mongwe tšhoša ka seatleng sa gagwe gore a reme bao ka moka ba se nago leswao diphatleng tša bona.

Ke bomang bao ba se nago leswao diphatleng tša bona?
Hloyo, go ikgantšha, go nyatša ba bangwe, go swaya diphošo, go se hlomphane, le tše dingwe. Ge o na le leihlo la mona, go kaone o le tswalele gore o kgone go irema dilo tše, gobane Modimo ga a di nyake legodimong la gagwe.

Modimo a le šegofatše ka moka.

Wa lena go Kriste,
N.V.Mlangeni.
MOPRESIDENTE.

en.title: Apostle's Greeting for the year 2008/2009.
en.message:
Beloved in the Lord I greet you. Let me remind you that: do not forget who you are, and what you were called for in this church of "Christ". You are the holy temple of God where God stays, and that you were called to work for the salvation of your souls and those of your family who have passed on. We will only do that if we love each other, and are one.

Beloved do not believe every spirit, but test whether they are of God because many false prophets have gone out into the world. Know the spirit of God by this; all spirits that confess that Jesus Christ has come in the flesh are His, there is that spirit that does not confess Jesus, that one is not of God. That is the antichrist you heard is coming, and has already arrived in the world. You are the children of God, you have defeated those spirits because He who is in you is greater than he who is in the world. They are of the world therefore they speak of the world, and the world hears them. We are of God, whoever knows God hears us, whoever is not of God does not hear us. By this let us know the spirit of God and the spirit of deception.

Beloved let us love one another because love comes from God, and everyone who loves is born of God. Whoever does not love does not know God. Let each one love his neighbour as he loves himself. Love your male and female officers, you will be loving God Himself.

Enter well into the new year of 2009. Praise the good you have seen, Forget the bad you have seen. Celebrate the days of Christmas well. May God bless you all in the new year and all your families, and may diseases subside so you all live.

I am yours in Christ,
N.V.Mlangeni
President.

st.title: Tumeliso ea Moapostola ea selemo sa 2008/2009.
st.message:
Baratuoa Moreneng kea le lumelisa. E re ke le hopotse hore: le se ke la lebala hore le bo-mang, le hore le biletselitsoe eng kerekeng ena ea "Kreste". Lona le tempele e halalelang ea Molimo moo Molimo a lulang teng, 'me le biletselitsoe ho sebeletsa poloko ea meea ea lona le ea malapa a lona a seng a fetile. Re tla etsa seo feela haeba re ratana, re le bang.

Baratuoa le se ke la lumela moea o mong le o mong, empa le leke hore na ke ea Molimo hobane baprofeta ba bangata ba bohata ba tsoetse lefatšeng. Tsebang moea oa Molimo ka sena; meea eohle e lumelang hore Jesu Kreste o tlile nameng ke ea hae, ho na le moea o sa lumeleng Jesu, oo hase oa Molimo. Eo ke mohanyetsi oa Kreste eo le utloileng hore oa tla, mme o se a fihlile lefatšeng. Lona le bana ba Molimo, le hlōtse meea eo hobane ea ho lona e moholo ho feta ea lefatšeng. Bona ke ba lefatše kahoo ba bua tsa lefatše, 'me lefatše lea ba utloa. Rona re ba Molimo, ea tsebang Molimo oa re utloa, ea seng oa Molimo ha a re utloe. Ka hona a re tsebeng moea oa Molimo le moea oa thetso.

Baratuoa a re rataneng hobane lerato le tsoa ho Molimo, mme e mong le e mong ea ratang o tsoetsoe ke Molimo. Ea sa rateng ha a tsebe Molimo. E mong le e mong a rate moahelani oa hae joalokaha a ithata. Ratang basebeletsi ba lona ba banna le ba basali, le tla be le rata Molimo ka boeena.

Kenang hantle selemong se secha sa 2009. Rorisang tse ntle tseo le li boneng, Lebalang tse mpe tseo le li boneng. Ketekang hantle matsatsi a Keresemese. Molimo a le hlohonolofatse bohle selemong se secha le malapa a lona 'ohle, mme maloetse a theohile hore le phele bohle.

Ke 'na oa lona ho Kreste,
N.V.Mlangeni
Mopresidente.

ts.title: Xilumiso xa Mupostola xa lembe ra 2008/2009.
ts.message:
Varhandziwa eka Hosi ndza mi losa. A ndzi mi tsundzuxeni leswaku: mi nga rivali leswaku mi vamani, naswona mi vitaneriwe yini ekerekeni leyi ya "Kreste". N'wina mi tempeli yo kwetsima ya Xikwembu laha Xikwembu xi tshamaka kona, naswona mi vitaniwile ku tirhela ku ponisiwa ka mimoya ya n'wina ni ya mindyangu ya n'wina leyi hundzeke. Hi ta endla sweswo ntsena loko hi rhandzana, naswona hi ri un'we.

Varhandziwa mi nga kholwi moya wun'wana ni wun'wana, kambe ringani mimoya leswaku i ya Xikwembu xana hikuva vaprofeta vo tala va mavunwa va humele emisaveni. Tivani moya wa Xikwembu hi leswi; mimoya hinkwayo leyi pfumelaka leswaku Yesu Kreste u tile enyameni i ya xona, ku na moya wolowo lowu nga pfumelikiki Yesu, wolowo a hi wa Xikwembu. Wolowo i nala wa Kreste loyi mi tweke leswaku wa ta, naswona u se a fikile emisaveni. N'wina mi vana va Xikwembu, mi yi hlurile mimoya yoleyo hikuva loyi a nga eka n'wina i nkulu ku tlula loyi a nga emisaveni. Vona i va misava hikokwalaho va vulavula swa misava, naswona misava ya va twa. Hina hi va Xikwembu, loyi a tivaka Xikwembu wa hi twa, loyi a nga riki wa Xikwembu a nga hi twi. Hi sweswo a hi tiveni moya wa Xikwembu ni moya wa vuxisi.

Varhandziwa a hi rhandzaneni hikuva rirhandzu ri huma eka Xikwembu, naswona un'wana ni un'wana loyi a rhandzaka u tswariwe hi Xikwembu. Loyi a nga rhandziki a nga tivi Xikwembu. Un'wana ni un'wana a a rhandze warikwavo kukotisa leswi a tirhandzaka hakona. Rhandzani malandza ya n'wina ya vavanuna ni ya vavasati, mi ta va mi rhandza Xikwembu hi xoxe.

Nghenani kahle eka lembe lerintshwa ra 2009. Dzunisani leswinene leswi mi swi voneke, Rivalani swo biha leswi mi swi voneke. Tlhandlekelani kahle masiku ya Khisimusi. Xikwembu a xi mi katekise hinkwenu eka lembe lerintshwa na mindyangu ya n'wina hinkwayo, naswona mavabyi ma hunguteka leswaku mi hanya hinkwenu.

Hi mina wa n'wina eka Kreste,
N.V.Mlangeni
Puresidente.

xh.title: Umbuliso woMpostile wonyaka ka-2008/2009.
xh.message:
Bathandekayo eNkosini ndiyanibulisa. Ndithi mandinikhumbuze ukuba: ningalibali ukuba ningobani, nokuba nabizelwa ntoni kule cawe ka-"Kristu". Nina niyitempile engcwele uThixo ahlala kuyo, kwaye nabizelwa ukusebenzela usindiso lwemiphefumlo yenu neyabo bakuni asele bedlule ehlabathini. Siya kukwenza oko kuphela xa sithandana, kwaye simunye.

Bathandekayo ningakholwa ngamimoya yonke, kodwa yivavanyeni ukuba ivela kuThixo na kuba baninzi abaprofeti bobuxoki abaphumele ehlabathini. Yazini umoya kaThixo ngale nto; yonke imimoya evumayo ukuba uYesu Kristu ufikile enyameni yeyakhe, kukho loo moya ungamvumiyo uYesu, lowo asinguwo okaThixo. Lowo ngumchasi-Kristu enive ngaye ukuba uyeza, kwaye asele efikile ehlabathini. Nina ningabantwana bakaThixo, niyoyisile loo mimoya kuba lowo ukuni mkhulu kunalowo usehlabathini. Bona ngabehlabathi ngoko bathetha okwehlabathi, kwaye ihlabathi liyabeva. Thina singabakaThixo, omaziyo uThixo uyasiva, ongenguye okaThixo akasiva. Ngoko ke masiwazi umoya kaThixo nomoya wenkohliso.

Bathandekayo masithandane kuba uthando luvela kuThixo, kwaye wonke othandayo uzalwe nguThixo. Ongathandiyo akamazi uThixo. Omnye nomnye makathande ummelwane wakhe njengoko ezithanda yena. Thandani amagosa enu angamadoda namabhinqa, niya kuba nithanda uThixo ngokwakhe.

Ngenani kakuhle kunyaka omtsha ka-2009. Nincome okuhle enikubonileyo, nilibale okubi enikubonileyo. Zibhiyozeleni kakuhle iintsuku zeKrisimesi. UThixo anisikelele nonke kunyaka omtsha kunye neentsapho zenu zonke, kwaye nezifo zihle ukuze niphile nonke.

Ndim owakho kuKristu,
N.V.Mlangeni
UMongameli.

zu.title: Umbuliso Wompostoli wonyaka-ka 2008/2009.
zu.message:
Bathandekayo elNkosini ngiyanibingelela. Ngithi ake nginikhumbuze ukuthi: ningakhohlwa eniylkho, nenakubizelwa kulenkonzo-ka "Christ". Nina niyi-thempell elingcwele lika-Nkulunkulu lapho u-Nkulunkulu ehlala khona, nanokuthi nabizeliwa ukuzosebenzela usindiso Iwemiphefumulo yenu kanye napakini abangasekhoyo. Siyokwenza lokho kuphela-nje uma sithandana, simunye.

Bathandekayo ningakholwa yibobonke omoya, kepha hlolani ukuthi bangabaka-Nkulunkułu yini ngokuba baningi abaprofethi bamanga abaphumele ezweni. Yazini umoya ka-Nikulunkulu ngatokhu; bonke omoya abavuma ukuthi u-Jesu Kristu ufikile enyameni bangabakhe, kukhona loyo moya ongavumi uJesu, akasiye oka-Nkulunkulu loyo. Loyo ungumphiki Kristu enizwe ngaye ukuthi uyeza, nokuthi usefikile ezweni. Nina ningabantwana baka Nkulunkulu, niwehlulite leyo moya ngoba okini mkhulu kunaloyo ośezweni. Borra bangabezwe ngalokho bakhuluma okwasezweni, nelizwe Hyabezwa. Thina singabaka-Nkulunkulu, omaziyo uNkulunkulu uyasizwa, ongasiye oka-Nkulunikulu akasizwa. Ngalokho masiwazi umoya ka-Nkulunkulu nomoya wokwedukisa.

Bathandėkayo masithandane ngoba uthando luvéla kuNkulunkulu, nabo bonke abathandanayo bazelwe uNkulunkulu. Ongathandiyo akamazi uŃkulunkulu. Omunye nomunye akathande umakhelwane wakhe njengoba ezithanda yena. Thandani izinceku nezincekukazi zenu, niyobe nithanda uNkulunkulu uqobo Iwakhe.

Ningene kahle onyakeni omusha ka-2009. Nituse okuhle enikubonlle, Mikhohlwe okubi enikubonile. Nizigubhe kahle izinsuku zika khisimusi.Unkulunkulu anibusise nonke onyakeni omusha nemindeni yenu yonke, nezifo zidambe niphile nonke.

Yimina owenu ku-Kristu,
N.V.Mlangeni
Umongameli.

nso.title: Tumedišo ya Moapostola ya ngwaga wa 2008/2009.
nso.message:
Barategi go Morena ke a le dumediša. A ke le gopotše gore: le se ke la lebala gore le bomang, le gore le bileditšwe eng kerekeng ye ya "Kriste". Lena le tempele e kgethwa ya Modimo moo Modimo a dulago gona, le gore le bileditšwe go šomela phološo ya meoya ya lena gotee le ya malapa a lena bao ba fetilego. Re tla dira seo fela ge re ratana, re le tee.

Barategi le se ke la dumela meoya ka moka, eupša lekang gore na ke ya Modimo gobane baporofeta ba maaka ba bantši ba tšwetše lefaseng. Tsebang moya wa Modimo ka se; meoya ka moka yeo e dumago gore Jesu Kriste o tlile nameng ke ya gagwe, go na le moya woo o sa dumego Jesu, yoo ga se wa Modimo. Yoo ke mophikakriste yo le kwelego gore o e tla, le gore o šetše a fihlile lefaseng. Lena le bana ba Modimo, le fentše meoya yeo gobane yo a lego go lena ke yo mogolo go feta yo a lego lefaseng. Bona ke ba lefase ka gona ba bolela tša lefase, le lefase le a ba kwa. Rena re ba Modimo, yo a tsebago Modimo o a re kwa, yo e sego wa Modimo ga a re kwe. Ka se a re tsebeng moya wa Modimo le moya wa timetšo.

Barategi a re rataneng gobane lerato le tšwa go Modimo, le mang le mang yo a ratago o tswetšwe ke Modimo. Yo a sa ratego ga a tsebe Modimo. Yo mongwe le yo mongwe a rate moagišani wa gagwe bjalo ka ge a ithata. Ratang bahlanka ba lena ba banna le ba basadi, le tla be le rata Modimo ka noši.

Tsenang gabotse ngwageng o moswa wa 2009. Reta se sebotse seo o se bonego, Lebala se sebe seo o se bonego. Ketekang gabotse matšatši a khirisemose. Modimo a le šegofatše ka moka ngwageng o moswa le malapa a lena ka moka, le malwetši a fokotšege gore le phele ka moka.

Ke nna wa lena go Kriste,
N.V.Mlangeni
Mopresidente.

zu.title: Umbuliso woMpostoli wonyaka-ka 2009/2010
zu.message:
Bathandekayo eNkosini.

Ngiyanibingelela egameni lika Kristu oyinkosi nomsindisi wethu.

Akengilethe ukubonga phakathi kwenu kulonyaka ka 2009/ 2010, sisagcinekile kuzilingo nokuhlupheka kwalomhlaba.

Mangisho lokhu ukuthi uNkulunkulu wethu uyaphila, uyasizwa uma simbiza sisebunzimeni bemisebenzi yesitha, njengokugula enyameni nasemoyeni. Kodwa-ke asingamkhumbuli kuphela uma sinobunzima esisuke sikubo, uma sekudlulile lokho bese siyakhohiwa uyena, bese sifana nomuntu ongakholwa, athi uma ehamba angabi nandaba noNkulunkulu uMdali wakhe akhulume nje umathanda, kodwa ake akhutshwe onyaweni lophe uzwane, ukhala kakhululu, ayibize inkosi akade enganandaba nayo athi; "awu nkosi yami, ngaze ngalimala." Kusho ukuthi ubuhlungu obunye nobunye buyamsondeza kuNkulunkulu, ayikhumbule inkosi yakhe ngaleso sikhathi, kuthi kungadlula akhohlwe abese ephindela futhi kuleziya zinto ekade ekhuzwa kuzo uNkulunkulu angazifuni.

Konke lokho kudalwa yini? Ukungeneliseki, nobukhulu, nokuzibona ngingcono kunomunye umuntu. Ngiyaninxusa bathandekayo eNkosini ukuthi asizehlise sibe njengabantwana, sibe yize ukuze uNkulunkulu yena abe utho ngaphakathi kwethu. Sihloniphe umhlaba esiphila kuwo nababusi bawo.

Ngithanda ukusho ukuthi uma umuntu engahloniphi omunye umuntu usuke esephelelwe unembeza ngaphakathi kwakhe. Akufanele ukuthi sikhohlwe ukuthi uNkulunkulu wasipha inggondo yokucabanga, sazane ngimazi omunye umuntu ukuthi naye udalwe uNkulunkulu njengami, ubuhlungu abuzwayo nami ngiyabuzwa, futhi siyeke ukucabangelana izinto ezingenabu-Nkulunkulu, ezingekho, ngoba lokho ukudlinza, kanti siyafundiswa ukuthi ukudlinza kuyisono ngoba kungenzeka ukuthi udlinzela umfowenu noma udadewenu ngento engekho, ususesonweni ngoba usufana nomuntu obulele umphefumulo ongenacala.

Asibe inkonzo, senze esakubizelwa kulenkonzo, sishumayele umbuso wezulu lapho ukrestu eyinkosi nomsindisi khona. Sibe noxolo nothando ngaphakathi kwethu. Kepha konke lokho kugale emakhaya. Ngiyazidla ngabavangeli, ugandaganda lo, Angisakhulumi ngenzalabantu, omama bomthandazo (blue train). Ingavinjwa ngubani? Ayimi eziteshini ezincane. Kuqhela yonke into esuke iphambi kwayo, kuphephuka konke okusemaceleni.

Alishe Ivangeli bantwana baka-Baba. Izifo aziphele phakathi kwenu, namathuba emisebenzi awavuleke ezweni ububha buphele.

Owenu ku-Krestu.
N.V.Mlangeni
Umongameli.

en.title: Apostle's Greeting for the year 2009/2010
en.message:
Beloved in the Lord.

I greet you in the name of Christ our Lord and saviour.

Let me bring thanks among you this year 2009/2010, we are still kept safe from the temptations and suffering of this world.

Let me say this, our God is alive, He hears us when we call Him in the difficulty of the enemy's works, like sickness in flesh and spirit. But let us not remember Him only when we are in difficulty, when that has passed we forget Him, and be like an unbeliever, who walks not caring about God His Creator and speaks whatever he likes, but let him stub his toe, he cries loudly, calling the Lord he did not care about saying; 'oh my Lord, I am hurt.' This means that any pain draws a person closer to God, to remember his Lord at that time, and when it passes he forgets and goes back to those things God warned him against and does not want.

What causes all this? Dissatisfaction, pride, and seeing oneself better than another person. I urge you beloved in the Lord to humble ourselves and be like children, be nothing so that God Himself may be something within us. Let us respect the earth we live in and its rulers.

I want to say that if a person does not respect another person, he has lost his conscience within. We must not forget that God gave us the mind to think, to know that another person is also created by God like me, the pain they feel I also feel, and let us stop suspecting each other of ungodly things that do not exist, because that is suspicion, and we are taught that suspicion is a sin because it can happen that you suspect your brother or sister of something that does not exist, and you sin because you become like a person who killed an innocent soul.

Let us be a church, do what we were called for in this church, preach the kingdom of heaven where Christ is Lord and saviour. Let us have peace and love within us. But all that must start at home. I am proud of the evangelists, this tractor, I am not talking about the people-bearer, the praying mothers (blue train). Who can block it? It does not stop at small stations. Everything in front of it moves aside, everything on the sides is blown away.

Let the Gospel burn, children of the Father. May diseases end among you, and job opportunities open in the land and poverty end.

Yours in Christ.
N.V. Mlangeni
President.

nso.title: Tumedišo ya Moapostola ya ngwaga wa 2009/2010
nso.message:
Barategi go Morena.

Ke le dumediša ka leina la Kriste yo e lego Morena le mophološi wa rena.

E re ke tliše ditebogo gare ga lena ngwageng wo wa 2009/2010, re sa bolokilwe molekong le tlaišegong ya lefase le.

E re ke re, Modimo wa rena o a phela, o a re kwa ge re mo bitša mathateng a mešomo ya lenaba, go swana le bolwetši nameng le moyeng. Eupša a re se ke ra mo gopola fela ge re le mathateng, ge a fetile re a mo lebala, ra swana le yo a sa dumego, yo a sepelago a sa kgathale ka Modimo Mmopi wa gagwe a bolela se a se ratago, eupša a ke a kgotšwe monwana wa leoto, o lla kudu, a bitša Morena yo a bego a sa kgathale ka yena a re; 'joo Morena wa ka, ke gobetše.' Se se ra gore bohloko bofe goba bofe bo batametša motho kgauswi le Modimo, go gopola Morena wa gagwe ka nako yeo, mme ge bo feta o a lebala a boela dilong tšeo Modimo a mo lemošitšego tšona a sa di nyake.

Se ka moka se hlolwa ke eng? Go se kgotsofale, boikgantšho, le go ipona o le kaone go phala motho yo mongwe. Ke le kgothatša barategi go Morena gore re ikokobetše re be bjalo ka bana, re be lefeela gore Modimo ka noši a be selo ka gare ga rena. A re hlompheng lefase leo re phelago go lona le babuši ba lona.

Ke nyaka go re ge motho a sa hlomphe motho yo mongwe, o lobile letswalo la gagwe ka gare. Ga ra swanela go lebala gore Modimo o re file monagano wa go nagana, go tseba gore motho yo mongwe le yena o hlotšwe ke Modimo go swana le nna, bohloko bjo ba bo kwago le nna ke a bo kwa, mme a re tlogeleng go gononelana ka dilo tše di se nago bomodimo tše di sego gona, gobane seo ke kgononelo, gomme re rutwa gore kgononelo ke sebe gobane go ka direga gore o gononele ngwaneno goba kgaetšedi ya gago ka selo se se sego gona, mme o dire sebe gobane o swana le motho yo a bolayago moya wo o se nago molato.

A re beng kereke, re dire seo re bileditšwego sona kerekeng ye, re rere mmušo wa legodimo moo Kriste e lego Morena le mophološi. A re beng le khutšo le lerato ka gare ga rena. Eupša tšeo ka moka di swanetše go thoma ka gae. Ke ikgantšha ka baebangedi, terekere ye, ga ke bolele ka rwalabatho, bomme ba thapelo (terene e tala). Ke mang a ka e thibelago? Ga e eme ditešeneng tše nnyane. Se sengwe le se sengwe se se lego pele ga yona se suta thoko, se sengwe le se sengwe sa ka mathoko se a fefolwa.

Ebangedi a e tuke, bana ba Tate. Malwetši a fele gare ga lena, gomme menyetla ya mešomo e bulege nageng mme bodiidi bo fele.

Wa lena go Kriste.
N.V. Mlangeni
Mopresidente.

xh.title: Umbuliso woMpostile wonyaka ka-2009/2010
xh.message:
Bathandekayo eNkosini.

Ndiyanibulisa egameni likaKristu oyiNkosi nomSindisi wethu.

Mandizise umbulelo phakathi kwenu kulo nyaka ka-2009/2010, sisagciniwe kwizilingo nasekubandezelekeni kweli hlabathi.

Manditsho oku, uThixo wethu uyaphila, uyasiva xa simbiza ebunzimeni bemisebenzi yotshaba, njengokugula enyameni nasemoyeni. Kodwa masiyingamkhumbuli kuphela xa sisebunzimeni, xa oko kudlulile simlibale, kwaye sibe njengongakholwayo, ohamba engakhathali ngoThixo uMdali wakhe ethetha nantoni na ayithandayo, kodwa makabethe uzwane lwakhe, ukhala kakhulu, ebiza iNkosi abengakhathali ngayo esithi; 'owu Nkosi yam, ndenzakele.' Oku kuthetha ukuba nayiphi na intlungu isondeza umntu kuThixo, ukuba akhumbule iNkosi yakhe ngelo xesha, kwaye xa idlula uyalibala abuyele kwezo zinto uThixo wamlumkisa ngazo kwaye angazifuniyo.

Kudalwa yintoni konke oku? Ukungoneliseki, ikratshi, nokuzibona ubhetele kunomnye umntu. Ndiyanibongoza bathandekayo eNkosini ukuba sizithobe kwaye sibe njengabantwana, sibe yinto engento ukuze uThixo ngokwakhe abe yinto ngaphakathi kwethu. Masihloniphe umhlaba esiphila kuwo nabalawuli bawo.

Ndifuna ukuthi ukuba umntu akamhloniphi omnye umntu, uphulukene nesazela sakhe ngaphakathi. Asifanele silibale ukuba uThixo wasinika ingqondo yokucinga, ukuba sazi ukuba omnye umntu naye udalwe nguThixo njengam, intlungu abayivayo nam ndiyayiva, kwaye masiyeke ukukrokreleana ngezinto ezingekhoyo, kuba oko kukurhanela, kwaye sifundiswa ukuba ukurhanela sisono kuba kunokwenzeka ukuba urhanele umzalwana okanye udade wenu ngento engekhoyo, kwaye wona kuba uba njengomntu obulele umphefumlo ongenatyala.

Masibe yicawe, senze oko sabizelwa kona kule cawe, sishumayele ubukumkani bamazulu apho uKristu eyiNkosi nomsindisi. Masibe noxolo nothando ngaphakathi kwethu. Kodwa konke oko makale ekhaya. Ndiyazingca ngabavangeli, le nqwelo, andithethi ngomthwali-bantu, oomama bomthandazo (uloliwe oluhlaza). Ngubani onokuyivala? Ayimi kwizikhululo ezincinci. Yonke into ephambi kwayo iyashenxa, yonke into esemacaleni iyaphetshethwa.

IVangeli mayitshise, bantwana boBawo. Izifo maziphele phakathi kwenu, namathuba emisebenzi avuleke elizweni kwaye intlupheko iphele.

Owakho kuKristu.
N.V. Mlangeni
UMongameli.

ts.title: Xilumiso xa Mupostola xa lembe ra 2009/2010
ts.message:
Varhandziwa eka Hosi.

Ndzi mi losa hi vito ra Kreste loyi a nga Hosi na muponisi wa hina.

A ndzi tise ku nkhensa exikarhi ka n'wina eka lembe leri ra 2009/2010, ha ha hlayisiwile eka miringo na ku xaniseka ka misava leyi.

A ndzi vule leswi, Xikwembu xa hina xa hanya, xa hi twa loko hi xi vitana eku tikeni ka mintirho ya nala, ku fana na vuvabyi enyameni na le moyeni. Kambe a hi nga xi tsundzuki ntsena loko hi ri eku tikeni, loko sweswo swi hundzile ha xi rivala, kutani hi fana na munhu la nga pfumeriki, loyi a fambaka a nga khathali hi Xikwembu Muvumbi wa yena a vula xin'wana na xin'wana lexi a xi rhandzaka, kambe a a khunguvanyisiwe xikunwana xa yena, u rila hi matimba, a vitana Hosi leyi a nga khathali hi yona a ku; 'mawe Hosi yanga, ndzi vavisekile.' Leswi swi vula leswaku ku vava kwihi na kwihi ku tshineta munhu kusuhi na Xikwembu, ku tsundzuka Hosi ya yena hi nkarhi wolowo, naswona loko swi hundza wa rivala kutani a tlhelela eka swilo sweswo leswi Xikwembu xi n'wi tsundzuxeke eka swona naswona xi nga swi laviki.

I yini lexi vangaka leswi hinkwaswo? Ku nga eneriseki, ku tikukumuxa, na ku tivona u ri antswa ku tlula munhu un'wana. Ndzi mi khongela varhandziwa eka Hosi leswaku hi titsongahata hi va tanihi vana, hi nga vi nchumu leswaku Xikwembu hi xoxe xi nga va nchumu endzeni ka hina. A hi hlonipheni misava leyi hi tshamaka eka yona na vafumi va yona.

Ndzi lava ku vula leswaku loko munhu a nga hloniphi munhu un'wana, u lahlekeriwe hi ripfalo ra yena endzeni. A hi fanelanga ku rivala leswaku Xikwembu xi hi nyikile mianakanyo yo ehleketa, ku tiva leswaku munhu un'wana na yena u tumbuluxiwile hi Xikwembu ku fana na mina, ku vava loku va ku twaka na mina ndza ku twa, naswona a hi tshikeni ku ehleketelelana hi swilo swa vuxikwembu leswi nga riki kona, hikuva sweswo i ku ehleketelela, naswona hi dyondzisiwa leswaku ku ehleketelela i xidyoho hikuva swi nga endleka leswaku u ehleketelela makwenu wa xinuna kumbe wa xisati hi nchumu lowu nga riki kona, kutani u dyoha hikuva u fana na munhu loyi a dlayeke moya lowu nga riki na nandzu.

A hi veni kereke, hi endla leswi hi vitaneriweke swona ekerekeni leyi, hi chumayela mfungho wa tilo laha Kreste a nga Hosi na muponisi. A hi veni na ku rhula na rirhandzu endzeni ka hina. Kambe hinkwaswo sweswo swi fanele ku sungula ekaya. Ndzi tinyungubyisa hi vavangeli, terekitara leyi, a ndzi vulavuli hi murhwala-vanhu, vamanana lava khongelaka (xitimela xa rihlaza). I mani la nga yi pfalelaka? A yi yimi eswitichini leswitsongo. Hinkwaswo leswi nga emahlweni ka yona swi fambela etlhelo, hinkwaswo leswi nga ematlhelo swa hahluriwa.

Evhangeli a yi pfurhe, vana va Tatana. Mavabyi a ma hele exikarhi ka n'wina, naswona menyetla ya mintirho yi pfuleka etikweni naswona vusweti byi hela.

Wa n'wina eka Kreste.
N.V. Mlangeni
Puresidente.

st.title: Molaetsa oa Moapostola oa selemo sa 2009/2010
st.message:
Baratuoa Moreneng.

Kea le lumelisa ka lebitso la Kreste eo e leng Morena le mopholosi oa rona.

E re ke tlise liteboho har'a lona selemong sena sa 2009/2010, re sa ntse re bolokiloe litekong le mahlomoleng a lefatše lena.

E re ke re, Molimo oa rona oa phela, oa re utloa ha re mo bitsa bothateng ba mesebetsi ea sera, joalo ka ho kula nameng le moeeng. Empa a re se keng ra mo hopola feela ha re le bothateng, ha boo bo fetile rea mo lebala, mme re tšoane le motho ea sa lumeleng, ea tsamaeang a sa tsotelle Molimo Mmopi oa hae a bua eng kapa eng eo a e ratang, empa a ke a khoptjoe monoana oa hae oa leoto, o lla haholo, a bitsa Morena eo a neng a sa mo tsotelle a re; 'oho Morena oa ka, ke utloile bohloko.' Sena se bolela hore bohloko bofe kapa bofe bo hulela motho haufi le Molimo, ho hopola Morena oa hae ka nako eo, mme ha bo feta oa lebala mme o khutlela ho lintho tseo Molimo a mo lemositseng ka tsona le tseo a sa li batleng.

Hona ho bakoa ke eng? Ho se khotsofale, boikhohomoso, le ho ipona o le betere ho feta motho e mong. Ke le khothaletsa baratuoa Moreneng hore re ikokobetse mme re be joalo ka bana, re be lefeela e le hore Molimo ka boeena e be ntho e itseng kahare ho rona. A re hlompheng lefatše leo re phelang ho lona le babusi ba lona.

Ke batla ho re haeba motho a sa hlomphe motho e mong, o lahlehetsoe ke letsoalo la hae kahare. Ha rea lokela ho lebala hore Molimo o re file kelello ho nahana, ho tseba hore motho e mong le eena o bopiloe ke Molimo joalo ka 'na, bohloko boo ba bo utloang le 'na kea bo utloa, mme a re tloheleng ho belaellana ka lintho tse se nang bomolimo tse seng teng, hobane seo ke pelaelo, 'me re rutoa hore pelaelo ke sebe hobane ho ka etsahala hore u belaelle mor'eno kapa khaitseli ea hao ka ntho e seng teng, 'me u etse sebe hobane u tšoana le motho ea bolaileng moea o se nang molato.

A re beng kereke, re etse seo re biletselitsoeng sona kerekeng ena, re bolele 'muso oa leholimo moo Kreste e leng Morena le mopholosi. A re beng le khotso le lerato kahare ho rona. Empa seo sohle se tlameha ho qala hae. Ke motlotlo ka baevangeli, terekere ena, ha ke bue ka mojari oa batho, bomme ba rapelang (terene e putsoa). Ke mang ea ka e thibelang? Ha e eme liteisheneng tse nyane. Ntho e 'ngoe le e 'ngoe e ka pele ho eona ea sutha, ntho e 'ngoe le e 'ngoe e ka mahlakoreng ea fefoloa.

Evangeli a e che, bana ba Ntate. Maloetse a fele har'a lona, 'me menyetla ea mesebetsi e bulehe naheng mme bofutsana bo fele.

Ea lona ho Kreste.
N.V. Mlangeni
Mopresidente.

zu.title: Umbuliso womPostoli wonyaka-ka2010-2011
zu.message:
Bathandekayo e-Nkosini,
Ngiyanibingelela nonke egameni elihle leNkosi yothu uJesu Kristu, nginamukele futhi osukwini olukhulu kangaka esilwenzelwe yiyo iNkosi ngothando Iwayo nangomusa wayo.

Mangisho ukuthi njengoba ngasho ukuthi: uma ngabe sifuna ukubona uthando uNkulunkulu asisthanda ngalo, akuqale thina sithandane. Umama athande ubaba wakwakhe amhloniphe, nezingane zihloniphe abazali emakhaya.

Umzalwane aziqhenye ngomshumayeli wakhe, nomshumayeli kanjalo ngoMprisita wakhe, noMprisita kanjalo ngoMdala wakhe, noMdala kanjalo ngo District wakhe, naye uDistrict kanjalo ngoMveleli wakhe, uMveleli naye aziqhenye ngoMpostoli wakhe, ingonyama iyonithwala nonke ngamahlombe ayo abanzi inise kukrestu.

Yasho kanjalo iNkosi yamakhosi yathi: hlalani ngokuthula eJerusalema, nihlephule isinkwa, nithandane, nibe munye njengami nobaba. Uma nenze kanjalo, mina nobaba sizohlala phakathi kwenu. Nibusisiswe uma benithuka, bekhuluma konke okubi ngani, beqamba amanga ngenxa yami. Jabulani nithokoze ngoba umvuzo wenu mukhulu ezulwini.
Ningaphindiseli ububi ngobubi, uJehova woninqobela.

Nibe nosuku oluhle nolumandi olnesibusiso.
Owenu eNkosini,
N.V.Mlangeni
Umongameli.

en.title: Apostle's Greeting for the year 2010-2011
en.message:
Beloved in the Lord,
I greet you all in the beautiful name of our Lord Jesus Christ, and I welcome you to such a great day made for us by the Lord through His love and grace.

Let me say that as I have said: if we want to see the love God has for us, it must begin with us loving one another. A mother must love and respect her husband, and children must respect their parents in the home.

A brother must be proud of his preacher, the preacher likewise of his Priest, the Priest likewise of his Elder, the Elder likewise of his District, the District likewise of his Overseer, the Overseer also proud of his Apostle, the lamb will carry you all on its broad shoulders and bring you to Christ.

So said the King of kings: dwell in peace in Jerusalem, break bread, love one another, be one as I and the father. If you do so, the father and I will dwell among you. You are blessed when they insult you, speak all evil against you, telling lies because of me. Rejoice and be glad because your reward is great in heaven.
Do not repay evil with evil, Jehovah will conquer for you.

Have a good and sweet blessed day.
Yours in the Lord,
N.V.Mlangeni
President.

nso.title: Tumedišo ya Moapostola ya ngwaga wa 2010-2011
nso.message:
Barategi go Morena,
Ke le dumediša ka moka ka leina le lebotse la Morena wa rena Jesu Kriste, mme ke le amogela letšatšing le legolo le re le diretšwego ke Morena ka lerato le mogau wa Gagwe.

E re ke re bjalo ka ge ke boletše: ge re nyaka go bona lerato leo Modimo a re ratago ka lona, go swanetše go thoma ka rena re ratana. Mma a rate le go hlompha monna wa gagwe, gomme bana ba hlomphe batswadi ba bona ka gae.

Ngwanabo rena o swanetše go ikgantšha ka moreri wa gagwe, moreri le yena ka Moprista wa gagwe, Moprista le yena ka Mogolo wa gagwe, Mogolo le yena ka Selete sa gagwe, Selete le sona ka Molebeledi wa sona, Molebeledi le yena a ikgantšhe ka Moapostola wa gagwe, kwanyana e tla le rwala ka moka magetleng a yona a magolo ya le iša go Kriste.

Kgoši ya dikgoši e boletše bjalo ya re: dulang ka khutšo Jerusalema, arolelanang senkgwa, ratanang, ebang batee bjalo ka nna le tate. Ge le dira bjalo, nna le tate re tla dula gare ga lena. Le šegofaditšwe ge ba le roga, ba bolela bobe ka moka ka lena, ba bolela maaka ka baka la ka. Thabang le hlalale gobane moputso wa lena o mogolo legodimong.
Le se ke la lefetša bobe ka bobe, Jehofa o tla le fenyeletša.

Ebang le letšatši le lebotse le le bose le le šegofaditšwego.
Wa lena go Morena,
N.V.Mlangeni
Mopresidente.

xh.title: Umbuliso woMpostile wonyaka ka-2010-2011
xh.message:
Bathandekayo eNkosini,
Ndiyanibulisa nonke egameni elihle leNkosi yethu uYesu Kristu, kwaye ndiniyamkela kolu suku lukhulu senzelwe lona yiNkosi ngothando nobabalo Lwayo.

Manditsho ukuba njengoko nditshilo: ukuba sifuna ukubona uthando uThixo asithanda ngalo, kufuneka kuqale ngathi sithandane. Umama makathande kwaye ahloniphe umyeni wakhe, nabantwana bahloniphe abazali babo ekhaya.

Umzalwana makazingce ngomshumayeli wakhe, umshumayeli kwangokunjalo ngoMbingeleli wakhe, uMbingeleli kwangokunjalo ngoMdala wakhe, uMdala kwangokunjalo ngesiThili sakhe, isiThili kwangokunjalo ngoMveleli waso, uMveleli naye azingce ngoMpostile wakhe, imvana iyakunithwala nonke emagxeni ayo abanzi inise kuKristu.

Yatsho iNkosi yookumkani yathi: hlalani ngoxolo eYerusalem, qhekezani isonka, thandanani, nibe banye njengam nobawo. Ukuba nenza njalo, ubawo nam siya kuhlala phakathi kwenu. Nisikelelwe nina xa banithukayo, bathethe konke okubi ngani, bexoka ngenxa yam. Vuyani nigcobe kuba umvuzo wenu mkhulu ezulwini.
Ningaphindezeli ububi ngobubi, uYehova uya kunoyisela.

Yibani nosuku oluhle nolumnandi olusikelelweyo.
Owakho eNkosini,
N.V.Mlangeni
UMongameli.

ts.title: Xilumiso xa Mupostola xa lembe ra 2010-2011
ts.message:
Varhandziwa eka Hosi,
Ndzi mi losa hinkwenu hi vito ro saseka ra Hosi ya hina Yesu Kreste, naswona ndzi mi amukela eka siku leri rikulu leri hi endleriweke rona hi Hosi hi rirhandzu na tintswalo ta Yona.

A ndzi vule leswaku hilaha ndzi vuleke hakona: loko hi lava ku vona rirhandzu leri Xikwembu xi nga na rona eka hina, swi fanele ku sungula hi hina ku rhandzana. Manana u fanele ku rhandza na ku hlonipha nuna wa yena, naswona vana va fanele ku hlonipha vatswari va vona ekaya.

Makwerhu wa xinuna u fanele ku tinyungubyisa hi muchumayeli wa yena, muchumayeli hilaha ku fanaka hi Muprista wa yena, Muprista hilaha ku fanaka hi Nkulu wa yena, Nkulu hilaha ku fanaka hi Xifundzha xa yena, Xifundzha hilaha ku fanaka hi Mulanguteri wa xona, Mulanguteri na yena a tinyungubyisa hi Mupostola wa yena, xinyimpfana xi ta mi rhwala hinkwenu emakatleni ya xona yo anama xi mi tisa eka Kreste.

Hosi ya tihosi yi vule tano yi ku: tshamani hi ku rhula eYerusalema, phemani xinkwa, rhandzanani, vanani van'we tanihi mina na tatana. Loko mi endla tano, tatana na mina hi ta tshama exikarhi ka n'wina. Mi katekile loko va mi rhukana, va vula hinkwaswo swo biha hi n'wina, va vula mavunwa hikwalaho ka mina. Tsakani mi hlalala hikuva hakelo ya n'wina i yikulu etilweni.
Mi nga tlheriseli vubihi hi vubihi, Yehovha u ta mi hlulela.

Vanani na siku lerinene na ro tsokombela leri katekisiweke.
Wa n'wina eka Hosi,
N.V.Mlangeni
Puresidente.

st.title: Molaetsa oa Moapostola oa selemo sa 2010-2011
st.message:
Baratuoa Moreneng,
Kea le lumelisa bohle ka lebitso le letle la Morena oa rona Jesu Kreste, 'me ke le amohela letsatsing lena le leholo leo re le eleditsoeng ke Morena ka lerato le mohau oa Hae.

E re ke re joalo ka ha ke boletse: haeba re batla ho bona lerato leo Molimo a re ratang ka lona, ho tlameha ho qala ka rona ho ratana. 'M'e o tlameha ho rata le ho hlompha monna oa hae, 'me bana ba hlomphe batsoali ba bona ka tlung.

Moena o tlameha ho ikhohomosa ka moreri oa hae, moreri le eena ka Moprista oa hae, Moprista le eena ka Moholo oa hae, Moholo le eena ka Setereke sa hae, Setereke le sona ka Molebeli oa sona, Molebeli le eena a ikhohomose ka Moapostola oa hae, konyana e tla le jara bohle mahetleng a eona a sephara mme e le tlise ho Kreste.

Ho boletse Morena oa marena: lulang ka khotso Jerusalema, arolelanang bohobe, ratanang, ebang bang joalo ka nna le ntate. Haeba le etsa joalo, ntate le nna re tla lula har'a lona. Le hlohonolofalitsoe ha ba le rohaka, ba bua tsohle tse mpe ka lona, ba bua leshano ka lebaka la ka. Thabang le nyakalle hobane moputso oa lona o moholo leholimong.
Le se ke la busetsa bobe ka bobe, Jehova o tla le hlolela.

Ebang le letsatsi le letle le le monate le hlohonolofalitsoeng.
Ea lona Moreneng,
N.V.Mlangeni
Mopresidente.

zu.title: Umbuliso woMpostoli wonyaka-ka 2011-2012
zu.message:
Bathandekayo eNkisini,
Ngiyanibingelela egameni elihle leNkosi yethu uJesu Kristu.

Njengoba sisuka kuzindawo ezahlukene kumagumbi omane omhlaba, sizodumisa uMdali ngeNdodana yakhe uJesu Krestu, ngithanda ukusho ukuthi nathi sinishumayeza lona ilizwi esalizwa lokuthi uNkulunkulu ungukukhanya, ubumyama abukho kuye nakanye. Uma sithi sinenhlangayelo naye kodwa sibe sisahamba ebumnyameni, sinamanga ngoba iginiso alikho kithi. Kepha uma sihamba ekukhanyeni njengalokhu yena uqobo esekukhanyeni, nathi asibe sekukhanyeni omunye nomunye. Ngegazi likaJesu iNdodana yakhe uyakusihlambulula ezonweni zethu zonke. Angikholwa ukuthi usekhona osayingabaza lenkonzo kaKristu, ngabe akuyena owalenkonzo.

Bobaba thandani omkenu, nani bomama thandani abayeni benu, ukuze nabantwana bafunde ukuthandana emakhaya ethu, bafunde ukuhlonipha abazali, nabo futhi bahloniphane bebodwa. Asiphathe kahle izihambi, sihloniphe omakhelwane bethu, sibathande njengoba sizithanda thina. Siyafunda ezincwadini ezingcwele ukuthi uNkulnkulu walithanda izwe kangaka, waze wathumela iNciodana yakhe ezelwe yodwa ukuthi izofela izwe.

Izinto ezenzeka ezweni lonke zihlasimulisa umziba. Ngaphandle abantu bayabulalana bebodwa. Lesi yisikhathi sokuthi sihlangane sibe munye, sithandaze, singalilahli ithemba noma ngabe kunjani, sihlale kuyo ingoyama. Angeke mina nginilahle, ngiyokuwa ngivuka nani kuze kube sekugcineni. Ningabi namathemba kodwa nibe nethemba elilodwa. Ningamngabazi, akekho omunye nguye lo! Hlalani nonke ngamoya munye nithembane, omunye nomunye encekwini yakhe, ingonyama yona iyonithwala nonke emahlombe ayo abanzi inise ku-Kristu, uma nihlezi ngokuhlephula isinkwa sasezulwini, hhayi izindaba zabantu, namagama abantu.

UNkulunkulu anibusise nonke! Akuthi ngokuhlangana kwethu kulendawo yaku-Tsolo, eMpumalanga Kapa izifo zonke ziphele namhlanje, enkonizwen ka-Krestu, abantwana bakababa baphile impilo enhle nemnandi nemindeni yabo, Amen!

Yimi owenu ku Krestu,
N. V. MILANGENI.
UMONGAMELI

en.title: Apostle's Greeting for the year 2011-2012
en.message:
Beloved in the Lord,
I greet you in the beautiful name of our Lord Jesus Christ.

As we come from different places in the four corners of the world, we will praise the Creator through His Son Jesus Christ, I would like to say that we also preach to you the word we heard that God is light, there is no darkness in Him at all. If we say we have fellowship with Him but we still walk in darkness, we are lying because the truth is not in us. But if we walk in the light as He Himself is in the light, let us also be in the light one with another. By the blood of Jesus His Son He will cleanse us from all our sins. I do not believe that there is anyone who still doubts this church of Christ, if there is they are not of this church.

Fathers love your wives, and you mothers love your husbands, so that children may learn to love each other in our homes, learn to respect their parents, and also respect each other. Let us treat strangers well, respect our neighbours, love them as we love ourselves. We learn in the holy books that God so loved the world, that He sent His only begotten Son to die for the world.

The things happening in the whole world are terrifying. Outside people are killing each other. This is the time for us to unite and be one, pray, let us not lose hope no matter what, let us stay in the lion. I will never abandon you, I will fall and rise with you until the end. Do not have many hopes but have one hope. Do not doubt Him, there is no other, this is Him! Dwell all in one spirit and trust each other, each one to his officer, the lion will carry you all on its broad shoulders and take you to Christ, if you sit breaking the bread of heaven, not people's stories, and people's names.

May God bless you all! Let it be that by our gathering in this place of Tsolo, in the Eastern Cape all diseases end today, in the church of Christ, the children of the father live a good and sweet life with their families, Amen!

I am yours in Christ,
N. V. MLANGENI.
PRESIDENT

nso.title: Tumedišo ya Moapostola ya ngwaga wa 2011-2012
nso.message:
Barategi go Morena,
Ke le dumediša ka leina le lebotse la Morena wa rena Jesu Kriste.

Bjalo ka ge re tšwa mafelong a fapanego dikhutlong tše nne tša lefase, re tlo tumiša Mmopi ka Morwa wa gagwe Jesu Kriste, ke rata go bolela gore le rena re le rerela lentšu leo re le kwelego la gore Modimo ke seetša, ga go na leswiswi go yena le gatee. Ge re re re na le kopano le yena eupša re sa sepela leswiswing, re a aketša gobane therešo ga e gona go rena. Eupša ge re sepela seetšeng bjalo ka ge yena ka noši a le seetšeng, a le rena re be seetšeng yo mongwe le yo mongwe. Ka madi a Jesu Morwa wa gagwe o tla re hlwekiša dibeng tša rena ka moka. Ga ke dumele gore go na le yo a sa belaelago kereke ye ya Kriste, ge a le gona ga se wa kereke ye.

Botate ratang basadi ba lena, le lena bomme ratang banna ba lena, gore bana ba ithute go ratana magaeng a rena, ba ithute go hlompha batswadi, le bona gape ba hlomphane. A re swareng baeng gabotse, re hlomphe baagišani ba rena, re ba rate bjalo ka ge re ithata. Re ithuta dipukung tše dikgethwa gore Modimo o ratile lefase gakaaka, a ba a romela Morwa wa gagwe yo a tswetšwego a nnoši gore a hwele lefase.

Dilo tše di diregago lefaseng ka moka di a tšhoša. Ka ntle batho ba a bolayana. Ye ke nako ya gore re kopane re be batee, re rapele, re se ke ra lahlegelwa ke tshepo go sa kgathalege gore go bjang, a re duleng taung. Nka se tsoge ke le lahlile, ke tla wa ke tsoga le lena go fihla mafelelong. Le se ke la ba le ditshepo tše dintši eupša le be le tshepo e tee. Le se ke la mo belaela, ga go na yo mongwe, ke yena yo! Dulang ka moka ka moya o tee gomme le tshepane, yo mongwe le yo mongwe go mohlanka wa gagwe, tau e tla le rwala ka moka magetleng a yona a magolo ya le iša go Kriste, ge le dutše le arolelana senkgwa sa legodimo, e sego ditshebo tša batho, le maina a batho.

Modimo a le šegofatše ka moka! A e be gore ka go kopana ga rena lefelong le la Tsolo, Kapa Bohlabela malwetši ka moka a fele lehono, kerekeng ya Kriste, bana ba tate ba phele bophelo bjo bobotse le bjo bose le malapa a bona, Amene!

Ke nna wa lena go Kriste,
N. V. MLANGENI.
MOPRESIDENTE

xh.title: Umbuliso woMpostile wonyaka ka-2011-2012
xh.message:
Bathandekayo eNkosini,
Ndiyanibulisa egameni elihle leNkosi yethu uYesu Kristu.

Njengoko sisuka kwiindawo ezahlukeneyo kwiimbombo zone zehlabathi, siza kudumisa uMdali ngoNyana wakhe uYesu Kristu, ndithanda ukutsho ukuba nathi sinishumayeza ilizwi esalivayo lokuba uThixo ukukhanya, ubumnyama abukho kuye nakancinci. Ukuba sithi sinobudlelwane naye kodwa sibe sisahamba ebumnyameni, siyaxoka kuba inyaniso ayikho kuthi. Kodwa ukuba sihamba ekukhanyeni njengoko yena ngokwakhe esekukhanyeni, nathi masibe sekukhanyeni omnye nomnye. Ngegazi likaYesu uNyana wakhe uya kusihlambulula kwizono zethu zonke. Andikholelwa ukuba usekho osayithandabuzayo le cawe kaKristu, ukuba ukho ayingowale cawe.

Bootata thandani abafazi benu, nani boomama thandani abayeni benu, ukuze nabantwana bafunde ukuthandana emakhaya ethu, bafunde ukuhlonipha abazali, nabo kwakhona bahloniphane. Masiphathe kakuhle iindwendwe, sihloniphe abamelwane bethu, sibathande njengoko sizithanda. Sifunda kwiincwadi ezingcwele ukuba uThixo walithanda ihlabathi kangaka, waze wathumela uNyana wakhe okuphela kwamzeleyo ukuba afele ihlabathi.

Izinto ezenzeka kwihlabathi liphela ziyothusa. Ngaphandle abantu bayabulalana. Eli lixesha lokuba simanyane sibe banye, sithandaze, singalilahli ithemba nokuba kunjani, sihlale kuyo ingonyama. Andisoze ndinilahle, ndiya kuwa ndivuka nani kude kube sekupheleni. Ningabi namathemba amaninzi kodwa nibe nethemba elinye. Ningamthandabuzi, akukho wumbi nguye lo! Hlalani nonke ngamoya mnye nithembane, omnye nomnye kwisicaka sakhe, ingonyama yona iya kunithwala nonke emagxeni ayo abanzi inise kuKristu, ukuba nihlezi niqhekeza isonka sasezulwini, hayi amabali abantu, namagama abantu.

UThixo anisikelele nonke! Makuthi ngokuhlangana kwethu kule ndawo yakuTsolo, eMpuma Kapa izifo zonke ziphele namhlanje, ecaweni kaKristu, abantwana bakabawo baphile ubomi obuhle nobumnandi neentsapho zabo, Amen!

Ndim owakho kuKristu,
N. V. MLANGENI.
UMONGAMELI

ts.title: Xilumiso xa Mupostola xa lembe ra 2011-2012
ts.message:
Varhandziwa eka Hosi,
Ndzi mi losa hi vito ro saseka ra Hosi ya hina Yesu Kreste.

Tanihi leswi hi sukaka etindhawini to hambana emagoveni ya mune ya misava, hi ta dzunisa Muvumbi hi N'wana wa yena Yesu Kreste, ndzi rhandza ku vula leswaku na hina hi mi chumayela rito leri hi ri tweke ra leswaku Xikwembu i ku vonakala, munyama a wu kona eka xona nikatsongo. Loko hi vula leswaku hi na vuxaka na xona kambe hi ha famba emunyameni, ha hemba hikuva ntiyiso a wu kona eka hina. Kambe loko hi famba eku vonakaleni hilaha xona hi xoxe xi nga eku vonakaleni, na hina a hi veni eku vonakaleni un'wana ni un'wana. Hi ngati ya Yesu N'wana wa xona xi ta hi basisa eswidyohweni swa hina hinkwaswo. A ndzi kholwi leswaku ku na loyi a ha kanakana kereke leyi ya Kreste, loko a ri kona a hi wa kereke leyi.

Vatatana rhandzani vasati va n'wina, na n'wina vamanana rhandzani vavanuna va n'wina, leswaku vana va dyondza ku rhandzana emakaya ya hina, va dyondza ku hlonipha vatswari, na vona nakambe va hloniphana. A hi khomeni vaendzi kahle, hi hlonipha vaakelani va hina, hi va rhandza hilaha hi tirhandzaka hakona. Hi dyondza etibukwini to kwetsima leswaku Xikwembu xi rhandzile misava swonghasi, xi kala xi rhumela N'wana wa xona la tswariweke a ri yexe leswaku a fela misava.

Swilo leswi endlekaka emisaveni hinkwayo swa chavisa. Ehandle vanhu va dlayana. Leyi i nkarhi wa leswaku hi hlangana hi va un'we, hi khongela, hi nga lahlekeriwi hi ntshembo hambiloko ku ri njhani, a hi tshameni eka nghala. A ndzi nge pfuki ndzi mi lahlile, ndzi ta wa ndzi pfuka na n'wina ku fika emakumu. Mi nga vi na mintshembo yo tala kambe mi va na ntshembo wun'we. Mi nga n'wi kanakani, a ku na un'wana hi yena loyi! Tshamani hinkwenu hi moya wun'we mi tshembana, un'wana ni un'wana eka nandza wa yena, nghala yona yi ta mi rhwala hinkwenu emakatleni ya yona yo anama yi mi yisa eka Kreste, loko mi tshamile mi phema xinkwa xa le tilweni, ku nga ri mavarivari ya vanhu, na mavito ya vanhu.

Xikwembu a xi mi katekise hinkwenu! A swi ve leswaku hi ku hlangana ka hina endhawini leyi ya Tsolo, eKapa Vuxa mavabyi hinkwawo ma hela namuntlha, ekerekeni ya Kreste, vana va tatana va hanya vutomi byinene ni byo tsokombela ni mindyangu ya vona, Amen!

Hi mina wa n'wina eka Kreste,
N. V. MLANGENI.
PURESIDENTE

st.title: Molaetsa oa Moapostola oa selemo sa 2011-2012
st.message:
Baratuoa Moreneng,
Kea le lumelisa ka lebitso le letle la Morena oa rona Jesu Kreste.

Joalo ka ha re tsoa libakeng tse fapaneng likhutlong tse nne tsa lefatše, re tlo rorisa 'Mopi ka Mora oa hae Jesu Kreste, ke rata ho bolela hore le rona re le bolella lentsoe leo re le utloileng la hore Molimo ke leseli, ha ho na lefifi ho eena ho hang. Haeba re re re na le kamanong le eena empa re sa ntse re tsamaea lefifing, re thetsa hobane 'nete ha e eo ho rona. Empa haeba re tsamaea leseling joalo ka ha eena ka boeena a le leseling, le rona a re beng leseling e mong le e mong. Ka mali a Jesu Mora oa hae o tla re hloekisa libeng tsa rona tsohle. Ha ke lumele hore ho na le ea sa ntsaneng a belaella kereke ena ea Kreste, haeba a le teng hase oa kereke ena.

Bo-ntate ratang basali ba lona, le lona bo-mme ratang banna ba lona, hore bana ba ithute ho ratana malapeng a rona, ba ithute ho hlompha batsoali, 'me le bona hape ba hlomphane. A re tšoarenge baeti hantle, re hlomphe baahelani ba rona, re ba rate joalo ka ha re ithata. Re ithuta libukeng tse halalelang hore Molimo o ratile lefatše hakaalo, a ba a romela Mora oa hae ea tsoetsoeng a le mong hore a shoele lefatše.

Lintho tse etsahalang lefatšeng lohle lia tšosa. Kantle batho baa bolaoana. Ena ke nako ea hore re kopane re be bang, re rapele, re se ke ra lahleheloa ke tšepo ho sa tsotellehe hore na ho joang, a re luleng ho tau. Nke ke ka hlola ke le lahla, ke tla oa ke tsohe le lona ho fihlela qetellong. Le se ke la ba le litšepo tse ngata empa le be le tšepo e le 'ngoe. Le se ke la mo belaella, ha ho e mong, ke eena enoa! Lulang kaofela ka moea o le mong 'me le tšepane, e mong le e mong ho mohlanka oa hae, tau e tla le jara kaofela mahetleng a eona a sephara e le ise ho Kreste, haeba le lutse le arolelana bohobe ba leholimo, eseng litšebebo tsa batho, le mabitso a batho.

Molimo a le hlohonolofatse bohle! E se eka ka ho kopana ha rona sebakeng sena sa Tsolo, Kapa Bochabela maloetse 'ohle a fele kajeno, kerekeng ea Kreste, bana ba ntate ba phele bophelo bo botle le bo monate le malapa a bona, Amen!

Ke 'na oa lona ho Kreste,
N. V. MLANGENI.
MOPRESIDENTE

zu.title: Umbuliso wonyaka-ka 2012-2013
zu.message:
Ngiyanibingelela egameni elihle leNkosi yethu nomsindisi uJesu Krestu.

Angithathe lelithuba ngibonge umzalwane nodade, ngemisebenzi emihle abayenzile ukusindisa abantu baka-Nkulunkulu kumakhamandelo ekade beboshwe kuwona. Yebo, bengebodwa kepha bekanye nomshumayeli wevangeli.

Ngibonge futhi no-mprisita, nenesi yezulu, kanjalo nenyanga yezulu. Ngibonge futhi kanye nengelozi yasezulwini ngokwembathisa lesisizwe ingubo emhlophe qwa, egenachaphaza. Ngalokha sakhuseleka isizwe sikababa kwaze kwabo lapha esikhona namhlanje.

Ngakho-ke ngithi: Phambili bantwana bendlu ka Israeli! Asiyidumise njalo iNkosi enesihawu nomusa uJesu Krestu. Uma-nje singavuma ukulahla imisebenzi ka-Adamu omdala angeke uNkulunkulu angasiphi esikucelayo ngegama lakhe. Kuphela-je uma simcela ngendlela ayifunayo, sizithobe, sizehlise, sihloniphane, sibe ngabantwario, sibe nothando, singabukelani phansi, sihloniphe izinceku zoMpostoli. Sithande abapostoli uNkulunkulu asiphe bona, siyobe sithathanda izimpilo zethu. Ingoyama iyosithwala ngamahlombe ayo abanzi isise kuKrestu.

Asidumise-ke sonke siyibonge iNkosi. Iziło zonke ziphele namhlanje, kanye nobubha buphele. Sihlaje ngokuhlephula isinkwa emakhaya ethu. uNkulunkulu uyosibusisa ngaso sonke isikhathi.

Owenu eNkosini,
N.V.Mlangeni
Umongameli.

en.title: Greeting for the year 2012-2013
en.message:
I greet you in the beautiful name of our Lord and saviour Jesus Christ.

Let me take this opportunity to thank the brother and sister, for the good works they have done to save the people of God from the chains they were bound in. Yes, not alone but together with the preacher of the gospel.

I also thank the priest, and the nurse of heaven, as well as the healer of heaven. I also thank together with the angel of heaven for clothing this nation in a pure white garment, without a spot. By this the nation of our father was protected until where we are today.

Therefore I say: Forward children of the house of Israel! Let us always praise the Lord of compassion and grace Jesus Christ. If only we can agree to cast away the works of the old Adam, God will not fail to give us what we ask in his name. Only if we ask him in the way he wants, humble ourselves, lower ourselves, respect each other, be like children, have love, not look down on each other, respect the servants of the Apostle. Let us love the apostles God gave us, we will be loving our lives. The lion will carry us on its broad shoulders and take us to Christ.

Let us all praise and thank the Lord. May all diseases end today, and poverty end. Let us stay by breaking bread in our homes. God will bless us at all times.

Yours in the Lord,
N.V.Mlangeni
President.

nso.title: Tumedišo ya ngwaga wa 2012-2013
nso.message:
Ke le dumediša ka leina le lebotse la Morena le mophološi wa rena Jesu Kriste.

E re ke tšee sebaka se ke leboge ngwanabo rena le kgaetšedi, ka mešomo e mebotse ye ba e dirilego go phološa batho ba Modimo diketaneng tše ba bego ba tlemilwe go tšona. Ee, e sego ba nnoši eupša mmogo le moreri wa ebangedi.

Ke leboga gape le moprista, le mooki wa legodimo, gotee le ngaka ya legodimo. Ke leboga gape mmogo le morongwa wa legodimong ka go apeša setšhaba se seaparo se sešweu se se hlwekilego, se se se nago letheba. Ka se setšhaba sa tate se ile sa šireletšwa go fihla mo re lego gona lehono.

Ka gona ke re: Pele bana ba ntlo ya Isiraele! A re tumišeng ka mehla Morena wa kgaugelo le mogau Jesu Kriste. Ge fela re ka dumela go lahla mešomo ya Adama wa kgale, Modimo a ka se palelwe ke go re fa se re se kgopelago ka leina la gagwe. Fela ge re mo kgopela ka tsela ye a e nyakago, re ikokobetša, re inyenyefatša, re hlomphana, re ba bjalo ka bana, re ba le lerato, re sa nyatšane, re hlompha bahlanka ba Moapostola. A re rateng baapostola bao Modimo a re filego bona, re tla be re rata maphelo a rena. Tau e tla re rwala magetleng a yona a magolo ya re iša go Kriste.

A re tumišeng ka moka gomme re leboge Morena. Malwetši ka moka a fele lehono, le bodiidi bo fele. A re duleng ka go arolelana senkgwa magaeng a rena. Modimo o tla re šegofatša ka dinako tšohle.

Wa lena go Morena,
N.V.Mlangeni
Mopresidente.

xh.title: Umbuliso wonyaka ka-2012-2013
xh.message:
Ndiyanibulisa egameni elihle leNkosi nomsindisi wethu uYesu Kristu.

Mandithathe eli thuba ndibonge umzalwana nodade, ngemisebenzi emihle abayenzileyo ukusindisa abantu bakaThixo kumakhamandela abebekade beboshwe kuwo. Ewe, bengabodwa kodwa bekunye nomshumayeli wevangeli.

Ndibonge kwakhona nombingeleli, nomongikazi wasezulwini, kunye nenyanga yasezulwini. Ndibonge kwakhona kunye nengelosi yasezulwini ngokwambathisa esi sizwe isambatho esimhlophe qwa, esingenachaphaza. Ngaloo nto isizwe sikabawo sakhuseleka kude kube lapha sikhoyo namhlanje.

Ngoko ke ndithi: Phambili bantwana bendlu kaSirayeli! Masiyidumise njalo iNkosi enemfesane nobubele uYesu Kristu. Ukuba nje singavuma ukulahla imisebenzi ka-Adamu omdala uThixo akayi kusilela ukusinika esikucelayo ngegama lakhe. Kuphela nje ukuba simcela ngendlela ayifunayo, sizithobe, sizenze abancinci, sihloniphane, sibe njengabantwana, sibe nothando, singajongelani phantsi, sihloniphe izicaka zoMpostile. Masibathande abapostile uThixo asinike bona, siya kuba sithanda iimpilo zethu. Ingonyama iya kusithwala emagxeni ayo abanzi isise kuKristu.

Masidumise ke sonke siyibonge iNkosi. Izifo zonke maziphele namhlanje, kunye nobuhlwempu buphele. Masihlale ngokuqhekeza isonka emakhaya ethu. uThixo uya kusisikelela ngamaxesha onke.

Owakho eNkosini,
N.V.Mlangeni
UMongameli.

ts.title: Xilumiso xa lembe ra 2012-2013
ts.message:
Ndzi mi losa hi vito ro saseka ra Hosi na muponisi wa hina Yesu Kreste.

A ndzi teke nkarhi lowu ku nkhensa makwerhu wa xinuna na wa xisati, hi mintirho leyinene leyi va yi endleke ku ponisa vanhu va Xikwembu emaketanini lawa a va bohiwile eka wona. Ina, ku nga ri voxe kambe swin'we na muchumayeli wa evhangeli.

Ndzi tlhela ndzi nkhensa muprista, na nesi wa le tilweni, swin'we na n'anga ya le tilweni. Ndzi tlhela ndzi nkhensa swin'we na ntsumi ya le tilweni hi ku ambexa tiko leri hi nguvu yo basa yo kwetsima, leyi nga riki na xivati. Hi sweswo tiko ra tatana wa hina ri sirheleriwile ku fika laha hi nga kona namuntlha.

Hikokwalaho ndzi ri: Emahlweni vana va yindlu ya Israyele! A hi dzuniseni nkarhi hinkwawo Hosi ya ntwelavusiwana na tintswalo Yesu Kreste. Loko ntsena hi nga pfumela ku cukumeta mintirho ya Adamu wa khale, Xikwembu a xi nge tsandzeki ku hi nyika leswi hi swi kombelaka hi vito ra xona. Ntsena loko hi xi kombela hi ndlela leyi xi yi lavaka, hi titsongahata, hi tiyisa ehansi, hi hloniphana, hi fana na vana, hi va na rirhandzu, hi nga langutelani ehansi, hi hlonipha malandza ya Mupostola. A hi rhandzeni vapostola lava Xikwembu xi hi nyikeke vona, hi ta va hi rhandza vutomi bya hina. Nghala yi ta hi rhwala emakatleni ya yona yo anama yi hi yisa eka Kreste.

A hi dzuniseni hinkwerhu hi nkhensa Hosi. Mavabyi hinkwawo a ma hele namuntlha, ni vusweti byi hela. A hi tshameni hi ku phema xinkwa emakaya ya hina. Xikwembu xi ta hi katekisa nkarhi hinkwawo.

Wa n'wina eka Hosi,
N.V.Mlangeni
Puresidente.

st.title: Molaetsa oa selemo sa 2012-2013
st.message:
Kea le lumelisa ka lebitso le letle la Morena le mopholosi oa rona Jesu Kreste.

E re ke nke monyetla ona ho leboha moena le khaitseli, ka mesebetsi e metle eo ba e entseng ho pholosa batho ba Molimo litlamong tseo ba neng ba tlamiloe ho tsona. Ee, eseng ba le bang empa mmoho le moreri oa evangeli.

Ke leboha hape le moprista, le mooki oa leholimo, hammoho le ngaka ea leholimo. Ke leboha hape mmoho le lengeloi la leholimo ka ho apesa sechaba sena seaparo se sesoeu se hloekileng, se se nang letheba. Ka sena sechaba sa ntate se ile sa sireletsoa ho fihlela moo re leng teng kajeno.

Ka hona ke re: Pele bana ba ntlo ea Iseraele! A re roriseng kamehla Morena oa qenehelo le mohau Jesu Kreste. Haeba feela re ka lumela ho lahla mesebetsi ea Adama oa khale, Molimo a ke ke a hloleha ho re fa seo re se kopang ka lebitso la hae. Feela haeba re mo kopa ka tsela eo a e batlang, re ikokobetsa, re inyenyefatsa, re hlomphana, re tšoana le bana, re e-na le lerato, re sa nyelisane, re hlompha bahlanka ba Moapostola. A re rateng baapostola bao Molimo a re fileng bona, re tla be re rata maphelo a rona. Tau e tla re jara mahetleng a eona a sephara e re ise ho Kreste.

A re roriseng bohle 'me re lebohe Morena. Maloetse 'ohle a fele kajeno, le bofutsana bo fele. A re luleng ka ho arolelana bohobe malapeng a rona. Molimo o tla re hlohonolofatsa ka linako tsohle.

Ea lona Moreneng,
N.V.Mlangeni
Mopresidente.

zu.title: Umbuliso wolMpostoli wonyaka ka-2013/2014
zu.message:
Bathandekayo eNkosini, ngiyanibingelela egameni elihle leNkosi yethu Jesu Kristu.
Angiqale ngibingelele indlu yabapostoli (Apostle Board), ngibingelele nendlu engenhla (Central Council), nendlu engenzansi (Lower House). Ngibingelele i-Central Youth Committee, ngibingelele zonke izirceku kusukela kumdala webandla, umprisita, unshumayeli kanye nomzalwane nodade. 'gingakhohlwa o-mampostoli no-mamveleli, no-manyanga no-manesi benkonzo, oma-mprisita, oma-mshumayeli kanye nodade balenkonzo.

Ngithi mangibonge kini nonke ngeqhaza elikhulu enalibamba enkonzweni sizwe sikababa. Kwala umoya omkhulu unixakazisa kepha nathi "asisuki la, kungamane kungamuke izandla sibambelele."

Igundwane lizimbela umgodi lapho lizohlala khona, bese kuthi uma seliqedile, selihlezi kamnandi nosapho Iwalo, afike ufeleba, inyoka phela, engakwazi ukuzenzela lutho yona, ifike ixoshe amagundwane emzini wawo ihlale khona inethezeke emzini engawakhanga ngamandla ayo, ngoba yona iyisiqhwaga.

Nani bantwana baka-Nkulunkulu najuluka nasebenza kanzima nipatanisa, nithengisa otamatisi.ezindlelani, nishiswa yilanga ninethwa nayizimvula, izingane zenu zilale zingadlile ngoba nizama ukthi nithole imali yokwakha izindlu zokukhonzela. Kwathi lapho niqeda khona ukwakha lezo zindlu, noma ezinye zingakapheli kahle, kodwa senikhonzela kuzona, wafika u-dragoni inyoka enkulu wanidudula ezindlini zenu enazakha kanzima.

Lathi izwi lompostoli phumani bantwa baka-baba nidedele izihonga, ezingakwazi ukuzenzela lutho zona. Ngempela naphuma- hayi ngoba-ningamagwala kepha nahlonipha izwi lompostoli nenza njengoba eshilo, ngiyanibonga kakhulu. Isambane siyawumba umgodi singahlali kuwo, ngokuxakaziswa yizinja sibaleke siyokwemba omunye phambili. Kungakho kuthiwa amandla esambane awapheli.

Uma ningakhumbula ngathi kini amaqhinga nokuhlakanipha kuyaphela, kodwa ubulima abupheli. Izihlakaniphi azingeni embusweni wezulu, futhi noNkulunkulu akahambisani nezihlakaniphi. U-Nkulunkulu wonipha amandla, nozakha ezinye izindlu. Hlalani ethembeni....... elilodwa, ningabi namathemba kodwa nibe nethemba elilodwa.

Nibe nosuku olumnandi ninethezeke lapha e-Pitoli. U-Nkulunkulu anibusise nasezindleleni, ahambe nani, nihlale ngokuhlephula isinkwa njalo. Ziyoncipha nezifo kube yimpilo sonke isikhathi, futhi nihloniphane nithandane.

Nibe nokuthula phakathi kwenu.

Owenu
N.V.Mlarigeni.
Umpostoli.

en.title: Apostle's Greeting for 2013/2014
en.message:
Beloved in the Lord, I greet you in the good name of our Lord Jesus Christ.
Let me begin by greeting the Apostle Board, the Central Council, and the Lower House. I greet the Central Youth Committee, I greet all officers from the community elder, priest, evangelist, and brothers and sisters. Not forgetting mother apostles and mother overseers, and all female officers.

I want to thank you all for the huge role you played in the church, nation of our father. Even when strong winds shook you, you said "we are not moving here, even if our hands break off, we will hold on."

You, children of God, sweated and worked hard making ends meet, selling tomatoes on the streets, burned by the sun and rained on, your children sleeping hungry because you were trying to get money to build houses of worship. And when you finished building those houses, even if some were not fully complete but you were worshipping in them, along came a dragon, a big snake, and pushed you out of your houses that you built with difficulty.

The word of the apostle said come out, children of the father, and leave the empty shells that cannot do anything for themselves. Indeed you came out - not because you are cowards but you respected the word of the apostle and did as he said, I thank you very much.

If you remember I said to you tricks and cleverness come to an end, but foolishness does not. The clever do not enter the kingdom of heaven, and God does not go with the clever. God gave you strength, and you will build other houses. Stay in one hope.

Have a wonderful and comfortable day here in Pretoria. May God bless you on your journeys, go with you, and may you always live by breaking bread. Diseases will decrease and there will be health all the time, and respect and love one another.

Peace be among you.

Yours,
N.V. Mlangeni.
Apostle.

nso.title: Tumedišo ya Moapostola ya 2013/2014
nso.message:
Barategi go Morena, ke le dumediša ka leina le lebotse la Morena wa rena Jesu Kriste.
E re ke thome ka go dumediša Boto ya Baapostola, Lekgotla la Magareng, le Ntlo ya Tlase. Ke dumediša Komiti ya Bafsa ya Magareng, ke dumediša bahlanka ka moka go tloga go mogolo wa setšhaba, moprista, moebangedi, le bana babo rena le dikgaetšedi. Ke sa lebale bomme baapostola le bomme balebeledi, le bahlanka ka moka ba basadi.

Ke nyaka go le leboga ka moka ka karolo e kgolo ye le e kgathilego kerekeng, setšhaba sa tate. Le ge diphefo tše maatla di be di le šišinya, le itše "ga re tloge mo, le ge diatla tša rena di ka kgaoga, re tla kgomarela."

Lena, bana ba Modimo, le fufutšwe gomme la šoma ka thata go iphediša, le rekiša ditamati mebileng, le fišwa ke letšatši le go nelwa ke pula, bana ba lena ba robala ka tlala gobane le be le leka go hwetša tšhelete ya go aga dintlo tša borapelo. Gomme ge le feditše go aga dintlo tšeo, le ge tše dingwe di be di se tša fela gabotse eupša le be le rapela go tšona, gwa tla drakone, noga e kgolo, ya le lelekela ka ntle ga dintlo tša lena tše le di agilego ka bothata.

Lentšu la moapostola le itše tšwang, bana ba tate, gomme le tlogele magapetla a a se nago selo ao a ka se kgonego go itirela selo. Ruri le tšwile - e sego gobane le le magwala eupša le hlomphile lentšu la moapostola gomme la dira ka moo a boletšego, ke le leboga kudu.

Ge le gopola ke le boditše gore maano le bohlale di a fela, eupša bošilo ga bo fele. Ba bohlale ga ba tsene mmušong wa legodimo, gomme Modimo ga a sepele le ba bohlale. Modimo o le file maatla, gomme le tla aga dintlo tše dingwe. Dulang tshepong e tee.

Ebang le letšatši le lebotse le le lekhutšo mo Pretoria. Modimo a le šegofatše maetong a lena, a sepele le lena, gomme eka le ka dula le phela ka go arolelana senkgwa. Malwetši a tla fokotšega gomme go tla ba le maphelo ka dinako tšohle, gomme le hlomphane le go ratana.

Khutšo a e be gare ga lena.

Wa lena,
N.V. Mlangeni.
Moapostola.

xh.title: Umbuliso woMpostile ka-2013/2014
xh.message:
Bathandekayo eNkosini, ndiyanibulisa egameni elihle leNkosi yethu uYesu Kristu.
Mandiqale ngokubulisa iBhodi yabaPostile, iBhunga eliPhakathi, kunye neNdlu eNgezantsi. Ndibulisa iKomiti yoLutsha ePhakathi, ndibulisa onke amagosa ukusukela kumdala woluntu, umbingeleli, umvangeli, nabazalwana noodade. Ndingalibali oomama abapostile noomama abaveleli, nawo onke amagosa angamanina.

Ndifuna ukunibulela nonke ngendima enkulu eniyidlalileyo ecaweni, isizwe sikabawo wethu. Kwanaxa imimoya enamandla inishukumisa, nathi "asihambi apha, nokuba izandla zethu zingaqhawuka, siya kubambelela."

Nina, bantwana bakaThixo, nibilile naze nasebenza nzima nisenza iindlela zokuphila, nithengisa iitumato ezitalatweni, nitshiswa lilanga nanetha, abantwana benu belala belambile kuba benizama ukufumana imali yokwakha izindlu zonqulo. Kwaye xa nizigqibile ukuzakha ezo zindlu, nokuba ezinye bezingekagqitywa ngokupheleleyo kodwa benikhonza kuzo, kwafika inamba, inyoka enkulu, yanikhupha ezindlwini zenu enazakha ngobunzima.

Ilizwi lompostile lathi phumani, bantwana baka bawo, nize nishiye amaqokobhe angenanto angenakuzenzela nto. Inene naphuma - hayi kuba ningamagwala kodwa nalihlonipha ilizwi lompostile naze nenza njengoko watshoyo, ndiyanibulela kakhulu.

Ukuba niyakhumbula ndathi kuni amaqhinga nobukrelekrele buyaphela, kodwa ubudenge abupheli. Abakrelekrele abangeni ebukumkanini bamazulu, kwaye uThixo akahambi nabakrelekrele. UThixo uninike amandla, kwaye niya kwakha ezinye izindlu. Hlalani ethembeni elinye.

Yibani nosuku oluhle nolutofotofo apha ePitoli. UThixo anisikelele kuhambo lwenu, ahambe nani, kwaye nanga ningasoloko niphila ngokuqhekeza isonka. Izifo ziya kuncipha kwaye kuya kubakho impilo ngamaxesha onke, kwaye nihloniphane nithandane.

Uxolo malube nani.

Owakho,
N.V. Mlangeni.
UMpostile.

ts.title: Xilumiso xa Mupostola xa 2013/2014
ts.message:
Varhandziwa eka Hosi, ndzi mi losa hi vito ro saseka ra Hosi ya hina Yesu Kreste.
A ndzi sungule hi ku losa Bodo ya Vapostola, Huvo ya le Xikarhi, ni Yindlu ya le Hansi. Ndzi losa Komiti ya Vantshwa ya le Xikarhi, ndzi losa malandza hinkwawo ku suka eka nkulu wa muganga, muprista, muvangeli, ni vamakwerhu va vavanuna ni va vavasati. Ndzi nga rivali vapostola va vamanana ni valanguteri va vamanana, ni malandza hinkwawo ya vavasati.

Ndzi lava ku mi nkhensa hinkwenu hi xiphemu lexikulu lexi mi xi tlangileke ekerekeni, tiko ra tatana wa hina. Hambiloko timheho ta matimba ti mi tsekatsekisile, mi te "a hi suki laha, hambiloko mavoko ya hina ma tshoveka, hi ta khomelela."

N'wina, vana va Xikwembu, mi fufumelerile naswona mi tirha hi matimba ku endla leswaku swilo swi famba kahle, mi xavisa matamatisi etindhawini, mi hisiwa hi dyambu ni ku neriwa hi mpfula, vana va n'wina va etlela hi ndlala hikuva a mi ringeta ku kuma mali yo aka tindlu ta vugandzeri. Kutani loko mi hetile ku aka tindlu teto, hambiloko tin'wana ti nga si hela kahle kambe a mi gandzela eka tona, ku tile drakoni, nyoka leyikulu, yi mi hlongola etindlwini ta n'wina leti mi ti akeke hi ku tika.

Rito ra mupostola ri te humani, vana va tatana, mi siya swikhumba leswi nga riki na nchumu leswi nga kotiki ku tiendlela nchumu. Hakunene mi humile - ku nga ri hikuva mi magwala kambe mi hloniphile rito ra mupostola naswona mi endlile hilaha a vuleke hakona, ndza mi nkhensa swinene.

Loko mi tsundzuka ndzi te eka n'wina mano ni vutlhari swa hela, kambe vuphukuphuku a byi heli. Lava tlhariheke a va ngheni emfunghweni wa tilo, naswona Xikwembu a xi fambi ni lava tlhariheke. Xikwembu xi mi nyikile matimba, naswona mi ta aka tindlu tin'wana. Tshamani eka ntshembo wun'we.

Vanani na siku ro saseka ni ro rhula laha Pitori. Xikwembu a xi mi katekise emaendzweni ya n'wina, xi famba na n'wina, naswona onge mi nga tshama mi hanya hi ku phema xinkwa. Mavabyi ma ta hunguteka naswona ku ta va ni rihanyo nkarhi hinkwawo, naswona hloniphanani ni ku rhandzana.

Ku rhula a ku ve exikarhi ka n'wina.

Wa n'wina,
N.V. Mlangeni.
Mupostola.

st.title: Molaetsa oa Moapostola oa 2013/2014
st.message:
Baratuoa Moreneng, ke le lumelisa ka lebitso le letle la Morena oa rona Jesu Kreste.
E re ke qale ka ho lumelisa Boto ea Baapostola, Lekhotla le Bohareng, le Ntlo e Tlase. Ke lumelisa Komiti ea Bacha ea Bohareng, ke lumelisa basebeletsi bohle ho tloha ho moholo oa sechaba, moprista, moevangeli, le bana beso le likhaitseli. Ntle le ho lebala bomme ba baapostola le bomme ba balebeli, le liofisiri tsohle tsa basali.

Ke batla ho le leboha bohle ka karolo e kholo eo le e bapalitseng kerekeng, sechabeng sa ntate oa rona. Esita le ha meea e matla e ne e le sisinya, le itse "ha re tlohe mona, leha matsoho a rona a ka robeha, re tla ts'oarella."

Lona, bana ba Molimo, le fufulecoe mme la sebetsa ka thata ho iphelisa, le rekisa litamati literateng, le chesoa ke letsatsi mme la nesoa ke pula, bana ba lona ba robala ka tlala hobane le ne le leka ho fumana chelete ea ho haha matlo a borapelo. 'Me ha le qetile ho haha matlo ao, leha a mang a ne a e-s'o phethoe ka botlalo empa le ne le rapela ho 'ona, ha tla drakone, noha e kholo, ea le sutumelletsa kantle ho matlo a lona ao le a hahileng ka thata.

Lentsoe la moapostola le itse tsoang, bana ba ntate, 'me le siee likhaketla tse se nang letho tse ke keng tsa iketsetsa letho. Ruri le tsoile - e seng hobane le makoala empa le hlomphile lentsoe la moapostola mme la etsa kamoo a boletseng, ke le leboha haholo.

Haeba le hopola ke le boleletse hore maqheka le bohlale lia fela, empa bothoto ha bo fele. Ba bohlale ha ba kene 'musong oa leholimo, 'me Molimo ha a tsamaee le ba bohlale. Molimo o le file matla, 'me le tla haha matlo a mang. Lulang tšepong e le 'ngoe.

Ebang le letsatsi le letle le le mabothobotho mona Pretoria. Molimo a le hlohonolofatse maetong a lona, a tsamaee le lona, 'me e se eka le ka lula le phela ka ho arolelana bohobe. Maloetse a tla fokotseha 'me ho tla ba le bophelo bo botle ka linako tsohle, mme le hlomphane 'me le ratane.

Khotso e be har'a lona.

Ea lona,
N.V. Mlangeni.
Moapostola.

zu.title: Umlayezo wokuvala unyaka
zu.message:
Ngiyanibingelela egameni elihle lenkosi yethu uJesu Kretu.

Okokuqala mangibonge imisebenzi emihle eniyenzile enkonzweni ka-Krestu, yokushaya ivangeli, ukuze ibandla likhuthalele ukuhlanganyela imisebenzi elinikezwa yona, nokuthi abavangeli bakhuthalele ukwembatha isambatho somvangeli. Ngingakhohlwa ukubonga oma-mpostoli nabo bonke oma-mvelelil, oma-district, oma-ouster, oma-priest Kanye noma-mshumayeli ngokufundisa odade ukuthi nabo benze abakuthunywayo.

Konke lokhu bekungeke kwenzeke uma bekusekhona ukwedelelana. Lokhu kwenzeka ngoba unembeza esekhona phakathi kwabo. Okubaluleke kakhulu yinhlonipho phakathi kwethu. Zonke izinto zobu Nkulunkulu ziyokwenzeka kuphela-nje uma sihloniphana, omncane ahloniphe omdala, nomdala ahloniphe omncane, sithandane sonke ngothando luka-Nkulunkulu, hayi elokuzenzisa. Unkulunkulu akamfuni umuntu ozenzisayo.

Ungathola kwezinye izindawo izinceku zifakana umoya omubi wokuvukela izinceku ezingenhla ngokungavumi ukukhokhelwa yizo, zifune ukukhokhelwa yizinceku ezithandwa yizona. Akukho okwedlula ukuthi omunye nomunye ahlale lapho umpostoli embeke khona. Uma kukhona ukungezwani noma ukungaboni ngaso linye, kuhlalwe phansi, omunye nomunye abeke isikhalo sakhe, kulungiswe lokho okungalungile ngokuhloniphana. Ngokwenza lokho siyobe sihlonipha umpostoli.

U-Nkulunkulu uyosibusisa siphile sonke nemíndeni yethu.

Nginifisela amaholidi armahle, ningene onyakeni omusha niphilile nonke. Nani nifiselane ukhisimusi omuhle ningene onyakeni omusha nezibusiso. Sibonge futhi ukuthi kulonyaka-ka 2014 lapho uNkulunkulu esibusise khona ngenkanyezi-umpostoli. Siyakubonga lokho ngoba bekungeke kwenzeke uma uNkulunkulu walenkonzo engaphili.

Ngiyanibonga nonke, futhi nginithanda nonke!

Yimina owenu eNkosini
N. V. Mlangeni.
Umongameli

en.title: Year closing message
en.message:
I greet you all in the good name of our Lord Jesus Christ.

Firstly I wish to thank the good works that you have done in the church of Christ, by preaching the gospel for the congregation to be eager to work in unity in doing the duties given to it, and also for the evangelical brothers to take interest in wearing their evangelical uniform. Not forgetting to thank our mother apostles, and sister overseers, district elders, community elders, priests and deacons, for teaching our sisters to also do what they have been sent to do.

All this would not have happened if there was still disrespecting of one another. This happens because they still have conscience within themselves. What is most important is respect among ourselves. All godly things will happen only if we respect one another, when the young respect the old and the old respect the young, loving one another with godly love not pretending. God does not want someone who pretends.

You may find in some places officers feeding each other with evil spirit of rebelling against their leaders by not accepting to be led by them, and seeking to be led by officers of their choice. There is nothing better than when each one remains where the apostle has put them. When there is a misunderstanding or difference of opinion, sit down and each one present their case and sort out what has gone wrong with respect to each other. By so doing we would be respecting the apostle.

God will bless us and let us all live with our families.

I wish you wonderful holidays, may you all begin the New Year in good health. You must also wish each other a Merry Christmas and move into the New Year with blessings. We also thank that this year 2014 God has blessed us with a star-an apostle. We thank that because this would not have happened if the God of this church was not alive.

I thank you all and I love you all!

Yours in the Lord
N. V. Mlangeni.
President.

nso.title: Molaetša wa go tswalela ngwaga
nso.message:
Ke le dumediša ka moka ka leina le lebotse la Morena wa rena Jesu Kriste.

Sa mathomo ke duma go leboga mešomo e mebotse ye le e dirilego kerekeng ya Kriste, ka go rera ebangedi gore phuthego e hlologele go šoma ka botee go direng mešomo ye e e filwego, le gore bana babo rena ba evangedi ba be le kgahlego ya go apara yunifomo ya bona ya evangedi. Ntle le go lebala go leboga bomme baapostola ba rena, le dikgaetšedi tša balebeledi, bagolo ba selete, bagolo ba setšhaba, baprista le badiakone, ka go ruta dikgaetšedi tša rena gore le tšona di dire seo di romilwego go se dira.

Se ka moka se be se ka se direge ge go be go sa na le go se hlomphane. Se se direga gobane ba sa na le letswalo ka gare ga bona. Se bohlokwa kudu ke tlhompho gare ga rena. Dilo ka moka tša bomodimo di tlo direga fela ge re hlomphana, ge bafsa ba hlompha bagolo gomme bagolo ba hlompha bafsa, re ratana ka lerato la bomodimo le le sa itirago. Modimo ga a nyake motho wa go itira.

Le ka hwetša mafelong a mangwe bahlanka ba fepana ka moya o mobe wa go tsogela baetapele ba bona madira ka go se amogele go etelelwa pele ke bona, gomme ba nyaka go etelelwa pele ke bahlanka ba kgetho ya bona. Ga go na se sekaone go phala ge yo mongwe le yo mongwe a dula mo moapostola a mmeilego gona. Ge go na le go se kwane goba phapano ya dikgopolo, dulang fase gomme yo mongwe le yo mongwe a tšweletše taba ya gagwe mme le lokiše se se fošagetšego ka go hlomphana. Ka go dira bjalo re tlo be re hlompha moapostola.

Modimo o tlo re šegofatša gomme a re dire gore ka moka re phele le malapa a rena.

Ke le lakaletša matšatši a maikhutšo a mabotse, eka ka moka le ka thoma Ngwaga o Moswa le phetše gabotse. Le swanetše go lakaletšana Keresemose e Botse mme le tsene Ngwageng o Moswa ka ditšhegofatšo. Re leboga gape gore ngwageng wo wa 2014 Modimo o re šegofaditše ka naledi-moapostola. Re leboga seo gobane se se be se ka se direge ge Modimo wa kereke ye a be a sa phele.

Ke leboga lena ka moka gomme ke le rata ka moka!

Wa lena go Morena
N. V. Mlangeni.
Mopresidente.

xh.title: Umyalezo wokuvala unyaka
xh.message:
Ndiyanibulisa nonke egameni elihle leNkosi yethu uYesu Kristu.

Okokuqala ndinqwenela ukubulela ngemisebenzi emihle eniyenzileyo ecaweni kaKristu, ngokushumayela ivangeli ukuze ibandla libe nomdla wokusebenza ngomanyano ekwenzeni imisebenzi eliyinikiweyo, nokuba abazalwana be-evangeli babe nomdla wokunxiba iyunifomu yabo ye-evangeli. Ndingalibali ukubulela koomama abapostile bethu, noo dade abaveleli, abadala bezithili, abadala boluntu, ababingeleli nabadeakoni, ngokufundisa oodade bethu ukuba nabo benze oko bathunyelwe ukuba bakwenze.

Konke oku bekungenakwenzeka ukuba bekusekho ukungahloniphani. Oku kwenzeka kuba banesazela ngaphakathi kwabo. Eyona nto ibalulekileyo yintlonipho phakathi kwethu. Zonke izinto zobuthixo ziya kwenzeka kuphela ukuba siyahloniphana, xa abancinci behlonipha abadala nabadala behlonipha abancinci, sithandana ngothando lobuthixo singazenzisi. UThixo akamfuni umntu ozenzisayo.

Unokufumanisa kwezinye iindawo amagosa efundisana ngomoya ombi wokuvukela iinkokeli zabo ngokungavumi ukukhokelwa zizo, nokufuna ukukhokelwa ngamagosa abawakhethileyo. Akukho nto ibhetele kunokuba ngamnye ahlale apho umpostile ambeke khona. Xa kukho ukungaqondani okanye umahluko wezimvo, hlalani phantsi nize ngamnye aveze uluvo lwakhe nize nilungise oko kungahambanga kakuhle ngokuhloniphana. Ngokwenza njalo siya kuba sihlonipha umpostile.

UThixo uya kusisikelela aze asenze siphile sonke neentsapho zethu.

Ndininqwenelela iiholide ezimnandi, nanga ningawuqala uNyaka oMtsha niphilile. Kufuneka ninqwenelelane iKrisimesi Emnandi nize ningene kuNyaka oMtsha neentsikelelo. Sibulela nokuba kulo nyaka ka-2014 uThixo usisikelele ngenkwenkwezi-umpostile. Siyabulela ngoko kuba oku bekungenakwenzeka ukuba uThixo wale cawe ebeyingaphili.

Ndiyabulela kuni nonke kwaye ndiyanithanda nonke!

Owakho eNkosini
N. V. Mlangeni.
UMongameli.

ts.title: Rungula ro pfala lembe
ts.message:
Ndzi mi losa hinkwenu hi vito ro saseka ra Hosi ya hina Yesu Kreste.

Eku sunguleni ndzi navela ku nkhensa mintirho leyinene leyi mi yi endleke ekerekeni ya Kreste, hi ku chumayela evhangeli leswaku vandlha ri hisekela ku tirha hi vun'we eku endleni ka mintirho leyi ri nyikiweke yona, swin'we ni leswaku vamakwerhu va vavanuna va evhangeli va tsakela ku ambala yunifomo ya vona ya evhangeli. Ndzi nga rivali ku nkhensa vapostola va hina va vamanana, ni valanguteri va vamanana, vakulu va swifundzha, vakulu va muganga, vaprista ni madiyakoni, hi ku dyondzisa vamakwerhu va vavasati ku tlhela va endla leswi va rhumiweke ku swi endla.

Hinkwaswo leswi a swi ta ka swi nga endlekanga loko a ka ha ri ni ku nga hloniphani. Leswi swi endleka hikuva va ha ri ni ripfalo endzeni ka vona. Lexi nga xa nkoka swinene i xichavo exikarhi ka hina. Swilo hinkwaswo swa vuxikwembu swi ta endleka ntsena loko hi hloniphana, loko lavatsongo va hlonipha lavakulu naswona lavakulu va hlonipha lavatsongo, hi rhandzana hi rirhandzu ra vuxikwembu hi nga tiyendzisi. Xikwembu a xi lavi munhu la tiyendzisaka.

U nga kuma etindhawini tin'wana malandza ma wundlana hi moya wo biha wo pfukela varhangeri va vona hi ku nga amukeli ku rhangeriwa hi vona, ni ku lava ku rhangeriwa hi malandza lawa va ma hlawulaka. A ku na lexinene ku tlula loko un'wana ni un'wana a tshama laha mupostola a n'wi vekeke kona. Loko ku ri ni ku nga twisisani kumbe ku hambana ka mavonelo, tshamani ehansi kutani un'wana ni un'wana a veka mhaka ya yena mi lulamisa leswi hoxekeke hi ku hloniphana. Hi ku endla tano hi ta va hi hlonipha mupostola.

Xikwembu xi ta hi katekisa naswona xi hi endla hinkwerhu hi hanya ni mindyangu ya hina.

Ndzi mi navelela tiholide to saseka, onge mi nga sungula Lembe Lerintshwa mi ri karhi mi hanya kahle hinkwenu. Mi fanele ku navelelana Khisimusi Leyinene naswona mi nghena eLembeng Lerintshwa ni mikateko. Hi tlhela hi nkhensa leswaku eka lembe leri ra 2014 Xikwembu xi hi katekisile hi nyeleti-mupostola. Ha swi nkhensa leswaku hikuva leswi a swi ta ka swi nga endlekanga loko Xikwembu xa kereke leyi a xi nga hanyi.

Ndza mi nkhensa hinkwenu naswona ndza mi rhandza hinkwenu!

Wa n'wina eka Hosi
N. V. Mlangeni.
Puresidente.

st.title: Molaetsa oa ho koala selemo
st.message:
Ke le lumelisa bohle ka lebitso le letle la Morena oa rona Jesu Kreste.

Ntlha ea pele ke rata ho leboha mesebetsi e metle eo le e entseng kerekeng ea Kreste, ka ho bolela evangeli e le hore phutheho e labalabele ho sebetsa ka bonngoe ho etsa mesebetsi eo e e filoeng, le hore barab'abo rona ba baevangeli ba be le thahasello ea ho apara junifomo ea bona ea evangeli. Ntle le ho lebala ho leboha bomme ba baapostola ba rona, le bo-mme ba balebeli, baholo ba setereke, baholo ba sechaba, baprista le badiakone, ka ho ruta likhaitseli tsa rona ho etsa seo ba rometsoeng ho se etsa.

Tsena tsohle li ne li ke ke tsa etsahala haeba ho ne ho sa ntse ho e-na le ho se hlomphane. Sena se etsahala hobane ba sa na le letsoalo ka hare ho bona. Ntho ea bohlokoa ka ho fetisisa ke tlhompho har'a rona. Lintho tsohle tsa bomolimo li tla etsahala feela haeba re hlomphana, ha bacha ba hlompha maqheku 'me maqheku a hlompha bacha, re ratana ka lerato la bomolimo re sa ikaketse. Molimo ha a batle motho ea ikaketsang.

O ka fumana libakeng tse ling liofisiri li fepana ka moea o mobe oa ho fetohela baetapele ba bona ka ho se amohele ho etelloa pele ke bona, 'me ba batla ho etelloa pele ke liofisiri tseo ba ikhethetseng tsona.
