Ha ho letho le molemo ho feta ha e mong le e mong a lula moo moapostola a mo behileng teng. Ha ho e-na le ho se utloisisane kapa phapang ea maikutlo, lulang fatše 'me e mong le e mong a hlahise taba ea hae 'me le lokise se fosahetseng ka ho hlomphana. Ka ho etsa joalo re tla be re hlompha moapostola.

Molimo o tla re hlohonolofatsa mme a re etse hore bohle re phele le malapa a rona.

Ke le lakaletsa matsatsi a phomolo a monate, e se eka le ka qala Selemo se Secha le phela hantle. Le tlameha ho lakaletsana Keresemese e Monate mme le kene Selemong se Secha ka litlhohonolofatso. Re boetse re leboha hore selemong sena sa 2014 Molimo o re hlohonolofalitse ka naleli-moapostola. Re leboha seo hobane sena se ne se ke ke sa etsahala haeba Molimo oa kereke ena a ne a sa phele.

Kea le leboha bohle mme kea le rata bohle!

Ea lona Moreneng
N. V. Mlangeni.
Mopresidente.

en.title: Greetings for the Year 2015/16
en.message:
Beloved in the Lord,

I write to you this letter which is the greetings of 2015/2016 being filled with amazing joy and love about you my father's children.

Firstly let me thank you all for your commitment in the church, and the love that I see within you. That alone means a lot to me; like I normally say to you that "love others as you love yourself" by so doing you will be loving the one who created you, because to look down upon your brother or sister and considering yourself to be better than they are, means that you still do not know even the one who created you.

Remember the words that were spoken by our Lord when He rose from the dead; He says "beloved". We got a new name at that moment when the Lord resurrected from the grave. We should not forget that our creator said your body is the temple of God, he wrote his church in your body. The limbs in your body are twelve, they are six on one side and six on the other side, and they are twelve in total. They all work in harmony.

Then He gave you the head and put brain inside it, which is your mind to think. He says you must think and do not be lazy to think, you must ask from God in whatever you do. When you ask for something that is good God will give you that which is good.

Do not be like the king's daughter who could dance, when the king said to her; "my child you have danced very well, better than the other girls, therefore ask for anything you like and I will give it to you" Then she said, 'father I am asking for the head of John the Baptist" It was difficult for her father but because he had promised her anything, because he loved her, John had to be killed and his head was brought in a platter, and the king's daughter was happy and danced even more.

Here then is a question that says: Was that a good request? It means if you ask for something good you will benefit that which is good and if you ask for something evil you shall be rewarded with that which is evil. Therefore learn to ask for something good to be rewarded with that which is good. You must learn to forgive so that you also can be forgiven.

God bless you with good health with your families.

Yours in Christ,
N.V. Mlangeni

zu.title: Umbuliso wonyaka ka-2015/16
zu.message:
Bathandekayo eNkosini,

Nginilobela lencwadi engumbuliso ka-2015/16 ngigcwele ukujabula okuyisimangaliso nothando oluyisimangaliso ngani bantwana bakababa.

Okokuqala mangibonge kini nonke ukuzimisela kwenu enkonzweni, nothando engilubona phakathi kwenu. Lokho-nje kukodwa kimina kusho okukhulu; njengoba ngike ngisho kini ukuthi "thanda omunye njengoba uzithanda wena uqobo lwakho" ngalokho uyobe uthanda lowo owakudalayo. Ngoba ukubukela phansi umfowenu noma udadewenu, uzibone wena ukuthi ungcono kunabo, kusho ukuthi nokudalileyo awukamazi.

Khumbula mazwi akhulunywa iNkosi yethu uma ivuka kwabafileyo; ithi: "bathandwa". Sathola igama elisha ngaleso sikhathi uma iNkosi ivuka ethuneni. Singakhohlwa ukuthi owasidalayo wathi umzimba wakho uyithempeli lika-Nkulunkulu, wayibhala inkonzo yakhe emzimbeni wakho. Amalungu emzimbeni wakho ayishumi nambili, ngasohlangothini lwakho ayisithupha, nakolunye uhlangothi ayisithupha, bese ehlangana abe yishumi nambili. Asebenza wonke ngokuzwana.

Wabe esekupha ikhanda wafaka ubuchopho phakathi kwalo, okuyingqondo yokucabanga. Uthi cabanga ungavilaphi ukucabanga, ucele ku-Nkulunkulu noma ngabe wenzani. Uma ucela okulungile uNkulunkulu uyokupha okulungile.

Ungalingisi intombi yenkosi eyayikwazi ukusina, lapho inkosi yathi kuyo mntanami usine kahle ukwedlula ezinye izintombi, ngakho-ke cela noma yini oyithandayo ngizokunika kona, yayisithi baba ngicela ikhanda lika Johane umbhabhadisi. Kwaba lukhuni kuyise wayo kodwa ngoba wayeyithembisile ukuthi noma yini ngoba eyithanda, kwafanela ukuthi abulawe uJohane lalethwa-ke ikhanda lakhe libekwe oqwembeni, yajabula-ke intombi yenkosi yasina kakhulu.

Nawuke umbuzo uthi: kwakuyisicelo esihle leso na? Kusho ukuthi uma ucela okulhle uyozuza okuhle kodwa uma ucela okubi uyozuza okubi. Ngakho-ke fundani ukucela okuhle ukuze namukeliswe okuhle. Fundani ukuxolela ukuze nani nixolelwe.

UNkulunkulu anibusise nibe nokuphila okuhle nemindeni yenu.

Yimi owenu kuKristo.
N. V. Mlangeni

nso.title: Ditumedišo tša Ngwaga wa 2015/16
nso.message:
Baratiwa Moreneng,

Ke le ngwalela lengwalo le e lego ditumedišo tša 2015/2016 le tletše lethabo le lerato le legolo ka lena bana ba tate.

Sa mathomo e re ke le leboge ka moka ga lena bakeng sa boikgafo bja lena kerekeng, le lerato leo ke le bonago go lena. Seo se nnoši se ra go gontši go nna; bjalo ka ge ke fela ke le botša gore "rata ba bangwe bjalo ka ge o ithata" ka go dira bjalo o tla be o rata yo a go hlotšego, gobane go nyatša ngwaneno goba kgaetšedi ya gago le go ipona o le kaone go ba phala, go ra gore ga o ešo wa tseba le yo a go hlotšego.

Gopola mantšu ao a boletšwego ke Morena wa rena ge a tsoga bahung; a re "baratiwa". Re hweditše leina le lefsa ka nako yeo ge Morena a tsoga lebitleng. Re se ke ra lebala gore mmopi wa rena o itše mmele wa gago ke tempele ya Modimo, o ngwadile kereke ya gagwe mmeleng wa gago. Ditho tša mmele wa gago di lesomepedi, di tshela ka lehlakoreng le lengwe gomme di tshela ka go le lengwe, di lesomepedi ka moka. Di šoma mmogo ka kwano.

Ke moka a go fa hlogo a tsenya bjoko ka gare ga yona, e lego monagano wa gago wa go nagana. O re o swanetše go nagana o se ke wa tšwafa go nagana, o kgopele go Modimo go se sengwe le se sengwe se o se dirago. Ge o kgopela se sebotse Modimo o tla go fa se sebotse.

Le se ke la swana le morwedi wa kgoši yo a bego a kgona go bina, ge kgoši e re go yena; "ngwanaka o binne gabotse kudu, go phala basetsana ba bangwe, ka gona kgopela se sengwe le se sengwe se o se ratago gomme ke tla go fa sona" Ke moka a re, 'tate ke kgopela hlogo ya Johane Mokolobetši" Go be go le thata go tatagwe eupša ka gobane o be a mo tshepišitše se sengwe le se sengwe, ka gobane o be a mo rata, Johane o be a swanetše go bolawa gomme hlogo ya gagwe ya tlišwa ka sebjana, gomme morwedi wa kgoši o be a thabile gomme a bina le go feta.

Fa go na le potšišo yeo e rego: Na eo e be e le kgopelo e botse? Se se ra gore ge o kgopela se sebotse o tla holega ka se sebotse gomme ge o kgopela se sebe o tla putswa ka se sebe. Ka gona ithute go kgopela se sebotse gore o putswe ka se sebotse. O swanetše go ithuta go lebalela gore le wena o lebalelwe.

Modimo a le šegofatše ka maphelo a mabotse le malapa a lena.

Wa lena go Kriste,
N.V. Mlangeni

xh.title: Imibuliso yoNyaka ka 2015/16
xh.message:
Bathandekayo eNkosini,

Ndinibhalela le leta iyimibuliso ka-2015/2016 izele luvuyo olumangalisayo nothando ngani bantwana baka tata.

Okokuqala mandinibulele nonke ngokuzinikela kwenu ecaweni, nothando endilubona ngaphakathi kwenu. Loo nto iyodwa ithetha lukhulu kum; njengoko ndidla ngokuthi kuni "thanda abanye njengoko uzithanda" ngokwenza njalo uya kube uthanda lowo ukudalileyo, kuba ukujongela phantsi umzalwana okanye udade wenu uzibona ungcono kunabo, kuthetha ukuba awukamazi kwanalowo ukudalileyo.

Khumbula amazwi athethwa yiNkosi yethu xa yavuka kwabafileyo; ithi "bathandwa". Safumana igama elitsha ngaloo mzuzu iNkosi yavuka engcwabeni. Asifanele silibale ukuba umdali wethu wathi umzimba wenu uyitempile kaThixo, wayibhala icawe yakhe emzimbeni wenu. Amalungu emzimbeni wenu alishumi elinesibini, amathandathu kwelinye icala amathandathu kwelinye icala, kwaye alishumi elinesibini ewonke. Onke asebenza ngemvisiswano.

Wandula ke wakunika intloko wafaka ingqondo kuyo, eyiyo ingqondo yakho yokucinga. Uthi umele ucinge yaye ungabi livila ukucinga, umele ucele kuThixo kuyo nantoni na oyenzayo. Xa ucela into elungileyo uThixo uya kukunika oko kulungileyo.

Musani ukuba njengentombi kakumkani eyayikwazi ukudansa, wathi ukumkani kuyo; "mntwanam udanse kakuhle kakhulu, ngcono kunamanye amantombazana, ngoko cela nayiphi na into oyithandayo ndiza kukunika" Emva koko yathi, 'tata ndicela intloko kaYohane uMbhaptizi" Kwakunzima kuyise kodwa kuba wayeyithembise nayiphi na into, ngenxa yokuba wayeyithanda, uYohane kwafuneka abulawe kwaye intloko yakhe yaziswa ngesitya, kwaye intombi kakumkani yavuya kwaye yadansa ngakumbi.

Nanku ke umbuzo othi: Ngaba eso yayisisicelo esihle? Kuthetha ukuba ukuba ucela into elungileyo uya kuzuza okokulungileyo kwaye ukuba ucela into embi uya kuvuzwa ngobubi. Ngoko ke funda ukucela okuhle ukuze uvuzwe ngoko kulungileyo. Umele ufunde ukuxolela ukuze nawe uxolelwe.

UThixo anisikelele ngempilo entle kunye neentsapho zenu.

Owakho kuKristu,
N.V. Mlangeni

ts.title: Swilumiso swa Lembe ra 2015/16
ts.message:
Varhandziwa eka Hosi,

Ndzi mi tsalela papila leri nga xilumiso xa 2015/2016 ri tele hi ntsako wo hlamarisa ni rirhandzu hi n'wina vana va tatana wa mina.

Ku sungula ndzi lava ku mi nkhensa hinkwenu hi ku tinyiketela ka n'wina ekerekeni, ni rirhandzu leri ndzi ri vonaka endzeni ka n'wina. Sweswo ntsena swi vula swo tala eka mina; hilaha ndzi toloveleke ku mi byela hakona leswaku "rhandza van'wana hilaha u tirhandzaka hakona" hi ku endla tano u ta va u rhandza loyi a ku tumbuluxeke, hikuva ku langutela ehansi makwenu wa xinuna kumbe wa xisati ni ku tivona u ri antswa ku va tlula, swi vula leswaku a wu si tiva hambi ku ri loyi a ku tumbuluxeke.

Tsundzukani marito lawa ya vuriweke hi Hosi ya hina loko Yi pfuka eku feni; Yi ri "varhandziwa". Hi kume vito lerintshwa hi nkarhi wolowo loko Hosi yi pfuka esirheni. A hi fanelanga ku rivala leswaku muvumbi wa hina u te miri wa wena i tempeli ya Xikwembu, u tsarile kereke ya yena emirimbeni wa wena. Swirho swa miri wa wena i khume-mbirhi, i tsevu etlhelo rin'we na tsevu etlhelo rin'wana, naswona i khume-mbirhi hinkwaswo. Hinkwaswo swi tirha hi ku twanana.

Kutani U ku nyikile nhloko a nghenisa byongo endzeni ka yona, leyi nga mianakanyo ya wena leswaku u ehleketa. U ri u fanele ku ehleketa naswona u nga vi lolo ku ehleketa, u fanele ku kombela eka Xikwembu eka hinkwaswo leswi u swi endlaka. Loko u kombela nchumu lowunene Xikwembu xi ta ku nyika leswinene.

Mi nga fani ni n'wana wa hosi wa nhwanyana loyi a kotaka ku cina, loko hosi yi ku eka yena; "n'wananga u cini kahle swinene, ku antswa ku tlula vanhwanyana lavan'wana, hikwalaho kombela xin'wana ni xin'wana lexi u xi lavaka naswona ndzi ta ku nyika xona" Kutani a ku, 'tatana ndzi kombela nhloko ya Yohane Mukhuvuri" Swi tikile eka tata wa yena kambe hikuva a n'wi tshembise xin'wana ni xin'wana, hikuva a n'wi rhandza, Yohane a fanele a dlayiwa kutani nhloko ya yena yi tisiwa hi xibye, kutani n'wana wa hosi a tsaka naswona a cina swinene.

Kutani laha ku ni xivutiso lexi nge: Xana xexo a xi ri xikombelo lexinene? Swi vula leswaku loko u kombela nchumu lowunene u ta pfuneka hi leswinene naswona loko u kombela swo biha u ta hakeriwa hi leswo biha. Hikwalaho dyondza ku kombela leswinene leswaku u hakeriwa hi leswinene. U fanele ku dyondza ku rivalela leswaku na wena u ta rivaleriwa.

Xikwembu xi mi katekisa hi rihanyo lerinene ni mindyangu ya n'wina.

Wa n'wina eka Kreste,
N.V. Mlangeni

st.title: Litumeliso tsa Selemo sa 2015/16
st.message:
Baratuoa Moreneng,

Ke le ngolla lengolo lena e leng litumeliso tsa 2015/2016 e tletse thabo e hlollang le lerato ka lona bana ba ntate.

Ntlha ea pele e re ke le lebohe bohle ka boitelo ba lona kerekeng, le lerato leo ke le bonang ho lona. Seo ka bosona se bolela ho hongata ho 'na; joalokaha ke atisa ho re ho lona "rata ba bang joalokaha u ithata" ka ho etsa joalo u tla be u rata ea u bopileng, hobane ho nyelisa mor'eno kapa khaitseli ea hao 'me u inka u le betere ho ba feta, ho bolela hore ha u e-so tsebe le ea u bopileng.

Hopolang mantsoe a builoeng ke Morena oa rona ha a tsoha bafung; o re "baratuoa". Re ile ra fumana lebitso le lecha motsotsong oo ha Morena a tsoha lebitleng. Ha rea lokela ho lebala hore 'mopi oa rona o itse' mele oa lona ke tempele ea Molimo, o ngotse kereke ea hae 'meleng oa lona. Litho tsa 'mele oa hao li leshome le metso e' meli, li tšeletseng ka lehlakoreng le leng le tse tšeletseng ka lehlakoreng le leng, 'me li leshome le metso e' meli kaofela. Kaofela li sebetsa ka kutloano.

Eaba o u fa hlooho a beha boko ka har'a eona, e leng kelello ea hau ea ho nahana. O re o tlameha ho nahana mme o se be botsoa ho nahana, o tlameha ho kopa ho Molimo ho eng kapa eng eo o e etsang. Ha u kopa se setle Molimo o tla u fa se setle.

Le se ke la tšoana le morali oa morena ea neng a tseba ho tants'a, ha morena a re ho eena; "ngoan'aka u tantšitse hantle haholo, ho feta banana ba bang, kahoo kopa eng kapa eng eo u e batlang 'me ke tla u fa eona" Eaba o re, 'ntate ke kopa hlooho ea Johanne Mokolobetsi" Ho ne ho le thata ho ntat'ae empa hobane a ne a mo tšepisitse letho, hobane a mo rata, Johanne o ne a tlameha ho bolaoa mme hlooho ea hae ea tlisoa ka sekotlolo, mme morali oa morena a thaba mme a tantša le ho feta.

Joale ho na le potso e reng: Na seo e ne e le kopo e ntle? Ho bolela hore ha u kopa ntho e ntle u tla rua molemo o motle mme ha u kopa se sebe u tla putsoa ka bobe. Ka hona ithute ho kopa se setle ho putsoa ka se setle. Le tlameha ho ithuta ho tšoarela e le hore le lona le tšoareloe.

Molimo a le hlohonolofatse ka bophelo bo botle le malapa a lona.

Ea lona ho Kreste,
N.V. Mlangeni

zu.title: UMBULISO WONYAKA KA-2017/2018
zu.message:
Bathandekayo ku Krestu, Ngiyanibingelela egameni leNkosi noMsindisi uJesu Kristu.

Nginilobela lombuliso ngigcwele ukujabula okuchichimayo ngani. Masibonge iNkosi uJesu Krestu owavuma ukuza emhlabeni onezinkathazo, nezinhlupheko eziningi ezinhlobonhlobo.

Ukuza kwakhe emhlabeni wayezosindisa thina Bantu baka yise, ngothando nangeqiniso. Kwathi labo abakholwa nguye wahlala nabo wabafundisa indlela yokukhonza, nokuthandaza, nokuhlephula isinkwa esingcwele, basidle izinsuku eziyisikhombisa (7) zokuphila kwabo.

Nathi-ke bathandekayo eNkosini, njengesi-zukulwane sanamhlanje kufanele ukuthi sibe njengalabo basendulo abasendulelayo, njengoba kuyithina esenziwe saba yitswayi noma usawoti, nokukhanya kwezwe. Ukuze phela abasezweni nabo bafise ukufana nathi. Singabi yitswayi elidumele, eligenakusetshenziswa muntu, itswayi elifanele ukulahlwa ngaphandle linyathelwe ngabantu gezinyawo.

Kwenzeka kanjani lokhu na? Lokhu kwenzeka uma umuntu esezibona emkhulu engasa-khokheleki lapho ebekwe khona, esezibona engcono.

Konke lokhu kudalwa yini na? Lokhu kudalwa ukunganeliseki. Ake ngibuze umbuzo. Kuyiqiniso yini ukuthi ingane iyakhula, ithi uma isindala ibisilingana nabazali bayo abyiletha kulomhlaba? Impendulo ithi cha. Ingane ayibakhuleli abazali bayo, ilingane nabo.

Bathandwa, akekho ongakhokhelwa. Sonke siyakhokhelwa. Lokho kwadalwa nguThixo, angeke kujike.

Athi omunye umuntu ubukade ungikhokhela izolo, hhayi namhlanje, namhlanje sesiyalingana.

Ngemuva kokuba uLucifer edalwe nguNkulunkulu wazitshela ukuthi uyalingana noThixo umenzi wakhe. Zadinwa izingilosi eZulwini, u-GABRIEL no MICHAEL, zamgxavula zamntshinga phansi emhlabeni. Unkulunkulu akulindele kithi ubuntwana, nokuzehlisa, sisebenze ngokuzwana. Omdala ahloniphe omncane, nabancane bahloniphe abadala. Sihloniphe nabanye ngaphakathi nangaphandle kwenkonzo ngoba nabo badalwe nguNkulunkulu.

Singakhohlwa ukuthi singamalungu kulomzimba ka Kristu, asebenza ngokuzwana. U Mpostoli wabekwa waba njenge THRONE. Kukhona-ke imifula emithathu eqhamuka kule THRONE, ethwala amanzi iwase ezansi ensimini, ukuze okutshaliwe kuthole ukuphila, kukhule kuthele izithelo.

Umfula wokuqala nguMvangeli, UMSHUMAYELI, UMZALWANE no DADE, abalanda abantu ehlane babalethe enkonzweni.

Umfula wesibili ngu Melusi, uMgcotshwa enkonzweni, ukusukela ku MPRISTI kufike ku MVELELI. Nguyena obelusayo labantu, abathethelele izono.

Umfula wesithathu nguMprofethi, owazisa umelusi ngokuzayo nokuzokwenzeka.

Kungakho uNkulunkulu ethi ibandla elingenawo umoya wuku-profetha lifile kanye nemisebenzi yalo. Ngoba alinakwazi indawo elimi kuyona ukuthi ingabe iyabisha noma injani.

Bathandwa qaphelani omubi, anganiqhathi noNkulunkulu ngamaqhinga, nangokuhlakanipha kwakhe okungayi ndawo, okungazange kwasindisa muntu. Singahlali ezihlalweni zabagxeki, ngoba kuyothiwa nathi singabagxeki.

Sibekelwe umthombo wokuphila, okufanele siphuze kuwona, okuyinceku yami enkonzweni. Siyeke ukuphuza emaxhaphozini IZINHLEBO, Ngoba siyokufa nokufa.

MINA NABAPOSTOLI SINIFISELA IMPILO ENHLE ENEZIBUSISO ONYAKENI KA 2018

Yimi owenu eMbizweni,
N.V.Mlangeni
Chief/President

en.title: GREETING FOR THE YEAR 2017/2018
en.message:
Beloved in Christ, I greet you in the name of the Lord and Saviour Jesus Christ.

I write this greeting filled with overflowing joy for you. Let us thank the Lord Jesus Christ who agreed to come to an earth with troubles, and many different kinds of suffering.

His coming to earth was to save us, the People of His father, with love and truth. And it was that those who believed in Him He stayed with them and taught them the way of worship, and to pray, and to break the holy bread, and they ate it for the seven (7) days of their lives.

We too, beloved in the Lord, as today's generation must be like those of ancient times who preceded us, since it is we who have been made to be salt, and the light of the world. So that those in the world may also desire to be like us. Let us not be tasteless salt, that cannot be used by anyone, salt that must be thrown outside to be trampled by people's feet.

How does this happen? This happens when a person sees themselves as great and no longer able to be led where they are placed, seeing themselves as better.

What is all this caused by? This is caused by dissatisfaction. Let me ask a question. Is it true that when a child grows, they say when they are older they become equal to their parents who brought them into this world? The answer says no. A child does not outgrow their parents, to be equal with them.

Beloved, there is no one who is not led. We are all led. That was created by God, it will not turn back.

Someone may say you were leading me yesterday, not today, today we are equal.

After Lucifer was created by God he told himself that he is equal to God his maker. The angels in Heaven were angry, GABRIEL and MICHAEL, they grabbed him and threw him down to earth. God expects from us childlike nature, and humility, to work in harmony. The older must respect the younger, and the younger respect the older. Let us respect others inside and outside the church because they too were created by God.

Let us not forget that we are joints in this body of Christ, working in harmony. The Apostle was placed to be like a THRONE. There are then three rivers coming from this THRONE, which carry water down to the field, so that what is planted gets life, grows and bears fruit.

The first river is the Evangelist, the PREACHER, BROTHER and SISTER, who fetch people in the wilderness and bring them to church.

The second river is the Shepherd, the Anointed in the church, from the PRIEST to the OVERSEER. He is the one who shepherds these people, and forgives sins.

The third river is the Prophet, who informs the shepherd about what is coming and what will happen.

That is why God says a congregation without the spirit of prophecy is dead together with its works. Because it cannot know the place where it stands whether it is sinking or how it is.

Beloved beware of the evil one, let him not pit you against God with tricks, and with his cleverness that goes nowhere, which never saved a person. Let us not sit in the seats of the critics, because it will be said we too are critics.

We have been given a fountain of life, from which we must drink, which is my officer in the church. Let us stop drinking from the swamps of GOSSIP, Because we will die and die.

I AND THE APOSTLES WISH YOU A GOOD LIFE WITH BLESSINGS IN THE YEAR 2018

Yours in the Call,
N.V. Mlangeni
Chief/President

nso.title: TUMEDIŠO YA NGWAGA WA 2017/2018
nso.message:
Barategi go Kriste, Ke le dumediša ka leina la Morena le Mophološi Jesu Kriste.

Ke le ngwalela tumedišo ye ke tletše ka lethabo le le peneng ka lena. A re lebogeng Morena Jesu Kriste yo a dumetšego go tla lefaseng la mathata, le ditlaišego tše dintši tša mehutahuta.

Go tla ga gagwe lefaseng e be e le go tlo phološa rena Batho ba tatagwe, ka lerato le ka therešo. Gomme ba ba dumetšego go yena o ile a dula le bona a ba ruta tsela ya go rapela, le go gopola, le go arolelana senkgwa se sekgethwa, ba se ja matšatši a a šupago (7) a bophelo bja bona.

Le rena barategi go Morena, bjalo ka moloko wa lehono re swanetše go ba bjalo ka ba kgale bao ba re etilego pele, ka ge e le rena re dirilwego letswai, le seetša sa lefase. Gore bao ba lego lefaseng le bona ba dume go swana le rena. Re se be letswai le le tapilego, le le ka se sa šomišwago ke motho, letswai le le swanetšego go lahlwa ka ntle le gatakelwe ke batho ka maoto.

Se se direga bjang? Se se direga ge motho a ipona a le mogolo a sa sa kgona go etelelwa pele mo a beilwego gona, a ipona a le kaone.

Se ka moka se hlolwa ke eng? Se se hlolwa ke go se kgotsofale. A ke botšiše potšišo. Na ke nnete gore ngwana o a gola, a re ge a le mogolo o lekanana le batswadi ba gagwe bao ba mo tlišitšego lefaseng le? Karabo e re aowa. Ngwana ga a fete batswadi ba gagwe ka bogolo, gore a lekane le bona.

Barategi, ga go na yo a sa etelelwego pele. Ka moka ga rena re a etelelwa pele. Seo se hlotšwe ke Modimo, se ka se bowe morago.

Yo mongwe a ka re o be o nnetelela pele maabane, e sego lehono, lehono re a lekana.

Ka morago ga gore Lusifera a hlolwe ke Modimo o ile a ipotša gore o lekana le Modimo mmopi wa gagwe. Barongwa Legodimong ba ile ba befelwa, GABRIEL le MICHAEL, ba mo swara ba mo lahlela fase lefaseng. Modimo o letetše go rena bjana, le boikokobetšo, re šome ka kwano. Yo mogolo a hlomphe yo monyenyane, le ba banyenyane ba hlomphe ba bagolo. Re hlomphe ba bangwe ka gare le ka ntle ga kereke gobane le bona ba hlotšwe ke Modimo.

A re se lebaleng gore re malokollo mmeleng wo wa Kriste, a a šomago ka kwano. Moapostola o beilwe a ba bjalo ka TERONE. Go na le dinoka tše tharo tše di tšwago TERONENG ye, tše di rwalago meetse di a iša tlase tšhemong, gore se se bjetšwego se hwetše bophelo, se gole se enye dienywa.

Noka ya mathomo ke Moebangedi, MORERI, NGWANEŠO le KGAETŠEDI, bao ba latago batho leganateng ba ba tliše kerekeng.

Noka ya bobedi ke Modiši, Motlotšwa kerekeng, go tloga go MOPRISTA go fihla go MOLEBELEDI. Ke yena yo a dišago batho ba, a ba swarele dibe.

Noka ya boraro ke Moporofeta, yo a tsebišago modiši ka tše di tlang le tše di tlogo direga.

Ke ka baka leo Modimo a rego phuthego ye e se nago moya wa boporofeta e hwile mmogo le mešomo ya yona. Gobane ga e kgone go tseba lefelo leo e emego go lona gore na e a nwelela goba go bjang.

Barategi hlokomelang yo mobe, a se le lwantšhe le Modimo ka maano, le ka bohlale bja gagwe bjo bo sa yego felo, bjo bo sa kago bja phološa motho. Re se duleng ditulong tša baswayadiphošo, gobane go tlo thwe le rena re baswayadiphošo.

Re beetšwe mothopo wa bophelo, woo re swanetšego go nwa go wona, e lego mohlanka wa ka kerekeng. A re tlogeleng go nwa mekgobeng ya DITSHEBO, Gobane re tlo hwa ra ba ra hwa.

NNA LE BAAPOSTOLA RE LE LAKALETŠA BOPHELO BJO BOBOTSE BJO BO NAGO LE DITŠHEGOFATŠO NGWAGENG WA 2018

Wa lena Pitšong,
N.V. Mlangeni
Moetapele/Mopresidente

xh.title: UMBULISO WONYAKA KA-2017/2018
xh.message:
Bathandekayo kuKristu, Ndiyanibulisa egameni leNkosi noMsindisi uYesu Kristu.

Ndinibhalela lo mbuliso ndizele luvuyo oluphuphumayo ngani. Masibulele iNkosi uYesu Kristu owavuma ukuza emhlabeni onezinkathazo, neentlupheko ezininzi eziziintlobo ngiintlobo.

Ukuza kwakhe emhlabeni wayezosindisa thina Bantwana baka yise, ngothando nangenyaniso. Kwathi labo bakholwayo kuye wahlala nabo wabafundisa indlela yokukhonza, nokuthandaza, nokuqhekeza isonka esingcwele, basitya iintsuku ezisixhenxe (7) zokuphila kwabo.

Nathi ke bathandekayo eNkosini, njengesizukulwana sanamhlanje kufanele ukuba sibe njengabo basendulo abasandulelayo, njengoko kuyithi esenziwe saba yityuwa, nokukhanya kwehlabathi. Ukuze nabasehlabathini bafise ukufana nathi. Singabi yityuwa edumeleyo, engenakusetyenziswa mntu, ityuwa efanele ukulahlwa phandle inyathelelwe ngabantu ngeenyawo.

Kwenzeka njani oku? Oku kwenzeka xa umntu esezibona emkhulu engasakhokheleki apho abekwe khona, esezibona engcono.

Konke oku kudalwa yintoni? Oku kudalwa kukungoneliseki. Makhe ndibuze umbuzo. Kuyinyaniso na ukuba umntwana uyakhula, athi xa emdala alingane nabazali bakhe abamzisa kweli hlabathi? Impendulo ithi hayi. Umntwana akabakhuleli abazali bakhe, alingane nabo.

Bathandwa, akukho ongakhokhelwayo. Sonke siyakhokhelwa. Oko kwadalwa nguThixo, akunakujika.

Athi omnye umntu ubukade undikhokhela izolo, hayi namhlanje, namhlanje sesiyalingana.

Emva kokuba uLucifer edalwe nguThixo wazixelela ukuba uyalingana noThixo umenzi wakhe. Zacaphuka iingelosi eZulwini, u-GABRIEL no MICHAEL, zamthi xhwi zamjikela phantsi emhlabeni. UThixo ulindele kuthi ubuntwana, nokuzithoba, sisebenze ngemvisiswano. Omdala mahloniphe omncinci, nabancinci bahloniphe abadala. Sihloniphe nabanye ngaphakathi nangaphandle kwecawa kuba nabo badalwe nguThixo.

Singalibali ukuba singamalungu kulo mzimba kaKristu, asebenza ngemvisiswano. UMpostile wabekwa waba njenge-THRONE (ITRONE). Kukho ke imilambo emithathu ephuma kule THRONE, ethwala amanzi iwase ezantsi entsimini, ukuze okutyaliweyo kufumane ubomi, kukhule kuthele iziqhamo.

Umlambo wokuqala nguMvangeli, UMSHUMAYELI, UMZALWANA no DADE, abalanda abantu entlango babazise ecaweni.

Umlambo wesibini nguMalusi, uMthanjiswa ecaweni, ukusukela kuMPRISTI kufike kuMVELELI. Nguye owalusa aba bantu, axolele izono.

Umlambo wesithathu nguMprofeti, owazisa umalusi ngokuzayo nokuzakwenzeka.

Kungoko uThixo esithi ibandla elingenamoya wesiprofeto lifile kunye nemisebenzi yalo. Kuba alinakwazi indawo elimi kuyo ukuba liyatshona na okanye linjani.

Bathandwa lumkelani ongendawo, anganiqhathi noThixo ngamaqhinga, nangobulumko bakhe obungayi ndawo, obungazange basindisa mntu. Singahlali kwizihlalo zabagxeki, kuba kuyothiwa nathi singabagxeki.

Sibekelwe umthombo wobomi, ekufanele sisele kuwo, osisicaka sam ecaweni. Siyeke ukusela emaxhaphozini EENTLEBENDWANE, Kuba siya kufa nokufa.

MNA NABAPOSTILE SININQWENELELA UBOMI OBUHLE OBUNEENTSIKELELO KUNYAKA KA-2018

Ndim owakho eBbizweni,
N.V. Mlangeni
INtloko/UMongameli

ts.title: XILUMISO XA LEMBE RA 2017/2018
ts.message:
Varhandziwa eka Kreste, Ndzi mi losa hi vito ra Hosi na Muponisi Yesu Kreste.

Ndzi mi tsalela xilumiso lexi ndzi tele hi ntsako lowukulu eka n'wina. A hi nkhenseni Hosi Yesu Kreste loyi a pfumeleke ku ta emisaveni leyi nga ni swiphiqo, ni mahlomulo yo tala ya tinxaka to hambanahambana.

Ku ta ka yena emisaveni a ku ri ku ta ponisa hina Vanhu va tata wa yena, hi rirhandzu ni ntiyiso. Kutani lava pfumeleke eka yena u tshamile na vona a va dyondzisa ndlela yo gandzela, ni ku khongela, ni ku avelana xinkwa xo kwetsima, va xi dya masiku ya nkombo (7) ya vutomi bya vona.

Na hina varhandziwa eka Hosi, tanihi xitukulwana xa namuntlha hi fanele ku fana na lava va khale lava hi rhangeleke, tanihi leswi ku nga hina lava endliweke munyu, ni ku vonakala ka misava. Leswaku na lava nga emisaveni va navela ku fana na hina. Hi nga vi munyu lowu nantswekiki, lowu nga tirhisiwiki hi munhu, munyu lowu faneleke ku cukumetiwa ehandle wu kandziyeriwa hi vanhu hi milenge.

Swi endlekisa ku yini leswi xana? Leswi swi endleka loko munhu a tivona a ri nkulu a nga ha rhangeleriwi laha a vekiweke kona, a tivona a antswa.

Hinkwaswo leswi swi vangiwa hi yini? Leswi swi vangiwa hi ku nga eneriseki. A ndzi vutise xivutiso. Xana i ntiyiso leswaku n'wana wa kula, a ku loko a kurile a ringanana na vatswari va yena lava n'wi tiseke emisaveni leyi? Nhlamulo yi ri e-e. N'wana a nga hundzi vatswari va yena, leswaku a ringanana na vona.

Varhandziwa, a ku na loyi a nga rhangeleriwiki. Hinkwerhu ha rhangeleriwa. Sweswo swi tumbuluxiwile hi Xikwembu, a swi nge tlheleli endzhaku.

Un'wana a nga ha ku a wu ndzi rhangela tolo, ku nga ri namuntlha, namuntlha ha ringanana.

Endzhaku ka loko Lusifere a tumbuluxiwile hi Xikwembu u tibyerile leswaku u ringanana na Xikwembu muvumbi wa yena. Tintsrumi etilweni ti hlundzukile, GABRIEL na MICHAEL, ti n'wi khoma ti n'wi lahlela ehansi emisaveni. Xikwembu xi langutele eka hina vuhlangi, ni ku titsongahata, hi tirhisana hi ku twanana. Lonkulu a hlonipha lontsongo, ni lavantsongo va hlonipha lavakulu. Hi hlonipha ni van'wana endzeni ni le handle ka kereke hikuva na vona va tumbuluxiwile hi Xikwembu.

Hi nga rivali leswaku hi swirho eka miri lowu wa Kreste, leswi tirhaka hi ku twanana. Mupostola u vekiwile a va tanihi XILUVELO. Ku na milambu yinharhu leyi humaka eka XILUVELO lexi, leyi rhwalaka mati yi ma yisa ehansi ensin'wini, leswaku leswi byariweke swi kuma vutomi, swi kula swi tswala mihandzu.

Nambu wo sungula i Muvangeli, MUCHUMAYELI, MAKWAKWERHU WA XINUNA na WA XISATI, lava landzaka vanhu emananga va va tisa ekerekeni.

Nambu wa vumbirhi i Murisi, Mutotiwa ekerekeni, ku sukela eka MUPRISTA ku fika eka MULANGUTERI. Hi yena la risaka vanhu lava, a va rivalela swidyoho.

Nambu wa vunharhu i Muprofeta, loyi a tivisaka murisi hi leswi taka ni leswi nga ta endleka.

Hi yona mhaka Xikwembu xi nge vandlha leri nga riki na moya wa vuprofeta ri file swin'we na mintirho ya rona. Hikuva a ri nge tivi ndhawu leyi ri yimeke eka yona leswaku xana ria mbombomela kumbe ri njhani.

Varhandziwa tivoneleni eka lowo biha, a nga mi lwanisi na Xikwembu hi mano, ni vutlhari bya yena lebyi nga yiki helo, lebyi nga zangiki byi ponisa munhu. Hi nga tshameni eswitshamanini swa vasori, hikuva ku ta vuriwa leswaku na hina hi vasori.

Hi vekeriwe xihlovo xa vutomi, laha hi faneleke ku nwa kona, lexi nga nandza wa mina ekerekeni. A hi tshikeni ku nwa emidzobeni ya MAVARIVARI, Hikuva hi ta fa ni ku fa.

MINA NA VAPOSTOLA HI MI NAVELELA VUTOMI LEBYINENE LEBYI NGA NI MIKATEKO EKA LEMBE RA 2018

Hi mina wa n'wina eka Xivito,
N.V. Mlangeni
Nhloko/Puresidente

st.title: TUMELISO EA SELEMO SA 2017/2018
st.message:
Baratuoa ho Kreste, Kea le lumelisa ka lebitso la Morena le Mopholosi Jesu Kreste.

Ke le ngolla tumeliso ena ke tletse thabo e kholo ka lona. A re lebeng Morena Jesu Kreste ea ileng a lumela ho tla lefatšeng le tletseng mathata, le matšoenyeho a mangata a mefuta-futa.

Ho tla ha hae lefatšeng e ne e le ho tlo pholosa rona Batho ba ntate oa hae, ka lerato le 'nete. Mme bao ba neng ba mo lumela a lula le bona a ba ruta tsela ea ho rapela, le ho kopa, le ho arolelana bohobe bo halalelang, 'me ba bo ja matsatsi a supileng (7) a bophelo ba bona.

Le rona baratuoa Moreneng, joaloka moloko oa kajeno re tlameha ho tšoana le ba boholo-holo ba re etelletseng pele, kaha ke rona ba entsoeng hore re be letsoai, le leseli la lefatše. E le hore ba lefatšeng le bona ba lakatse ho tšoana le rona. Re se be letsoai le sa utloahaleng, le ke keng la hlola le sebelisoa ke motho, letsoai le lokelang ho lahleloa kantle le ho hatakeloa ke batho ka maoto.

Sena se etsahala joang? Sena se etsahala ha motho a se a ipona a le moholo a sa sitoa ho etelletsoa pele moo a behiloeng teng, a ipona a le betere.

Sena sohle se bakoa ke eng? Sena se bakoa ke ho se khotsofale. E re ke botse potso. Na ke 'nete hore ngoana oa hola, a re ha a le moholo o lekana le batsoali ba hae ba mo tlisitseng lefatšeng lena? Karabo e re che. Ngoana ha a hōle ho feta batsoali ba hae, ho lekana le bona.

Baratuoa, ha ho ea sa etelletsoeng pele. Kaofela rea etelletsoa pele. Seo se bopiloe ke Molimo, se ke ke sa khutlela morao.

E mong a ka re u ne u nketelletse pele maobane, e seng kajeno, kajeno re ea lekana.

Kamora hore Lucifer a bopuoa ke Molimo o ile a ipolella hore o lekana le Molimo moetsi oa hae. Manyeloi Leholimong a ile a halefa, GABRIEL le MICHAEL, ba mo tšoara ba mo dihela fatše lefatšeng. Molimo o lebelletse ho rona bongoana, le boikokobetso, re sebetse ka kutloano. E moholo a hlomphe e monyenyane, mme ba banyenyane ba hlomphe ba baholo. Re hlomphe le ba bang kahare le kantle ho kereke hobane le bona ba bopiloe ke Molimo.

A re se keng ra lebala hore re manonyeletso 'meleng ona oa Kreste, o sebetsang ka kutloano. Moapostola o ile a beoa ho tšoana le TERONE. Ho na le linoka tse tharo tse tsoang ho TERONE ena, tse jarang metsi li a iseng tlaase tšimong, hore se jetsoeng se fumane bophelo, se hōle se behe litholoana.

Noka ea pele ke Moevangeli, MORERI, MOENA le KHAITSELI, ba latang batho lefeelleng ba ba tlise kerekeng.

Noka ea bobeli ke Molisa, Motlotsuoa kerekeng, ho tloha ho MOPRISTA ho isa ho MOLEBELI. Ke eena ea lisang batho bana, a ba tšoarele libe.

Noka ea boraro ke Moprofeta, ea tsebisang molisa ka tse tlang le tse tla etsahala.

Ke kahoo Molimo a reng phutheho e se nang moea oa boprofeta e shoele hammoho le mesebetsi ea eona. Hobane e ke ke ea tseba sebaka seo e emeng ho sona hore na ea teba kapa e joang.

Baratuoa hlokomelang e mobe, a se le loantshe le Molimo ka maqheka, le ka bohlale ba hae bo sa eeng kae, bo so kang ba pholosa motho. Re se keng ra lula litulong tsa basoli, hobane ho tla thoe le rona re basoli.

Re beetsoe mohloli oa bophelo, oo re lokelang ho noa ho oona, e leng mohlanka oa ka kerekeng. A re tloheleng ho noa mekhohlobong ea LITŠEBANG, Hobane re tla shoa mme re shoe.

NNA LE BAAPOSTOLA RE LE LAKALETSA BOPHELO BO BOTLE BO NANG LE DITLHOHONOLOFATSO SELEMONG SA 2018

Ea lona Pitsong,
N.V. Mlangeni
Hlooho/Mopresidente

zu.title: Umbuliso woMphostoli wonyaka-ka 2018/2019
zu.message:
Ngiyanibingelela nonke bathandekayo, egameni elihle le-Nkosi nomsindisi wethu uJesu Kristu.

Namhlanje masimbonge uThixo njengoba sigubha noma sibhiyozela iminyaka engamashumi amane enkonzweni yabaphostoli abayishumi nambili ku-Kristu. Pho, ingabe sisho ukuthi lenkonzo ineminyaka engamashumi amane kuphela yasungulwa na? Qhabo, akunjalo, nomongameli owasendulelayo waluchaza loludaba ngo 1988, mhla sasigubha iminyaka elishumi, abaningi benu basekhona kulenkonzo. Lenkonzo yamiswa yinkosi yethu uJesu Kristu, eminyakeni engaphezu kwezinkulungwane ezimbili, lapho yasho khona yathi: "phezu kwaleli dwala ngiyakulakha ibandla lami, amasango e-hayidese nokufa awayikulehlula;" Matt. 16:18. Nina nakhiwe phezu kwesisekelo saba-Phostoli naba phrofethi, lapho khona inkosi uqobo uJesu Kristu eyidwala lesisekelo.

Namhlanje sigubha, noma sibhiyozela umusa we-Nkosi esenzele wona kusukela ngombhiyozo ka 1988 kuze kube yilonyaka ka 2018. Sawubona umusa lapho u-Thixo esibusisa nge-Komkhulu lethu (Head office) e White House. Kwaba sengathi kuncane lokho; namhlanje sinekhaya lethu elikhulukazi ngendlela nathi ebesikade singayilindele, enizibonele nina ngokwenu i-Aloedale. Ukhona yini umuntu ophilile kahle ongathula-nje, angajabuleli umusa phezu komusa ongaka na? Njengoba sibhiyoza namhlanje sibonga izinto u-Thixo asenzele zona ngaphansi kobuholi buka mongameli wethu nesekela lakhe, selokhu bebambene njalo ngisho nasezikhathini ezinzima esedlule kuzona, esingeke sizibale ngoba zaziyimizamo ka-sathathe. Masigubhe lolusuku kodwa singakhohlwa ukuthandaza, futhi simbonge u-Thixo sicele asisingathe ukuya phambili. Ngiyethemba ukuthi nabanye ekade bengasiboni isidingo sukugubha lolusuku, sebeyabona manje njengoba sengichazile, futhi nabo sebezokhanyelwa.

Bathandekayo, ngisanikhumbuza futhi amazwi engawasho kini ngemibuliso eminyakeni eyedlule, ngoba phela izwi lika-Thixo limile phakade, futhi alipheli. "Yathi i-Nkosi yethu thina siwukukhanya kwezwe," lapho sihamba khona kufanele silethe ukukhanya; futhi thina sihamba ekukhanyeni kwenkosi yethu u-Jesu Kristu. Ohamba ekukhanyeni abukho ubumnyama kuye. ngoba uhamba ngeqiniso, nangothando, ezinyathelweni ze-golide, okuyiqiniso nothando.

Yathi futhi i-Nkosi kubafundi bayo: "Mina ngingumvini oyiwonawona. uBaba ungumlimi. Yilelo nalelo gatsha elikimi elingatheli izithelo, ubaba uyalisusa. Njengalokhu igatsha lingethele izithelo ngokwalo, kuphela uma lihlala emvinini, kanjalo nani, kuphela uma nihlala kimi. "Jhn.15:1-2,4. Lokhu kusho ukuthi ikhona eminye imivini okungafanele sihlale kuyo, leyo thina esizakhela yona ngokuhlakanipha okuwubuwula bethu. Lokhu i-Nkosi esenzela kona, kungoba nathi sihlezi emvinini oyiwonawona, uma bekungenjalo, ngabe usathane kade ayehlukanisa lenkonzo ka-Kristu! Ngake ngasho futhi ukuthi masizithobe ngaphansi kwesandla sezinceku zethu, omunye nomunye phansi kwenceku emkhokhelayo. Zinceku nezincekukazi, khumbulani ukuthi lemiphefumulo eniyikhokhelayo, ngelinye ilanga siyolandiswa ngayo phambi komelusi omkhulu u-Jesu Kristu. Siqaphele amalwimi ethu emabandleni. Ungamkhaci umuntu omdala ngoba nakhu phela uyamkhokhela, kodwa mkhuze noma umeluleke njengomzali wakho, noma umfowenu, noma udadewenu.

Bantu abasha, qaphelani izidakamizwa, notshwala, ngisho nogwayi imbala! Uma sihlangene ezinkonzweni, ezindlini zangasese ungaphika ukuthi kuhlangene abantu abakholwayo. Iphunga logwayi nentuthu kuyesabeka. Lokhu kuthunaza isithunzi senkonzo yethu, nese-Nkosi yethu eyasithenga ngenani eliphezulu kangaka. Usuke esekuphi uMoya Ongcwele ngaleso sikhathi, uma senza lezi zinto? Anifundiswanga yini ukuthi imizimba yethu iyithempeli lika Thixo na?

Namhlanje abantu abasha badumaza abazali babo ngokukhulelwa besafunda isikole; aniboni yini ukuthi nekusasa lenu liyonakala, ngoba manje anisakwazi ukuphumelelisa izifiso zenu? Musani ukwenza imizimba yenu i-hotela lapho kungena khona yonke inhlobo yomuntu, ababi nabalungileyo. Umuntu omusha makazithibe ezinkanukweni zenyama, kuze kufike isikhathi esifanele nekusasa eliqhakazile.

Uma-nje omunye nomunye engazithathela kulamazwi; nanso impilo, nezibusiso, nempumelelo, phezu kwenu. Lapho intando ka-Thixo yenzeka khona u-sathane akasondeli.

Phambili nkonzo ka-Kristu! Khula udlondlobale!

Yimi owenu e-Nkosini,
N.V.MLANGENI
President/ Chief Apostle.

en.title: Apostle's Greeting for the year 2018/2019
en.message:
I greet you all beloved, in the beautiful name of our Lord and saviour Jesus Christ.

Today let us thank God as we celebrate forty years in the church of the twelve apostles in Christ. Well, does this mean this church was only founded forty years ago? No, it is not so, the previous president explained this matter in 1988, the day we celebrated ten years, many of you were already in this church. This church was established by our Lord Jesus Christ, over two thousand years ago, where He said: "upon this rock I will build my church, and the gates of hades and death shall not overcome it;" Matt. 16:18. You are built on the foundation of the Apostles and prophets, where the Lord Jesus Christ Himself is the cornerstone.

Today we celebrate, or rejoice in the grace of the Lord which He has done for us from the celebration of 1988 until this year of 2018. We saw grace when God blessed us with our Head office at White House. It was as if that was small; today we have our huge home in a way we had not expected, which you have seen yourselves, Aloedale. Is there any person who is well who can just keep quiet, and not rejoice in such grace upon grace? As we celebrate today we thank the things God has done for us under the leadership of our president and his deputy, since they have been holding on together always even in the difficult times we have passed through, which we cannot count because they were the attempts of satan. Let us celebrate this day but not forget to pray, and thank God and ask Him to carry us forward. I hope that others who did not see the need to celebrate this day, now see since I have explained, and they too will be enlightened.

Beloved, I still remind you again of the words I said to you in greetings of past years, because indeed the word of God stands forever, and does not end. "Our Lord said we are the light of the world," wherever we walk we must bring light; and we walk in the light of our Lord Jesus Christ. Whoever walks in the light there is no darkness in him, because he walks in truth, and in love, in the golden footsteps, which are truth and love.

The Lord also said to His disciples: "I am the true vine. My Father is the gardener. Every branch in me that does not bear fruit, the father removes it. Just as a branch cannot bear fruit by itself, unless it remains in the vine, so neither can you, unless you remain in me. "Jhn.15:1-2,4. This means there are other vines we should not remain in, which we build for ourselves with our foolish wisdom. This is what the Lord does for us, because we also remain in the true vine, if it were not so, satan would have long divided this church of Christ! I also once said let us humble ourselves under the hand of our officers, each one under the officer leading them. Male and female officers, remember that these souls you are leading, one day we will account for them before the great shepherd Jesus Christ. Let us watch our tongues in the congregations. Do not curse an older person just because you are leading them, but rebuke or advise them like your parent, or your brother, or your sister.

Young people, beware of drugs, and alcohol, even tobacco! When we are gathered in services, in the toilets you would deny that believers are gathered there. The smell of tobacco and smoke is terrible. This degrades the dignity of our church, and of our Lord who bought us at such a high price. Where is the Holy Spirit at that time, if we do these things? Were you not taught that our bodies are the temple of God?

Today young people disappoint their parents by getting pregnant while still at school; do you not see that your future is also being destroyed, because now you can no longer fulfil your wishes? Do not make your bodies a hotel where every kind of person enters, the bad and the good. A young person must control themselves from the lusts of the flesh, until the right time and a bright future arrives.

If only everyone would take these words to heart; there is life, blessings, and success upon you. Where the will of God is done, satan does not come near.

Forward church of Christ! Grow and prosper!

I am yours in the Lord,
N.V.MLANGENI
President/ Chief Apostle.

nso.title: Tumedišo ya Moapostola ya ngwaga wa 2018/2019
nso.message:
Ke le dumediša ka moka barategi, ka leina le lebotse la Morena le mophološi wa rena Jesu Kriste.

Lehono a re lebogeng Modimo ka ge re keteka mengwaga e masomenne kerekeng ya baapostola ba lesomepedi go Kriste. Naa, seo se ra gore kereke ye e theilwe mengwaga e masomenne fela e fetilego? Aowa, ga go bjalo, mopresidente yo a fetilego o hlalositše taba ye ka 1988, letšatši leo re bego re keteka mengwaga e lesome, ba bantši ba lena le be le šetše le le kerekeng ye. Kereke ye e hlomilwe ke Morena wa rena Jesu Kriste, mengwaga ya go feta e dikete tše pedi e fetilego, mo a rilego: "godimo ga leswika le ke tla aga kereke ya ka, le ditswalo tša ntsweng di ka se e fenye;" Mat. 16:18. Lena le agilwe motheong wa Baapostola le baporofeta, moo Morena ka noši Jesu Kriste e lego leswika la sekhutlo.

Lehono re a keteka, goba re thabela mogau wa Morena wo a re diretšego wona go tloga moletlong wa 1988 go fihla ngwageng wo wa 2018. Re bone mogau ge Modimo a re šegofatša ka ntlokgolo ya rena go la White House. Gwa ba bjalo ka ge eka ke se senyenyane; lehono re na le legae la rena le legolo ka tsela yeo re bego re sa e letela, yeo le e bonego ka bolena, Aloedale. Naa go na le motho yo a phelago gabotse yo a ka fo homola, a se thabele mogau godimo ga mogau o mokaka? Bjalo ka ge re keteka lehono re leboga dilo tše Modimo a re diretšego tšona ka tlase ga boetapele bja mopresidente wa rena le motlatši wa gagwe, e sa le ba swarane ka mehla le dinakong tše thata tše re fetilego go tšona, tšeo re ka se kgonego go di bala gobane e be e le maiteko a sathane. A re ketekeng letšatši le eupša re se lebale go rapela, mme re leboge Modimo rekgopele gore a re rwalele pele. Ke holofela gore le ba bangwe bao ba bego ba sa bone tlhokego ya go keteka letšatši le, ba a bona bjale ka ge ke hlalositše, mme le bona ba tla seetšwa.

Barategi, ke sa le gopotša gape mantšu ao ke a boletšego go lena ditumedišong tša mengwaga e fetilego, gobane ruri lentšu la Modimo le ema go ya go ile, gomme ga le fele. "Morena wa rena o rile re seetša sa lefase," gongwe le gongwe mo re sepelago gona re swanetše go tliša seetša; mme re sepela seetšeng sa Morena wa rena Jesu Kriste. Yo a sepelago seetšeng ga go na leswiswi ka go yena. gobane o sepela ka therešo, le ka lerato, mehlaleng ya gauta, e lego therešo le lerato.

Morena o rile gape go barutiwa ba gagwe: "Nna ke morara wa nnete. Tate ke molemi. Lekala le lengwe le le lengwe le le go nna le le sa enyego dienywa, tate o a le tloša. Bjalo ka ge lekala le ka se kgone go enya dienywa ka bolona, ntle le ge le dula morareng, le lena ka mo go swanago, ntle le ge le dula go nna. "Joh.15:1-2,4. Se se ra gore go na le merara e mengwe yeo re sa swanelago go dula go yona, yeo re ikagelago yona ka bohlale bja rena bja bošilo. Se ke se Morena a re direlago sona, gobane le rena re dula morareng wa nnete, ge go be go se bjalo, sathane o be a tlo ba a arogantše kereke ye ya Kriste kgale! Ke kile ka re gape a re ikokobetšeng ka tlase ga seatla sa bahlanka ba rena, yo mongwe le yo mongwe ka tlase ga mohlanka yo a mo etelelago pele. Bahlanka ba banna le ba basadi, gopolang gore meoya ye le e etelelago pele, ka letšatši le lengwe re tla ikarabela ka yona pele ga modiši o mogolo Jesu Kriste. A re hlokomeleng maleme a rena diphuthegong. O se roge motho yo mogolo fela gobane o mo etelela pele, eupša mo kgaleme goba o mo eletswe bjalo ka motswadi wa gago, goba ngwaneno, goba kgaetšedi ya gago.

Bafsa, hlokomelang diokobatši, le bjala, gaešita le motsoko! Ge re kgobokane ditirelong, dintlwaneng tša boithomelo o ka latola gore badumedi ba kgobokane moo. Monko wa motsoko le muši di a tšhoša. Se se theola seriti sa kereke ya rena, le sa Morena wa rena yo a re rekilego ka theko ya godimo gakaaka. Moya o Mokgethwa o be o le kae ka nako yeo, ge re dira dilo tše? Naa ga se la rutwa gore mebele ya rena ke tempele ya Modimo?

Lehono bafsa ba nyamiša batswadi ba bona ka go ima ba sa tsena sekolo; naa ga le bone gore le bokamoso bja lena bo a senyega, gobane bjale ga le sa kgona go phethagatša dikganyogo tša lena? Le se ke la dira mebele ya lena hotele moo go tsenago mohuta o mongwe le o mongwe wa motho, ba babe le ba baloki. Mofsa o swanetše go ithiba dikganyogong tša nama, go fihlela go fihla nako ye e swanetšego le bokamoso bjo bo phadimago.

Ge fela yo mongwe le yo mongwe a ka tsenya mantšu a pelong; šeo bophelo, ditšhegofatšo, le katlego, godimo ga lena. Moo thato ya Modimo e dirwago, sathane ga a batamele.

Pele kereke ya Kriste! Gola o atlege!

Ke nna wa lena go Morena,
N.V.MLANGENI
Mopresidente/ Moapostola yo Mogolo.

xh.title: Umbuliso woMpostile wonyaka ka-2018/2019
xh.message:
Ndiyanibulisa nonke bathandekayo, egameni elihle leNkosi noMsindisi wethu uYesu Kristu.

Namhlanje masimbulele uThixo njengoko sibhiyozela iminyaka engamashumi amane kwicawe yabapostile abalishumi elinesibini kuKristu. Ngaba oku kuthetha ukuba le cawe yasekwa kuphela kwiminyaka engamashumi amane eyadlulayo? Hayi, akunjalo, umongameli wangaphambili wayicacisa le nto ngo-1988, mhla sasibhiyozela iminyaka elishumi, abaninzi benu babesele bekho kule cawe. Le cawe yasekwa yiNkosi yethu uYesu Kristu, kwiminyaka engaphezu kwamawaka amabini eyadlulayo, apho yathi: "phezu kweli liwa ndiya kulakha ibandla lam, namasango esihogo nokufa awayi kuloyisa;" Mat. 16:18. Nina nakhiwe phezu kwesiseko sabaPostile nabaprofeti, apho iNkosi ngokwayo uYesu Kristu ililitye lembombo.

Namhlanje siyabhiyozela, okanye siyavuyela ubabalo lweNkosi esenzele lona ukususela kumbhiyozo ka-1988 ukuza kuthi ga kulo nyaka ka-2018. Salubona ubabalo xeshikweni uThixo wasisikelela ngeKomkhulu lethu (Head office) eWhite House. Kwaba ngathi kuncinci oko; namhlanje sinekhaya lethu elikhulukazi ngendlela ebesingayilindelanga, enizibonele ngawenu amehlo e-Aloedale. Ingaba ukhona na umntu ophilileyo onokuthi athi cwaka nje, angaluvuyeli ubabalo phezu kobabalo olungaka? Njengoko sibhiyozela namhlanje sibulela izinto uThixo asenzele zona phantsi kobunkokeli bomongameli wethu nesekela lakhe, oko babambelelayo bekunye nangamaxesha anzima esidlule kuwo, esingenakuwabala ngenxa yokuba yayiyimigudu kasathana. Masiwubhiyozele lo mhla kodwa singalibali ukuthandaza, simbonge uThixo simcele asithwale siye phambili. Ndiyathemba ukuba nabanye abebengayiboni imfuneko yokubhiyozela lo mhla, bayabona ngoku njengoko ndicacisile, kwaye nabo baya kukhanyiseleka.

Bathandekayo, ndisanikhumbuza kwakhona amazwi endawatshoyo kuni kwimibuliso yeminyaka edlulileyo, kuba inene ilizwi likaThixo limile ngonaphakade, kwaye alipheli. "Yathi iNkosi yethu thina sikukukhanya kwehlabathi," apho sihamba khona kufuneka sizise ukukhanya; kwaye thina sihamba ekukhanyeni kweNkosi yethu uYesu Kristu. Ohamba ekukhanyeni akukho bumnyama kuye. kuba uhamba ngenyaniso, nangothando, emanyathelweni egolide, ayinyaniso nothando.

Yathi kwakhona iNkosi kubafundi bayo: "Mna ndingumdiliya wenyaniso. uBawo ngumlimi. Onke amasebe akum angathwali siqhamo, ubawo uyawasusa. Njengoko isebe lingenakuthwala siqhamo ngokwalo, ngaphandle kokuba lihlale emdiliyeni, nani ke ngokunjalo, ngaphandle kokuba nihlale kum. "Yoh.15:1-2,4. Oku kuthetha ukuba ikho eminye imidiliya ekungafanele sihlale kuyo, leyo sizakhela yona ngobulumko bethu bobudenge. Oku iNkosi isenzela kona, kuba nathi sihleli emdiliyeni wenyaniso, ukuba bekungenjalo, ngesathana kade wayahlula le cawe kaKristu! Ndekha ndathi kwakhona masizithobe phantsi kwesandla samagosa ethu, omnye nomnye phantsi kwegosa elimkhokelayo. Magosa angamadoda namabhinqa, khumbulani ukuba le miphefumlo niyikhokelayo, ngenye imini siya kuphendula ngayo phambi komalusi omkhulu uYesu Kristu. Masiqaphele iilwimi zethu emabandleni. Ungamthuki umntu omdala kuba nje uyamkhokela, kodwa mkhalimele okanye umcebise njengomzali wakho, okanye umntakwenu, okanye udade wenu.

Lutsha, lumkelani iziyobisi, notywala, kwanecuba! Xa sihlanganisene ezinkonzweni, ezindlini zangasese ungaphika ukuba kuhlanganisene amakholwa apho. Ivumba lecuba nentuthu liyoyikeka. Oku kuthoba isidima secawe yethu, neseNkosi yethu eyasithenga ngexabiso eliphezulu kangaka. Uba ephi uMoya oyiNgcwele ngelo xesha, xa sisenza ezi zinto? Anifundiswanga na ukuba imizimba yethu iyitempile kaThixo?

Namhlanje abantu abatsha badanisa abazali babo ngokumitha besesikolweni; aniboni na ukuba nekamva lenu liyonakala, kuba ngoku anisakwazi ukuphumeza iminqweno yenu? Musani ukwenza imizimba yenu ihotele apho kungena lonke uhlobo lomntu, ababi nabalungileyo. Umntu omtsha makazibambe kwiinkanuko zenyama, kude kufike ixesha elifanelekileyo nekamva eliqaqambileyo.

Ukuba nje omnye nomnye angawathathela entliziyweni la mazwi; nantsi impilo, neentsikelelo, nempumelelo, phezu kwenu. Apho intando kaThixo isenziwa khona, usathana akasondeli.

Phambili cawe kaKristu! Khula kwaye uphumelele!

Ndim owakho eNkosini,
N.V.MLANGENI
UMongameli/ UMpostile oyiNtloko.

ts.title: Xilumiso xa Mupostola xa lembe ra 2018/2019
ts.message:
Ndzi mi losa hinkwenu varhandziwa, hi vito ro saseka ra Hosi na muponisi wa hina Yesu Kreste.

Namuntlha a hi nkhenseni Xikwembu tanihi leswi hi tlangelaka makume mune wa malembe ekerekeni ya vapostola va khume-mbirhi eka Kreste. Xana, leswi swi vula leswaku kereke leyi yi simekiwile eka makume mune wa malembe ntsena lama hundzeke xana? E-e, a swi tano, puresidente loyi a hundzeke u hlamuserile mhaka leyi hi 1988, siku hi tlangelaka khume ra malembe, vo tala va n'wina a mi se mi ri kona ekerekeni leyi. Kereke leyi yi simekiwile hi Hosi ya hina Yesu Kreste, eka malembe ya ku tlula magidi mambirhi lama hundzeke, laha a nga te: "ehenhla ka ribye leri ndzi ta aka kereke ya mina, naswona tinyangwa ta tihele ni rifu a ti nge yi hluli;" Mat. 16:18. N'wina mi akiwe ehenhla ka masungulo ya Vapostola ni vaprofeta, laha Hosi hi yoxe Yesu Kreste a nga ribye ra yinhla.

Namuntlha ha tlangela, kumbe hi tsakela tintswalo ta Hosi leti yi hi endleleke tona ku sukela eku tlangeleni ka 1988 ku fika eka lembe leri ra 2018. A swi fana ni loko sweswo swi ri switsongo; namuntlha hi na kaya ra hina lerikulu swinene hi ndlela leyi a hi nga yi langutelanga, leyi mi yi voneke hi n'wexe, Aloedale. Xana u kona munhu la hanyaka kahle loyi a nga miyelaka ntsena, a nga tsakeli tintswalo ehenhla ka tintswalo to fika laha xana? Tanihi leswi hi tlangelaka namuntlha hi nkhensa swilo leswi Xikwembu xi hi endleleke swona ehansi ka vuholi bya puresidente wa hina ni xandla xa yena, leswi va khomelelaneke nkarhi hinkwawo hambi na le minkarhini yo tika leyi hi hundzeke eka yona, leyi hi nga kotikiki ku yi hlayela hikuva a ku ri matshalatshala ya sathana. A hi tlangeleni siku leri kambe hi nga rivali ku khongela, naswona hi nkhensa Xikwembu hi kombela leswaku xi hi rhwala hi ya emahlweni. Ndzi tshemba leswaku na van'wana lava a va nga voni xilaveko xo tlangela siku leri, sweswi va vona tanihi leswi ndzi hlamuseleke, naswona na vona va ta voningeriwa.

Varhandziwa, ndza ha mi tsundzuxa nakambe marito lawa ndzi ma vuleke eka n'wina eswilumisweni swa malembe lama hundzeke, hikuva hakunene rito ra Xikwembu ri yima hilaha ku nga heriki, naswona a ri heli. "Hosi ya hina yi te hina hi ku vonakala ka misava," hinkwako laha hi fambaka kona hi fanele ku tisa ku vonakala; naswona hina hi famba eku vonakaleni ka Hosi ya hina Yesu Kreste. Loyi a fambaka eku vonakaleni a ku na munyama eka yena. hikuva u famba hi ntiyiso, na rirhandzu, emikondzweni ya nsuku, ku nga ntiyiso na rirhandzu.

Hosi yi tlhele yi byela vadyondzisiwa va yona yi ku: "Mina ndzi nsinya wa vhinya wa ntiyiso. Tatana i murimi. Rhavi rin'wana ni rin'wana eka mina leri nga tswaliki mihandzu, tatana wa ri susa. Tanihi leswi rhavi ri nga kotiki ku tswala mihandzu hi roxe, loko ri nga tshami ensinyeni wa vhinya, na n'wina swi tano, loko mi nga tshami eka mina. "Yoh.15:1-2,4. Leswi swi vula leswaku ku na minsinya yin'wana ya vhinya leyi hi nga fanelangiki ku tshama eka yona, leyi hi tiakelaka yona hi vutlhari bya hina bya vuphukuphuku. Leswi hi leswi Hosi yi hi endlelaka swona, hikuva na hina hi tshama ensinyeni wa vhinya wa ntiyiso, loko a swi nga ri tano, sathana a a ta va a hambanisile kereke leyi ya Kreste khale! Ndzi tshame ndzi vula nakambe leswaku a hi titsongahateni ehansi ka voko ra malandza ya hina, un'wana ni un'wana ehansi ka nandza loyi a n'wi rhangelaka. Malandza ya vavanuna ni ya vavasati, tsundzukani leswaku mimoya leyi mi yi rhangelaka, siku rin'wana hi ta tihlamulela ha yona emahlweni ka murisi lonkulu Yesu Kreste. A hi hlayiseni tindzimi ta hina emavandlheni. Mi nga rhukani munhu lonkulu hikuva mi n'wi rhangela, kambe n'wi tshinyeni kumbe mi n'wi tsundzuxa tanihi mutswari wa n'wina, kumbe makwenu, kumbe sesi wa n'wina.

Vantshwa, tivoneleni eka swidzidziharisi, ni byala, hambi fole! Loko hi hlengeletanile emintirhweni, etindlwini ta vuxotelo u nga landzula leswaku vapfumeri va hlengeletanile kwalaho. Nun'hwelo wa fole ni musi swa chavisa. Leswi swi thevula xindzhuti xa kereke ya hina, ni xa Hosi ya hina leyi hi xaveke hi ntsengo wa le henhla swonghasi. Moya wo Kwetsima wu le kwihi hi nkarhi wolowo, loko hi endla swilo leswi? Xana a mi dyondzisiwanga leswaku mimiri ya hina i tempeli ya Xikwembu xana?

Namuntlha vantshwa va khomisa vatswari va vona tingana hi ku tika va ha nghena xikolo; xana a mi voni leswaku vumundzuku bya n'wina na byona byi onhiwa, hikuva sweswi a mi nga ha koti ku hetisisa ku navela ka n'wina? Mi nga endli mimiri ya n'wina hotela laha ku nghenaka tinxaka hinkwato ta vanhu, lavo biha ni lavanene. Muntshwa u fanele ku tikhoma eka ku navela ka nyama, ku fika nkarhi lowu faneleke ni vumundzuku lebyo saseka.

Loko ntsena un'wana ni un'wana a nga teka marito lawa embilwini; nghenani vutomi, mikateko, ni ku humelela, ehenhla ka n'wina. Laha ku rhandza ka Xikwembu ku endliwaka kona, sathana a nga tshineli.

Yani emahlweni kereke ya Kreste! Kula u ndlandlamuka!

Hi mina wa n'wina eka Hosi,
N.V.MLANGENI
Puresidente/ Mupostola wa Nkulu.

st.title: Tumeliso ea Moapostola ea selemo sa 2018/2019
st.message:
Kea le lumelisa bohle baratuoa, ka lebitso le letle la Morena le mopholosi oa rona Jesu Kreste.

Kajeno a re lebeng Molimo ha re keteka lilemo tse mashome a mane kerekeng ea baapostola ba leshome le metso e 'meli ho Kreste. Joale, na sena se bolela hore kereke ena e thehiloe feela lilemong tse mashome a mane tse fetileng? Che, ha ho joalo, mopresidente ea fetileng o hlalositse taba ena ka 1988, tsatsing leo re neng re keteka lilemo tse leshome, ba bangata ba lona ba ne ba se ba le kerekeng ena. Kereke ena e thehiloe ke Morena oa rona Jesu Kreste, lilemong tse fetang likete tse peli tse fetileng, moo a neng a re: "holim'a lefika lena ke tla haha kereke ea ka, mme menyako ea lihele le lefu ha e na ho e hlōla;" Mat. 16:18. Lona le hahiloe motheong oa Baapostola le baprofeta, moo Morena ka boeena Jesu Kreste e leng lejoe la motheo.

Kajeno re keteka, kapa re thabela mohau oa Morena oo a re etselitseng oona ho tloha moketeng oa 1988 ho fihlela selemong sena sa 2018. Re bone mohau ha Molimo a re hlohonolofatsa ka ntlo-khōlō ea rona White House. Ho ne ho bonahala eka ke e nyane; kajeno re na le lehae la rona le leholohali ka tsela eo re neng re sa e lebella, eo le iponetseng eona, Aloedale. Na ho na le motho ea phelang hantle ea ka khutsang feela, a sa thabele mohau holim'a mohau o mokana? Ha re keteka kajeno re leboha lintho tseo Molimo a re etselitseng tsona tlas'a boetapele ba mopresidente oa rona le motlatsi oa hae, kaha ba ntse ba tšoarane kamehla esita le linakong tse thata tseo re fetileng ho tsona, tseo re ke keng ra li bala hobane e ne e le matsapa a satane. A re ketekeng letsatsi lena empa re se lebale ho rapela, mme re lebohe Molimo re kope hore a re jarele pele. Ke tšepa hore le ba bang ba neng ba sa bone tlhoko ea ho keteka letsatsi lena, ba ea bona joale kaha ke hlalositse, 'me le bona ba tla bonesetsoa.

Baratuoa, ke sa le hopotsa hape mantsoe ao ke a buileng ho lona litumelisong tsa lilemo tse fetileng, hobane ruri lentsoe la Molimo le eme ka ho sa feleng, mme ha le fele. "Morena oa rona o itse rona re leseli la lefatše," hohle moo re tsamaeang teng re tlameha ho tlisa leseli; 'me re tsamaea leseling la Morena oa rona Jesu Kreste. Ea tsamaeang leseling ha ho na lefifi ho eena. hobane o tsamaea ka 'nete, le ka lerato, mehatong ea khauta, e leng 'nete le lerato.

Morena o boetse a re ho barutuoa ba hae: "Nna ke sefate sa morara sa nnete. Ntate ke molemi. Lekala le leng le le leng le ho nna le sa beheng tholoana, ntate oa le tlosa. Joalokaha lekala le ke ke la beha tholoana ka bolona, haese ha le lula sefateng sa morara, le lona ka mokhoa o tšoanang, haese ha le lula ho nna. "Joh.15:1-2,4. Sena se bolela hore ho na le lifate tsa morara tse ling tseo re sa lokelang ho lula ho tsona, tseo re iketsang tsona ka bohlale ba rona ba bothoto. Sena ke seo Morena a re etsetsang sona, hobane le rona re lula sefateng sa morara sa 'nete, hoja ho ne ho se joalo, satane o ka be a arotse kereke ena ea Kreste khale! Ke kile ka re hape a re ikokobetseng tlas'a letsoho la liofisiri tsa rona, e mong le e mong tlas'a ofisiri e mo etellang pele. Liofisiri tsa banna le tsa basali, hopolang hore meea ena eo le e etellang pele, ka le leng la matsatsi re tla ikarabella ka eona kapele ho molisa e moholo Jesu Kreste. A re hlokomeleng maleme a rona liphuthehong. U se ke oa rohaka motho e moholo hobane feela u mo etella pele, empa mo khalemele kapa u mo eletse joaloka motsoali oa hau, kapa ngoan'eno, kapa khaitseli ea hau.

Bacha, hlokomelang lithethefatsi, le joala, esita le koae! Ha re bokane litšebeletsong, matloaneng u ka hana hore balumeli ba bokane moo. Monko oa koae le mosi lia tšosa. Sena se theola seriti sa kereke ea rona, le sa Morena oa rona ea re rekileng ka theko e phahameng hakaalo. Moea o Halalelang o kae ka nako eo, ha re etsa lintho tsee? Na ha lea rutoa hore 'mele ea rona ke tempele ea Molimo?

Kajeno bacha ba soabisa batsoali ba bona ka ho ima ba ntse ba kena sekolo; na ha le bone hore le bokamoso ba lona boa senyeha, hobane joale ha le sa khona ho phethahatsa litakatso tsa lona? Le se ke la etsa 'mele ea lona hotele moo ho kenang mefuta eohle ea motho, ba babe le ba lokileng. Mocha o tlameha ho itšoara litakatsong tsa nama, ho fihlela ho fihla nako e nepahetseng le bokamoso bo khanyang.

Hafeela e mong le e mong a ka nka mantsoe ana botebong ba pelo; bona bophelo, litlhohonolofatso, le katleho, holim'a lona. Moo thato ea Molimo e etsoang teng, satane ha a atamele.

Pele kereke ea Kreste! Hola o atlehe!

Ke 'na oa lona Moreneng,
N.V.MLANGENI
Mopresidente/ Moapostola e Moholo.

zu.title: UMBULISO WOMPOSTOLI KUZINCEKU ZONKE NAMABANDLA ONKE Ku-2019/2020
zu.message:
Bathandwa ku-Kristu

Ngiyanibingelela nonke egameni elihle leNkosi nomfeli wethu uJesu Kristu. Mangisho ukuthi akesibonge ngazwi linye, uthando olungaka iNkosi eyasithanda ngalo, yasifuna yasithola, yeza kithi, yahlala nathi. Akuthina esayifuna, kepha iyona eyafuna thina, ngoba ifuna ukutshengisa uthando lwayo kithi ukuze sifunde ukuthi uthando luyinto enjani, sithandane, siyeke ukulwa ngoba iNkosi ayibafuni abantu abaxabanayo. Ukuxabanana akuqhamuki ku-Thixo kepha kuqhamuka ezinkanukweni zenyama.

Ngathi kini ngomunye unyaka, umuntu noma engakhohlwa, azibone sengathi uyaziphilela-je, akhohlwe ukuthi leyo mpilo ayiphilayo ivela ku Nkulunkulu, nokuthi uyena ophethe ukuphila kwethu. Ake akhutshwe loyo muntu ezwe ubuhlungu onyaweni lwakhe, uyomuzwa ethi "awu Thixo wami ngaze ngalimala". Okusho ukuthi kanti ubuhlungu buyamenza umuntu akhumbule ukuthi akazidalanga, kepha wadalwa ngu Thixo, abesesondela ku Thixo.

Ngabe sengithi kufanele ukuthi uma ungumuntu ocabangayo mfowethu nawe dadewethu ubohamba uhambe uzincinze, uzizwe ukuthi ingbe usayiphilela yini inkosi yakho uJesu Kristu, noma cha, ngoba uyobulokhu uthi ngiyaphila kanti kudala wafa ebuthixweni, sewaba yigobongo nje, noma usudikizelela ekufeni.

Asiyiphilele inkosi ngokweqiniso, sibonakale siyibo abahambisi bezindaba ezilungileyo ngokushaya ivangeli loxolo nothando. Uthando luvela kuNkulunkulu ngoba uNkulunkulu uluthando, umuntu onothando uzelwe nguNkulunkulu. Lowo ongenalo uthando uNkulunkulu akekho kuye.

uThixo abe nani nemindeni yenu, nikhuseleke nonke.
Nginifisela unyaka omusha omuhle, onezibusiso ku-2019/2020.
Izifo nokweswela makuphele phakathi kwenu, kepha izibusiso namathuba emisebenzi zivulelwe ngaphakathi kwenu!

Owenu eNkosini
N.V. Mlangeni
U-Mongameli

en.title: APOSTLE'S GREETING TO ALL OFFICERS AND ALL CONGREGATIONS For 2019/2020
en.message:
Beloved in Christ

I greet you all in the good name of the Lord and our saviour Jesus Christ. Let me say let us thank with one voice, the great love with which the Lord loved us, sought us and found us, came to us, and stayed with us. It is not us who sought Him, but He is the one who sought us, because He wants to show His love to us so that we may learn what kind of thing love is, love each other, and stop fighting because the Lord does not want people who fight. Fighting does not come from God but comes from the lusts of the flesh.

I said to you another year, even if a person forgets, and sees themselves as if they are just living for themselves, and forgets that the life they live comes from God, and that He is the one who holds our life. Let that person stub their toe and feel pain on their foot, you will hear them say "oh my God I am hurt". Which means that pain makes a person remember that they did not create themselves, but they were created by God, and then they draw closer to God.

I would then say it is necessary that if you are a thinking person my brother and you my sister you should walk and pinch yourself, and feel whether you are still living for your Lord Jesus Christ, or not, because you will just keep saying I am alive yet you died long ago in divinity, you have just become an empty shell, or you are twitching to death.

Let us live for the Lord in truth, let us be seen as the bringers of good news by preaching the gospel of peace and love. Love comes from God because God is love, a person with love is born of God. He who does not have love, God is not in him.

May God be with you and your families, and may you all be protected.
I wish you a beautiful, blessed new year in 2019/2020.
Let diseases and lack end among you, but let blessings and job opportunities be opened within you!

Yours in the Lord
N.V. Mlangeni
President

nso.title: TUMEDIŠO YA MOAPOSTOLA GO BAHLANKA KA MOKA LE DIPHUTHEGO KA MOKA Ya 2019/2020
nso.message:
Barategi go Kriste

Ke le dumediša ka moka ka leina le lebotse la Morena le mohwedi wa rena Jesu Kriste. E re ke re a re lebogeng ka lentšu le tee, lerato le legolo leo Morena a re ratilego ka lona, a re nyaka a re hwetša, a tla go rena, a dula le rena. Ga se rena re mo nyakilego, eupša ke yena a re nyakilego, gobane o nyaka go bontšha lerato la gagwe go rena gore re ithute gore lerato ke selo sa mohuta mang, re ratane, re tlogele go lwa gobane Morena ga a nyake batho ba ba lwang. Go lwa ga go tšwe go Modimo eupša go tšwa dikganyogong tša nama.

Ke le boditše ngwaga o mongwe, motho le ge a ka lebala, a ipona eka o no iphelela fela, a lebala gore bophelo bjoo a bo phelago bo tšwa go Modimo, le gore ke yena a swerego bophelo bja rena. E re motho yoo a kgotšwe a kwe bohloko leotong la gagwe, o tla mo kwa a re "joo Modimo wa ka ke gobetše". Seo se ra gore kanti bohloko bo dira gore motho a gopole gore ga se a itlhola, eupša o hlotšwe ke Modimo, a be a batamela go Modimo.

Nka re go a hlokagala gore ge o le motho wa go nagana ngwanešo le wena kgaetšedi ya ka o be o eya o eya o itšhware, o ikwe gore na e be o sa phelela Morena wa gago Jesu Kriste, goba aowa, gobane o tla dula o re ke a phela mola kgale o hwile go bomodimo, o fo ba lekgapetla fela, goba o a hwa.

A re pheleleng Morena ka therešo, re bonagale re le batliši ba ditaba tše dibotse ka go rera ebangedi ya khutšo le lerato. Lerato le tšwa go Modimo gobane Modimo ke lerato, motho wa lerato o tswetšwe ke Modimo. Yo a se nago lerato Modimo ga a gona go yena.

Modimo a be le lena le malapa a lena, le šireletšwe ka moka.
Ke le lakaletša ngwaga o moswa o mobotse, wo o šegofaditšwego wa 2019/2020.
Malwetši le tlhokego di fele gare ga lena, eupša ditšhegofatšo le menyetla ya mešomo di bulegegare ga lena!

Wa lena go Morena
N.V. Mlangeni
Mopresidente

xh.title: UMBULISO WOMPOSTILE KUZINCEKU ZONKE NAMABANDLA ONKE Ka-2019/2020
xh.message:
Bathandekayo kuKristu

Ndiyanibulisa nonke egameni elihle leNkosi nomfeli wethu uYesu Kristu. Mandithi masibonge ngazwi linye, uthando olungaka iNkosi eyasithanda ngalo, yasifuna yasifumana, yeza kuthi, yahlala nathi. Asithi esayifunayo, kodwa yiyo eyasifunayo, kuba ifuna ukubonisa uthando lwayo kuthi ukuze sifunde ukuba uthando luyinto enjani, sithandane, siyeke ukulwa kuba iNkosi ayibafuni abantu abaxabanayo. Ukuxabana akuveli kuThixo kodwa kuvela kwiinkanuko zenyama.

Ndathi kuni ngomnye unyaka, umntu nokuba uyalibala, ezibona ngathi uyaziphilela nje, alibale ukuba loo mpilo ayiphilayo ivela kuThixo, nokuba nguye ophethe ubomi bethu. Makhe akhutshwe loo mntu eve intlungu enyaweni lakhe, uya kumva esithi "owu Thixo wam ndenzakele". Oku kuthetha ukuba kanti intlungu iyamenza umntu akhumbule ukuba akazidalanga, kodwa wadalwa nguThixo, aze asondele kuThixo.

Ngoko ke ndingathi kufuneka ukuba ungumntu ocingayo mzalwana wam nawe dade wethu uhambe uhambe uzikrobise, uzive ukuba usayiphilela na iNkosi yakho uYesu Kristu, okanye hayi, kuba uya kuhlala uthi ndiyaphila kanti kade wafa kubuThixo, uligobolondo nje, okanye uyangcangcazela ukufa.

Masiyiphilele iNkosi ngenyaniso, sibonakale siyibo abahambisi beendaba ezilungileyo ngokushumayela ivangeli yoxolo nothando. Uthando luvela kuThixo kuba uThixo luthando, umntu onothando uzalwe nguThixo. Lowo ungenalo uthando uThixo akakho kuye.

UThixo abe nani neentsapho zenu, nikhuseleke nonke.
Ndininqwenelela unyaka omtsha omhle, onesikelelo ka-2019/2020.
Izifo nokuswela makuphele phakathi kwenu, kodwa iintsikelelo namathuba emisebenzi zivulelwe phakathi kwenu!

Owakho eNkosini
N.V. Mlangeni
UMongameli

ts.title: XILUMISO XA MUPOSTOLA EKA MALANDZA HINKWAWO NA MAVANDLHA HINKWAWO Xa 2019/2020
ts.message:
Varhandziwa eka Kreste

Ndzi mi losa hinkwenu hi vito lerinene ra Hosi na mufeli wa hina Yesu Kreste. A ndzi vule leswaku a hi nkhenseni hi rito rin'we, rirhandzu lerikulu leri Hosi yi hi rhandzeke ha rona, yi hi lavile yi hi kuma, yi ta eka hina, yi tshama na hina. A hi hina lava hi yi laveke, kambe hi yona leyi nga hi lava, hikuva yi lava ku komba rirhandzu ra yona eka hina leswaku hi ta dyondza leswaku rirhandzu i nchumu wa njhani, hi rhandzana, hi tshika ku lwa hikuva Hosi a yi lavi vanhu lava lwaka. Ku lwa a ku humi eka Xikwembu kambe ku huma eka ku navela ka nyama.

Ndzi mi byerile lembe rin'wana, munhu hambiloko a rivala, a tivona onge u tihanyela ntsena, a rivala leswaku vutomi byebyo lebyi a byi hanyaka byi huma eka Xikwembu, naswona hi xona lexi khomeke vutomi bya hina. A ku humelele munhu yoloye a twa ku vava enengeni wa yena, u ta n'wi twa a ku "mawe Xikwembu xanga ndzi vavisekile". Leswi swi vulaka leswaku kasi ku vava ku endla munhu a tsundzuka leswaku a nga tiendlanga, kambe u tumbuluxiwile hi Xikwembu, kutani a tshinela kusuhi na Xikwembu.

Kutani a ndzi ta vula leswaku swa fanela leswaku loko u ri munhu wo ehleketa makwerhu wa xinuna na wena makwerhu wa xisati u fanele u famba u famba u tiphincha, u titwa leswaku xana u ha hanyela Hosi ya wena Yesu Kreste, kumbe e-e, hikuva u ta tshamela ku vula u ku ndzi hanya kasi khale u file eku vuxikwembu, u xikhumba ntsena, kumbe u le ku rhurhumeleni ka rifu.

A hi hanyeleni Hosi hi ntiyiso, hi voniwa hi ri hina vafambisi va mahungu lamanene hi ku chumayela evhangeli ya ku rhula na rirhandzu. Rirhandzu ri huma eka Xikwembu hikuva Xikwembu i rirhandzu, munhu wa rirhandzu u tswariwe hi Xikwembu. Loyi a nga riki na rirhandzu Xikwembu a xi kona eka yena.

Xikwembu a xi ve na n'wina na mindyangu ya n'wina, mi sirheleleka hinkwenu.
Ndzi mi navelela lembe lerintshwa lerinene, ra mikateko ra 2019/2020.
Mavabyi na vusweti a swi hele exikarhi ka n'wina, kambe mikateko na menyetla ya mintirho a swi pfuleke exikarhi ka n'wina!

Wa n'wina eka Hosi
N.V. Mlangeni
Puresidente

st.title: TUMELISO EA MOAPOSTOLA HO BAHLANKA BOHLE LE DIPHUTHEHO TSOHLE Ea 2019/2020
st.message:
Baratuoa ho Kreste

Kea le lumelisa bohle ka lebitso le letle la Morena le moshuelli oa rona Jesu Kreste. A ke re a re lebokeng ka lentsoe le le leng, lerato le leholo leo Morena a re ratileng ka lona, a re batla a re fumana, a tla ho rona, a lula le rona. Hase rona ba mo batlileng, empa ke eena ea re batlileng, hobane o batla ho bontša lerato la hae ho rona e le hore re ithute hore lerato ke ntho e joang, re ratane, re tlohele ho loana hobane Morena ha a batle batho ba loanang. Ho loana ha ho tsoe ho Molimo empa ho tsoa litakatsong tsa nama.

Ke le boleletse selemong se seng, motho leha a ka lebala, a ipona eka o iphelela feela, a lebala hore bophelo boo a bo phelang bo tsoa ho Molimo, le hore ke eena ea tšoereng bophelo ba rona. A ke ho hlokoe motho eo a utloe bohloko leotong la hae, u tla mo utloa a re "ao Molimo oa ka ke hlabehile". Ho bolelang hore athe bohloko bo etsa hore motho a hopole hore ha a itlhola, empa o bopiloe ke Molimo, ebe o atamela ho Molimo.

Ke ne nka re ho hlokahala hore haeba u motho ea nahanang ngoan'eso le uena khaitseli ea ka u be u ee u tsamaee u itšoare, u ikutloe hore na ebe u sa ntsane u phelela Morena oa hau Jesu Kreste, kapa che, hobane u tla 'ne u re ke ea phela empa khale u shoele bomolimong, u se u le lekhapetla feela, kapa u thothomela lefung.

A re pheleleng Morena ka 'nete, re bonahale re le batho ba tlisang litaba tse molemo ka ho bolela evangeli ea khotso le lerato. Lerato le tsoa ho Molimo hobane Molimo ke lerato, motho ea nang le lerato o tsoetsoe ke Molimo. Ea se nang lerato Molimo ha a eo ho eena.

Molimo a be le lona le malapa a lona, le sireletsoe bohle.
Ke le lakaletsa selemo se secha se setle, se nang le litlhohonolofatso sa 2019/2020.
Maloetse le tlhoko ha li fele har'a lona, empa litlhohonolofatso le menyetla ea mesebetsi li bulehe kahare ho lona!

Ea lona Moreneng
N.V. Mlangeni
Mopresidente

en.title: APOSTLE GREETING FOR THE YEAR 2020-2021
en.message:
Beloved in the Lord,

Let me take this opportunity and greet you all in the name of our Lord Jesus Christ.

Let us look back and reflect on the hard times we went through due to the COVID-19 pandemic that passed with a number of the Lord's beloved children. I am grateful for the Lord's protection and grace that has been over you.

We should not forget our heroes and heroines in our Apostles, Mother Apostles, Officers, Mother Officers and our brothers and sisters that were rested due to this pandemic. In all of this, we were not shaken but remained in faith due to our trust in the Lord.

I am grateful to the Apostles, Overseers and District Elders who gathered in prayer in the fight against this evil spirit that wanted to destroy the house of Israel.

Let me remind you beloved, there came a time when Faroe together with his armoured men declared war against Israel. When Israel became aware of this fear fell upon them as there was nowhere to run. When the Lord saw their fear, He put a cloud of protection between the children of Israel and the army of Faroe. Therefore the Egyptians never got to see the Israelites.

The power of God descended to His servant Moses to conquer all of Faroe's army as they were looking at them. Finally all of Faroe's wisdom perished in the Red sea. After that the children of Israel praised with joy thanking God for conquering the evil one.

Therefore beloved, I ask that we remain breaking bread everyday, stay with our leaders and carry the gospel of peace. If we do so, God will protect us at all times.

May diseases, illnesses, and suffering end among us.

I wish you a new year full of health and blessings.

Yours in the Lord,
J.R. MAGANO
President & Chief Apostle

zu.title: UMBULISO WOMPOSTOLI WONYAKA KA 2020-2021
zu.message:
Bathandwa eNkosini,

Mangithathe lelithuba nginibulise nonke egameni leNkosi yethu uJesu Kristu.

Masibuyeleni emuva sibhekisise ubunzima esindlule kubo ngenxa yobhubhane be COVID-19 ethathe imiphefumulo eminingi yabantu bakaThixo. Ngibonga umkhuselo nomusa kaNkulunkulu onikhusele.

Singakhohlwa ngamaqhawe ethu abaPhostoli namaqhawekazi omama Phostoli, izinceku nezincekukazi, abazalwane nodade abasendulelayo ngenxa yobhubhane be COVID 19. Kukho konke lokhu azange sisuka okholweni ngoba simthemba uThixo.

Ngibonga abaPhostoli, abaVeleli kanye nezinyanga zezulu (District Elders) ezahlanganyela ngomthandazo ukulwa nomoya omubi obukade ufisa ukuqeda umuzi waka Israyeli.

Ake nginikhumbuze bathandwa, kwafika isikhathi lapho uFaro athatha khona inqola yempi kanye nebutho lakhe ukuyohlasela u-Israyeli. Kuthe u-Israyeli ebona lokhu wefikelwa ukwesaba okukhulu futhi kungekho ukubaleka. Kwathi uNkulunkulu ekubona lokhu wafaka ifu (umkhuselo) phakathi kwabantwana bakhe nebutho likaFaro. Ngakho abaseGibhithe abakwazanga ukubona ama-Israyeli.

Amandla kaNkulunkulu ehlela encekwini yakhe uMoses ukuthi ayinqobe yonke impi kaFaro ayembhekene nayo. Ngempela ekugcineni yonke inhlakanipho kaFaro yaphelela olwandle olubomvu. Emva kwalokho badumisa ngentokozo namahubo abantwana bakwa Israyeli bebonga uNkulunkulu ngokubanqobela omubi.

Ngokunjalo bathandwa ngicela sihlale ngokuhlephula isinkwa nsukuzonke, sihlale kubakhokheli bethu sihambise ivangeli lokuthula. Uma siyokwenza njalo uNkulunkulu uzosikhusela ngezikhathi zonke.

Izifo, nokugula, nenhlupheko maziphele phakathi kwethu.

Nginifisela unyaka omusha onempilo kanye nezibusiso.

Yimi owenu eNkosini,
J.R. MAGANO
President & Chief Apostle

nso.title: TUMEDIŠO YA MOAPOSTOLA YA NGWAGA WA 2020-2021
nso.message:
Barategi go Morena,

E re ke tšee sebaka se ke le dumediše ka moka ka leina la Morena wa rena Jesu Kriste.

A re lebelele morago gomme re naganišiše ka dinako tše thata tše re fetilego go tšona ka baka la leuba la COVID-19 leo le fetilego le bana ba bantši ba Morena ba ba rategago. Ke leboga tšhireletšo le mogau wa Morena wo o bilego godimo ga lena.

Ga re a swanela go lebala bagale ba rena ba banna le ba basadi go Baapostola ba rena, Bomme Baapostola, Bahlanka, Bomme Bahlanka le bana babo rena le dikgaetšedi tšeo di khutšitšego ka baka la leuba le. Mo go se ka moka, ga se ra ka ra šišinyega eupša re tšwetše pele tumelong ka baka la go tshepa ga rena go Morena.

Ke leboga Baapostola, Balebeledi le Bagolo ba Selete bao ba kgobokanego thapelong ntweng ya go lwantšha moya wo mobe wo o bego o nyaka go senya ntlo ya Isiraele.

E re ke le gopotše barategi, go tlile nako yeo Faro a nago le banna ba gagwe ba ba hlamilego ba tsebagaditšego ntwa kgahlanong le Isiraele. Ge Isiraele e lemoga se, poifo e ile ya ba wela godimo ka ge go be go se na mo ba ka tšhabelago gona. Ge Morena a bona poifo ya bona, o ile a bea leru la tšhireletšo magareng ga bana ba Isiraele le madira a Faro. Ka gona Baegipita ga se ba ka ba bona Baisiraele.

Maatla a Modimo a theogela go mohlanka wa gagwe Moše go fenya madira ka moka a Faro mola ba ba lebeletše. Mafelelong bohlale ka moka bja Faro bo ile bja fela lewatleng le lehwibidu. Ka morago ga moo bana ba Isiraele ba ile ba tumiša ka lethabo ba leboga Modimo ka go fenya yo mobe.

Ka gona barategi, ke kgopela gore re tšwele pele re arolelana senkgwa letšatši le lengwe le le lengwe, re dule le baetapele ba rena gomme re rwale ebangedi ya khutšo. Ge re ka dira bjalo, Modimo o tla re šireletša ka dinako tšohle.

Malwetši, mahloko, le tlaišego a di fele gare ga rena.

Ke le lakaletša ngwaga o moswa o tletšego maphelo le ditšhegofatšo.

Wa lena go Morena,
J.R. MAGANO
Mopresidente le Moapostola yo Mogolo

xh.title: UMBULISO WOMPOSTILE WONYAKA KA-2020-2021
xh.message:
Bathandekayo eNkosini,

Mandithathe eli thuba ndinibulise nonke egameni leNkosi yethu uYesu Kristu.

Makhe sikrwaqule emva sicingisise ngamaxesha anzima esidlule kuwo ngenxa yobhubhane we-COVID-19 odlule nabantwana beNkosi abaninzi abathandekayo. Ndibulela ukhuseleko nobabalo lweNkosi olube phezu kwenu.

Masingabalibali amagorha namagorhakazi ethu kubaPostile, ooMama abaPostile, amaGosa, ooMama amaGosa kunye nabazalwana noodade bethu abaphumleyo ngenxa yalo bhubhane. Kuko konke oku, asizange sishukunyiswe kodwa sahlala elukholweni ngenxa yokuthembela kwethu eNkosini.

Ndibulela kubaPostile, abaVeleli kunye nabaDala beZithili abahlanganisana ngomthandazo kumlo ochasene nalo moya ungendawo obufuna ukutshabalalisa indlu kaSirayeli.

Mandinkhumbuze bathandekayo, kwakho ixesha apho uFaro ekunye namadoda akhe axhobileyo wabhengeza imfazwe nxamnye namaSirayeli. Xa amaSirayeli eqonda oku, ayehlelwa luloyiko kuba kwakungekho ndawo yakubaleka. Xa iNkosi ibona ukoyika kwawo, yabeka ilifu lokhuseleko phakathi kwabantwana bakaSirayeli nomkhosi kaFaro. Ngoko ke amaYiputa zange awabone amaSirayeli.
