Amandla kaThixo ehlela kwisicaka sakhe uMoses ukuba oyise wonke umkhosi kaFaro ngelixa bewajongile. Ekugqibeleni bonke ubulumko bukaFaro batshabalala kulwandle olubomvu. Emva koko abantwana bakaSirayeli badumisa ngovuyo bebulela uThixo ngokuwoyisa ongendawo.

Ngoko ke bathandekayo, ndicela ukuba siqhubeke siqhekeza isonka yonke imihla, sihlale neenkokeli zethu kwaye sithwale ivangeli yoxolo. Ukuba senza njalo, uThixo uya kusikhusela ngamaxesha onke.

Izifo, ukugula, nokubandezeleka makuphele phakathi kwethu.

Ndininqwenelela unyaka omtsha ozele yimpilo neentsikelelo.

Owakho eNkosini,
J.R. MAGANO
UMongameli kunye noMpostile oyiNtloko

ts.title: XILUMISO XA MUPOSTOLA XA LEMBE RA 2020-2021
ts.message:
Varhandziwa eka Hosi,

Ndzi pfumeleleni ndzi teka nkarhi lowu ku mi losa hinkwenu hi vito ra Hosi ya hina Yesu Kreste.

A hi languteni endzhaku hi ehleketa hi minkarhi yo tika leyi hi hundzeke eka yona hikwalaho ka ntungu wa COVID-19 lowu hundzeke ni vana va Hosi vo tala lava rhandzekaka. Ndzi nkhensa nsirhelelo na tintswalo ta Hosi leswi veke ehenhla ka n'wina.

A hi fanelanga ku rivala tinhenha ta hina ta vavanuna ni ta vavasati eka Vapostola va hina, Vapostola va Vamanana, Malandza, Malandza ya Vamanana na vamakwerhu va vavanuna ni va vavasati lava wisisiweke hikwalaho ka ntungu lowu. Eka leswi hinkwaswo, a hi tsekatsekisiwanga kambe hi tshamile eripfumelweni hikwalaho ka ku tshemba ka hina eka Hosi.

Ndzi nkhensa Vapostola, Valanguteri na Vakulu va Swifundzha lava hlengeletaneke hi xikhongelo entiyweni wo lwisana na moya lowu wo biha lowu a wu lava ku lovisa yindlu ya Israyele.

A ndzi mi tsundzuxeni varhandziwa, ku tile nkarhi lowu Faro swin'we na vavanuna va yena lava hlomeke va tiviseke nyimpi ehenhla ka Israyele. Loko Israyele yi xiya leswi, ku chava ku va wele ehenhla hikuva a ku nga ri na laha va nga tsutsumelaka kona. Loko Hosi yi vona ku chava ka vona, yi veka papa ra nsirhelelo exikarhi ka vana va Israyele ni vuthu ra Faro. Hikokwalaho Vaegipita a va zanganga va vona Vaisrayele.

Matimba ya Xikwembu ya xikele nandza wa xona Muxe leswaku a hlula vuthu hinkwaro ra Faro loko va ri karhi va va languta. Eku heteleleni vutlhari hinkwabyo bya Faro byi lovile elwandle ro tshwuka. Endzhaku ka sweswo vana va Israyele va dzunisile hi ntsako va nkhensa Xikwembu hi ku hlula lowo biha.

Hikokwalaho varhandziwa, ndzi kombela leswaku hi ya emahlweni hi phema xinkwa siku ni siku, hi tshama ni varhangeri va hina ni ku rhwala evhangeli ya ku rhula. Loko hi endla tano, Xikwembu xi ta hi sirhelela mikarhi hinkwayo.

Mavabyi, vuvabyi, ni ku xaniseka a swi hele exikarhi ka hina.

Ndzi mi navelela lembe lerintshwa leri teleke hi rihanyo ni mikateko.

Wa n'wina eka Hosi,
J.R. MAGANO
Puresidente ni Mupostola wa Nkulu

st.title: TUMELISO EA MOAPOSTOLA BAKENG SA SELEMO SA 2020-2021
st.message:
Baratuoa Moreneng,

E re ke nke monyetla ona ke le lumelise bohle ka lebitso la Morena oa rona Jesu Kreste.

A re ke re hetleng morao 'me re nahane ka linako tse thata tseo re fetileng ho tsona ka lebaka la seoa sa COVID-19 se fetileng le bana ba Morena ba bangata ba ratehang. Ke leboha tšireletso le mohau oa Morena o bileng holim'a lona.

Ha rea lokela ho lebala bahale ba rona ba banna le ba basali ho Baapostola ba rona, Bomme Baapostola, Liofisiri, Bomme Liofisiri le bana babo rona le likhaitseli tse phomotseng ka lebaka la seoa sena. Ho sena sohle, ha rea ka ra sisinyeha empa re lutse tumelong ka lebaka la tšepo ea rona ho Morena.

Ke leboha Baapostola, Balebeli le Baholo ba Setereke ba ileng ba bokana thapelong ntoeng e khahlanong le moea ona o mobe o neng o batla ho senya ntlo ea Iseraele.

E re ke le hopotse baratuoa, ho ile ha tla nako eo Faro a nang le banna ba hae ba hlometseng ba phatlalatsang ntoa khahlanong le Iseraele. Ha Iseraele e elelloa sena, tšabo e ile ea ba oela holimo kaha ho ne ho se moo ba ka balehelang teng. Ha Morena a bona tšabo ea bona, a beha leru la tšireletso lipakeng tsa bana ba Iseraele le lebotho la Faro. Kahoo Baegepeta ha baa ka ba bona Baiseraele.

Matla a Molimo a theohela ho mohlanka oa hae Moshe ho hlola lebotho lohle la Faro ha ba ntse ba ba shebile. Qetellong bohlale bohle ba Faro bo ile ba timela leoatleng le lefubelu. Kamora moo bana ba Iseraele ba ile ba rorisa ka thabo ba leboha Molimo ka ho hlola ea khopo.

Kahoo baratuoa, ke kopa hore re tsoelepele ho arolelana bohobe letsatsi le letsatsi, re lule le baetapele ba rona 'me re jare evangeli ea khotso. Haeba re etsa joalo, Molimo o tla re sireletsa ka linako tsohle.

Maloetse, ho kula, le mahlomola a fele har'a rona.

Ke le lakaletsa selemo se secha se tletseng bophelo bo botle le litlhohonolofatso.

Ea lona Moreneng,
J.R. MAGANO
Mopresidente le Moapostola e Moholo

zu.title: UMBULISO WOMPOSTOLI KUZINCEKU ZONKE NAMABANDLA ONKE KU-2022-2023
zu.message:
Bathandwa beNkosi uKrestu,

Manginibulise ngokukhethekile nonke ngegama elithi uKrestu idwala lamadwala elilokhu limile kuzimpilo zethu. Elakhe iBandla lisalokhu liphezu kwedwala. Ngeke sithande ukwahlukana naleliBandla. Kodwa iNkosi mayisigcine, silifuze, ngoba lona labonwa abaFundi, labusiswa.

INdodana kaThixo yavuma ukuza emhlabeni ukuze abantu bakaYise basindiswe. Phela inzondo yelizwe inamandla, iyabhubhisa indalo kaThixo. Abantwana beNgonyama nabo bayaphazamiseka ngezinto ezenzekayo: izingozi; inkemba; nezinye izikhali; ukuchitheka kwegazi. Sike sizibuze baThandwa ukuthi izidalwa zikabani lezi ezifa kalula kanje? Impendulo: EZIKA THIXO MDALI!!!

UThixo Bathandwa, kadalanga yini abantu ngomfanekiso wakhe, ukuze bathandane na? Uma uThando lukaThixo luphakathi kwethu, ngeke simbone umfowethu eyisitha kimi. Ngoba naye udalwe ngomfanekiso kaBaba.

Ngivumeleni, Bathandwa, ngithi lezikhali ezenza lomonakalo ziphethwe yizandla ezingafanelekile: ABALELEYO!! Abaningi babo abalwazi loluThando lwa-Krestu. Phela loloThando lufundisa ukunyamezela, lumi phakade, alujiki. Mthandwa, usulibele yini ukuthi laba asebalala abakwazi ukunyamezela? Bafuna usindiso lwabakubo abaphilayo lufike manje.

Bathandi bezindaba ezilungile, baVangeli bezindaba zikaKrestu, balandeli beNkosi uKrestu asisukumeni sithandazeni, uThixo makasihole siyofakaza, siyongqina ngeVangeli kuzizukulwane zonke esiphila nazo enyameni.

Abaphilayo bayolamukela iVangeli lokuphila, balehlisele kwabaleleyo bakubo. Bona-ke bayobe sebelahla izikhali zenyama ezinyaweni zethu, bese bethatha izikhali zikaMoya. Kuyoba novuyo lapho bamemeza bathi: 'Asibambene nenyama negazi, kepha sibambene nemimoya yalobubumnyama.' Isitha esikhulu akusiye lomuntu obulewe, kepha: IMIMOYA KASATHANE.

Abantu balinde izindaba zeVangeli lombuso, uThixo Baba asisize sikhuthalele iVangeli lovuko. Bonke bovuka badumise AMANDLA ENGONYAMA. Phela yona yabathengela impilo ephakade ngegazi layo!!

Masimemezeni sonke ekuhlaleni, sithi: Phezulu ngeVangeli!! Phezulu Ngokuthandana!! Phezulu Ngokukhuthala!!
Phansi Ngokuvilapha!! Phansi Ngamagama abanye abantu!! Phansi Ngama-Groupana angenabuThixo!! Phansi Ngamabhokisi!! Phansi Ngezifo!!

Bantwana engibaphiwe uThixo uBaba osithandayo, ngivumeleni ngithi: Nginifisela IZINKONZO EZINHLE, ZINGAMELWE YIZINGONYAMA ZIKA-ISRAYELI; Nginifisele uX-MAS no-NEW YEAR omuhle kanye nama-SUMMER HOLIDAYS.

'UThixo aniphe impilo enhle; kube nokuthula nenhlonipho emindenini yenu; Izibusiso zibe ziningi; kwande amathuba emisebenzi; kube nempumelelo ezikoleni; makakhule wonke amaBandla; kungabibikho indlala nokweswela; kuqalekiswe imimoya kaSathane; kanjalo nibusiswe ngabantwana emishadweni yenu.'

Yimi owenu ku-Krestu,
S.D. Ndlovu
(Chief Apostle)

en.title: APOSTLE'S GREETING TO ALL OFFICERS AND CONGREGATIONS FOR 2022-2023
en.message:
Beloved of the Lord Christ,

Let me greet you all specially in the name that Christ is the rock of rocks that stands firm in our lives. His Church still stands on the rock. We would never want to separate from this Church. But may the Lord keep us, that we may resemble it, because it was seen by the Disciples, and blessed.

The Son of God agreed to come to earth so that His Father's people might be saved. Indeed the hatred of the world is powerful, it destroys God's creation. The children of the Lion are also disturbed by the things happening: accidents; the sword; and other weapons; the spilling of blood. Have we ever asked ourselves, Beloved, whose creatures are these that die so easily? The answer: THEY ARE GOD THE CREATOR'S!!!

Did God, Beloved, not create people in His own image, so that they might love one another? If the Love of God is within us, I will not see my brother as an enemy. Because he too is created in the image of the Father.

Allow me, Beloved, to say that these weapons causing this damage are held by unworthy hands: THE SLEEPING ONES!! Many of them do not know this Love of Christ. Indeed that Love teaches patience, it stands forever, it does not turn back. Beloved, have you forgotten that these sleeping ones cannot endure? They want the salvation of their living relatives to arrive right now.

Lovers of good news, Evangelists of the news of Christ, followers of the Lord Christ, let us stand up and pray, may God lead us to go and testify, to bear witness through the Gospel to all generations we live with in the flesh.

The living will receive the Gospel of life, and pass it down to the sleeping ones of their family. They will then drop the weapons of the flesh at our feet, and take up the weapons of the Spirit. There will be joy when they shout saying: 'We wrestle not against flesh and blood, but against the spirits of this darkness.' The great enemy is not this person who is killed, but: THE SPIRITS OF SATAN.

People are waiting for the news of the Gospel of the kingdom, may God the Father help us to be diligent for the Gospel of resurrection. All will awaken and praise the POWER OF THE LION. For He bought eternal life for them with His blood!!

Let us all shout where we sit, saying: Up with the Gospel!! Up with Loving one another!! Up with Diligence!!
Down with laziness!! Down with gossiping about other people!! Down with little groups without God!! Down with coffins!! Down with diseases!!

Children I have been given by God the Father who loves us, allow me to say: I wish you BEAUTIFUL SERVICES, PRESIDED OVER BY THE LIONS OF ISRAEL; I wish you a good CHRISTMAS and NEW YEAR and SUMMER HOLIDAYS.

'May God give you good health; let there be peace and respect in your families; May blessings be many; may job opportunities increase; may there be success in schools; may all Congregations grow; let there be no hunger and lack; may the spirits of Satan be cursed; and likewise may you be blessed with children in your marriages.'

Yours in Christ,
S.D. Ndlovu
(Chief Apostle)

nso.title: TUMEDIŠO YA MOAPOSTOLA GO BAHLANKA KA MOKA LE DIPHUTHEGO KA MOKA YA 2022-2023
nso.message:
Barategi ba Morena Kriste,

E re ke le dumediše ka moka ka go kgethega ka leina la gore Kriste ke leswika la maswika leo le emego le tiile maphelong a rena. Kereke ya Gagwe e sa eme leswikeng. Re ka se tsoge re nyakile go kgaogana le Kereke ye. Eupša Morena a re boloke, gore re e swane, gobane e bonwe ke Barutiwa, gomme ya šegofatšwa.

Morwa wa Modimo o dumetše go tla lefaseng gore batho ba Tatagwe ba phološwe. Ruri hloyo ya lefase e maatla, e senya tlholo ya Modimo. Bana ba Tau le bona ba ferekanywa ke dilo tše di diregago: dikotsi; tšhoša; le dibetša tše dingwe; tšhologo ya madi. Na re kile ra ipotšiša, Barategi, gore tše ke dibopiwa tša mang tše di hwago gabonolo ka tsela ye? Karabo: KE TŠA MODIMO MMOPI!!!

Na Modimo, Barategi, ga se a hlola batho ka seswantšho sa gagwe, gore ba ratane? Ge Lerato la Modimo le le ka gare ga rena, nka se bone ngwanešo e le lenaba go nna. Gobane le yena o hlotšwe ka seswantšho sa Tate.

Ntumelleleng, Barategi, go re dibetša tše di bakago tshenyo ye di swerwe ke diatla tše di sa swanelago: BA BA ROBETŠEGO!! Ba bantši ba bona ga ba tsebe Lerato le la Kriste. Ruri Lerato leo le ruta kgotlelelo, le ema go ya go ile, ga le boe morago. Morategi, na o lebetše gore ba ba robetšego ga ba kgone go kgotlelela? Ba nyaka gore phološo ya ba malapa a bona ba ba phelago e fihle gona bjale.

Barati ba ditaba tše dibotse, Baebangedi ba ditaba tša Kriste, balatedi ba Morena Kriste a re emeng re rapeleng, Modimo a re etelele pele re ye go hlatsela, re ye go ba dihlatse ka Ebangedi go meloko ka moka ye re phelago le yona nameng.

Ba ba phelago ba tla amogela Ebangedi ya bophelo, ba e fetišetša go ba ba robetšego ba malapa a bona. Ke moka ba tla lahla dibetša tša nama maotong a rena, gomme ba tšea dibetša tša Moya. Go tla ba le lethabo ge ba goelela ba re: 'Ga re lwe le nama le madi, eupša re lwa le meoya ya leswiswi le.' Lenaba le legolo ga se motho yo a bolawago, eupša: MEOYA YA SATHANE.

Batho ba emetše ditaba tša Ebangedi ya mmušo, Modimo Tate a re thuše go ba mafolofolo Ebangeding ya tsogo. Ka moka ba tla tsoga gomme ba tumiša MAATLA A TAU. Gobane o ba reketše bophelo bjo bo sa felego ka madi a gagwe!!

A re goeleleng ka moka mo re dutšego gona, re re: Godimo ka Ebangedi!! Godimo ka go Ratana!! Godimo ka Mafolofolo!!
Fase ka botšwafa!! Fase ka ditshebo tša batho ba bangwe!! Fase ka dihlophananyana tše di se nago Modimo!! Fase ka mapokisi a bahu!! Fase ka malwetši!!

Bana bao ke ba filwego ke Modimo Tate yo a re ratago, ntumelleleng ke re: Ke le lakaletša DITIRELO TŠE DIBOTSE, TŠE DI ETELETŠWEGO PELE KE DITAU TŠA ISIRAELE; Ke le lakaletša Keresemose e botse le Ngwaga o Moswa gotee le Matšatši a makhutšo a Selemo.

'Modimo a le fe maphelo a mabotse; a go be le khutšo le tlhompho malapeng a lena; Ditšhegofatšo a di be dintši; menyetla ya mešomo a e ate; a go be le katlego dikolong; Diphuthego ka moka a di gole; a go se be le tlala le tlhokego; meoya ya Sathane a e rogekwe; gomme ka mo go swanago le šegofatšwe ka bana manyalong a lena.'

Wa lena go Kriste,
S.D. Ndlovu
(Moapostola yo Mogolo)

xh.title: UMBULISO WOMPOSTILE KUZINCEKU ZONKE NAMABANDLA ONKE KA-2022-2023
xh.message:
Bathandekayo beNkosi uKristu,

Mandibulise ngokukhethekileyo nonke ngegama elithi uKristu liliwa lamaliwa elisame kwiimpilo zethu. ICawe yakhe isame phezu kweliwa. Asingeze sithande ukwahlukana nale Cawe. Kodwa iNkosi mayisigcine, siyifuze, kuba yabonwa ngabaFundi, yasikelelwa.

UNyana kaThixo wavuma ukuza emhlabeni ukuze abantu bakaYise basindiswe. Kaloku inzondo yehlabathi inamandla, iyatshabalalisa indalo kaThixo. Abantwana beNgonyama nabo bayaphazamiseka zizinto ezenzekayo: iingozi; ikrele; nezinye izixhobo; ukuphalazwa kwegazi. Sakha sazibuza na baThandwa ukuba zizidalwa zikabani ezi zifa ngokulula kangaka? Impendulo: ZEZIKATHIXO UMDALI!!!

Ngaba uThixo, baThandwa, akadalanga abantu ngomfanekiso wakhe, ukuze bathandane na? Ukuba uThando lukaThixo luphakathi kwethu, andinakumbona umzalwana wam njengotshaba kum. Kuba naye udalwe ngomfanekiso kaBawo.

Ndivumeleni, baThandwa, ndithi ezi zixhobo zenza lo monakalo ziphethwe zizandla ezingafanelekanga: ABALELEYO!! Abaninzi babo abalwazi olu Thando lukaKristu. Kaloku olo Thando lufundisa unyamezelo, lumi ngonaphakade, alujiki. Mthandwa, ulibele na ukuba aba sele belele abakwazi kunyamezela? Bafuna usindiso lwabakubo abaphilayo lufike ngoku.

Bathandi beendaba ezilungileyo, baVangeli beendaba zikaKristu, balandeli beNkosi uKristu masiphakame sithandaze, uThixo makasikhokele siye kungqina, siye kungqina ngeVangeli kuzo zonke izizukulwana esiphila nazo enyameni.

Abaphilayo baya kuyamkela iVangeli yobomi, bayidlulisele kwabaleleyo bakubo. Baya kuthi ke balahle izixhobo zenyama ezinyaweni zethu, baze bathathe izixhobo zoMoya. Kuya kubakho uvuyo xa bekhwaza besithi: 'Asizamazamani nanyama nagazi, kodwa sizamazamana nemimoya yobu bumnyama.' Olona tshaba lukhulu asingulo mntu ubuleweyo, kodwa: YIMIMOYA KASATHANA.

Abantu balinde iindaba zeVangeli yobukumkani, uThixo uBawo makasincede sikhuthalele iVangeli yovuko. Bonke baya kuvuka badumise AMANDLA ENGONYAMA. Kuba yona yabathengela ubomi obungunaphakade ngegazi layo!!

Masikhwazeni sonke apho sihleli khona, sithi: Phezulu ngeVangeli!! Phezulu Ngokuthandana!! Phezulu Ngokukhuthala!!
Phantsi Ngokuvilapha!! Phantsi Ngokuhleba abanye abantu!! Phantsi NgamaQela angenabo uThixo!! Phantsi Ngamabhokisi omngcwabo!! Phantsi Ngezifo!!

Bantwana endibaphiwe nguThixo uBawo osithandayo, ndivumeleni ndithi: Ndininqwenelela IINKONZO EZINTLE, EZONGAMELWE ZIINGONYAMA ZIKASIRAYELI; Ndininqwenelela iKRISIMESI neNYAKA ENTSHA entle kunye neeHOLIDE ZASEHLOTYENI.

'UThixo aninike impilo entle; kubekho uxolo nentlonipho kwiintsapho zenu; Iintsikelelo mazibe ninzi; kwande amathuba emisebenzi; kubekho impumelelo ezikolweni; makhule onke amaBandla; kungabikho ndlala nokuswela; mayiqalekiswe imimoya kaSathana; kwaye ngokunjalo nisikelelwe ngabantwana emitshatweni yenu.'

Ndim owakho kuKristu,
S.D. Ndlovu
(UMpostile oyiNtloko)

ts.title: XILUMISO XA MUPOSTOLA EKA MALANDZA HINKWAWO NA MAVANDLHA HINKWAWO XA 2022-2023
ts.message:
Varhandziwa ba Hosi Kreste,

Ndzi pfumeleleni ndzi mi losa hi ku hlawuleka hinkwenu hi vito ra leswaku Kreste i ribye ra maribye leri yimeke ri tiya evuton'wini bya hina. Kereke ya Yena ya ha yimile eribyeni. A hi nge pfuki hi lavile ku hambana na Kereke leyi. Kambe Hosi a yi hi hlayise, leswaku hi fana na yona, hikuva yi voniwile hi Vadyondzisiwa, yi katekisiwa.

N'wana wa Xikwembu u pfumerile ku ta emisaveni leswaku vanhu va Tata wa Yena va ponisiwa. Hakunene rivengo ra misava ri ni matimba, ri lovisa ntumbuluko wa Xikwembu. Vana va Nghala na vona va pfilunganyisiwa hi swilo leswi humelelaka: timhangu; fumu; na matlhari man'wana; ku halatiwa ka ngati. Xana hi tshame hi tivutisa, Varhandziwa, leswaku swivumbiwa leswi faka hi ku olova swonghasi i swa mani? Nhlamulo: I SWA XIKWEMBU MUVUMBI!!!

Xana Xikwembu, Varhandziwa, a xi tumbuluxanga vanhu hi xifaniso xa xona, leswaku va rhandzana? Loko Rirhandzu ra Xikwembu ri ri endzeni ka hina, a ndzi nge voni makwerhu tanihi nala eka mina. Hikuva na yena u tumbuluxiwile hi xifaniso xa Tatana.

Ndzi pfumeleleni, Varhandziwa, ku vula leswaku matlhari lawa ya vangaka tshenyo leyi ya khomiwe hi mavoko lama nga fanelangiki: LAVA ETLELEKE!! Vo tala va vona a va ri tivi Rirhandzu leri ra Kreste. Hakunene Rirhandzu rero ri dyondzisa ku tiyisela, ri yima hilaha ku nga heriki, a ri tlheleli endzhaku. Murhandziwa, xana u rivarile leswaku lava etleleke a va koti ku tiyisela? Va lava leswaku ku ponisiwa ka maxaka ya vona lama hanyaka ku fika sweswi.

Varhandzi ba mahungu lamanene, Vavangeli va mahungu ya Kreste, valandzeri va Hosi Kreste a hi yimeni hi khongela, Xikwembu a xi hi rhangela hi ya fakaza, hi ya nyikela vumbhoni hi Evhangeli eka tinxaka hinkwato leti hi hanyaka na tona enyameni.

Lava hanyaka va ta amukela Evhangeli ya vutomi, va yi hundzisela eka lava etleleke va mindyangu ya vona. Kutani va ta cukumeta matlhari ya nyama emilengeni ya hina, va teka matlhari ya Moya. Ku ta va ni ntsako loko va huwelela va ku: 'A hi lwi na nyama ni ngati, kambe hi lwa na mimoya ya munyama lowu.' Nala lonkulu a hi munhu loyi a dlayiweke, kambe: I MIMOYA YA SATHANA.

Vanhu va rindzele mahungu ya Evhangeli ya mfungho, Xikwembu Tatana a xi hi pfune ku va ni mafolofolo eka Evhangeli ya ku pfuka eku feni. Hinkwavo va ta pfuka va dzunisa MATIMBA YA NGHALA. Hikuva yi va xavele vutomi lebyi nga heriki hi ngati ya yona!!

A hi huweleleni hinkwerhu laha hi tshamengiki kona, hi ku: Ehenhla hi Evhangeli!! Ehenhla Hi Ku Rhandzana!! Ehenhla Hi Mafolofolo!!
Ehansi Hi vulolo!! Ehansi Hi ku hleva vanhu van'wana!! Ehansi Hi mintlawanyana leyi nga riki na Xikwembu!! Ehansi Hi mabokisi ya vafi!! Ehansi Hi mavabyi!!

Vana lava ndzi nyikiweke vona hi Xikwembu Tatana loyi a hi rhandzaka, ndzi pfumeleleni ndzi ku: Ndzi mi navelela TINKONZO TO SASEKA, LETI RHANGELERIWAKA HI TINGHALA TA ISRAYELE; Ndzi mi navelela KHISIMUSI yo saseka ni LEMBE LERINTSHWA swin'we ni TIHOLIDE TA XALATI.

'Xikwembu a xi mi nyike rihanyo lerinene; a ku ve ni ku rhula ni xichavo emindyangwini ya n'wina; Mikateko a yi andze; menyetla ya mintirho a yi andze; a ku ve ni ku humelela eswikolweni; Mavandlha hinkwawo a ma kule; a ku nga vi na ndlala ni vusweti; mimoya ya Sathana a yi rhukaniwe; naswona hilaha ku fanaka mi katekisiwa hi vana emicathweni ya n'wina.'

Hi mina wa n'wina eka Kreste,
S.D. Ndlovu
(Mupostola wa Nkulu)

st.title: TUMELISO EA MOAPOSTOLA HO BAHLANKA BOHLE LE DIPHUTHEHO TSOHLE BAKENG SA 2022-2023
st.message:
Baratuoa ba Morena Kreste,

E re ke le lumelise bohle ka ho khetheha ka lebitso la hore Kreste ke lefika la mafika le emeng le tiile maphelong a rona. Kereke ea Hae e ntse e eme lefikeng. Re ke ke ra hlola re batla ho arohana le Kereke ena. Empa Morena a re boloke, e le hore re e tšoane, hobane e bonoe ke Barutuoa, mme ea hlohonolofatsoa.

Mora oa Molimo o ile a lumela ho tla lefatšeng e le hore batho ba Ntat'ae ba pholosoe. Ruri lehloeo la lefatše le matla, le senya pōpo ea Molimo. Bana ba Tau le bona ba tšoenngoa ke lintho tse etsahalang: likotsi; sabole; le libetsa tse ling; tšollo ea mali. Na re kile ra ipotsa, Baratuoa, hore ebe tsena ke libopuoa tsa mang tse shoang habonolo tjee? Karabo: KE TSA MOLIMO 'MOPI!!!

Na Molimo, Baratuoa, ha a bopa batho ka setšoantšo sa hae, hore ba ratane? Haeba Lerato la Molimo le le kahare ho rona, nka se bone ngoan'eso e le sera ho 'na. Hobane le eena o bopiloe ka setšoantšo sa Ntate.

Ntumelleng, Baratuoa, ho re libetsa tsena tse bakang tšenyo ena li tšoeroe ke matsoho a sa tšoanelang: BA ROBETSENG!! Ba bangata ba bona ha ba tsebe Lerato lena la Kreste. Ruri Lerato leo le ruta mamello, le eme kamehla, ha le fetolohe. Moratuoa, na u lebetse hore bana ba seng ba robetse ha ba khone ho mamella? Ba batla hore poloko ea beng ka bona ba phelang e fihle hona joale.

Barati ba litaba tse molemo, Baevangeli ba litaba tsa Kreste, balateli ba Morena Kreste a re emeng re rapele, Molimo a re etelle pele ho ea paka, ho ea fana ka bopaki ka Evangeli melokong eohle eo re phelang le eona nameng.

Ba phelang ba tla amohela Evangeli ea bophelo, ba e fetisetse ho ba robetseng ba malapa a bona. Ba tla lahlela libetsa tsa nama maotong a rona, mme ba nke libetsa tsa Moea. Ho tla ba le thabo ha ba hooa ba re: 'Ha re loane le nama le mali, empa re loana le meea ea lefifi lena.' Sera se seholo hase motho enoa ea bolaoang, empa: MEEA EA SATANE.

Batho ba emetse litaba tsa Evangeli ea 'muso, Molimo Ntate a re thuse ho ba mahlahahlaha bakeng sa Evangeli ea tsoho. Bohle ba tla tsoha mme ba rorise MATLA A TAU. Hobane o ba raketse bophelo bo sa feleng ka mali a hae!!

A re hooeng bohle moo re lutseng teng, re re: Holimo ka Evangeli!! Holimo ka ho Ratana!! Holimo ka Mafolofolo!!
Fatše ka botsoa!! Fatše ka ho seba batho ba bang!! Fatše ka lihlopha tse se nang Molimo!! Fatše ka mabokose a bafu!! Fatše ka maloetse!!

Bana bao ke ba filoeng ke Molimo Ntate ea re ratang, ntumelleng ke re: Ke le lakaletsa LITŠEBELETSO TSE NTLE, TSE ETELETSIOENG PELE KE LITAU TSA ISERAELE; Ke le lakaletsa KERESEMESE e ntle le SELEMO SE SECHA hammoho le MATSATSI A PHOMOLO A LEHLABULA.

'Molimo a le fe bophelo bo botle; a ho be le khotso le tlhompho malapeng a lona; Litlhohonolofatso a li be ngata; menyetla ea mesebetsi e ate; a ho be le katleho likolong; Liphutheho tsohle li hōle; ho se be le tlala le tlhoko; meea ea Satane e rohakoe; mme ka mokhoa o tšoanang le hlohonolofatsoe ka bana lenyalong la lona.'

Ea lona ho Kreste,
S.D. Ndlovu
(Moapostola e Moholo)

zu.title: UMBULISO WOMPOSTILE KUWO WONKE AMABANDLA NEZINCEKU ZAKHE KUNYAKA KA 2023-2024
zu.message:
Bathandwa beNkosi uKrestu,

Mangiphinde nginibulise egameni leNkosi yethu uKrestu noMsindisi wethu.

Mangisho ukuthi iziNgonyama ziyaphila, ziyasizwa uma simemeza, sisebunzimeni bemisebenzi kaSatane. Ziyasinakekela imini nobusuku. Bantwana bakaBABA, ngiyaziqhenya ngani, ngenxa yokuthi singabalowo owadela ubuhle beZulu, wathwala isiphambano sehlazo ukuze sisindiswe nezidalwa zakowethu.

Kulonyaka ofile ngibone sihamba kahle sonke sibambene, sibekezelelana kungekho ozenzela okwakhe. Phela ningabofakazi, Bathandwa, ukuthi ozenzelayo uyolinyazwa yilokho azenzela kona yena. Owenza okomkhokheli unokuphila okuphakade.

Kulonyaka ofileyo abaningi bethu baveze ubuqotho obumangalisayo. Savuya sesibona impumelelo sikhumbuzwa izimfundo ezindala zabaPOSTILE njenge:-
 a) Izishumi zenyama,
 b) Hlala lapho ubekwe khona,
 c) uThando,
 d) nokungaphuzi kumaXhaphozi
Ngivumeleni mangithi lezimfundiso bese sizikhohliwe. Nazimukela kahle Bathandwa, nenza izenzo. Khona-ke abanye bethu bathathe ixesha elide ukufunda ukwenza okuhle. Phela asifani ngokumukela ukwenza okuhle.

Kufana nje nemfundo yoThando esayaziswa ngenkathi singena kuleliZulu. Sayifunda imisebenzi yoThando, sathola ukuthula emoyeni yethu. Safundiswa ukuthi ukuprofetha, izilimi nokwazi kungaphela, kodwa uThando alusoze lwaphela. UTHANDO MALUQALE ENDLINI. Uma uThando lukhona endlini yami, yini pho umemeze uthi 'ayingathintwa muntu i-cellphone yami!' Sesehlukene yini? Engathi washo phambi kwezihlwele ukuthi, ukufa kuphela okuyosehlukanisa. Nakhu sihlukana siphila nje! Kanti uqonde kuphi UKUFA? Kwenyama noma komoya? Ngabe wayephosisa yini uMphostoli Paul uma ethi: uThando luyabekezela!?

Bathandwa, asizincinze sizibone ukuthi kungabe sisathandana ngenyaniso yini?

Ilizwe lifuna ukungena eNkonzweni! Libuza ukuthi lwashonaphi uThando lwethu. Phela bathi basazi ngalo. Bathi olwethu luhlukile namanye. LONA "LUMBATHISWE NGAMANDLA KAMOY'ONGCWELE." Ngiyazethemba iziNgonyama zikanye nami kulomthandazo. Siyazi ukuthi isitha sethu uSatane.

'Singeniseni boBaba kunyaka omusha onezinsikelelo, enyameni nasemoyeni. Sivuleleni amathuba okuqasheka, si-registeke emsebenzini. Baphase abafundi bethu.
Ngomsa wakho Baba ngicela usiphe abantwana kwimishado yethu, iVangeli, ukubekezelelana, ongenhla AFUNDE ongezansi, kanjalo nongezansi afunde ongenhla, khona kuzophela izinhliziyo eziwo HLUTHU!!! Yebo, inhliziyo iyavama ukuduka!!!'

Yimi owenu ku-Krestu,
S.D. Ndlovu
(Chief Apostle)

en.title: APOSTLE'S GREETING TO ALL CONGREGATIONS AND HIS OFFICERS IN THE YEAR 2023-2024
en.message:
Beloved of the Lord Christ,

Let me greet you again in the name of our Lord Christ and our Saviour.

Let me say that the Lions are alive, they hear us when we cry out, when we are in the difficulties of Satan's works. They take care of us day and night. Children of the FATHER, I am proud of you, because we belong to the one who gave up the beauty of Heaven, and carried the cross of shame so that we and our fellow creatures might be saved.

In the past year I saw us walking well, all holding together, tolerating one another with no one doing their own thing. Indeed you are witnesses, Beloved, that the one who does their own thing will be harmed by what they do to themselves. The one who does what the leader says has eternal life.

In the past year many of us showed amazing integrity. We rejoiced seeing success being reminded of the old teachings of the APOSTLES such as:-
 a) Tithes of the flesh,
 b) Stay where you are placed,
 c) Love,
 d) and not drinking from the Swamps
Allow me to say we had forgotten these teachings. You received them well Beloved, and put them into action. However some of us take a long time to learn to do good. We are not the same in receiving to do good.

It is just like the teaching of Love we were made aware of when we entered this Heaven. We learned the works of Love, and found peace in our spirits. We were taught that prophecy, tongues and knowledge may end, but Love will never end. LOVE MUST START AT HOME. If Love is present in my home, why then do you shout saying 'no one must touch my cellphone!' Are we now separated? Yet you said before the crowds that, only death will separate us. Here we are separating while we are alive! And what kind of DEATH did you mean? Of the flesh or of the spirit? Was the Apostle Paul making a mistake when he said: Love is patient!?

Beloved, let us pinch ourselves and see if we still truly love one another in truth?

The world wants to enter the Church! It asks where our Love has gone. Indeed they say they know us by it. They say ours is different from others. IT IS "CLOTHED WITH THE POWER OF THE HOLY SPIRIT." I trust the Lions are with me in this prayer. We know that our enemy is Satan.

'Lead us Fathers into a blessed new year, in flesh and in spirit. Open employment opportunities for us, let us be registered at work. Let our students pass.
By your grace Father I ask you give us children in our marriages, the Gospel, tolerance, let the one above LEARN from the one below, and likewise the one below learn from the one above, so that quick-tempered hearts will end!!! Yes, the heart often strays!!!'

Yours in Christ,
S.D. Ndlovu
(Chief Apostle)

nso.title: TUMEDIŠO YA MOAPOSTOLA GO DIPHUTHEGO KA MOKA LE BAHLANKA BA GAGWE NGWAGENG WA 2023-2024
nso.message:
Barategi ba Morena Kriste,

E re ke le dumediše gape ka leina la Morena wa rena Kriste le Mophološi wa rena.

E re ke re Ditau di a phela, di a re kwa ge re goelela, ge re le mathateng a mešomo ya Sathane. Di re hlokomela mosegare le bošego. Bana ba TATE, ke ikgantšha ka lena, gobane re ba yola a tlogetšego botse bja Legodimo, a rwala sefampano sa dihlong gore rena le dibopiwa gotee le rena re phološwe.

Ngwageng wo o fetilego ke bone re sepela gabotse ka moka re swarane, re kgotlelelana go se na yo a itirelago tša gagwe. Ruri le dihlatse, Barategi, gore yo a itirelago o tla gobatšwa ke seo a itirelago sona. Yo a dirago tša moetapele o na le bophelo bjo bo sa felego.

Ngwageng wo o fetilego ba bantši ba rena ba bontšhitše potego ye e makatšago. Re thabile ge re bona katlego re gopotšwa dithuto tša kgale tša BAAPOSTOLA tša go swana le:-
 a) Dikarolo tša lesome tša nama,
 b) Dula mo o beilwego gona,
 c) Lerato,
 d) le go se nwe Mekgobeng
Ntumelleleng ke re re be re lebetše dithuto tše. Le di amogetše gabotse Barategi, la dira ditiro. Eupša ba bangwe ba rena ba tšea nako e telele go ithuta go dira se sebotse. Ga re swane ge re amogela go dira tše dibotse.

Go fo swana le thuto ya Lerato ye re tsebišitšwego yona ge re tsena Legodimong le. Re ithutile mešomo ya Lerato, ra hwetša khutšo meyeng ya rena. Re rutilwe gore boporofeta, maleme le tsebo di ka fela, eupša Lerato le ka se tsoge le fedile. LERATO LE SWANETŠE GO THOMA GAE. Ge Lerato le le gona ka gae ga ka, ke ka baka la eng o goelela o re 'ga go na yo a swanetšego go swara sellathekeng sa ka!' Na re šetše re kgaogane? Eupša o boletše pele ga mašaba gore, lehu fela le tla re aroganya. Še re a aroganya mola re phela! Gomme o be o ra LEHU la mohuta mang? La nama goba la moya? Na Moapostola Paulo o be a dira phošo ge a re: Lerato le a kgotlelela!?

Barategi, a re itšhwareng gomme re bone ge eba re sa ratana ka nnete?

Lefase le nyaka go tsena Kerekeng! Le botšiša gore Lerato la rena le ile kae. Ruri ba re ba re tseba ka lona. Ba re la rena le fapane le a mangwe. LE "APERE MAATLA A MOYA O MOKGETHWA." Ke tshepa gore Ditau di na le nna thapelong ye. Re a tseba gore lenaba la rena ke Sathane.

'Re gogeleng Botate ngwageng o moswa o šegofaditšwego, nameng le moyeng. Re buleleleng menyetla ya mešomo, a re ngwadišwe mešomong. A baithuti ba rena ba phase.
Ka mogau wa gago Tate ke kgopela gore o re fe bana manyalong a rena, Ebangedi, kgotlelelo, a yo a lego godimo a ITHUTE go yo a lego fase, le yo a lego fase ka mo go swanago a ithute go yo a lego godimo, gore dipelo tša go tuka kapele di fele!!! Ee, pelo gantši e a timetša!!!'

Wa lena go Kriste,
S.D. Ndlovu
(Moapostola yo Mogolo)

xh.title: UMBULISO WOMPOSTILE KUWO ONKE AMABANDLA NEZINCEKU ZAKHE KUNYAKA KA-2023-2024
xh.message:
Bathandekayo beNkosi uKristu,

Mandiphinde ndinibulise egameni leNkosi yethu uKristu noMsindisi wethu.

Manditsho ukuba iiNgonyama ziyaphila, ziyasiva xa sikhwaza, xa sisebunzimeni bemisebenzi kaSathana. Ziyasikhathalela imini nobusuku. Bantwana bakaBAWO, ndiyazingca ngani, kuba singabalowo wadela ubuhle beZulu, wathwala umnqamlezo wehlazo ukuze thina nezidalwa esinazo sisindiswe.

Kulo nyaka ufileyo ndibone sihamba kakuhle sonke sibambene, sinyamezelana kungekho ozenzela okwakhe. Kaloku ningamangqina, baThandwa, ukuba ozenzelayo uya kwenzakaliswa koko azenzela kona. Owenza okwenkokeli unobomi obungunaphakade.

Kulo nyaka ufileyo abaninzi bethu babonise ubuqotho obumangalisayo. Savuya sakubona impumelelo sikhunjuzwa iimfundiso ezindala zabaPOSTILE ezinjengokuthi:-
 a) Izishumi zenyama,
 b) Hlala apho ubekwe khona,
 c) UThando,
 d) nokungaseli kumaXhaphozi
Ndivumeleni mandithi ezi mfundiso besesizilibele. Nazamkela kakuhle baThandwa, nenza izenzo. Kodwa ke abanye bethu bathatha ixesha elide ukufunda ukwenza okulungileyo. Kaloku asifani ekwamkeleni ukwenza okulungileyo.

Kufana nje nemfundiso yoThando esayaziswayo ngenxa yokungena kweli Zulu. Sayifunda imisebenzi yoThando, safumana uxolo emoyeni wethu. Safundiswa ukuba isiprofeto, iilwimi nokwazi kungaphela, kodwa uThando alusoze luphele. UTHANDO MALUQALE EKHAYA. Ukuba uThando lukho ekhaya lam, yini na ke ukuba ukhwaze uthi 'mayingachukunyiswa mntu i-cellphone yam!' Ngaba sesahlukene? Kanti watsho phambi kwezihlwele ukuba, ukufa kuphela okuyakusahlukanisa. Naku sisahlukana siphila nje! Kanti ububhekisa KUKUFA okunjani? Okwenyama okanye okomoya? Ngaba uMpostile uPawulos wayephazama na xa esithi: uThando luyanyamezela!?

BaThandwa, masizikrobise sibone ukuba ngaba sisathandana ngenyaniso na?

Ihlabathi lifuna ukungena eCaweni! Libuza ukuba lutshone phi uThando lwethu. Kaloku bathi basazi ngalo. Bathi olwethu lwahlukile kwamanye. LONA "LWAMBATHISWE NGAMANDLA KAMOY'ONGCWELE." Ndiyathemba iiNgonyama zikunye nam kulo mthandazo. Siyazi ukuba utshaba lwethu nguSathana.

'Singeniseni boBawo kunyaka omtsha oneentsikelelo, enyameni nasemoyeni. Sivuleleni amathuba engqesho, sibhaliswe emsebenzini. Baphase abafundi bethu.
Ngobabalo lwakho Bawo ndicela usinike abantwana emitshatweni yethu, iVangeli, ukunyamezelana, ongasentla AFUNDE kongasezantsi, ngokunjalo nongasezantsi afunde kongasentla, khon'ukuze ziphele iintliziyo ezivutha msinya!!! Ewe, intliziyo iyathanda ukulahleka!!!'

Ndim owakho kuKristu,
S.D. Ndlovu
(UMpostile oyiNtloko)

ts.title: XILUMISO XA MUPOSTOLA EKA MAVANDLHA HINKWAWO NA MALANDZA YA YENA EKA LEMBE RA 2023-2024
ts.message:
Varhandziwa ba Hosi Kreste,

Ndzi pfumeleleni ndzi mi losa nakambe hi vito ra Hosi ya hina Kreste ni Muponisi wa hina.

A ndzi vule leswaku Tinghala ti hanya, ta hi twa loko hi huwelela, loko hi ri emaxangwini ya mintirho ya Sathana. Ti hi hlayisa nhlikanhi ni vusiku. Vana va TATANA, ndzi tinyungubyisa hi n'wina, hikuva hi va loyi a tshikeke vusaseki bya Tilo, a rhwala xihambano xa tingana leswaku hina ni swivumbiwa-kulobye hi ponisiwa.

Eka lembe leri feke ndzi vone hi famba kahle hinkwerhu hi khomelelane, hi lehiselana mbilu ku nga ri na loyi a tiendlelaka swa yena. Hakunene mi timbhoni, Varhandziwa, leswaku loyi a tiendlelaka u ta vavisiwa hi leswi a tiendlelaka swona yena. Loyi a endlaka leswi murhangeri a swi vulaka u na vutomi lebyi nga heriki.

Eka lembe leri feke vo tala va hina va kombise vutshembeki byo hlamarisa. Hi tsakile hi vona ku humelela hi tsundzuxiwa tidyondzo ta khale ta VAPOSTOLA to fana na:-
 a) Vukhume bya nyama,
 b) Tshama laha u vekiweke kona,
 c) Rirhandzu,
 d) ni ku nga nwi eMidzobeni
Ndzi pfumeleleni ndzi vula leswaku tidyondzo leti a hi ti rivarile. Mi ti amukele kahle Varhandziwa, mi endla swiendlo. Kambe van'wana va hina va teka nkarhi wo leha ku dyondza ku endla leswinene. A hi fani eku amukeleni ku endla leswinene.

Swi fana ni dyondzo ya Rirhandzu leyi hi tivisiweke yona loko hi nghena eTilweni leri. Hi dyondzile mintirho ya Rirhandzu, hi kuma ku rhula emoyeni wa hina. Hi dyondzisiwile leswaku vuprofeta, tindzimi ni vutivi swi nga hela, kambe Rirhandzu a ri nge pfi ri herile. RIRHANDZU RI FANELE KU SUNGULA EKA YA. Loko Rirhandzu ri ri kona ekaya ra mina, hikwalaho ka yini sweswi u huwelela u ku 'ku nga vi na munhu loyi a khumbaka selfoni ya mina!' Xana se hi hambanile? Kasi u vurile emahlweni ka mintshungu leswaku, rifu ntsena ri ta hi hambanisa. Hi hina lava hi hambanaka hi ri karhi hi hanya! Kasi u vula RIFU ra njhani? Ra nyama kumbe ra moya? Xana Mupostola Pawulo a a hoxa loko a ku: Rirhandzu ra tiyisela!?

Varhandziwa, a hi tiphinceni hi vona loko hi ha rhandzana hi ntiyiso?

Misava yi lava ku nghena eKerekeni! Yi vutisa leswaku Rirhandzu ra hina ri ye kwihi. Hakunene va ri va hi tiva hi rona. Va ri ra hina ri hambanile ni man'wana. RONA RI "AMBEXIWE HI MATIMBA YA MOYA LOWO KWETSIMA." Ndzi tshemba Tinghala ti na mina exikhongelweni lexi. Ha swi tiva leswaku nala wa hina i Sathana.

'Hi rhangeleni Vatatana eka lembe lerintshwa ra mikateko, enyameni ni le moyeni. Hi pfuleni menyetla ya mintirho, a hi tsarisiwi entirhweni. A swichudeni swa hina swi phasa.
Hi tintswalo ta wena Tatana ndzi kombela u hi nyika vana emicathweni ya hina, Evhangeli, ku lehiselana mbilu, loyi a nga ehenhla A DYONDZE eka loyi a nga ehansi, na loyi a nga ehansi hi ku fanana a dyondza eka loyi a nga ehenhla, leswaku timbilu ta ku hlundzuka hi ku hatlisa ti ta hela!!! Ina, mbilu yi tala ku lahleka!!!'

Hi mina wa n'wina eka Kreste,
S.D. Ndlovu
(Mupostola wa Nkulu)

st.title: TUMELISO EA MOAPOSTOLA HO LIPHUTHEHO TSOHLE LE BAHLANKA BA HAE SELEMONG SA 2023-2024
st.message:
Baratuoa ba Morena Kreste,

E re ke le lumelise hape ka lebitso la Morena oa rona Kreste le Mopholosi oa rona.

E re ke re Litau lia phela, lia re utloa ha re hooa, ha re le mathateng a mesebetsi ea Satane. Li re hlokomela motšeare le bosiu. Bana ba NTATE, ke ikhohomosa ka lona, hobane re ba ea ileng a tlohela botle ba Leholimo, a jara sefapano sa lihlong e le hore rona le libopuoa 'moho le rona re pholosoe.

Selemong sena se shoeleng ke bone re tsamaea hantle kaofela re tšoarane, re mamellana ho se ea iketsetsang tsa hae. Ruri le lipaki, Baratuoa, hore ea iketsetsang o tla utloisoa bohloko ke seo a iketsetsang sona. Ea etsang ho ea ka moetapele o na le bophelo bo sa feleng.

Selemong sena se shoeleng ba bangata ba rona ba bontšitse bots'epehi bo hlollang. Re thabile ha re bona katleho re hopotsoa lithuto tsa khale tsa BAAPOSTOLA tse kang:-
 a) Karolo ea leshome ea nama,
 b) Lula moo u behiloeng teng,
 c) Lerato,
 d) le ho se noe Mekhohlobong
Ntumelleng ho re re ne re lebetse lithuto tsena. Le li amohetse hantle Baratuoa, la etsa liketso. Empa ba bang ba rona ba nka nako e telele ho ithuta ho etsa se setle. Ha re tšoane ho amoheleng ho etsa se setle.

Ho tšoana hantle le thuto ea Lerato eo re ileng ra e hlokomelisoa ha re kena Leholimong lena. Re ithutile mesebetsi ea Lerato, ra fumana khotso meeeng ea rona. Re rutiloe hore boprofeta, maleme le tsebo li ka fela, empa Lerato le ke ke la fela le ka mohla. LERATO LE TLAMEHA HO QALA HAE. Haeba Lerato le le teng lapeng la ka, ke hobane'ng joale u hooa u re 'ha ho na ea lokelang ho thetsa selefounu ea ka!' Na joale re arohane? Empa u boletse pela matšoele hore, lefu feela le tla re arola. Mona re arolana re ntse re phela! Hona u ne u bolela LEFU la mofuta ofe? La nama kapa la moea? Na Moapostola Pauluse o ne a fositse ha a re: Lerato lea mamella!?

Baratuoa, a re itšoareng 'me re bone hore na re ntse re ratana e le kannete na?

Lefatše le batla ho kena Kerekeng! Le botsa hore na Lerato la rona le ile kae. Ruri ba re ba re tseba ka lona. Ba re la rona le fapane le a mang. LONA "LE APESITSOE KA MATLA A MOEA O HALALELANG." Ke tšepa hore Litau li na le 'na thapelong ena. Rea tseba hore sera sa rona ke Satane.

'Re etelle pele Bo-ntate selemong se secha se hlohonolofalitsoeng, nameng le moeeng. Re bulele menyetla ea mesebetsi, a re ngolisoe mosebetsing. A baithuti ba rona ba phase.
Ka mohau oa hau Ntate ke kopa hore u re fe bana manyalong a rona, Evangeli, mamello, a ea kaholimo a ITHUTE ho ea katlase, le ea katlase ka mokhoa o tšoanang a ithute ho ea kaholimo, e le hore lipelo tse halefang kapele li fele!!! Ee, pelo e atisa ho lahleha!!!'

Ea lona ho Kreste,
S.D. Ndlovu
(Moapostola e Moholo)

zu.title: UMBULISO WOMPOSTILE KUWO WONKE AMABANDLA NEZINCEKU ZAKHE KUNYAKA KA 2024-2025
zu.message:
Bathandwa beNkosi uKrestu,

Ngivumeleni ngibulise abantwana baka-Baba ngegama elihle leNkosi yethu uJesu Krestu owasizala kabusha, kungentando yendoda nowesifazane.

Baningi abantu abakuthandayo ukubuliswa ngaloluhlobo. Baphumelelanga. Thina sibe nenhlanhla, kodwa zincane IZIBONGO zethu kulowo owasithenga ngegazi!!

Sesiphinde safika lesosikhathi kwi-Calendar yeBandla lethu, esibhekwe yiwo wonke umntwana kaThixo. Kuvunguza umoya kwabaphilayo nabaleleyo. Babuzana ukuthi: kazi iNkosi izothetha nathi ithini? Izofundisa ithini? isibusise isiyale kukuphi? Phela iNkosi ithi engibathandayo ngiyabasola, ngibayale, ngibaholele endleleni yokulunga.

Ngiyaziqhenya ngeziNgonyama ezahamba phambi kwethu. Zilokhu zisinakekela zisigcina njalo. Kanti neziphilayo aziyekile ukusithandazela.

Mangisho ukuthi kunyaka odlulile, ngibone ekuhambeni kwami ubuThixo obumangalisayo emaBandleni, engingabala inhlonipho, uthando nokuthula. Ngifunde ukuthi uThixo ukupha okucelayo.

Angiphiki ukuthi abanye basabona sengathi kuhle ukubukisa ngamahlazo kubalingani babo. Masingamdumazi uMoya oNgcwele ohlala kithi kuloMbuso kaBaba esawucelayo.

Mthandwa, uke uzibuze ukuthi: ngabe sikuthi ukuba "UMBUSO WAKHO BABA" awufikanga ezimpilweni zethu? Ngisho ngoba uma sewufikile, kwaba khona ushintsho phakathi kwethu:
i) Sezwa intando kaBaba yenzeka kithi - savuma ukungena kwiBandla esasingalifuni
ii) Saphiwa isinkwa sethu semihla ngemihla - sayeka ukuhlephula ngamagama abanye abantu
iii) Sathethelelwa amacala ethu - uMoya oNgcwele wasifundisa ukuxolela abanye: Kusuke sekunjani uma sekuthiwa:- Ha! ababhekani labo, inkukhu nempaka!!
  - Akuphele lokho bantwana bombuso! Nami ngiyanethemba
  - Asifundaneni, sibekezelelane sizwe sikaBaba.

- Ongenhla kafunde abangezansi
- Abangezansi bafunde abangenhla
- Akenisho:- sowashintsha ama-office kuze kube nini...?

Ngicela uBaba wezipho aniphe lezizibusiso ezivela kuziNgonyama:-
a) Aziphele izifo, siphile.
b) Amathuba okuqashwa makavele.
c) Izikhundla eziphezulu zivele emsebenzini wenyama.
d) Imishado emhlophe.
e) Abantwana emshadweni yethu.
f) Abafundi baphase.
g) Makubuse uThando eNkonzweni.
h) UKhisimusi, New Year kanye namaHolide amahle.

Siyabonga.

Yimi owenu ku-Krestu,
S.D. Ndlovu
(President & Chief Apostle)

en.title: APOSTLE'S GREETING TO ALL CONGREGATIONS AND HIS OFFICERS IN THE YEAR 2024-2025
en.message:
Beloved of the Lord Christ,

Allow me to greet the children of the Father in the beautiful name of our Lord Jesus Christ who gave us new birth, not of the will of man and woman.

Many people love to be greeted in this way. They were not successful. We have been fortunate, but our THANKSGIVING is too little to the one who bought us with blood!!

That time has come again in our Church Calendar, looked forward to by every child of God. The spirit blows among the living and the sleeping. They ask each other: I wonder what the Lord will say to us? What will He teach? Where will He bless and advise us? Indeed the Lord says those I love I rebuke, I advise, I lead in the path of righteousness.

I am proud of the Lions who walked before us. They continue to care for us and keep us always. And the living ones have not stopped praying for us.

Let me say that in the past year, I saw in my travels amazing Godliness in the Congregations, among which I can count respect, love and peace. I have learned that God gives you what you ask for.

I do not deny that some still feel it is good to show off disgrace to their peers. Let us not disappoint the Holy Spirit who dwells in us in this Kingdom of the Father we prayed for.

Beloved, have you ever asked yourself: where would we be if "YOUR KINGDOM, FATHER" had not arrived in our lives? I say this because once it arrived, there was a change among us:
i) We felt the Father's will being done in us - we agreed to enter the Church we did not want
ii) We were given our daily bread - we stopped breaking bread using other people's names
iii) We were forgiven our trespasses - the Holy Spirit taught us to forgive others:
How is it then when it is said:- Ha! they don't look at each other, like a chicken and a wildcat!!
  - Let that end children of the kingdom! I too trust you
  - Let us learn from each other, tolerate each other nation of the Father.

- Let the one above learn from the ones below
- Let the ones below learn from the one above
- Tell me:- how long will you keep changing offices...?

I ask the Father of gifts to give you these blessings that come from the Lions:-
a) Let diseases end, that we may live.
b) Let employment opportunities appear.
c) Let top positions appear in the work of the flesh.
d) White weddings.
e) Children in our marriages.
f) Let students pass.
g) Let Love rule in the Church.
h) Christmas, New Year and beautiful Holidays.

Thank you.

Yours in Christ,
S.D. Ndlovu
(President & Chief Apostle)

nso.title: TUMEDIŠO YA MOAPOSTOLA GO DIPHUTHEGO KA MOKA LE BAHLANKA BA GAGWE NGWAGENG WA 2024-2025
nso.message:
Barategi ba Morena Kriste,

Ntumelleleng ke dumediše bana ba Tate ka leina le lebotse la Morena wa rena Jesu Kriste yo a re tswetšego lefsa, e sego ka thato ya monna le mosadi.

Batho ba bantši ba rata go dumedišwa ka tsela ye. Ga se ba atlega. Rena re bile le mahlatse, eupša DITEBOGO tša rena di nyenyane go yola a re rekilego ka madi!!

Nako yeo e fihlile gape Khalendareng ya Kereke ya rena, yeo e lebeletšwego ke ngwana yo mongwe le yo mongwe wa Modimo. Moya o a foka go ba ba phelago le ba ba robetšego. Ba a botšišana ba re: ke ipotšiša gore Morena o tlo re botša eng? O tlo ruta eng? O tlo re šegofatša le go re eletša kae? Ruri Morena o re bao ke ba ratago ke a ba kgalema, ke a ba eletša, ke ba hlahla tseleng ya toko.

Ke ikgantšha ka Ditau tšeo di sepetšego pele ga rena. Di tšwela pele go re hlokomela le go re boloka ka mehla. Gomme le tše di phelago ga se tša tlogela go re rapelela.

E re ke re ngwageng wo o fetilego, ke bone maetong a ka Bomodimo bjo bo makatšago Diphuthegong, gare ga tšeo nka balago tlhompho, lerato le khutšo. Ke ithutile gore Modimo o go fa seo o se kgopelago.

Ga ke latole gore ba bangwe ba sa bona eka go botse go bontšha dihlong go ba mphato wa bona. A re se ke ra nyamiša Moya o Mokgethwa wo o dulago ka go rena Mmušong wo wa Tate wo re o rappeletšego.

Morategi, na o kile wa ipotšiša gore: re be re tlo ba kae ge nkabe "MMUŠO WA GAGO, TATE" o se wa fihla maphelong a rena? Ke bolela se gobane e rile ge o fihla, gwa ba le phetogo gare ga rena:
i) Re kwele thato ya Tate e dirwa ka go rena - re dumetše go tsena Kerekeng yeo re bego re sa e nyake
ii) Re filwe senkgwa sa rena sa letšatši le letšatši - re tlogetše go arolelana senkgwa ka maina a batho ba bangwe
iii) Re swaretšwe melato ya rena - Moya o Mokgethwa o re rutile go lebalela ba bangwe:
Go bjang gona ge go thwe:- Ha! ga ba lebelelana, bjalo ka kgogo le phaga!!
  - A seo se fele bana ba mmušo! Le nna ke a le tshepa
  - A re ithutaneng, re kgotlelelane setšhaba sa Tate.

- Yo a lego godimo a ithute go ba ba lego fase
- Ba ba lego fase ba ithute go yo a lego godimo
- Mpotšeng:- le tlo dula le fetola diofisi go fihla neng...?

Ke kgopela Tate wa dimpho gore a le fe ditšhegofatšo tše tše di tšwago go Ditau:-
a) Malwetši a fele, gore re phele.
b) Menyetla ya mešomo a e tšwelele.
c) Maemo a godimo a tšwelele mošomong wa nama.
d) Manyalo a mašweu.
e) Bana manyalong a rena.
f) A baithuti ba phase.
g) Lerato a le buše Kerekeng.
h) Keresemose, Ngwaga o Moswa le Matšatši a makhutšo a mabotse.

Re a leboga.

Wa lena go Kriste,
S.D. Ndlovu
(Mopresidente le Moapostola yo Mogolo)

xh.title: UMBULISO WOMPOSTILE KUWO ONKE AMABANDLA NEZINCEKU ZAKHE KUNYAKA KA-2024-2025
xh.message:
Bathandekayo beNkosi uKristu,

Ndivumeleni ndibulise abantwana bakaBawo ngegama elihle leNkosi yethu uYesu Kristu owasizala ngokutsha, kungengantando yandoda nankazana.

Baninzi abantu abakuthandayo ukubuliswa ngolu hlobo. Baphuncukana nako. Thina sibe nethamsanqa, kodwa LUNCINCI UBulelo lwethu kulowo wasithenga ngegazi!!

Liphinde lafika elo xesha kwiKhalenda yeCawe yethu, elijongwe ngamabawu nguye wonke umntwana kaThixo. Uvuthuza umoya kwabaphilayo nabaleleyo. Bayabuzana bathi: ingaba iNkosi izakuthi ntoni kuthi? Izakufundisa ntoni? Isikelele isiyale ngaphi? Kaloku iNkosi ithi endibathandayo ndiyabohlwaya, ndiyabayala, ndibakhokelele endleleni yobulungisa.

Ndiyazingca ngeeNgonyama ezahamba phambi kwethu. Zisoloko zisikhathalela zisigcina njalo. Kanti nezisaphilayo aziyekanga ukusithandazela.

Manditsho ukuba kunyaka ophelileyo, ndibone ekuhambeni kwam ubuThixo obumangalisayo emaBandleni, apho ndingabala intlonipho, uthando noxolo. Ndifunde ukuba uThixo ukunika oko ukucelayo.

Andikhanyiki ukuba abanye basabona ngathi kuhle ukubukisa ngamahlazo koogxa babo. Masingamdanisi uMoya oyiNgcwele ohlala kuthi kulo Mbuso kaBawo sawuthandazelayo.

Mthandwa, wakha wazibuza ukuba: ngebesephi ukuba "UMBUSO WAKHO BAWO" awufikanga ebomini bethu? Nditsho kuba uthe wakufika, kwabakho utshintsho phakathi kwethu:
i) Seva intando kaBawo isenzeka kuthi - savuma ukungena kwiCawe esasungayifuni
ii) Sanikwa isonka sethu semihla ngemihla - sayeka ukuqhekeza isonka ngamagama abanye abantu
iii) Saxolelwa iziphoso zethu - uMoya oyiNgcwele wasifundisa ukuxolela abanye:
Kuba njani ke xa kusithiwa:- Ha! abajongani abo, yinkukhu nempaka!!
  - Makuphele oko bantwana bobukumkani! Nam ndiyanithemba
  - Masifundane, sinyamezelane sizwe sikaBawo.

- Ongasentla makafunde kwabangasezantsi
- Abangasezantsi mabafunde kongasentla
- Khawutsho:- niza kutshintsha ii-ofisi kude kube nini...?

Ndicela uBawo wezipho aninike ezi ntsikelelo zivela kwiiNgonyama:-
a) Maziphele izifo, siphile.
b) Amathuba engqesho makavele.
c) Izikhundla eziphezulu mazivele emsebenzini wenyama.
d) Imitshato emhlophe.
e) Abantwana emitshatweni yethu.
f) Abafundi mabaphase.
g) Makulawule uThando eCaweni.
h) IKrisimesi, uNyaka oMtsha kunye neeHolide ezintle.

Siyabulela.

Ndim owakho kuKristu,
S.D. Ndlovu
(UMongameli kunye noMpostile oyiNtloko)

ts.title: XILUMISO XA MUPOSTOLA EKA MAVANDLHA HINKWAWO NA MALANDZA YA YENA EKA LEMBE RA 2024-2025
ts.message:
Varhandziwa ba Hosi Kreste,

Ndzi pfumeleleni ndzi losa vana va Tatana hi vito ro saseka ra Hosi ya hina Yesu Kreste loyi a hi tswaleke ra vumbirhi, ku nga ri hi ku rhandza ka wanuna na wansati.

Vanhu vo tala va rhandza ku losiwa hi ndlela leyi. A va humelelanga. Hina hi vile ni nkateko, kambe KU NKHENSA ka hina i kutsongo eka loyi a hi xaveke hi ngati!!

Ri tlhele ri fika nkarhi wolowo eka Khalendara ya Kereke ya hina, lowu languteriweke hi n'wana un'wana na un'wana wa Xikwembu. Moya wa hunguta eka lava hanyaka na lava etleleke. Va vutisanaka va ku: xana Hosi yi ta ku yini eka hina? Yi ta dyondzisa yini? Yi ta hi katekisa na ku hi tsundzuxa kwihi? Phela Hosi yi ri lava ndzi va rhandzaka ndza va tshinya, ndza va tsundzuxa, ndzi va rhangela endleleni ya vululami.

Ndzi tinyungubyisa hi Tinghala leti fambeke emahlweni ka hina. Ti hambeta ti hi khathalela ni ku hi hlayisa nkarhi hinkwawo. Kasi ni leti hanyaka a ti tshikanga ku hi khongelela.

A ndzi vule leswaku eka lembe leri hundzeke, ndzi vone eku fambeni ka mina vuxikwembu byo hlamarisa eMavandlheni, laha ndzi nga hlayaka xichavo, rirhandzu ni ku rhula. Ndzi dyondzile leswaku Xikwembu xi ku nyika leswi u swi kombelaka.

A ndzi kaneti leswaku van'wana va ha vona onge i swinene ku kombisa tingana eka tintanga ta vona. A hi nga khomisi tingana Moya lowo Kwetsima lowu tshamaka eka hina eMfunghweni lowu wa Tatana lowu hi wu khongeleleke.

Murhandziwa, xana u tshame u tivutisa leswaku: a hi ta va kwihi loko "MFUNGHO WA WENA, TATANA" a wu nga fikanga evuton'wini bya hina? Ndzi vula leswi hikuva loko wu fikile, ku ve ni ku hundzuka exikarhi ka hina:
i) Hi twe ku rhandza ka Tatana ku endleka eka hina - hi pfumerile ku nghena eKerekeni leyi a hi nga yi lavi
ii) Hi nyikiwile xinkwa xa hina xa siku ni siku - hi tshikile ku phema xinkwa hi mavito ya vanhu van'wana
iii) Hi rivaleriwile swidyoho swa hina - Moya lowo Kwetsima wu hi dyondzisile ku rivalela van'wana:
Swi njhani ke loko ku vuriwa leswaku:- Ha! a va langutani valavo, ku fana na huku na mximba!!
  - A swi hele sweswo vana va mfungho! Na mina ndza mi tshemba
  - A hi dyondzaneni, hi lehiselana mbilu tiko ra Tatana.

- Loyi a nga ehenhla a dyondze eka lava nga ehansi
- Lava nga ehansi va dyondze eka loyi a nga ehenhla
- Ndzi byeleni:- mi ta tshamela ku cinca tiofisi ku fika rini...?

Ndzi kombela Tatana wa tinyiko a mi nyika mikateko leyi humaka eka Tinghala:-
a) Mavabyi a ma hele, hi hanya.
b) Menyetla ya mintirho a yi humelele.
c) Swikhundlha swa le henhla a swi humelele entirhweni wa nyama.
d) Micatho yo basa.
e) Vana emicathweni ya hina.
f) A swichudeni swi phasa.
g) Rirhandzu a ri fuma eKerekeni.
h) Khisimusi, Lembe Lerintshwa swin'we ni Tiholide to saseka.

Hi nkhensile.

Hi mina wa n'wina eka Kreste,
S.D. Ndlovu
(Puresidente ni Mupostola wa Nkulu)

st.title: TUMELISO EA MOAPOSTOLA HO LIPHUTHEHO TSOHLE LE BAHLANKA BA HAE SELEMONG SA 2024-2025
st.message:
Baratuoa ba Morena Kreste,

Ntumelleng ho lumelisa bana ba Ntate ka lebitso le letle la Morena oa rona Jesu Kreste ea re tsoetseng bocha, e seng ka thato ea monna le mosali.

Batho ba bangata ba rata ho lumelisoa ka tsela ena. Ha baa ka ba atleha. Rona re bile lehlohonolo, empa TITEBOHO tsa rona li nyane ho ea re rekileng ka mali!!

Nako eo e fihlile hape Khalendareng ea Kereke ea rona, e lebelletsoeng ke ngoana e mong le e mong oa Molimo. Moea oa foka ho ba phelang le ba robetseng. Baa botsana ba re: ebe Morena o tla re'ng ho rona? O tla ruta eng? O tla re hlohonolofatsa le ho re eletsa hokae? Ruri Morena o re bao ke ba ratang kea ba khalemela, kea ba eletsa, ke ba tataisetsa tseleng ea ho loka.

Ke ikhohomosa ka Litau tse tsamaileng pele ho rona. Li tsoela pele ho re hlokomela le ho re boloka kamehla. Mme le tse phelang ha lia tlohela ho re rapella.

E re ke re selemong se fetileng, ke bone maetong a ka Bomolimo bo hlollang Liphuthehong, har'a tseo nka balang tlhompho, lerato le khotso. Ke ithutile hore Molimo o u fa seo u se kopang.

Ha ke latole hore ba bang ba ntse ba bona ho le hotle ho bontša lihlong ho lithaka tsa bona. A re se keng ra soabisa Moea o Halalelang o lulang ho rona 'Musong ona oa Ntate oo re o rapeletseng.

Moratuoa, na u kile oa ipotsa hore: re be re tla ba hokae hoja "MMUSO OA HAU, NTATE" o ne o sa fihla bophelong ba rona? Ke re sena hobane eitse ha o fihla, ha e-ba le phetoho har'a rona:
i) Re utloile thato ea Ntate e etsahala ho rona - re lumetse ho kena Kerekeng eo re neng re sa e batle
ii) Re filoe bohobe ba rona ba letsatsi le letsatsi - re tlohetse ho arolelana bohobe ka mabitso a batho ba bang
iii) Re tšoaretsoe litšito tsa rona - Moea o Halalelang o re rutile ho tšoarela ba bang:
Ho joang he ha ho thoe:- Ha! ha ba shebane bao, joaloka khoho le phaka!!
  - A seo se fele bana ba 'muso! Le 'na kea le tšepa
  - A re ithuteng ho e mong, re mamellane sechaba sa Ntate.

- Ea kaholimo a ithute ho ba katlase
- Ba katlase ba ithute ho ea kaholimo
- Mpolelleng:- le tla lula le fetola liofisi ho fihlela neng...?

Ke kopa Ntate oa limpho a le fe litlhohonolofatso tsena tse tsoang ho Litau:-
a) Maloetse a fele, re phele.
b) Menyetla ea mesebetsi e hlahe.
c) Maemo a phahameng a hlahe mosebetsing oa nama.
d) Manyalo a masoeu.
e) Bana manyalong a rona.
f) Baithuti ba phase.
g) Lerato le buse Kerekeng.
h) Keresemese, Selemo se Secha le Matsatsi a phomolo a matle.

Rea leboha.

Ea lona ho Kreste,
S.D. Ndlovu
(Mopresidente le Moapostola e Moholo)

zu.title: UMBULISO WOMPOSTILE KUWO WONKE AMABANDLA NEZINCEKU ZAKHE KUNYAKA KA 2025-2026
zu.message:
Bathandwa beNkosi uKrestu,

Ngithi mangiphinde nginibulise egameni leNkosi yethu uKrestu noMsindisi wethu. Leligama enibizwa ngalo ukuthi Bathandwa akulona elalapha emhlabeni kodwa lavela kuBaba eseZulwini lakhe ngoba bonke labo abemukela iNdodana baphiwa igama elisha leli nani enibizwa ngalo namhlanje. Ukwamukela nokukholwa kwethu nguLizwi kwasiholela ekutheni siphiwe leligama elisha lokuthi singabantwana bakaThixo abathandiweyo.

Umusa noThando lukaThixo lwafinyeyela kithi sonke ngabanye ngabanye. Kanjani na? Ngokuvuma nokwamukela kwethu uLizwi njengabasendulo, '...Sukani esihlabathini, niye ekujuleni, nifake amanethi enu nibambe....' Yebo balalela izwi kwabonakala imikhumbi yabo icishe izike ngenxa yokugcwala kwezinhlanzi. Yebo, nathi lokho sakubona mhla kufika izithunywa zakhe, ezafika kithina kungentando yazo kepha kaThixo. Lokho futhi kusikhumbuza inkanyezi eyabonakala kubelusi endulo, yagcina ngokubaholela kuye umntwana ozelweyo, uJesu Krestu. Namanje kusenjalo ngaleliVangeli lokuthula noxolo esiphathiswe lona njengoba silapha eNkonzweni.

Yebo, uThixo ngeNdodana yakhe uKrestu, akavumanga ukuthi sibe yizintandane. Yingakho-ke usipha abazali okungabakhokheli bethu ukuze sibe umndeni onokuthula. Ngithi mina kinina asifundane - ongenhla makafunde abangezansi kanjalo nabangezansi bafunde ongenhla.

Kuza kanjani lokho na? Phela uThixo wathumba ababethunjwe uSatane, balandwa ngeVangeli besebugqilini besono, wabe esepha abantwana bakhe izipho zikaMoya ukuze yena uqobo ahlale phakathi kwethu naphakade. Yini isipho? Isipho yinto oyinika umuntu ngoba umthanda. Asikho isipho esivela kuThixo esiqhathaniswa nesinye ngoba zonke kuye zinhle kunjalo nje ziphelelisa umzimba weNkosi emhlabeni kanye naseZulwini ukuze kuthi izizwe ngezizwe, abaphilayo nabalele bonke, bangeniswe kuLombuso kaYise ongunaphakade. INdodana uKrestu yathi lapho ivula umlomo, '...Funani kuqala uMbuso weZulu, nokulunga kukaBaba, kanjalo konke okunye kuyolandela....' Uma sisembusweni kaThixo siyohlala ngokuthula, sithandane, sihloniphane. Akekho oyobona ububi kumfowabo noma kudadewabo.

Ngake ngathi kinina, 'uThando luyimpumputhe ngoba aluboni okwabantu futhi aluzifuneli okwalo kodwa okukaThixo.' Ngisasho futhi ngithi kini, Thandanani ngothando lolu uBaba nani anithande ngalo. UThando aluqale endlini, nibekezelelane bese luphumela ngaphandle. Nibe nokuthula, nokuzithoba, nihloniphe nabaKhokheli benu. Phela loluThando engikhuluma ngalo lwembathiswe amandla kaMoya Ongcwele. Yingakho izwi lithi, emva kokuphiwa isipho sikaMoya ONgcwele, amandla eBandla lokuqala - '...BAHLANGANYELA NJALO EZINTWENI ZONKE. BAHLEPHULA ISINKWA. LOKHO KWABA YINDLELA YOKUKHULEKA....'

Ngiyaziqhenya ngeziNgonyama ezahamba phambi kwethu. Kuyiqiniso ukuthi zilokhu zisinakekela, zisikhusele njalo, aziphezi! Kanti futhi nalezi eziphilayo, aziyekile ukusinakekela njalo. Yeka, uThando noMusa ongaka! Ngiqinisile, ngiqinisile, ngithi lomuzi kaThixo uyokuma naphakade!

Pho, uma uThixo engakithina, singayakukphi na? Nasendulo iziNgonyama zasho njalo kuyona iNdodana, uJesu Krestu, uma ebuza ukuthi zisehlaleleleni naye na? Impendulo yathi:- '...Uma uNkulunkulu ethathe ukuphila kwethu wakubeka kuwe Nkosi, singaya kuphi na?' Uthi kubona, nami-ke ngithi kini, anikhethwanga yimina kodwa uBaba oseZulwini! Ngakho-ke hlalani kimi, nami ngiyakuhlala kuBaba naleziNgonyama zikaBaba.

Abantu balinde izindaba zeVangeli laloMbuso weZulu. UThixo asisize sonke sikhuthalele iVangeli lovuko labalele. Bonke abalele bavuke badumise AMANDLA ENGONYAMA. Phela yona yasithenga ngegazi layo!!

Nikhumbule ukuthi imiqophiso emine (Size-4) ayizange ifike nabalandeli bakaKrestu, kepha yafika neNdodana uqobo ithunywe nguYise ukugoqa imithetho eyishumi kaMose yabe isisinika lemiqophiso emine:-
1) Izishumi zenyama,
2) Hlala lapho ubekwe khona, uphume iVangeli, uphangisise ngeSikhathi
3) uThando,
4) nokungaphuzi kumaXhaphozi.

Ngisaphinda ngithi kini, ngicela uBaba wezipho aniphe lezizibusiso ezivela kuziNgonyama:-
- Aziphele izifo, siphile.
- Amathuba okuqashwa makuvele.
- Izikhundla eziphezulu zivele emsebenzini wenyama.
- Nithole imishado emhlophe.
- Nibe nabantwana emshadweni yethu.
- Abafundi baphase ezikoleni, kumaKolishi nakumaNyuvesi.
- Makubuse uThando eNkonzweni.
- UKhisimusi, New Year kanye namaHolide amahle.

Siyabonga.
Yimi owenu ku-Krestu,
S.D. Ndlovu
(President & Chief Apostle)

en.title: APOSTLE'S GREETING TO ALL CONGREGATIONS AND HIS OFFICERS IN THE YEAR 2025-2026
en.message:
Beloved of the Lord Christ,

Let me greet you again in the name of our Lord Christ and our Saviour. This name 'Beloved' by which you are called is not of this earth but came from the Father in His Heaven because all those who receive the Son were given this new name by which you are called today. Our accepting and believing in the Word led us to be given this new name that we are the beloved children of God.

The Grace and Love of God reached all of us individually. How? By our agreeing and accepting the Word like those of old, '...Leave the sand, go into the deep, and let down your nets....' Yes they obeyed the word and their boats were seen almost sinking due to the fullness of fish. Yes, we too saw that the day His messengers arrived, who came to us not of their own will but of God's. That also reminds us of the star that was seen by the shepherds in ancient times, and ended up leading them to the newborn child, Jesus Christ. And it is still like that with this Gospel of peace which we have been entrusted with as we are here in the Church.

Yes, God through His Son Christ, did not allow us to be orphans. That is why He gives us parents who are our leaders so that we can be a peaceful family. I say to you let us learn from each other - let the one above learn from those below and likewise those below learn from the one above.

How does that come about? Indeed God captured those who had been captured by Satan, they were fetched by the Gospel while in the slavery of sin, and He then gave His children spiritual gifts so that He Himself could dwell among us forever. What is a gift? A gift is something you give a person because you love them. There is no gift from God that is compared to another because all are beautiful to Him and just like that they complete the body of the Lord on earth and in Heaven so that all nations, the living and all the sleeping, may be brought into this eternal Kingdom of His Father. The Son Christ said when He opened His mouth, '...Seek first the Kingdom of Heaven, and the righteousness of the Father, and all other things will follow....' If we are in the kingdom of God we will live in peace, love each other, respect each other. No one will see evil in his brother or sister.

I once said to you, 'Love is blind because it does not see the things of people and it does not seek its own but God's.' I still say to you again, Love one another with this love that the Father has loved you with. Love must start at home, be patient with each other and then it goes outside. Have peace, and humility, and respect your Leaders. Indeed this Love I am talking about is clothed with the power of the Holy Spirit. That is why the word says, after being given the gift of the Holy Spirit, the power of the first Church - '...THEY CONTINUED STEADFASTLY IN ALL THINGS. THEY BROKE BREAD. THAT BECAME THE WAY OF PRAYER....'

I am proud of the Lions who walked before us. It is true that they continue to care for us, protect us always, they do not stop! And also these living ones, have not stopped caring for us always. Oh, what Love and Grace! Truly, truly, I say this house of God will stand forever!

Well, if God is for us, where could we go? Even in ancient times the Lions said so to the Son Himself, Jesus Christ, when He asked why they were still staying with Him? The answer was:- '...If God has taken our lives and placed them in you Lord, where can we go?' He says to them, and I say to you, you were not chosen by me but the Father in Heaven! Therefore stay in me, and I will stay in the Father and these Lions of the Father.

People are waiting for the news of the Gospel of this Kingdom of Heaven. May God help us all to be diligent for the Gospel of the resurrection of the sleeping. Let all the sleeping awake and praise the POWER OF THE LION. For He bought us with His blood!!

Remember that the four pledges (Size-4) did not arrive with the followers of Christ, but arrived with the Son Himself sent by His Father to wrap up the ten commandments of Moses and He then gave us these four pledges:-
1) Tithes of the flesh,
2) Stay where you are placed, go out with the Gospel, hurry on Time
3) Love,
4) and not drinking from the Swamps.

I say to you again, I ask the Father of gifts to give you these blessings that come from the Lions:-
- Let diseases end, that we may live.
- Let employment opportunities appear.
- Let top positions appear in the work of the flesh.
- May you get white weddings.
- May you have children in our marriages.
- Let students pass in schools, Colleges and Universities.
- Let Love rule in the Church.
- Christmas, New Year and beautiful Holidays.

Thank you.
Yours in Christ,
S.D. Ndlovu
(President & Chief Apostle)

nso.title: TUMEDIŠO YA MOAPOSTOLA GO DIPHUTHEGO KA MOKA LE BAHLANKA BA GAGWE NGWAGENG WA 2025-2026
nso.message:
Barategi ba Morena Kriste,

E re ke le dumediše gape ka leina la Morena wa rena Kriste le Mophološi wa rena. Leina le le bitšwago Barategi ga se la mo lefaseng eupša le tšwa go Tate Legodimong la Gagwe gobane bohle ba ba amogelago Morwa ba filwe leina le le lefsa leo le bitšwago ka lona lehono. Go amogela le go dumela ga rena Lentšung go re gogetše gore re fiwe leina le le lefsa la gore re bana ba Modimo ba ba rategago.

Mogau le Lerato la Modimo di fihlile go rena ka moka ka o tee ka o tee. Bjang? Ka go dumela le go amogela ga rena Lentšu bjalo ka ba kgaleng, '...Tlogang lešabašabeng, le ye bodibeng, le iše dikgweba tša lena fase....' Ee ba kwile lentšu gwa bonagala dikepe tša bona di nyaka go nwelela ka baka la go tlala ga dihlapi. Ee, le rena re bone seo mohla barongwa ba gagwe ba fihla, bao ba tlilego go rena e sego ka thato ya bona eupša ya Modimo. Seo gape se re gopotša naledi yeo e bonwego ke badiši kgaleng, gomme ya feleletša e ba gogela go ngwana yo a tswetšwego, Jesu Kriste. Le ga bjale go sa le bjalo ka Ebangedi ye ya khutšo yeo re e filwego bjalo ka ge re le mo Kerekeng.

Ee, Modimo ka Morwa wa gagwe Kriste, ga se a dumela gore re be ditšhiwana. Ke ka baka leo a re fago batswadi e lego baetapele ba rena gore re be lapa la khutšo. Ke re go lena a re ithutaneng - yo a lego godimo a ithute go ba ba lego fase gomme le ba ba lego fase ba ithute go yo a lego godimo.

Seo se tla bjang? Ruri Modimo o thopile bao ba bego ba thopilwe ke Sathane, ba latwa ke Ebangedi ba le bokgobeng bja sebe, gomme a fa bana ba gagwe dimpho tša Moya gore yena ka noši a dule gare ga rena go ya go ile. Mpho ke eng? Mpho ke selo seo o se fago motho gobane o mo rata. Ga go na mpho e tšwago go Modimo yeo e bapišwago le e nngwe gobane ka moka go yena di botse ebile di feleletša mmele wa Morena lefaseng gotee le Legodimong gore ditšhaba ka ditšhaba, ba ba phelago le ba ba robetšego ka moka, ba tsenywe Mmušong wo wa Tatagwe wo o sa felego. Morwa Kriste o rile ge a bula molomo, '...Nyakang pele Mmušo wa Legodimo, le toko ya Tate, gomme tše dingwe ka moka di tla latela....' Ge re le mmušong wa Modimo re tla dula ka khutšo, ra ratana, ra hlomphana. Ga go na yo a tlogo bona bobe go ngwanabo goba kgaetšedi ya gagwe.

Ke kile ka re go lena, 'Lerato le foufetše gobane ga le bone tša batho gape ga le inyakele tša lona eupša tša Modimo.' Ke sa re gape go lena, Ratanang ka lerato le Tate a le ratilego ka lona. Lerato a le thome ka gae, le kgotlelelane gomme le tšwele ka ntle. Ebang le khutšo, le boikokobetšo, le hlomphe le Baetapele ba lena. Ruri Lerato le ke bolelago ka lona le apere maatla a Moya o Mokgethwa. Ke ka baka leo lentšu le rego, ka morago ga go fiwa mpho ya Moya o Mokgethwa, maatla a Kereke ya mathomo - '...BA ILE BA TŠWELA PELE DILONG KA MOKA. BA AROLELANA SENKGWA. SEO YA BA TSELA YA THAPELO....'

Ke ikgantšha ka Ditau tšeo di sepetšego pele ga rena. Ke nnete gore di tšwela pele go re hlokomela, di re šireletša ka mehla, ga di kgaotše! Gape le tše di phelago, ga se tša tlogela go re hlokomela ka mehla. Ijoo, Lerato le Mogau o mokaka! Ruri, ruri, ke re ntlo ye ya Modimo e tla ema go ya go ile!

Naa, ge Modimo a le nathi, re ka ya kae? Le kgaleng Ditau di boletše bjalo go yena Morwa, Jesu Kriste, ge a botšiša gore ke ka baka la eng ba sa dutše le yena? Karabo e bile:- '...Ge Modimo a tšere maphelo a rena a a bea go wena Morena, re ka ya kae?' O re go bona, le nna ke re go lena, ga se la kgethwa ke nna eupša Tate wa Legodimong! Ka gona dulang go nna, le nna ke tla dula go Tate le Ditau tše tša Tate.

Batho ba emetše ditaba tša Ebangedi ya Mmušo wo wa Legodimo. Modimo a re thuše ka moka go ba mafolofolo Ebangeding ya tsogo ya ba ba robetšego. Bohle ba ba robetšego a ba tsoge ba tumiše MAATLA A TAU. Gobane o re rekile ka madi a gagwe!!

Gopolang gore dikeno tše nne (Size-4) ga se tša fihla le balatedi ba Kriste, eupša di fihlile le Morwa ka noši a romilwe ke Tatagwe go phutha melao e lesome ya Moše gomme a re fa dikeno tše tše nne:-
1) Dikarolo tša lesome tša nama,
2) Dula mo o beilwego gona, o tšwe le Ebangedi, o akgofe ka Nako
3) Lerato,
4) le go se nwe Mekgobeng.

Ke sa boeletša gape go lena, ke kgopela Tate wa dimpho gore a le fe ditšhegofatšo tše di tšwago go Ditau:-
- Malwetši a fele, re phele.
- Menyetla ya mešomo a e tšwelele.
- Maemo a godimo a tšwelele mošomong wa nama.
- Le hwetše manyalo a mašweu.
- Le be le bana manyalong a rena.
- Baithuti ba phase dikolong, Dikhåletšheng le Diyunibesithing.
- Lerato a le buše Kerekeng.
- Keresemose, Ngwaga o Moswa le Matšatši a makhutšo a mabotse.

Re a leboga.
Wa lena go Kriste,
S.D. Ndlovu
(Mopresidente le Moapostola yo Mogolo)

xh.title: UMBULISO WOMPOSTILE KUWO ONKE AMABANDLA NEZINCEKU ZAKHE KUNYAKA KA-2025-2026
xh.message:
Bathandekayo beNkosi uKristu,

Mandiphinde ndinibulise egameni leNkosi yethu uKristu noMsindisi wethu. Eli gama nibizwa ngalo lokuba niBathandwa asilulo elalapha emhlabeni kodwa lavela kuBawo eZulwini lakhe kuba bonke abo bamkela uNyana bapiwa igama elitsha eli nibizwa ngalo namhlanje. Ukwamkela nokukholwa kwethu kwiLizwi kwasikhokelela ekubeni sinikwe eli gama elitsha lokuba singabantwana bakaThixo abathandekayo.

Ubabalo noThando lukaThixo lwafikelela kuthi sonke ngabanye. Njani? Ngokuvuma nokwamkela kwethu iLizwi njengabasendulo, '...Sukani esantiyeni, niye enzulwini, nifake iminatha yenu nibambe....' Ewe balithobela ilizwi kwabonakala amaphenyane abo ephantse ukutshona ngenxa yokugcwala kweentlanzi. Ewe, nathi oko sakubona mhla kwafika izithunywa zakhe, ezafika kuthi kungengantando yazo kodwa ekaThixo. Oko kwakhona kusikhumbuza inkwenkwezi eyabonakala kubalusi endulo, yagqibela ngokubakhokelela kumntwana ozelweyo, uYesu Kristu. Nanamhlanje kusenjalo ngale Vangeli yoxolo esiyiphathisiweyo njengoko silapha eCaweni.

Ewe, uThixo ngoNyana wakhe uKristu, akazange avume ukuba sibe ziinkedama. Kungoko esinika abazali abaziinkokeli zethu ukuze sibe lusapho olunoxolo. Ndithi mna kuni masifundane - ongasentla makafunde kwabangasezantsi ngokunjalo nabangasezantsi bafunde kongasentla.

Kuza njani oko? Kaloku uThixo wathimba abo babethinjwe nguSathana, balandwa ngeVangeli besebukhobokeni besono, waze wapha abantwana bakhe izipho zoMoya ukuze yena buqu ahlale phakathi kwethu ngonaphakade. Yintoni isipho? Isipho yinto oyinika umntu kuba umthanda. Akukho sipho sivela kuThixo esithelekiswa nesinye kuba zonke kuye zintle kwaye zizalisekisa umzimba weNkosi emhlabeni naseZulwini ukuze izizwe ngezizwe, abaphilayo nabaleleyo bonke, bangeniswe kuBukumkani bakaYise obungunaphakade. UNyana uKristu wathi xa evula umlomo, '...Funani kuqala uBukumkani beZulu, nobulungisa bakaBawo, zaye zonke ezinye izinto ziya kulandela....' Ukuba sikubukumkani bakaThixo siya kuhlala ngoxolo, sithandane, sihloniphane. Akukho uya kubona ububi kumzalwana okanye kudadewabo.

Ndekha ndathi kuni, 'Uthando luyimfama kuba aluboni okwabantu kwaye aluzifuneli okwalo kodwa okukaThixo.' Ndisatsho kwakhona ndithi kuni, Thandanani ngolu thando uBawo anithande ngalo. UThando maluqale ekhaya, ninyamezelane luze luphumele ngaphandle. Yibani noxolo, nokuzithoba, nihloniphe neziNkokeli zenu. Kaloku olu Thando ndithetha ngalo lwambathiswe amandla kaMoya oyiNgcwele. Kungoko ilizwi lisithi, emva kokunikwa isipho soMoya oyiNgcwele, amandla eCawe yokuqala - '...BAQhubeka BEZINIKILEYO EZINTWENI ZONKE. BAQHEKEZA ISONKA. OKO KWABA YINDLELA YOKUTHANDAZA....'

Ndiyazingca ngeeNgonyama ezahamba phambi kwethu. Kuyinyaniso ukuba zisoloko zisikhathalela, zisikhusela njalo, aZiyeki! Kanti ke nezi ziphilayo, aZiyekanga ukusikhathalela njalo. Hayi, uThando noBabalo olungaka! Inene, inene, ndithi le ndlu kaThixo iya kuma ngonaphakade!

Xa uThixo engakuthi, singaya phi na? Nasendulo iiNgonyama zatsho njalo kuye uNyana, uYesu Kristu, xa ebuza ukuba zihlelele ntoni naye na? Impendulo yathi:- '...Ukuba uThixo uthathe ubomi bethu wabubeka kuwe Nkosi, singaya phi na?' Uthi kuzo, nam ke ndithi kuni, anikhethwanga ndim kodwa nguBawo oseZulwini! Ngoko ke hlalani kum, nam ndiya kuhlala kuBawo nalezi Ngonyama zikaBawo.

Abantu balinde iindaba zeVangeli yobuBukumkani beZulu. UThixo masincede sonke sikhuthalele iVangeli yovuko lwabaleleyo. Bonke abaleleyo mabavuke badumise AMANDLA ENGONYAMA. Kuba yona yasithenga ngegazi layo!!

Nikhumbule ukuba izibophelelo ezine (Size-4) azizange zifike nabalandeli bakaKristu, kodwa zafika noNyana buqu ethunywe nguYise ukusonga imithetho elishumi kaMoses waze wasinika ezi zibophelelo zine:-
1) Izishumi zenyama,
2) Hlala apho ubekwe khona, uphume neVangeli, ukhawuleze ngeXesha
3) UThando,
4) nokungaseli kumaXhaphozi.

Ndisaphinda ndithi kuni, ndicela uBawo wezipho aninike ezi ntsikelelo zivela kwiiNgonyama:-
- Maziphele izifo, siphile.
- Amathuba engqesho makavele.
- Izikhundla eziphezulu mazivele emsebenzini wenyama.
- Nifumane imitshato emhlophe.
- Nibe nabantwana emitshatweni yethu.
- Abafundi mabaphase ezikolweni, kwiiKholeji nakwiiDyunivesithi.
- Makulawule uThando eCaweni.
- IKrisimesi, uNyaka oMtsha kunye neeHolide ezintle.

Siyabulela.
Ndim owakho kuKristu,
S.D. Ndlovu
(UMongameli kunye noMpostile oyiNtloko)

ts.title: XILUMISO XA MUPOSTOLA EKA MAVANDLHA HINKWAWO NA MALANDZA YA YENA EKA LEMBE RA 2025-2026
ts.message:
Varhandziwa ba Hosi Kreste,

A ndzi mi lose nakambe hi vito ra Hosi ya hina Kreste ni Muponisi wa hina. Vito leri mi vitaniwaka hi rona ra Varhandziwa a hi ra laha misaveni kambe ri hume eka Tatana eTilweni ra Yena hikuva hinkwavo lava amukelaka N'wana va nyikiwile vito lerintshwa leri mi vitaniwaka hi rona namuntlha. Ku amukela ni ku kholwa ka hina eRitweni swi hi fambisile leswaku hi nyikiwa vito leri lerintshwa ra leswaku hi vana va Xikwembu lava rhandzekaka.

Tintswalo ni Rirhandzu ra Xikwembu ri fike eka hina hinkwerhu hi un'we un'we. Njhani ke? Hi ku pfumela ni ku amukela ka hina Rito tanihi lava khale, '...Sukani esaveni, mi ya entiweni, mi hoxa mineti ya n'wina mi phasa....' Ina va yingisile rito kutani ku voniwa mabyatso ya vona ya lava ku mbombomela hikwalaho ko tala hi tinhlampfi. Ina, na hina sweswo hi swi vonile siku ku fikaka varhumiwa va yena, lava teke eka hina ku nga ri hi ku rhandza ka vona kambe ka Xikwembu. Sweswo nakambe swi hi tsundzuxa nyeleti leyi voniweke hi varisi ekhale, yi hetelela hi ku va rhangela eka n'wana la tswariweke, Yesu Kreste. Na sweswi ka ha ri tano hi Evhangeli leyi ya ku rhula leyi hi nyikiweke yona tanihi leswi hi nga laha Kerekeni.

Ina, Xikwembu hi N'wana wa xona Kreste, a xi pfumelanga leswaku hi va swisiwana. Hi yona mhaka xi hi nyikaka vatswari lava nga varhangeri va hina leswaku hi va ndyangu lowu nga ni ku rhula. Ndzi ri eka n'wina a hi dyondzaneni - loyi a nga ehenhla a a dyondze eka lava nga ehansi hilaha ku fanaka lava nga ehansi va dyondza eka loyi a nga ehenhla.

Sweswo swi ta njhani ke? Phela Xikwembu xi khomile lava a va khomiwe hi Sathana, va landziwa hi Evhangeli va ha ri evuhlongeni bya xidyoho, xi tlhela xi nyika vana va xona tinyiko ta Moya leswaku xona hi xoxe xi tshama exikarhi ka hina hilaha ku nga heriki. Nyiko i yini? Nyiko i nchumu lowu u wu nyikaka munhu hikuva u n'wi rhandza. A ku na nyiko leyi humaka eka Xikwembu leyi ringanisiwaka ni yin'wana hikuva hinkwato eka xona ti sasekile ti tlhela ti hetisekisa miri wa Hosi emisaveni swin'we ni le Tilweni leswaku matiko hi matiko, lava hanyaka ni lava etleleke hinkwavo, va nghenisiwa eMfunghweni lowu wa Tata wa Yena lowu nga heriki. N'wana Kreste u te loko a pfula nomu, '...Lavanteni ku sungula Mfungho wa Tilo, ni vululami bya Tatana, kutani swilo leswin'wana hinkwaswo swi ta landzela....' Loko hi ri emfunghweni wa Xikwembu hi ta tshama hi ku rhula, hi rhandzana, hi hloniphana. A ku na loyi a nga ta vona vubihi eka makwavo wa xinuna kumbe wa xisati.

Ndzi tshame ndzi ku eka n'wina, 'Rirhandzu ri fe matihlo hikuva a ri voni swa vanhu naswona a ri tilaveli swa rona kambe swa Xikwembu.' Ndza ha vula nakambe ndzi ku eka n'wina, Rhandzanani hi rirhandzu leri Tatana a mi rhandzeke ha rona. Rirhandzu a ri sungule ekaya, mi lehiselana mbilu kutani ri humela ehandle. Vanani ni ku rhula, ni ku titsongahata, mi hlonipha ni Varhangeri va n'wina. Phela Rirhandzu leri ndzi vulavulaka hi rona ri ambexiwe matimba ya Moya lowo Kwetsima. Hi yona mhaka rito ri ku, endzhaku ko nyikiwa nyiko ya Moya wo Kwetsima, matimba ya Kereke yo sungula - '...VA YE EMAHLWENI VA TINYIKETELA ESWILWENI HINKWASWO. VA PHEMA XINKWA. SWESWO SWI VE NDLELA YO KHONGELA....'

Ndzi tinyungubyisa hi Tinghala leti fambeke emahlweni ka hina. I ntiyiso leswaku ti hambeta ti hi khathalela, ti hi sirhelela nkarhi hinkwawo, a ti rhuteli! Kasi nakambe leti hanyaka, a ti tshikanga ku hi khathalela nkarhi hinkwawo. Mawaku, Rirhandzu ni Tintswalo to fika laha! Hakunene, hakunene, ndzi ri yindlu leyi ya Xikwembu yi ta yima hilaha ku nga heriki!

Kutani, loko Xikwembu xi ri na hina, hi nga ya kwihi ke? Na le khale Tinghala ti vule tano eka yena N'wana, Yesu Kreste, loko a vutisa leswaku hikwalaho ka yini va ha tshamile na yena? Nhlamulo yi te:- '...Loko Xikwembu xi tekile vutomi bya hina xi byi veka eka wena Hosi, hi nga ya kwihi?' U ri eka vona, na mina ndzi ri eka n'wina, a mi hlawuriwanga hi mina kambe Tatana wa le Tilweni! Hikokwalaho tshamani eka mina, na mina ndzi ta tshama eka Tatana ni Tinghala leti ta Tatana.

Vanhu va rindzele mahungu ya Evhangeli ya Mfungho lowu wa Tilo. Xikwembu a xi hi pfune hinkwerhu hi hisekela Evhangeli ya ku pfuka ka lava etleleke. Hinkwavo lava etleleke a va pfuke va dzunisa MATIMBA YA NGHALA. Hikuva yi hi xavile hi ngati ya yona!!

Tsundzukani leswaku switshembiso swa mune (Size-4) a swi zanganga swi fika ni valandzeri va Kreste, kambe swi fikile ni N'wana hi yexe a rhumiwe hi Tata wa yena ku pfunya milawu ya khume ya Muxe kutani a hi nyika switshembiso leswi swa mune:-
1) Vukhume bya nyama,
2) Tshama laha u vekiweke kona, u huma ni Evhangeli, u hatlisa hi Nkarhi
3) Rirhandzu,
4) ni ku nga nwi eMidzobeni.

Ndza ha tlhela ndzi vula eka n'wina, ndzi kombela Tatana wa tinyiko a mi nyika mikateko leyi humaka eka Tinghala:-
- Mavabyi a ma hele, hi hanya.
- Menyetla ya mintirho a yi humelele.
- Swikhundlha swa le henhla a swi humelele entirhweni wa nyama.
- Mi kuma micatho yo basa.
- Mi va ni vana emicathweni ya hina.
- Swichudeni swi phasa eswikolweni, eTikholiji ni le Tiyunivhesithi.
- Rirhandzu a ri fuma eKerekeni.
- Khisimusi, Lembe Lerintshwa swin'we ni Tiholide to saseka.

Hi nkhensile.
Hi mina wa n'wina eka Kreste,
S.D. Ndlovu
(Puresidente ni Mupostola wa Nkulu)

st.title: TUMELISO EA MOAPOSTOLA HO LIPHUTHEHO TSOHLE LE BAHLANKA BA HAE SELEMONG SA 2025-2026
st.message:
Baratuoa ba Morena Kreste,

E re ke le lumelise hape ka lebitso la Morena oa rona Kreste le Mopholosi oa rona. Lebitso lena la Baratuoa leo le bitsoang ka lona hase la mona lefatšeng empa le tsoa ho Ntate Leholimong la Hae hobane bohle ba amohelang Mora ba filoe lebitso lena le lecha leo le bitsoang ka lona kajeno. Ho amohela le ho lumela ha rona ho Lentsoe ho re lebisitse ho hore re fuoe lebitso lena le lecha la hore re bana ba Molimo ba ratehang.

Mohau le Lerato la Molimo li fihlile ho rona bohle ka bomong. Joang?
